title: 3D-Anlagenplaner/ Projektzeichner (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Die Eggersmann Anlagenbau Concept GmbH ist einer der führenden Hersteller im Anlagen- und Sondermaschinenbau für die Abfallwirtschaft. Das Unternehmen ist Teil der Eggersmann Gruppe, eines Verbundes international tätiger Unternehmen in den Bereichen Bauwesen und Recyclingtechnologie. Die Gruppe beschäftigt weltweit mehr als 1000 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter.

Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir für unseren Standort in Bad Oeynhausen einen 3D-Anlagenplaner/ Projektzeichner (m/w/d) in Vollzeit.

Aufgaben

  • Sie entwerfen eigenständig 3D-Aufstellungslayouts unserer Recyclinganlagen in der Angebots- und Projektierungsphase
  • Daraus einhergehend erstellen sie 2D-Ableitungszeichnungen und Verfahrensfließbilder
  • Sie planen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Konstruktion und Projekleitung alle Einzelmaschinen, Stahlbauten und Begehungen für das Projekt ein
  • Sie bilden die Schnittstelle zum Bauteil und stimmen sich regelmäßig während der Projektphase ab

Qualifikation

  • Sie haben eine erfolgreich abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung zum Technischen Produktdesigner, zum Maschinenbautechniker oder eine vergleichbare Berufsausbildung
  • Sie bringen idealerweise Erfahrungen im Umgang mit 3D-CAD Programmen mit
  • Sie zeichnen sich durch eine selbstständige und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise aus und mögen es in einem kleinen Projektteam zu arbeiten
  • Sie bringen ein technsichen Verständins und Interesse am Anlagenbau mit

Benefits

Bei uns leisten Sie einen relevanten Beitrag zum nachhaltigen Klimaschutz und helfen Anlagen im Bereich der Abfallaufbereitung oder Biogaserzeugung zu planen. Wir bieten Ihnen einen zukunftssicheren und sinnstiftenden Arbeitsplatz in einem Familienbetrieb mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einer Möglichkeit Ihren eigenen Fingerabdruck zu hinterlassen.

  • Familiäres Team mit flachen Hierarchien
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag
  • Attraktive Vergütung
  • Die Möglichkeit ein JobRad zu leasen
  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Fundierte Einarbeitung
  • Mehrere Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
  • Auf Wunsch unterstützen wir Sie bei der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge

Wenn wir Ihr Interesse geweckt haben, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung (Lebenslauf und Zeugnisse). Ein Anschreiben ist nicht notwendig.

title: Account Director, Influencer Marketing
descriptionHtml:
At Viral Nation, we specialize in building social-first ecosystems for brands to connect with the modern consumer journey. Our integrated solutions align strategy, talent, media, and technology with culturally relevant creativity to scale the world’s fastest-growing digital brands. Viral Nation offers a fluid, creative, and growth-oriented environment that will support your ambitions to apply your talents in an open, collaborative, and fast-paced culture. Our ability to stay at the forefront of the industry has fuelled our success and will guide us in paving the path forward. We’re driven to push boundaries and think beyond today to deliver strategies, and we’re just getting started.

While we continuously exceed our goals, we need your help – our success is only as great as our people. Strong performance leads to high expectations, and we must keep raising the bar!

Position Overview:

Viral Nation is seeking a dedicated Account Director with a robust mix of influencer marketing, social media, analytics, content marketing experience. By nature, they are a confident, courageous and strategic leader who excels in building bulletproof relationships with both their clients and their internal team. They are known to bring value to every conversation, provide consultative direction to their clients, and know when and how to challenge the status quo within our ever-changing industry. 

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the day-to-day primary point of contact for key clients, owning strategic relationships and ensuring consistent alignment to goals, KPIs, and performance expectations.
  • Identify, develop, and surface growth and expansion opportunities across accounts, partnering with CSLs and internal teams to drive revenue and long-term client value.
  • Lead strategic planning, quarterly business reviews, success measurement, and account vision-setting, ensuring narratives are insight-driven, performance-focused, and tied to client impact.
  • Oversee end-to-end campaign execution across influencer, community management, production, paid social, and events, ensuring flawless delivery across all products and services.
  • Lead and oversee creator communications for Macro & Mega tiers, ensuring white-glove talent management, clear expectations, and strong partnership execution.
  • Manage campaign pacing, KPIs, optimization efforts, and overall program success to consistently meet or exceed performance benchmarks.
  • Drive elevated brand storytelling, creative ideation, insights, and analytics, pushing teams to deliver innovative, differentiated work across a client portfolio.
  • Lead the BI partnership kickoff for all key accounts, aligning on measurement frameworks, KPIs, reporting timelines, and success metrics in collaboration with the CSL.
  • Own the wrap-report workflow, coordinating with BI, reviewing all reports for accuracy and strategic alignment, and ensuring insights are clearly communicated to clients.
  • Provide leadership, guidance and escalation support to Account Supervisors and Account Managers, fostering accountability and growth.
  • Coach and develop direct reports by providing regular feedback, training, and guidance, fostering a collaborative team culture that drives strong performance, career growth, and high-quality client delivery.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Creative, Finance, and BI to deliver integrated, scalable solutions for clients.
  • Act as the internal advocate for the client’s POV, ensuring their needs, priorities, and feedback are clearly represented across teams while balancing those inputs with what’s required to deliver successful, high-performing campaigns.
  • Maintain accurate Kantata project data, ensuring budgets, resourcing, timelines, and tasks are consistently reviewed and optimized.
  • Identify and implement AI-driven efficiencies across planning, forecasting, and client-facing materials to improve speed, quality, and scalability.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • 6+ years of experience in digital, social, and influencer marketing across integrated service offerings, managing multiple client portfolios with strong business outcomes.
  • Proven expertise in strategic planning, business insights, and performance measurement, using data to guide client recommendations, forecasting, and account growth.
  • Advanced knowledge of influencer marketing and production strategy, including paid and organic tactics, contract negotiations, content development, and campaign measurement.
  • Strong ability to lead high-level client relationships, ensuring alignment to goals, long-term partnership success, and consistent delivery.
  • Demonstrated success in revenue growth and account expansion through strategic recommendations and opportunity identification.
  • Effective people leader with experience coaching and developing teams to meet client expectations and performance standards.
  • Exceptional project management and cross-functional collaboration skills, partnering with planning, creative, production, and media teams to drive results.
  • Expert grasp of social platforms, amplification strategies, and cross-channel integration.
  • Proficient with influencer management tools (e.g., CreatorIQ, Klear, Tagger, Upfluence), social management platforms (Sprout, Sprinklr, Hootsuite), CRM tools (HubSpot), and presentation software (MS Office, Google Workspace).
  • Familiarity with creative tools (Photoshop, Canva, motion graphics) and relevant certifications (Facebook Blueprint, Twitter Flight School, Google Analytics) are a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience will also be considered.

Privacy Policy: By submitting your application, you acknowledge your data will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

Compensation Philosophy:
At Viral Nation, compensation is structured, performance-led, and market-aligned. Pay decisions are intentional, based on role requirements, performance, and market alignment by country, and are set to maintain internal pay equity across comparable roles and levels.
Compensation progression is tied to demonstrated performance, expanded scope, and sustained contribution over time, not tenure alone. Employee compensation is reviewed regularly through formal performance reviews and check-ins to ensure alignment with role expectations and impact.   AI in Recruitment:   Viral Nation does not use AI-enabled tools to screen, assess, rank, or select candidates – our hiring teams make all hiring decisions. AI note-taking tools may be used during interviews.

DEI Commitment:

Viral Nation is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in our agency. Viral Nation welcomes applications from people with visible and non-visible disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruiting and selection process.

title: Account Executive Cabinets (Axe Paris - Lyon)
descriptionHtml:
Alassio recrute son ou sa Account Executive Cabinets (axe Paris–Lyon) !

En un coup d’œil

  • Contrat : CDI, à pourvoir dès que possible

  • Lieu : Paris ; déplacements fréquents sur l’axe Paris–Lyon ; hybride

  • Périmètre : axe Paris–Lyon

  • Expérience : 3-5 ans minimum en vente full cycle SaaS B2B

  

Missions

 

🏗️ Alassio, en quelques mots

Le marché de la paie en cabinet d’expertise-comptable est dominé depuis des décennies par des solutions historiques. Chez Alassio, notre ambition est de rénover le métier au bénéfice des gestionnaires de paie, avec un logiciel moderne, évolutif et pensé pour les réalités du terrain.

Lancé en juillet 2025 et déployé en clientèle depuis mars 2026, Alassio accélère pour accompagner de nouveaux cabinets partout en France, tout en maintenant une exigence forte sur la qualité du produit et de l’accompagnement.

 

🎯 Pourquoi ce poste, maintenant

Pour accompagner cette accélération, nous cherchons un·e Account Executive Cabinets sur le périmètre Paris–Lyon : un profil commercial qui aime prospecter, comprendre des enjeux métier exigeants et transformer une relation de confiance en signature.

 

🚀 Ton rôle

Tu développes ton portefeuille de cabinets en full cycle, de la prospection au closing. Tu es responsable de ton pipeline et de tes opportunités, avec l’appui des équipes Product, Tech, Déploiement et Accompagnement (DnA).

 

🧭 Tes missions

Prospecter et créer tes opportunités

  • Prendre en charge l’inbound de ton périmètre : qualifier les demandes, mener les découvertes, traiter les sollicitations avec réactivité et assurer des relances structurées

  • Identifier les cabinets à potentiel et construire une prospection ciblée via les canaux adaptés : online, événementiel, mises en relation et rencontres terrain

  • Combiner appels, emails, mises en relation et rendez-vous pour ouvrir de nouvelles conversations

Qualifier, démontrer et conclure

  • Comprendre l’organisation du cabinet, ses usages, ses irritants et ses enjeux de changement de logiciel de paie

  • Qualifier les besoins, les interlocuteurs, le processus de décision et le calendrier du projet

  • Préparer et mener des démonstrations adaptées, en mobilisant les expertises internes lorsque nécessaire

  • Piloter chaque étape du cycle : suivi des échanges, traitement des objections, proposition commerciale, négociation et closing

  • Maintenir un pipeline fiable, avec des prochaines étapes claires et des prévisions commerciales argumentées

  • Préparer une transmission fluide aux équipes Déploiement et Accompagnement (DnA) pour que les engagements pris pendant la vente soient compris et partagés

Développer une présence terrain sur ton périmètre

Rencontrer régulièrement les cabinets et leurs décideurs sur l’axe Paris–Lyon, développer ton réseau et représenter Alassio lors de salons et d’événements du secteur comptable et social. Transformer les rencontres en opportunités qualifiées et organiser tes tournées pour conjuguer proximité client et efficacité commerciale. Les déplacements fréquents sur l’axe Paris–Lyon font partie du poste.

Contribuer au quotidien de l’équipe

  • Participer aux points d’équipe, aux revues de pipeline et aux échanges de pratiques

  • Partager les objections, les signaux marché et les apprentissages utiles au collectif dans une organisation lean et product-led

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration des messages, des supports et des méthodes commerciales, sans perdre de vue tes objectifs principaux

 

🛠️ Une collaboration rapprochée avec la Tech et le Product

Chez Alassio, les Sales ne travaillent pas à distance du produit. Tu échanges régulièrement avec les équipes Tech et Product pour comprendre ce que nous construisons, préparer les démonstrations, éclaircir les cas d’usage et faire remonter les besoins du terrain avec précision.

Tu sais contextualiser les contraintes d’un cabinet, distinguer un besoin d’une demande de fonctionnalité et aligner ton discours commercial sur les capacités réelles du produit, sans promettre ce qui n’est pas validé.

 

🤖 Notre OS interne au quotidien

CRM, documentation partagée, IA et automatisations sont des leviers pour mieux prospecter, préparer tes rendez-vous et assurer ton suivi. Tu prends rapidement en main de nouveaux outils, documentes tes échanges, maintiens une information fiable et partages les pratiques qui rendent l’équipe plus efficace.

  

Profil recherché

 

🌱 Expérience

  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans la vente full cycle en SaaS B2B, sur des cycles impliquant plusieurs interlocuteurs et du présentiel

  • Une autonomie de lead generation : tu sais créer tes opportunités et mener une prospection régulière, sans attendre qu’on t’alimente en leads

  • Une capacité à conduire une découverte approfondie, démontrer la valeur, assurer le suivi commercial et négocier jusqu’à la signature

  • Une connaissance de l’écosystème comptable ou de la paie est un plus ; l’anglais professionnel est apprécié

  • Des notions ou une expérience passée dans la vente indirecte sont un plus

 

🛠️ Compétences et outils

  • Une forte appétence pour la collaboration avec les équipes Tech et Product, au-delà de la simple remontée de demandes clients

  • Une grande agilité avec les outils numériques, l’IA et les automatisations, associée à une utilisation rigoureuse de notre OS interne. Tu comprends l’importance de la data pour une approche méthodique

  • Une curiosité réelle pour les métiers de la paie et les enjeux des cabinets, avec l’envie de monter en compétence sur un produit à forte profondeur métier

 

💎 Qualités

  • Autonomie, proactivité et esprit collectif : tu avances sur tes objectifs tout en contribuant à la vie de l’équipe

  • Le goût du terrain et la disponibilité pour des déplacements fréquents sur l’axe Paris–Lyon

  • Data-driven et pragmatique : nous prenons des décisions basées sur des métriques précises et métier

  • Clarté, curiosité et esprit de coopération pour travailler avec les équipes et les cabinets

  

Processus de sélection

1️⃣ Premier entretien avec Maxime, Head of Sales 1h

2️⃣ Business case à partir de situations réelles avec Tancrède (CEO), Alexandre (Déploiement & Accompagnement) et Maxime - en présentiel 📍

3️⃣ Approfondissement métier et motivations avec Alexandre (Partner Success) et Maxime 1h

4️⃣ Prises de références

5️⃣ Rencontre avec l’équipe dans nos bureaux, en présentiel 1h

  

Ce que nous offrons

 

👊 Une mission au contact du terrain et du produit

Un rôle commercial full cycle au contact des cabinets, du produit et de l’équipe, pour accompagner la croissance d’Alassio sur l’axe Paris–Lyon.

 

🎁 Rémunération et avantages

  • 💰 Rémunération compétitive + BSPCE

  • 🏥 Mutuelle Alan

  • 🍽️ Carte Swile (tickets restaurant)

  • 💻 Matériel de pointe (MacOS, écran incurvé)

  • 🏝️ RTT

title: Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Caseware ist die globale KI-Plattform für Audit und Accounting. Gegründet vor über 35 Jahren in Toronto, nutzen heute mehr als 500.000 Anwender:innen in 130 Ländern unsere Lösungen, und über 36.000 Fachleute weltweit führen Caseware als Skill auf LinkedIn. Als wachstumsstarkes Technologieunternehmen, backed by Hg, beschleunigen wir die Transformation unserer Branche Richtung Cloud und AI, und bauen die nächste Generation von Audit- und Accounting-Workflows. Wenn du in einem Umfeld arbeiten willst, das global skaliert, technologisch vorne liegt und echten Impact liefert, bist du bei uns richtig.

Als Account Executive (m/w/d) bei Caseware wandelst Du Marktinteresse in messbare Ergebnisse. Du gewinnst neue Kunden, baust bestehende Beziehungen gezielt aus und erkennst Potenziale innerhalb deines Kundenportfolios frühzeitig. Mit ausgeprägter Abschlussstärke und einem klaren Gespür für Chancen schaffst du stabile Umsatzströme und nachhaltige Partnerschaften.

📍Es handelt sich um eine unbefristete Vollzeitposition mit Sitz in Düsseldorf (oder Stuttgart) und einem flexiblen hybriden Arbeitsmodell.


Was Du machst:

  • Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und entwickelst sie gezielt weiter, indem du die individuellen Bedürfnisse deiner Ansprechpartner genau verstehst.

  • Du stärkst die Marktpräsenz von Caseware und baust dein professionelles Netzwerk aktiv aus, indem du mit wichtigen Entscheidern und relevanten Branchenkontakten im Austausch bist.

  • Du stellst sicher, dass alle Vertriebsaktivitäten, Kundendaten und Vertragsdetails vollständig und korrekt im CRM dokumentiert sind, damit Transparenz und effiziente Abläufe jederzeit gewährleistet sind.


    • Was Du mitbringst:

  • Du kommunizierst überzeugend, trittst souverän auf und schaffst es, schnell tragfähige Beziehungen zu relevanten Stakeholdern aufzubauen.

  • Du hast nachweislich Erfolge in der Gewinnung von Neukunden und im strategischen Ausbau bestehender Kundenbeziehungen erzielt.

  • Du gehst mit Neugier, Motivation und einer pragmatischen, lösungsorientierten Haltung auf Kunden und ihre Herausforderungen zu.

title: Account Executive, Ecommerce
descriptionHtml:
At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers.
From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection.
As a certified B Corp, we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.
Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries—from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches.
We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn, backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started!
The Role

You'll be a full-cycle Account Executive in the Ecommerce team, selling both our software and our services. There are no BDRs here, so you own the whole thing: finding the account, qualifying it, running the demo, negotiating and closing.

Your sales funnel will be a mix of inbound, outbound and partner-sourced deals with ecommerce brands. Once you are in touch with a good fit prospect you will need to talk the language of merchants (AOV, repeat purchase rate, abandoned carts, flows) and want to help build a team that's still taking shape.


What you'll do

  • Run the full sales cycle, from first touch to signed contract

  • Manage inbound demand of prospects and customers looking to signup or upgrade

  • Prospect into ecommerce brands: claim accounts from the team's account pool, research them and run specific messaging plays

  • Qualify with MEDDIC/SPICED and keep your pipeline honest

  • Run discovery and demos that link Brevo to the merchant's numbers: revenue per subscriber, repeat purchase, recovered carts

  • Work with the broader team on complex deals and with Partner Managers on agency and Shopify ecosystem deals

  • Keep the CRM clean and forecast accurately every week

  • Spot cross-sell and upsell opportunities in existing accounts and hand them over or work them as agreed

  • Feed back what you hear from merchants to Product and Marketing

  • Show up at ecommerce events and tradeshows when it makes sense


    • What you bring

    Must have

  • Either fluent Spanish or German

  • You've built something nobody asked you to. A side business, a club, a channel, a better way of doing your old job. Size doesn't matter. We want the story.

  • You've got something to prove. To yourself, to us, or to whoever doubted you.

  • You actually want to sell. Not just "open to sales". You like the conversation, the chase and the close.

  • You read people. You notice what someone isn't saying, and you adjust.

  • You don't accept "that's how it's done". You question it, then you go and try the other way.

  • You're a bit unreasonable about what's possible. A "no" tells you something

  • Excellent spoken and written French, at C1 or higher

    • Nice to have

  • 3+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, with a track record of hitting quota

  • Comfortable running both fast cycles (a few weeks) and longer, multi-stakeholder deals

  • Experience prospecting your own pipeline, not only working inbound

  • Able to turn a merchant's problem into a clear business case with numbers

  • Rigorous with CRM and forecasting

  • Hands-on knowledge of Shopify, Klaviyo, Mailchimp or similar tools

  • Experience selling to ecommerce or retail businesses, or selling martech, CRM or Shopify apps

  • Experience with MEDDIC or another structured qualification method

  • Experience working with agencies or partner channels

    • We're looking for someone who

  • Owns their number and their pipeline, without being chased

  • Is genuinely curious about how online stores make money

  • Moves fast but knows when a deal needs more care

  • Gives and takes feedback openly

  • Wants to help shape how a new team works, not just follow a playbook


    • What we offer

  • [Base + variable, OTE range if you can share it]

  • RTT days, 50% public transport reimbursement and a sustainable mobility package

  • Swile meal vouchers (€12.50/day)

  • English classes and access to 155,000+ Udemy courses

  • Remote-friendly setup, home office budget and relocation help for international hires

  • Private healthcare (70% covered), 6-week second-parent leave and extra sick-child leave

  • Team events, inter-office trips and social, green and LGBTQIA+ communities


    • Hiring Process

    1. Intro call with Talent Acquisition

    2. Interview with the hiring manager (William Hearn, Sales Director Ecommerce)

    3. Case study: discovery and pitch to an ecommerce brand [with who?]

    4. Final interview with the Ecommerce BU General Manager

    Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, if this role speaks to you, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Account Executive, Enterprise Hunter (DACH Market)
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The DACH Enterprise team is at the forefront of driving revenue and growth across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. As trusted business partners, we work with the most ambitious market leaders and high-growth innovators — DeepL, Refurbed, N26 to Nestlé — helping them build the financial infrastructure that powers their next stage of growth. We're known for our product expertise, rigorous thinking, and user-first approach to problem-solving.

Stripe's financial infrastructure is the engine that unlocks new revenue streams, automates complex local compliance, and drives global expansion for the region's most prominent businesses. This is a pivotal moment for Stripe in DACH — the market opportunity is significant, and our team serves as a critical source of user feedback and market intelligence, with direct influence on the product roadmap and growth strategy. What you’ll do

title: AI Researcher - Pre-training (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission
Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model. Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.

We are hiring an AI Researcher (f/m/d) to join our Pre-training team and help advance the architecture and training of our next generation of foundation models. If you are excited about how large models learn, want to run experiments that feed directly into production training runs, and want hands-on time on large-scale clusters (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs), we would love to hear from you.

Team Culture
We foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We collaborate closely on complex technical problems, working in pairs or using mob programming to resolve challenging issues. New team members learn through real work: from your first weeks you will pair with experienced researchers on live problems, and take on more ownership as you grow into it.

About the Role
As an AI Researcher in Pre-training (f/m/d), you will work on the technical levers that determine the success of our next-generation models: architecture, optimization, stability, and scaling.

Working at the intersection of research and engineering, you will learn to translate mathematical reasoning and empirical observations into principled training decisions, from small-scale proxy experiments to multi-thousand-GPU runs. You will start with well-scoped problems alongside senior researchers and progressively take ownership of larger parts of the training recipe.

We are looking for someone with strong fundamentals, sharp experimental instincts, exceptional skills, and the drive to go deep fast. You learn as much from a failed run as from a paper, you write code others can build on, and you want to become an expert in large-scale pre-training.

Your Responsibilities

  • Recipe & Architecture Experiments: Design and run ablations on core elements of the training recipe (optimizers, schedules, initialization), and implement PyTorch-based architectural changes. Evaluate their effect on convergence, stability, and training efficiency.

  • Scaling Experiments: Run and analyze small-scale proxy experiments, and contribute to the hyperparameter scaling laws and scale-up methods we use to predict behavior at multi-thousand-GPU scale.

  • Run Monitoring & Debugging: Help monitor large-scale training runs and investigate convergence issues such as loss spikes and divergence. Work with the team to track down distributed training failures.

  • Research to Practice: Follow the literature, reproduce promising results at small scale, and bring ideas worth testing to the team.

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work with the Compute Performance, Data, Evaluation, and Post-Training teams to understand how hardware constraints and the rest of the model lifecycle shape pre-training decisions.

Core Qualifications

  • You are proficient in Python and have hands-on experience with PyTorch.

  • You have a strong foundation in machine learning, shown through research (e.g., a PhD, a strong MS'c thesis, or publications), open-source contributions, or substantial professional or substantial personal projects.

  • You have a solid mathematical background (linear algebra, probability, optimization) and enjoy reasoning formally about why models train the way they do.

  • You understand how transformers work and have pre-trained LLMs from scratch yourself, even at small scale.

  • You design experiments carefully, report noisy and negative results honestly, and can explain clearly what your evidence does and does not show.

  • You have a track record of picking up unfamiliar technical areas quickly and going deep, for example by reimplementing papers, ramping up on a large new codebase, or debugging a problem well outside your comfort zone.

  • You write clean, maintainable code and care about reproducible experiments.

  • You communicate clearly, raise problems early, and actively seek out and act on feedback.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Distributed Training: Experience training models on multi-GPU or multi-node setups, or familiarity with distributed frameworks (e.g., Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, torchtitan) and parallelism strategies (data, tensor, pipeline, expert).

  • Training Dynamics: Familiarity with scaling laws, hyperparameter transfer (e.g., µP), or recent work on optimizers and training stability.

  • Efficient Architectures: Exposure to Mixture-of-Experts, efficient attention variants, or other inference-efficient designs.

  • Research Output: Publications at top-tier venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) or contributions to open-source ML training libraries.

  • Systems Curiosity: Low-level kernel optimization is not required, but we highly value a strong curiosity about the hardware and systems constraints that shape scale.

title: Alliance Director
descriptionHtml:
SLSQ427R333

You will serve as the business development engine for Databricks' Gold-tier and Rising Silver partner portfolio in EMEA, owning the motions that convert partner relationships into partner-sourced pipeline and consumption growth. Your primary mandate is intentional market-making: moving partners from delivery-first behaviour into structured demand creation through Big Bet account engagements, joint GTM campaigns, Brickbuilder solution plays, and scalable co-sell execution. You will work closely with Partner Sales Managers (PSMs), Partner Solutions Architects (PSAs), as well as Partner and Field Marketing to plan, execute, and advance partner GTM and to build the GTM capability within partners that makes this motion repeatable. You will report to the EMEA Partner Manager Leader.

The impact you will have:

  • You will own the business development motion for a defined portfolio of Gold-tier and Rising Silver partners in EMEA, co-developing structured GTM plans with the partners that drive partner-sourced pipeline volume (early-stage opportunity creation) and velocity aligned to the partner-sourced contribution targets.
  • You will lead a targeted number of partner industry workshops per partner per year and run a defined number of structured partner GTM campaigns per quarter, moving partners from opportunistic co-selling to programmatic, campaign-driven demand generation aligned to Company and GTM Priorities.
  • You will translate the Databricks Brickbuilder program into live partner GTM plays — identifying the right use cases, qualifying partners for Specialization and Brickbuilder eligibility, and connecting partner solution IP to Databricks sales programs and customer outcome maps for the key industries.
  • You will execute the Power-of-3 motion (SI + ISV + Cloud) within your partner portfolio, brokering joint account engagements that combine your partners industry depth with cloud hyperscaler funding, and ISV capability to create multi-workload, multi-year customer outcomes.
  • You will build GTM capacity inside your partner portfolio — driving sales badge completion, sales masterclasses, partner champion development, and Specialization progression — moving partners from certified to market-making, with the goal that each priority partner has a dedicated Databricks GTM team operating at the Databricks field standard.
  • You will own the partner-facing governance model for your portfolio: Plan-on-a-Page and Partner Cockpit discipline, deal registration and SLA compliance, cadenced partner business updates, and the CRM hygiene that ensures partner-sourced and delivery pipeline is correctly marked and credited.
  • You will run co-marketing investment decisions for your portfolio (MDF, Accelerate, co-sponsored demand gen), applying ROI discipline — strategic impact over activity volume — aligned to the principle that investment is intent, not incremental spending.
  • You will operate as a Partner First leader in the field, treating priority partners as extensions of the Databricks sales team: setting accountability expectations, recognizing and scaling what works, and being the first call for partners who are creating net-new pipeline in accounts.

What we look for:

  • Partner business development or channel sales experience: a demonstrated track record of driving partner-sourced or partner-initiated pipeline — not just co-sell support — with tangible evidence of moving a partner from reactive delivery to proactive demand creation.
  • Campaign and programmatic GTM execution: experience designing and running structured joint campaigns with partners, not one-off events; ability to connect partner solution IP (e.g. Brickbuilder-style accelerators) to sales programs and customer outcome narratives.
  • Partner portfolio management: experience managing a defined portfolio of regional or national SIs, selecting and prioritizing partners by commercial fit and growth potential, and building Joint Business Plans that produce measurable sourced pipeline outcomes.
  • Operational rigor: comfort owning deal registration hygiene, KPI/OKR tracking (sourced, conversion, campaign attribution, etc.), pipeline review cadence, and partner governance (Plan-on-a-Page, Cockpit, etc.) with the discipline to keep metrics correct, analyze, using AI tools in your daily work, and act on what the data shows.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: ability to work across PSM, PSA, Field Marketing, and Field Sales and Pre-Sales Leaders, to qualify, advance, and close partner-sourced opportunities. Experience navigating Sales and partner team alignment around co-sell priorities and partner accreditation.
  • Value selling and partner enablement: ability to help partners build an outcome-focused, industry-specific narrative for C-suite and LoB buyers — not just pitch the platform — and to run sales masterclasses and capability sessions that improve partner sales confidence and conversion.
  • Domain knowledge: understanding of mid-tier SIs' business models, how their P&L is structured, and what "partner-sourced" means operationally in their context; awareness of the EMEA data/AI competitive landscape, including the hyperscaler dynamics (AWS, Microsoft, GCP) that shape partner investment decisions.
  • Ambition and execution pace: comfort operating in a high-growth, fast-moving environment where the operating model is still being built, and contributing to building it. The ability to move fast on Big Bet account engagements and campaigns without waiting for perfect conditions.

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. title: Analytics Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Tired of being told “that’s not your scope”?

Plenty of good analysts hit the same wall: you query the data but never build the pipelines, you’re boxed into one lane, and more scope means waiting your turn. Here, it’s the opposite.

Taptap Send moves billions of dollars a month across 6 of 7 continents. We’re probably the largest, fastest-growing money movement business you’ve never heard of. Cards, wallets, business-to-business payments, institutional payments, and new markets are all launching now, and each needs its data, reconciliations and reporting built from scratch. That’s your work.

The job

You’ll own the external reports the business can’t operate without, then automate them into reliable, reusable dbt models. From day one you’ll work with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product and Data Engineering to make sure every number is modelled correctly.

  • Own external reporting: deliver the datasets behind month-end close and regulatory reporting, on time, every cycle.

  • Automate: turn multi-day manual work into scheduled pipelines, runbooks and dbt models, so it only gets done once.

  • Get ahead of launches: build reports and reconciliations as each product and market goes live, before anyone asks.

  • Be first line for data requests: build models so people and AI agents can answer repeat questions themselves.

  • Keep data trustworthy: build tests, checks and alerts that catch reconciliation breaks and stale data before they become incidents.

  • Share what you know: peer-review code and join our weekly meetups.

Why you’ll want it

Grow as fast as you’re able. We hire for potential, not years of experience. On a lean, talent-dense team, you’ll own real work early and take on more the moment you’re ready.

Go from querying data to designing systems. Data, product or business analyst? You don’t need to be an analytics engineer yet. Build the pipelines behind the numbers, and learn dbt, testing, automation and AI tooling from senior analytics engineers.

Don't get boxed in. Own the reporting, automate it, then take on our biggest problems wherever they sit. Your hiring manager started in Finance and has since worked across Partner Ops, Fraud, Compliance, Reconciliation and Product.

See the whole business. You’ll follow a transfer from the moment a customer taps send, through partner payout and reconciliation, to the report a regulator reads.

Own numbers that matter. Auditors and Finance rely on what you build. This isn’t a dashboard role.

Put more money in families’ hands. Remittances are a lifeline for millions of families and are worth more than all foreign aid. Every report you automate helps us keep transfers cheap and reliable.

You’ll fit if you have

1-2+ years in a data or analytics role

A technical or quantitative degree, or equivalent experience

Strong SQL and experience wrangling messy, complex data

Some experience automating repetitive work (e.g. scripts, scheduled jobs)

A strong sense of ownership: when something is broken, ownerless or late, you step in, fix it, and make sure it doesn’t happen again

Reliability under deadlines, a “no task too small” attitude, and comfort chasing stakeholders

The right to work in the UK

Nice to have: startup or scale-up experience, Python or R, dbt, Looker or Mode, and something you’ve built, at work or on the side, because the manual way annoyed you.

Sound like you? Apply, even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to meet you.

title: Assistant Financial Controller
descriptionHtml:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

Reporting to Sarah Phillips, you’ll own month-end for Flock’s finance team and strengthen the controls around it, running the close and producing the variance analysis and MI that FP&A and our senior team use for budgeting and reporting. We’re automating finance on our new platform and the team uses AI every day, so there’s plenty of room to improve how the work gets done as well as doing it.

It suits a recently qualified accountant with strong core accounting from practice, who has already improved a process or control somewhere and wants to keep growing within the finance team.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the month-end close from start to finish so it lands accurately and on time.

  • Prepare balance sheet reconciliations and post journals, keeping the ledger clean and well evidenced.

  • Run variance analysis and build the monthly MI pack, explaining what moved and why.

  • Strengthen our financial controls and automate manual steps wherever you find them.

  • Prepare our VAT returns and assist with group reporting.

  • Work with FP&A so the numbers behind budgets and senior reporting are right.

  • Support the annual audit and work alongside our external auditors.

  • Use AI tools in your daily work to speed up reconciliations, analysis and reporting, and share what works with the team.

  • Pick up ad hoc finance projects, including R&D tax claims if you have the experience.

 

What you’ll need

  • An ACA qualification, ideally recently qualified, although we’ll also consider strong ACCA or CIMA candidates.

  • A practice background with hands-on month-end experience, whether from non-audit client work or time in industry. Big 4 or not makes no difference to us.

  • Solid core accounting and close attention to detail, including balance sheet reconciliations, journals and variance analysis.

  • Experience strengthening financial controls or improving a finance process, with an example you can talk us through.

  • Curiosity and ambition, with the drive to push things forward and keep learning.

  • An interest in AI. You don’t need to be an expert, but you should already be using it at work or in your own time and want to do more with it.

Nice to have:

  • Audit experience.

  • Experience using NetSuite.

  • Experience automating finance processes.

  • Exposure to R&D tax claims.

  • Experience in the tech sector.

 

Benefits

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

 

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that’s a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.

title: Backend Engineer - Platform Core
descriptionHtml:
Backend Engineer (Golang) – Platform Core

Location: Remote, European time zones, Full-time, Permanent

About FullEnrich:

Every go-to-market motion runs on data, but no single provider has ever had complete coverage. We solve that problem with waterfall enrichment: instead of relying on a single data source, we orchestrate 20+ premium providers around the world, automatically querying them until we find the best available contact information. The result is industry-leading coverage and data quality, helping sales and GTM teams connect with the right people faster.

What started as a better way to find emails and phone numbers has grown into a broader vision: becoming the trusted B2B data layer powering modern revenue teams and AI-driven workflows alike. Today, more than 5,000 customers, including companies like AWS, Deel, HubSpot, Clay, and Artisan, trust us to power their prospecting and enrichment.

Founded in Paris and now headquartered in San Francisco, we're a team of 50+ people across the US, Europe, LATAM, and Israel, growing quickly and building with speed, ownership, and ambition. That's where you come in.

About the Role:

At the heart of FullEnrich is our waterfall engine. It's the system responsible for deciding which data providers to call, in what order, under which conditions, and what happens when something fails. It works well today, but what we're building next is significantly more ambitious.

We're evolving the engine to become far more flexible and configurable, supporting account-specific requirements, dynamic routing based on different optimization goals, and seamless integration of new providers and behaviors without introducing unnecessary complexity.

This is a foundational part of our product, and getting the architecture right is critical to how we scale.

We're looking for an experienced Backend Engineer who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges and taking ownership of the systems behind them.

If you've built high-throughput routing systems, designed multi-provider orchestration layers, or worked on infrastructure that needs to adapt to different customers and use cases, this is exactly the kind of challenge you'll be taking on.

What You'll Do:

  • Own and evolve our core routing engine: Take ownership of provider selection, fallback logic, load balancing, and queue management. Our waterfall currently operates as a modular Go monolith, and you'll help evolve it to support account-level customization at scale without introducing unnecessary complexity.

  • Build and improve provider integrations: Design how we connect to and manage third-party data providers, focusing on rate limiting, reliability, and observability. This includes supporting external provider credentials, configurable provider ordering, and well-defined fallback behavior when providers are unavailable.

  • Develop intelligent routing capabilities: Build the logic that dynamically selects providers based on different optimization objectives, including speed, coverage, compliance, and intelligent load balancing, while managing rate limits effectively.

  • Design scalable multi-tenant architecture: Develop the foundations for sub-accounts, customer-specific credit pools, and endpoint-level configuration, ensuring the engine remains flexible, scalable, and maintainable.

  • Build composable verification workflows: Integrate validity and compliance checks into the enrichment pipeline as configurable steps, allowing results to be independently verified regardless of their original data source.

  • Strengthen our core architecture: Improve and refactor existing systems as we scale, applying strong engineering practices to keep our codebase clean, understandable, reliable, and easy to maintain.

  • Shape technical decisions: Work closely with our engineering leadership to translate product requirements into thoughtful architectural solutions, balancing immediate needs with long-term scalability.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 3 months:

  • Develop a deep understanding of our existing waterfall engine, provider integrations, and core backend architecture.

  • Build strong relationships with the engineering team and identify opportunities to improve reliability, performance, and maintainability.

  • Start contributing to the evolution of our routing engine, taking ownership of initial architectural improvements and technical decisions.

By 6 months:

  • Take ownership of key components of our core platform, delivering meaningful improvements to provider orchestration, fallback logic, and routing capabilities.

  • Help introduce more flexible, account-level configuration while keeping the architecture clean, scalable, and maintainable.

  • Improve the reliability and observability of our provider integrations, reducing operational complexity as we scale.

By 12 months:

  • Play a leading role in delivering a more intelligent, configurable waterfall engine that supports different customer needs and optimization goals at scale.

  • Establish robust architectural foundations for multi-tenancy, composable verification, and continued provider expansion.

  • Be a trusted technical contributor within the engineering team, helping shape long-term architectural decisions and ensuring our core platform remains reliable, performant, and ready for future growth.

What We're Looking For:

  • Strong backend engineering experience: You've built and maintained production systems involving routing, fallback mechanisms, queues, concurrency, and rate limiting. You understand how distributed and multi-provider systems behave under pressure and how to design for reliability.

  • An architecture-first mindset: You're comfortable taking a product requirement, identifying potential structural challenges, and designing solutions that will stand the test of time. You think beyond implementation and consider scalability, maintainability, and long-term impact.

  • Deep experience with Golang: Go is at the core of our backend. You're confident working with modular architectures, clean code principles, and ideally hexagonal architecture.

  • Experience managing technical complexity: You can navigate systems with multiple interconnected components, from account-level configuration and provider orchestration to compliance workflows and multi-tenancy, without compromising clarity or simplicity.

  • Strong ownership and problem-solving skills: You're proactive, pragmatic, and comfortable making technical decisions. You enjoy getting into the details, understanding why systems behave the way they do, and finding solutions to challenging engineering problems.

  • A collaborative approach: You communicate clearly, challenge ideas constructively, and enjoy working with other engineers to build reliable, high-quality systems.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with data routing, enrichment pipelines, or multi-provider orchestration systems.

  • Experience building API marketplace infrastructure or multi-tenant SaaS backends.

  • Familiarity with API-first product architectures.

  • An interest in the evolving data infrastructure landscape.

Our Tech Stack

Our backend is built primarily in Golang, following a modular, hexagonal architecture.

Our wider stack includes:

  • Backend: Go (Golang)

  • Databases & Search: PostgreSQL, OpenSearch

  • Infrastructure: DigitalOcean, Docker

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions

  • Monitoring & Observability: Grafana

You'll be joining an engineering team of around 10 people, working on one of the most critical components of our platform.

Interview Process

We aim to keep our process straightforward, transparent, and focused on getting to know each other.

  1. Introduction to FullEnrich with our Talent team (30 min) – A chance to learn more about you, introduce FullEnrich and the role, and explore whether there's a mutual fit.

  2. CTO & VP Engineering Interview (60 minutes): A conversation about your experience, the role, and a technical discussion based on a real experiment.

  3. Technical Assessment: A take-home exercise completed in your own time, followed by a review and discussion.

  4. Team & Culture Interview: Meet with a member of the team to learn more about how we work together and ensure there's a strong mutual fit.

FullEnrich is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or disability.

title: Broker Development Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

Brokers bring in nearly all of Flock’s business, so they’re central to how we grow. As a Broker Development Manager, you’ll look after a panel of key broker partners with real growth potential, deepen the relationships we already have and build new ones as we move into new sectors. You’ll report to our Head of Distribution.

You’ll show brokers what our connected fleet proposition does for their clients: it cuts risk and cost and keeps drivers safer. We’re AI-first, so you’ll use AI every day to research brokers, prepare for meetings and spot opportunities across your panel, leaving more time for the conversations that win business.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Be the main face of Flock for a panel of key broker partners and grow the business you do together.

  • Drive a high volume of quality submissions from your panel.

  • Grow the panel, onboarding new brokers quickly and getting them trading.

  • Find new ways to promote Flock’s appetite and proposition as we expand into new sectors.

  • Build data-led growth plans for each account and follow them through.

  • Support day-to-day trading so brokers win and keep business with Flock, keeping conversion and retention high.

  • Work with underwriting, product and other teams across Flock towards shared growth goals.

  • Use AI daily for broker research, meeting prep and pipeline analysis.

 

What you’ll need

  • At least five years managing broker relationships in insurance, with a strong reputation in the market.

  • An existing network of broker contacts you can bring to Flock from day one.

  • A strong understanding of the commercial broker market, competing carriers and how broker businesses work.

  • A track record of beating revenue targets and working well with teams across a business.

  • A consultative sales approach that matches Flock’s proposition to what each broker needs.

  • Pace and energy: you move fast, spot opportunities and solve problems.

  • Comfortable using AI at work and curious about where else it could help you win business.

Nice to have: experience building broker networks in Commercial Motor Fleet, an active broker panel in commercial insurance, or a record of taking new technology or products to brokers.

 

Benefits

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

This role is expected to be field based rather than office based, working with brokers across Manchester and the surrounding region, so visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days. As long as you’re meeting brokers consistently each week, time at our Central London office, a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street, can be weekly or monthly.

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that’s a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.

title: Business Analyst (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du begeisterst dich für Technologie und suchst einen Job, der unfassbar abwechslungsreich ist und dir tiefe Einblicke in zahlreiche Unternehmen und Branchen bietet?

Deine Mission? Du holst das volle Potenzial aus unseren Business Apps heraus, indem du Geschäftsprozesse analysierst, deine Kund:innen hinsichtlich ihrer Anforderungen berätst und letztlich das Projekt von A bis Z gemeinsam mit deinen Kund:innen erfolgreich durchführst.

Außerdem hast du Lust, die Digitalisierung von Unternehmen entscheidend zu beeinflussen & voranzutreiben sowie den Raum München mit uns zu erobern. 🚀

Deine Aufgaben

Als Business Analyst:in bist du die Schnittstelle zwischen unserer Software und unseren Kund:innen - das heißt:

  • Du analysierst die Geschäftsprozesse unserer Kund:innen und baust dir ein tiefes Verständnis für ihre technischen und funktionellen Anforderungen auf

  • Du designst und konfigurierst spezifisch-zugeschnittene Lösungen in unserer Odoo Software und implementierst diese in den Unternehmen unserer Kund:innen

  • Du managst du deine Projekte eigenverantwortlich, definierst deine Deadlines und überwachst deine Deliverables, sodass einem smoothen Go Live nichts im Weg steht

  • Du gibst individuelle Trainings in der Software

  • Du stehst im engen Kontakt mit unseren Sales Teams sowie unseren Entwickler:innen und unterstützt unser Partner:innen-Netzwerk dabei, Odoo Expert:in zu werden

  • Dein Feedback hilft uns, die Software stetig weiterzuentwickeln

Qualifikation

Bei Odoo schätzen wir deine Fähigkeiten mehr als den Lebenslauf.

Das erwarten wir von dir:

  • Einen Bachelor/Master Abschluss oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

  • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch (C1-C2) und Englisch

  • Ein analytisches Mindset und die Fähigkeit strukturiert und autonom zu arbeiten.

  • Eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe & eine ausgeprägte Tech-Affinität

  • Proaktivität und Durchsetzungsvermögen.

  • Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Arbeitserfahrung.

  • Nice to have: XML, Python oder JS Kenntnisse.


Warum Odoo?

Langweilige 0815 Jobs, mit komplizierten Entscheidungswegen, starren Hierarchien und Micromanaging sind nicht so dein Ding? Cool, unser auch nicht!

Bei uns wirst du in einer offenen Atmosphäre arbeiten, in der du die Freiheit hast, deine Ideen zu verwirklichen. Garantiert unkompliziert! 😌

Außerdem ist unser Produkt natürlich super cool und generiert einen wirklichen Mehrwert für unsere Kund:innen.

Deine Benefits

  • BVG-Ticket : Damit du einfach von A nach B kommst.

  • Sachbezug oder Urban Sports: Mit deinen monatlichen 50 € hast du die Wahl: Lass dir das Guthaben flexibel auf eine Mastercard buchen oder entscheide dich alternativ für eine Urban Sports M-Mitgliedschaft.

  • Food & Drinks : Zentrales Office mit Spreeblick, dazu Snacks, Müsli, und Spaßgetränke, sowie einen Zuschuss zu deinem Mittagessen.

  • Work-Life Balance : FFlexible Arbeitszeiten bei einer 38 Stunden Woche und einem hybriden Arbeitsmodell mit 2 Homeoffice Tagen und 3 Office Tagen in unserem Büro in Friedrichshain.

  • Company Culture : Regelmäßige End-of-Month Events für alle sowie jedes Quartal ein Budget von 40€ pro Person für Team-Events.

  • Go Global - Austauschprogramm : Lust auf Auslandserfahrung? Nach 2 Jahren Odoo hast du die Möglichkeit dich an einen unserer weltweiten Standorte versetzen zu lassen.

  • Faires Gehalt: Wir spielen mit offenen Karten. Abhängig von deiner relevanten Berufserfahrung liegt das Bruttojahresgehalt für diese Rolle zwischen 52.000-60.000€.

Bei Odoo setzen wir uns für ein vielfältiges, inklusives und authentisches Arbeitsumfeld ein.

Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen von allen Menschen, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, ethnischer Herkunft, Religion, sexueller oder Geschlechtsidentität, Behinderung oder anderen Merkmalen.

Bewirb dich trotzdem! Vielleicht bist du genau die richtige Person für diesen Job!

descriptionHtml:
Die Gesellschaft für innovative Personalwirtschaftssysteme mbH ist ein führender Softwarehersteller von integrierten HR Management-Anwendungen für staatliche, öffentliche und soziale Arbeitgeber in Deutschland. Unser Produkt KIDICAP® ist seit 40 Jahren auf dem Markt und wird heute von rund 25.000 Organisationen als Cloud Service genutzt. KIDICAP® bildet eine moderne Web-APP-Plattform für alle Bereiche des Human Capital Managements und alle Unternehmensgrößen. Das Unternehmen beschäftigt rund 200 Mitarbeiter:innen, mit wachsender Tendenz.

Zur Verstärkung des Entwicklungs-Teams suchen wir ab sofort einen:

Business Analyst/ Product Owner Meldeverfahren (m/w/d)

Arbeitsorte: Remote (Deutschland) oder Offenbach am Main oder Leipzig | Zeitmodell: Vollzeit

Die Tech & Produkt-Organisation

Aufbau: Die Tech & Produkt Organisation besteht aus knapp 160 Mitarbeiter:innen und ist verteilt auf 2 Bereiche (Core & Fachapplikationen) und insgesamt ca. 15 crossfunktionale Teams. Die Produkt-Teams sind nach Produktnutzergruppen ausgerichtet wie bspw. Lohnabrechnung, Mitarbeiter-Self-Service oder Personaladministration.

Kultur: Leitmotive sind „You build it, you run it“, “Common Ownership” und Clean Code. Die Arbeitsweise ist pragmatisch und agil. Agile Coaches stehen on Demand zur Verfügung.

Tools

  • Ticket-System: Jira
  • Dokumentation: Confluence
  • Office Suite: Microsoft 365
  • Kommunikation: MS-Teams

Deine Aufgaben

Du bist die fachliche Instanz für dein Meldeverfahren, von der gesetzlichen Änderung über die Berechnungslogik bis zur Auslieferung.

  • Analyse von Änderungen im Sozialversicherungsrecht und in den Meldeverfahren sowie deren Umsetzung in Anforderungen, Jira und unseren internen Systemen
  • Erstellung präziser Anforderungsspezifikationen und User Stories, Priorisierung gemeinsam mit dem Scrum-Team und (Mit-)Verantwortung für das Product Backlog
  • Weiterentwicklung des Produkts mit eigenen Ideen, inklusive Neukonzeption gewachsener Komponenten, wo der bestehende Ansatz nicht mehr trägt
  • Sicherstellung von Konformität und Wartung als verlässliche Basis für unsere Kunden
  • Enge Abstimmung mit Kunden als fachliche Ansprechperson
  • Unterstützung der fachlichen Qualitätssicherung sowie Verantwortung für Kommunikation und Dokumentation in deinem Bereich
  • Arbeit mit agilen Methoden wie Scrum, Design Thinking oder Personas

Requirements

Entscheidend ist für uns, dass du dich gern in komplexe Berechnungs- und Melderegeln einarbeitest und ein Team mitnehmen kannst.

  • Erfahrung in der Entgeltabrechnung, in SV-Meldeverfahren, bei einer Krankenkasse oder einem Abrechnungsanbieter, idealerweise mindestens drei Jahre
  • Kenntnis des Sozialversicherungsrechts, der Meldeverfahren und aktueller Änderungen
  • Analytisches Denken und der Anspruch, Dinge genau zu verstehen
  • Technisches Verständnis für große, gewachsene Softwaresysteme oder die klare Bereitschaft, es dir anzueignen
  • Überzeugungskraft verbunden mit der Fähigkeit, zuzuhören und Entscheidungen gemeinsam zu tragen
  • Eine methodische, selbstständige und proaktive Arbeitsweise
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1+)

Benefits

  • New Work: 100% Home-Office möglich, Flex-Arbeitsplätze an den Standorten
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Freie Zeiteinteilung und familienfreundliche Kultur
  • Prämien und Boni: Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg
  • Urlaub: 30 Tage + bis zu 12 Zusatztage (Arbeitszeitkonto), Option auf Sabbatical
  • Weiterbildung: Regelmäßige interne oder externe Angebote sowie nach individueller Absprache
  • Vergünstigungen: Pluxee Benefits Card, Corporate Benefits Rabatte
  • Altersvorsorge: Arbeitgeberfinanzierte betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Fitness: Jobrad-Leasing, Gesundheitskurse, Online-Rücken-Fitness

Compensation: 80-100K Base + 60K OTE + Participation in our warrant program

About Teton

Teton is building the foundational data layer for the point of care, using real‑time, multimodal AI to create a digital twin of both the resident and the care environment, giving care providers clear visibility into what is happening at the bedside. Our technology removes the administrative and observational workload that slows care teams down, allowing them to focus on delivering exceptional care.

Through a combination of in‑room hardware and intuitive desktop and mobile applications, Teton supports a seamless experience for residents, carers and operators. Our solution provides unprecedented access to real‑time data, creating a digital twin of resident states and care delivery that gives care teams actionable intelligence to make faster, safer and better‑informed decisions.

With strong demand and clear product‑market fit, we are scaling rapidly across the UK. This role offers a rare opportunity to land and shape the largest relationships in our highest‑potential region.

The Role

The Business Development Director will hunt and close Teton’s new business with the UK’s largest care operators: large care home groups, including national and multi‑regional operators and REIT‑backed portfolios, alongside strategic partners across the NHS and wider health and social care system.

This is a hunter role. You will own a focused portfolio of named target groups, open doors with senior decision‑makers and drive deals to signature with pace. Your focus is closing high six‑ to seven‑figure agreements that set the pace for Teton’s UK growth.

Key Responsibilities

New business

  • Prospect relentlessly into your named enterprise care groups and the portfolio owners behind them, through outbound, events and referrals. (Smaller groups are covered by our Business Development Managers.)

  • Own the full sales cycle from first meeting to signed contract, keeping deals moving through pilots, procurement and legal with urgency.

  • Consistently close high six‑ to seven‑figure, multi‑site agreements, converting pilots into paid, estate‑wide rollouts.

Executive relationships

  • Build trusted relationships with CEOs, COOs, CFOs, Directors of Quality and Clinical Directors, as well as investors and property owners behind operator portfolios.

  • Present compelling, outcome‑led business cases covering falls reduction, staffing efficiency, regulatory outcomes and ROI to boards and investment committees.

Partners and procurement

  • Use REIT, landlord, channel‑partner and NHS relationships to open doors and accelerate deals with target groups.

  • Lead or contribute to tenders and formal procurement processes, working with internal clinical, product and compliance teams.

Pipeline and forecasting

  • Build and maintain a high‑value enterprise pipeline with rigorous qualification, accurate forecasting and disciplined CRM hygiene.

  • Partner closely with Customer Success and Account Management to ensure seamless handover and expansion across signed groups.

  • Represent Teton at senior industry forums, roundtables and sector events, turning every event into qualified pipeline.

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years of B2B enterprise sales experience, including at least 3 years selling complex SaaS or technology‑enabled solutions into large, regulated organisations, ideally health or social care.

  • A consistent record of exceeding multi‑million‑pound new business quotas, including closing high six‑ to seven‑figure deals.

  • Experience driving multi‑stakeholder deals to close at pace, with board‑level sponsors, procurement and legal.

  • A strong network across UK care home groups, operator investors or the NHS, with credibility at C‑suite level.

  • Commercial acumen: comfortable building ROI models, structuring pilots and phased rollouts, and negotiating complex commercial terms.

  • Working knowledge of the UK care regulatory landscape (CQC, clinical safety standards such as DCB0129/0160, data protection) or the ability to get there quickly.

  • Experience with tenders, frameworks or public‑sector procurement is a strong advantage.

  • A true hunter: you open doors at the most senior level, build your own pipeline and are driven by closing. You thrive in high‑growth environments and take ownership.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

  • Valid driver’s licence and willingness to travel across the UK, with occasional travel to Copenhagen.

  • Based in or near London, with regular presence in our London office.

What We Offer

  • Highly competitive base salary and uncapped commission, with a senior‑level OTE.

  • Participation in our warrant programme.

  • The chance to win the UK’s largest care groups in a fast‑scaling business.

  • The opportunity to work with state‑of‑the‑art technology in a pioneering field.

  • A vibrant, learning‑focused environment with significant room for growth and impact.

What It’s Like Working at Teton

We are a high‑performing, fast‑moving team of ambitious people who care deeply about our mission. The learning curves are steep, and expanding your skill set is not just encouraged but expected. You will be challenged, supported and surrounded by people who take ownership and move quickly.

We are looking for individuals who believe in our long‑term vision and value entrepreneurship over a traditional nine‑to‑five. If you want a role where your work genuinely shapes the future of care delivery, and you are ready for the ride, we would love to meet you.

title: Business Development Representative
descriptionHtml:
A little about us

incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Notion, Linear, Ramp and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

Being a BDR at incident.io means learning to sell from some of the best in the business, while representing a product and account team that make every conversation an easy one to be proud of.

What that looks like day to day

Cold calling is the heart of this role, and most of our meetings get booked over the phone - not because it's easy, but because it's still the fastest way to build real trust with a prospect. We don't copy-paste templates, and we don't spam: every call and every piece of outreach is backed by careful research and planning alongside the AEs you partner with, so the person on the other end knows you're not a random dial.

We're founded by engineers, and that shows up in how BDRs work too, everyone gets unlimited Claude tokens, and our head of business development is a former RevOps leader himself, so there's a real emphasis on testing, measuring, and optimizing your own workflow like an engineer would, not just running the same script on repeat.

BDRs are the bench for our wider GTM team, and your progress here matters beyond just you, it's how we keep the whole GTM engine strong. The path to AE is real, and for those who put in the work, that next step can come faster than you'd expect elsewhere - with the strength of the peer group you're learning from making all the difference.

Who you are

  • You've got a strong why. Whatever got you here - sport, a career switch, a BDR track record that deserved the promotion you didn't get last time, you know exactly what you're chasing, and that's what gets you through the hard days.

  • Cold calling doesn't scare you. A "no" doesn't ruin your afternoon, it's just the next dial.

  • You're genuinely curious about people. You want to know what's keeping a VP of Engineering up at night, not just whether they'll take a meeting.

  • You can write. Not novels, just outreach someone actually wants to open and reply to.

  • You run toward the hard thing. Given the choice between the easy route and the challenging one, you take the challenging one, because you know that's where the bigger payoff is.

  • You're always looking for a better way to work, and that includes using AI properly, testing new tools and workflows, not just running the same playbook because it's familiar.

  • Startup life suits you. Things change, the odd thing is on fire, and you're fine figuring it out as you go with people around to help.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

  • Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover — we want you and the people you love to be looked after.

  • Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

  • First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

  • Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

  • Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

  • Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

  • Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

  • Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

Compensation: £65K – £70K • Offers Equity

title: Business Development Representative, UK
descriptionHtml:

We're the AI-first CRM that turns conversations into revenue. On-site, WhatsApp, email, voice: our AI Agents sell, support, and retain customers for the best B2C brands out there, autonomously.

We believe the future of commerce is warmer, more human than ever - just at a scale no human team could pull off alone.

Based in London and working remotely, you'll take full ownership of the process, from picking the accounts to handing over qualified meetings, and building the UK pipeline from the ground up. title: C++ Software Engineer, Early Careers
descriptionHtml:
At IMC, technology is not a department; it's at the heart of everything we do. Developed in-house, our innovative software makes millions of trading decisions daily, and we win by making better and faster decisions than our competition.

IMC's Amsterdam-based C++ Execution development teams work on software that sits directly in the latency-critical loop of our technology stack and touches every part of our organisation. We connect IMC to exchanges around the world, process massive volumes of market data in real time, execute complex trading algorithms, and integrate advanced hardware solutions where software alone isn't fast enough.

Your Core Responsibilities

As a software engineer, you'll work in multidisciplinary teams alongside other engineers, traders, researchers, and quants, both locally and across our global offices, taking ownership of end-to-end product development, from requirements gathering to production. You'll write reliable, high-performance software while balancing time to production with quality and testability. Advanced automated testing lets us deploy to production daily. Within a complex landscape of varying systems and technologies, you'll be constantly challenged to consider trade-offs between latency, throughput, simplicity, scalability and maintainability.

  • Building and maintaining the systems that connect IMC to exchanges: parsing market data feed, managing order entry, and keeping us fast and reliable on the path where latency counts.

  • Implementing and optimising execution logic in close collaboration with traders and quants, translating trading ideas into production code.

  • Working with our hardware teams to integrate FPGA-based systems and low-latency network solutions into our trading stack.

  • Measuring, profiling and improving the performance of our systems.

  • Developing expertise across the entire software development lifecycle, learning from experienced engineers along the way.

Your Skills and Experience

  • 2-3 years of full-time professional work experience post-graduation 

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field

  • Strong knowledge of algorithms and data structures

  • Solid programming skills in modern C++ (C++17 or later)

  • An interest in how software actually runs on hardware: memory, caches, networking

  • A high degree of flexibility and adaptability: willing and able to deal with uncertainty and ambiguity in a rapidly evolving environment

  • Ability to solve problems creatively and proactively

  • Curiosity and a willingness to learn. Interest in financial markets; previous knowledge is not required.

About Us

IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.
