title: CDI - Senior Product Engineer - Paris
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Ce que vous construisez ne reste pas à l’état de démonstration : de vrais utilisateurs, au sein de grands groupes, s’en servent chaque jour. Applications et agents se conçoivent et s’exploitent en binôme avec l’AI Product Manager. Une équipe sinistres retrouve ainsi sur un seul écran les documents utiles et un brouillon de réponse ; ailleurs, un processus de commande ne demande plus aucune ressaisie manuelle.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que de vrais utilisateurs s’appuient sur ce que vous livrez.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Product Engineer.

Activités et responsabilités

À chaque projet, l’AI Product Manager pilote le produit avec le client : ce qui se construit en premier, et la vérification que les utilisateurs s’en servent, se décident à deux.

Autour de l’application, trois métiers se croisent : les AI Engineers pour le comportement du modèle, les Platform Engineers pour le déploiement, les Context & Analytics Engineers pour les données dont l’application a besoin. Les tests se font avec les utilisateurs finaux, le code se relit entre pairs et les nouvelles recrues sont accompagnées.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Construire des applications métier : front end, back end et API.

  • Intégrer des agents et des assistants dans un processus métier, avec des contrôles humains là où ils comptent.

  • Automatiser des processus de bout en bout.

  • Intégrer un modèle dans un outil que les équipes utilisent déjà.

  • Construire les connecteurs dont le cas d’usage a besoin, par exemple un serveur MCP pour un outil métier.

  • Concevoir l’expérience utilisateur de l’IA : quand une personne valide, comment afficher les sources et l’incertitude.

  • Définir avec l’AI Product Manager les évaluations propres au cas d’usage et les suivre en production.

  • Assumer ce que vous livrez après la mise en production : monitoring, incidents, adoption.

Profil recherché

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous avez construit des applications avec un front end, un back end et des API, même si votre expertise est plus marquée d’un côté.

  2. Du code testé, relu et documenté, en Python, TypeScript ou dans un langage similaire.

  3. Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.

  4. Des besoins d’utilisateurs transformés en une première version, puis améliorée à partir de leurs retours.

  5. Le monitoring, les incidents et l’adoption font, pour vous, partie du métier.

  6. Une aisance à expliquer vos choix techniques à des personnes non techniques.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Une expérience de construction d’agents ou d’assistants au-dessus d’un LLM : appel d’outils, orchestration.

  • Une expérience de conception de parcours avec validation humaine (human-in-the-loop) ou d’interfaces d’IA.

  • Une expérience d’intégration à des logiciels métier, comme un ERP ou un CRM.

  • Une expérience au contact des clients.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Entre le produit, l’interface et le modèle, le Product Engineer occupe le point où l’IA rencontre ses utilisateurs. Leurs réactions s’observent directement, et chaque version livrée tient compte de ce que les usages ont révélé.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’apprend sur les projets : conception d’agents, évaluation par cas d’usage, expérience utilisateur de l’IA, avec l’appui des AI Engineers et de la communauté Product Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Product Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).

Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme le chapter AI Product Manager.

Processus de recrutement

Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.

  1. Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.

  2. Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance).

  3. Screening technique (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.

  4. Code review et live coding (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.

  5. Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.

  6. Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.

Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.

Rémunération : 60 000€ à 70 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + jusqu’à 6 000€ de variable selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.

Grâce à ses différentes entités expertes et sectorielles, Theodo aide ses clients à concevoir des produits innovants, à accélérer leur développement et à répondre à leurs enjeux stratégiques et opérationnels.

Contexte du recrutement

Dans un contexte de développement et de transformation continue, Theodo France doit poursuivre sa croissance, renforcer son excellence opérationnelle et assurer l’alignement entre ses ambitions stratégiques et leur mise en œuvre au quotidien.

Pour accompagner Noémie Parker dans le pilotage de ses priorités et le développement de Theodo France, nous recherchons un(e) Chief of Staff, véritable bras droit, capable de faire le lien entre la vision stratégique, les décisions de la direction et leur exécution opérationnelle.

Au plus près des enjeux de l’entreprise, tu travailleras sur des sujets transverses à fort impact, en interaction avec les équipes de direction et les responsables opérationnels.   • Préparer les supports de communication permettant de partager la vision, les priorités et les résultats avec l’ensemble des équipes.

3. Piloter les chantiers stratégiques et transverses

  • Identifier et structurer les projets prioritaires pour le développement de Theodo France.

  • Définir les objectifs, les indicateurs de suivi, les responsabilités et les échéances de chaque chantier.

  • Coordonner les parties prenantes et accompagner les responsables de projets dans leur exécution.

  • Suivre l’avancement des initiatives, identifier les risques et proposer des plans d’action correctifs.

Tes perspectives

En devenant Chief of Staff, tu seras au cœur des décisions et des enjeux de développement de Theodo France.

Tu développeras une compréhension approfondie du fonctionnement d’une entreprise technologique, de la définition de sa stratégie à son exécution opérationnelle. Tu travailleras directement avec la direction sur des problématiques variées, avec un niveau d’exposition élevé et une forte autonomie.

Ce poste te permettra de développer des compétences solides en stratégie, en pilotage de la performance, en gestion de projets complexes et en leadership transverse.

À terme, cette expérience pourra ouvrir la voie à des fonctions de direction opérationnelle, de direction de business unit ou à d’autres rôles de leadership au sein d’un environnement entrepreneurial.

Profil recherché

title: Chief of Staff & Operations
descriptionHtml:
About Agent F

Agent F is building an autonomous finance function: software that takes on the work of keeping a company’s finances in order. That means bringing information together from different systems, recording transactions correctly, preparing useful reports, and helping people understand what needs their attention.

Today, much of this work depends on spreadsheets, repeated data entry and people checking one system against another. Our ambition is to make that work increasingly automatic, while keeping every number explainable and every consequential action under clear control.

We are building towards a complete business management system for growing companies. This role will shape both the company and the way we work.

About the role

You will run the inside of Agent F. Projects get carried through end to end, the inbox and the follow-ups behind it get resolved, finance and administration simply work, and whatever can be automated internally gets automated, on our own technology wherever possible. The point is leverage: leadership stays on C-level sales, product, strategy and investors, and the company runs smoothly underneath.

This is an operating role with a lot of freedom. Some weeks the most important thing is a notary appointment, a filing deadline or a payment; other weeks it is a project that has stalled, a new hire who needs a proper first week, or a workflow that should never have needed a person in the first place. You decide what matters, you make it happen, and you make sure it does not come back.

You will also lay the foundation for what comes next. We expect to grow quickly. The processes, documentation and automations you build now are what let the company double without doubling its administration. Agent F is its own first customer: our finance operations should run on our product, and you will make sure they do.

What you will build and own

  • Project execution. Maintain the company project list. Every project has an owner, a next step and a date. Chase, unblock, close. Report weekly which projects are on track, at risk or done.

  • Inbox and follow-ups. Triage, prepare and resolve what lands with leadership. Track follow-ups across customers, investors, partners and providers so nothing stays open without an owner.

  • Finance operations. Monthly close inputs for the tax advisor, invoice flows, expense and card management, payroll inputs, cash reporting, VAT and filing deadlines. Automate these flows on our own stack first.

  • The second brain. Own the internal knowledge and workflow system and its AI agents. Every recurring task is automated or delegated before it gets a second owner.

  • Legal and admin operations. Contract templates and signatures, notary and registry processes, insurance, the compliance register, data-protection documentation. Work with external counsel; own the follow-through.

  • People operations. Assist in onboarding new hires, keep the hiring process running (scheduling, candidate communication, paperwork) and handle contracts and equity documentation.

  • Investor and board operations. Monthly updates, data room, KPI pack, meeting logistics; the numbers are ready on time.

For example, a new customer contract, a notary appointment for the GmbH and a VAT filing all land in the same week while the CEO is travelling. You would get the contract signed, the appointment prepared and the filing submitted, and then set up the workflow so that the next contract, appointment and filing need no one to chase them.

What you bring

You have five or more years in roles that combined operating responsibility with structure: startup operations, finance operations, consulting followed by an operating role, or a founder’s office in a scaling company. You have run a function end to end and can show processes that still work without you.

You can explain how you took a messy, recurring piece of work and made it disappear (through a process, a tool or an automation) and what it freed up. You are comfortable with numbers, contracts and tools, and you use AI tools to build automations as a matter of course.

Core experience

  • Operations or finance operations in a startup or scaling company, with end-to-end ownership of a function.

  • German administration and accounting: invoices, monthly close inputs, payroll inputs, VAT and filings, working with a tax advisor.

  • Project management across a company: owners, deadlines, status, escalation.

  • Building workflows and automations with modern tools and AI agents; documenting them so others can run them.

  • Working with external counsel, notaries, banks and providers; contracts and signatures.

  • Clear, short written communication in German and English.

Useful additional experience

Experience in a founder’s office or chief-of-staff role; investor reporting and data rooms; people operations and onboarding; experience with accounting or ERP software from the user side.

What early progress could look like

In your first months, you would take over the project list and the inbox, get the monthly finance operations running on a fixed rhythm, and automate the first two or three recurring flows. You would onboard the next hires and set up the hiring process so that it runs without leadership attention.

We would look for projects that close on time, an inbox with no orphaned items, filings and numbers delivered on schedule, and a growing list of work that no longer needs a person.

Operational excellence and customer commitments

You take pride in a company that runs smoothly. When something in operations needs a same-day answer (a payment, a filing, a signature, an escalation that landed with leadership), you handle it or find the person who can, and you stay on it until it is done.

Availability during travel and fundraising phases is part of the role. You keep people informed, close loops and improve the process afterwards so that the same situation needs less attention next time.

How you will work

This is a senior founding role reporting to the CEO, with the freedom to decide week by week what the inside of the company needs most. You will work with every function (sales, engineering, marketing) and with our external advisors and providers. You will use AI tools and our own product to automate your work and remain responsible for the result.

Everyone shares responsibility for the whole company and the customer outcome. You will pick up the most important work or whatever is on fire, including tasks outside your specialty. You take initiative, bring in the right expertise and stay involved until the problem is resolved. Customer impact and urgency determine where you focus.

The role is full-time and based in Berlin. We work from our offices in Neukölln and Mitte and expect regular presence there. Hybrid arrangements with regular days in the Berlin office are possible in exceptional cases. Fluent German is required.

Start a conversation

Tell us about a function you ran end to end and a piece of recurring work you made disappear. What did it look like before, what did you build, and what still runs without you today? A short written example is enough.

title: Complaints Team Lead - Cards
descriptionHtml:
About Zable

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

  • Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

  • The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

  • Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

  • Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

Join us if you want to

  • Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one

  • Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

That team will resolve complex vehicle complaints fairly, deliver good customer outcomes and drive process improvement, and you’ll champion a data-driven culture throughout.

Zable aims to resolve every complaint promptly, with a diligent and fair investigation for each customer. Feedback is central to how we evolve as a business and keep meeting our customers’ expectations. The team is encouraged to speak up, take each complaint on its own merits and share insights that help the business improve and grow.
Handling complaints well has never mattered more, for our customers and for us, as we grow our products in the UK.

How you’ll impact those objectives

  • Directly manage, support and develop a team of Complaints Officers handling motor finance complaints, making sure they meet individual and team KPIs to high standards in line with FCA regulations.

  • Act as the team’s subject matter expert on credit card complaints including PSD2 complaints.

  • Bring proven experience of fast-paced, evolving financial services environments: embracing ambiguity, managing multiple priorities and guiding your team through significant change.

  • Champion the use of AI models and data analytics within the team to allocate workloads, find efficiency opportunities and produce actionable insights.

  • Regularly review management information and team outputs, using data to monitor trends, flag issues early and drive continuous improvement in customer outcomes and operational processes.

  • Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration and professional development, coaching your team to use technology and new data sources to increase their impact.

  • Build strong relationships across Operations and Product so that feedback from your team turns into meaningful business change.

  • Embed robust quality assurance so your team makes consistent decisions and follows the right processes.

  • Take the lead on escalated or high-risk complaints, setting the standard for professionalism, communication and judgement.

  • Stay up to date with industry regulation (particularly FCA and DISP) and best practice, so your team operates with integrity and puts good customer outcomes first.

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Has successfully managed or led teams in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment, ideally in motor finance or wider regulated financial services.

  • Has hands-on experience of credit card or personal loans complaints handling as well as exposure to PSD2 complaints.

  • Has used AI models or data analytics to transform operational processes or improve performance.

  • Communicates with clarity, empathy and confidence, and can explain complex technical and regulatory concepts to customers and colleagues.

  • Has a keen eye for process improvement and a balanced approach to risk and compliance.

  • Has strong knowledge of FCA regulations and DISP complaint-handling standards.

If you’re passionate about people, technology and data-led change in a high-growth business, and you have experience handling card and/or loan complaints, we encourage you to apply.

title: Credit Analyst - German Speaking
descriptionHtml:
About Wayflyer

Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer.

Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan.

You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney.

The challenge

Our German market is growing and deal volume is growing with it. We need an analyst who can decide which businesses we fund, turning incomplete information into a clear fund or no-fund call. Some of that information will come from reps and customers.

What you'll actually do

  • Analyse financial and non-financial data on new and existing customers, and quantify the risks of running and funding an eCommerce business

  • Own the day-to-day relationship with our German-speaking sales and CS rep

  • Lead calls with German customers, acting as their trusted point of contact

  • Shadow customer calls at first, then lead them

  • Assess and structure loan opportunities across small, mid-market and enterprise deals, working with sales and operations

What this role could turn into

This is a growing market and you’ll grow with it. You’ll start by owning relationships with our German-speaking reps and shadowing customer calls. From there, this role can lead to:

  • Senior Credit Analyst for the German market, handling escalations and leading customer calls and complex deals

  • Mentoring and coaching new Analysts as the German underwriting team grows, and shaping how we underwrite the market

  • Portfolio management or wider credit risk, with direct exposure to senior leaders through our approval meetings

Who thrives here

You’re curious, high-agency and entrepreneurial. Maybe you’ve run a side business, started a run club or led a university society. You think in first principles, can simplify complex problems, and balance risk with growth. You’re articulate, detail-oriented and a self-starter. You’ll probably end up doing things that aren’t in this job description. That’s not a warning - it’s the point.

We hire for range

  • Fluent/Native German and English is required (note: these will be tested as part of the interview process)

Location and working policy

📍Berlin, Dublin or London. You’ll be in the office 4 days a week for your first 6 months, then it becomes flexible under our standard hybrid policy.

The good stuff

25 days off, plus public holidays. Private healthcare, life insurance, and a pension. Equity - because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want.

title: Customer Account Executive
descriptionHtml:

About Tailscale 

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

Join Tailscale’s growing Sales team and help existing customers get more value from our product.

As a Customer Account Executive, you will own the full sales cycle for expansion and renewal opportunities across a portfolio of existing customers—from account planning, prospecting and discovery through evaluation, negotiation and close. You will identify new use cases, build relationships with key stakeholders and help customers expand their adoption of Tailscale. This is a quota-carrying closing role for someone with previous full-cycle B2B SaaS sales experience. You will partner closely with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Support, Marketing and Product to deliver results for customers.

We’re a collaborative team with a wide variety of backgrounds. We coach each other, share feedback and support one another in achieving our goals while staying focused on our customers’ needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop a strong understanding of Tailscale, its use cases and the business value it delivers to customers.
  • Proactively build and qualify expansion pipeline within existing accounts by identifying new teams, stakeholders and use cases.
  • Own and deliver against an expansion and renewal quota across your customer portfolio.
  • Run the full sales cycle: lead discovery, coordinate technical evaluations with Solutions Engineering, communicate value, develop proposals, negotiate commercial terms and close agreements.
  • Balance near-term revenue delivery with consistent pipeline generation and timely renewal planning.
  • Maintain accurate opportunity records and provide reliable weekly forecasts, with clear next steps, close plans and visibility into risks.
  • Build mutual action plans with customers and partner with Customer Success and Solutions Engineering to support adoption, demonstrate value and drive expansion and renewals.

What We Are Looking For

  • 1+ years of quota-carrying, full-cycle B2B SaaS sales experience.

  • Experience selling developer or technical products, particularly in a product-led growth (PLG) environment.
  • Strong discovery, presentation and relationship-building skills, including experience engaging senior managers and executives.
  • A track record of meeting or exceeding sales quota and the ability to manage multiple opportunities at different stages of the sales cycle.
  • Proven pipeline management and forecasting discipline, with experience using a CRM and tools such as Gong to manage opportunities and collaborate internally.
  • Experience partnering with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success and Support to deliver positive customer outcomes.
  • A proactive, accountable approach to growing existing customer relationships, with the curiosity and initiative to uncover new opportunities in a high-growth software business.
  • This role is based in London and requires three days per week in the office.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

For this position, our pay ranges reflect target OTE (on target earnings), inclusive of base salary and variable compensation tied to the attainment of quarterly sales targets.

UK Pay Range (OTE)£118,500—£118,500 GBP

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities. 
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!

  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

title: Data Center Architect
descriptionHtml:
Role Profile

Job Title: Data Centre Architect

Reports to: Head of Data Centre Development

Location: UK hybrid

Company Overview:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we’re building this organisation from the ground up. We’re looking for people who’d rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of team you’ve previously managed.

This is a senior individual contributor role with authority to sign off technical schedules, working with cluster and network architects, NVIDIA and other OEM engineers, colocation provider engineering and sales teams, and the internal Procurement, Legal, Finance and Site Operations teams.

What You’ll Do

You will be the single technical authority between our GPU-as-a-service business and the colocation providers that host our NVIDIA clusters. You turn cluster architecture and OEM requirements into a precise, contractable statement of work (SOW) for the data centre white space, then hold the provider to it through design, installation and acceptance.

We are growing from tens of megawatts to hundreds, on rack-scale liquid-cooled platforms at 130 kW per rack and rising to 200 kW and beyond. Mistakes in power, cooling or fibre specification show up as stranded capacity, delayed cluster delivery and disputes, so the role carries real commercial weight.

Key Responsibilities

Technical negotiation with colocation providers

  • Lead technical due diligence on candidate sites: power availability and energisation dates, redundancy topology, liquid-cooling capability, floor loading, rack logistics, fibre and meet-me access.

  • Negotiate the technical schedules of the colocation agreement with commercial and legal: capacity and density commitments, power and cooling SLAs, temperature and flow envelopes, metering, expansion rights, change control and remedies.

  • Challenge provider claims with evidence: single-line diagrams, P&IDs, load-bank and commissioning records, reference customers.

Specification & SOW

  • Work with cluster architects and OEMs (NVIDIA first) to capture rack, power, cooling, network and layout requirements, and keep them current across product generations.

  • Write and own the technical SOW for white-space fitout: containment and cooling interfaces, power distribution to rack, structured cabling and pathways, rack and POD layout, security zoning, labelling and records.

  • Define clear scope boundaries and responsibilities between us, the colocation provider, OEMs and installation contractors, with no gaps and no overlaps.

  • Maintain a requirements baseline with traceability from OEM document, to SOW clause, to acceptance test.

Design, installation & acceptance

  • Review provider and contractor designs, shop drawings and method statements against the SOW; run design reviews and close findings.

  • Define acceptance: factory and site tests, liquid flush and cleanliness, power quality, thermal performance at full load, fibre loss, burn-in, and the evidence pack needed for each gate.

  • Attend key witness tests and sign off, or reject, completion of each phase before hardware is energised.

  • Manage technical change requests and variations, and advise on cost and schedule impact.

Knowledge & standards

  • Build reusable reference designs, SOW templates and a site-scoring framework so each new deployment starts from a proven baseline.

  • Track the roadmap: higher rack densities, 800 VDC distribution, new cooling classes and optics, and tell the business early what it means for sites already contracted.

Deliverables You Own:

  • Site technical assessment: Scored, evidence-based report per candidate site, comparable across providers, with risks and mitigations.

  • Technical schedules to the colocation agreement: Measurable commitments, tested in acceptance, with remedies agreed by legal.

  • Cluster white-space SOW: Complete enough that a contractor can price and build without asking us questions; traceable to OEM requirements.

  • Reference designs and layouts: Rack, row and POD layouts, power and cooling single-line and P&ID level interfaces, fibre pathways and densities.

  • Acceptance test plan and evidence pack: Pass and fail criteria set before work starts; signed results per gate.

  • Requirements baseline and change log: One current version of the truth, with every variation recorded and costed.

  • Risk and issues register: Technical risks to schedule and capacity, with owners and dates.

Working Relationships:

  • Cluster and network architects: You translate their cluster design into facility requirements, and they rely on you to say what a site can and cannot carry.

  • OEMs, mainly NVIDIA: You are the facility-side counterpart; you obtain, interpret and challenge site-requirement documents.

  • Colocation providers: Day-to-day technical counterpart through negotiation, build and acceptance.

  • Procurement, legal and finance: You provide the technical substance of commercial terms and the impact of variations.

  • Site operations and deployment teams: You hand over a clean specification and acceptance evidence, and take back lessons learned.

What You Bring:

  • 8 or more years in data centre design, delivery or technical consulting, including at least 3 years on high-density (50 kW per rack or more) or liquid-cooled deployments.

  • Direct experience writing or reviewing technical specifications and SOWs for white-space fitout, and managing contractors against them to acceptance.

  • Strong working knowledge of data centre power: MV and LV distribution, UPS and generator topologies, redundancy models (N+1, 2N, distributed), busway and rack power, metering and power quality.

  • Strong working knowledge of cooling: direct-to-chip liquid cooling, CDUs, facility and technology loops, warm-water and dry-cooler designs, fluid quality and flushing, leak detection and containment.

  • Working knowledge of structured cabling and pathways for large GPU fabrics (single-mode optics, high fibre counts, InfiniBand and Ethernet physical layers), and of rack and POD layouts.

  • Familiarity with NVIDIA rack-scale platforms (GB200 or GB300 class, or later) and their facility requirements, and the ability to read OEM site-requirement documents critically.

  • Proven ability to run technical negotiations with colocation or construction counterparties, and to explain trade-offs to commercial, legal and executive audiences.

  • Command of standards such as EN 50600 and the Uptime Tier framework, ASHRAE TC 9.9 liquid-cooling guidance, and commissioning practice (levels 1 to 5).

  • Excellent written communication: you produce clear, unambiguous contract-grade documents.

Preferred Skills (Nice to Have):

  • Experience at a hyperscaler, neocloud or colocation provider on the operator or customer side.

  • Experience with 800 VDC or other DC distribution, large battery storage, or power smoothing for AI load swings.

  • Chartered engineer status or equivalent; recognised data centre credentials (for example CDCP, CDFOM, Uptime ATD or AOS).

  • Familiarity with BIM, digital-twin tools and requirements-management tools.

  • Willingness to travel up to 30% to sites in the UK, Europe and the US.

Success Measures:

  • First 90 days: Audit current colocation contracts and SOWs and list technical gaps; publish a requirements baseline for the current NVIDIA platform; take over technical lead on one live negotiation; agree the site-scoring framework with the cluster architects.

  • 6 months: One complete SOW issued and priced with no material scope disputes; acceptance plan agreed with the provider before build starts; reusable SOW template adopted by the team.

  • 12 months: Every new site contracted on the template with traceable requirements; clusters accepted on schedule with no facility-caused performance issues; fewer late variations and a measurable cut in time from site shortlist to signed technical schedule.

Qualities we look for:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up.

  • Inspire the change: There’s no blueprint for the future. You’ll embrace challenges and change.

  • You’re real and you’re true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you’ll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you’re talking to, you treat everyone the same.

  • Get stuck in: You’d rather be building than overseeing. Our strategy will keep evolving, and so will you — attitude and adaptability matter more to us than a fixed playbook or a big team behind you.

Package & Process:

  • Employment type: Full-time, permanent.

  • Travel: Up to 30%.

  • Interview process:

    Talent Screening >Hiring Manager Screen > Technical Interview > Final with the Head of Data Centre Development.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all backgrounds.

descriptionHtml:
Jedes Team hat KI. Nur wenige haben sie gemeistert. Wir Menschen sind gemacht, uns anzupassen. Aber KI entwickelt sich so rasant, dass die meisten Belegschaften kaum noch Schritt halten.


Als Teil von Multiverse ist StackFuel Deutschlands führender Anbieter für Daten- und KI-Weiterbildung. 2017 in Berlin gegründet, haben wir bereits über 8.000 Absolvent:innen weitergebildet, mit einer Abschlussquote von über 90 % bei Unternehmen wie der Deutschen Bahn, Mercedes-Benz und Telefónica.

Seit 2026 gehören wir zu Multiverse und bauen gemeinsam den KI-Adoption-Layer für Europa auf: das fehlende Bindeglied zwischen den KI-Tools, in die Unternehmen investiert haben, und den Menschen, die sie im Arbeitsalltag nutzen sollen. Multiverse hat im April 2026 seine jüngste Finanzierungsrunde abgeschlossen und wird mit 2,1 Mrd. US-Dollar bewertet. Insgesamt haben wir über 500 Mio. US-Dollar von Investoren wie Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Schroders Capital und Lightspeed eingesammelt.

Wir wollen 100.000 Beschäftigte in Deutschland für das KI-Zeitalter weiterbilden: mit einem Team, das den deutschen Markt kennt, und einem starken Partner im Rücken, der uns Tempo ermöglicht.

Du willst mitgestalten, wie Deutschlands Arbeitswelt im KI-Zeitalter erfolgreich wird? Dann komm zu uns.

Darum geht's

Daten sind die Grundlage jeder guten KI, und gute Data-Skills sind knapp. Du änderst das. Als Data Learning Products Lead leitest du unser Trainingsportfolio im Bereich Data und führst das Team, das es entwickelt. Du bringst neue Programme von der Idee bis zum Launch und sorgst dafür, dass sie fachlich vorne liegen, didaktisch überzeugen und sich wirtschaftlich tragen.

Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Curriculum, Produktmanagement und fachlicher Führung. Eng zusammen arbeitest du mit Learning Content Engineers, Engineering, Sales, Marketing und der Geschäftsführung. Du bringst deine Fachperspektive in die Portfolio-Strategie ein und setzt sie mit deinem Team um. Außerdem gestaltest du mit, wie wir Lerninhalte künftig AI-gestützt und skalierbar produzieren.

Das bringst du mit

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium im MINT-Bereich (z. B. Informatik, Data Science, Ingenieurwesen) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Fundierte Expertise in Data und KI und ein gutes Gespür dafür, welche Trends relevant werden

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung technischer Trainings, Curricula oder Lernprodukte, gern im Tech- oder EdTech-Umfeld

  • Erfahrung im Produkt-, Curriculum- oder Projektmanagement, also im Planen und Priorisieren

  • Erste Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung von Teams oder in der Steuerung externer Expert:innen (Disziplinarische Führung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.)

  • Spaß an modernen Tools und Workflows, etwa Lernplattformen, Git oder AI-gestützten Produktionsprozessen

  • Analytische Stärke, Organisationstalent und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen klar zu vermitteln

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse

Das bieten wir Dir

 

Arbeitskultur
Dich erwartet eine lösungsorientierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, eine offene Feedbackkultur sowie ein starker Teamspirit. Zwei vom gesamten StackFuel-Team gewählte Trustees unterstützen Dich bei Fragen und Anliegen als neutrale, vertrauliche Anlaufstelle.

Ownership
Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit.

Wir arbeiten in einem hybriden Modell und sind üblicherweise 3 Tage pro Woche vor Ort in unserem Office in Berlin.

Raum für Austausch
Regelmäßiger Austausch im Team, saisonale Feiern und eine immer gut gefüllte Küche sorgen für ein lebendiges Miteinander.

If you are a Data Scientist who enjoys turning instrument data into proof of what is possible, why not join us in Abingdon, Oxfordshire, and help prove the analysis methods behind advanced semiconductor metrology systems.

We are looking for an ambitious and adaptable Data Scientist to join our new Data Science team in the Technology department, reporting to the Data Science Lead and working closely with our Modelling Scientist. You will generate and curate data, develop and test new algorithms, and benchmark them against what the instrument can physically deliver. When a method proves itself, you will package it for the Data Analysis team in Engineering, who turn it into robust product software. You will work with real customer use cases and wafer data from Applications Development, and proof-of-concept data from R&D.

We are an AI-first team, so you will use AI tools every day, while checking carefully what they produce. If your passion is speed, evidence and finding out what the data can really tell you, we’d love to hear from you.

What you’ll be doing

  • Generate synthetic data, and build and maintain the demo and performance data libraries
  • Analyse instrument data to quantify noise and limitations, and help establish the information limit, meaning what is physically extractable from the instrument
  • Develop and test new algorithms and analysis methods (for example PCA, percentile methods and machine learning) on real and synthetic data
  • Benchmark methods against the information limit: achievable performance, measurement uncertainty, gauge R&R and drift contributors
  • Write clean, reproducible prototype code with test data and expected performance, ready to hand over to Data Analysis, and build analysis tools used across the Technology department
  • Use AI tools every day to code, explore, analyse and report faster, verify what they produce, and present your results to the team

Education and experience

  • Degree or above in Physics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Engineering or a similar subject, or [2] years’ relevant experience in data science or quantitative research

Skills and experience we’re looking for:

  • Data analysis in Python (NumPy, SciPy, pandas, scikit-learn or similar)
  • Heavy, day-to-day use of AI tools in your technical work, such as coding assistants and LLMs, with the judgement to verify their outputs
  • Image or signal processing, ideally on data from scientific instruments
  • Statistics applied to measurement data: uncertainty, repeatability, noise and drift
  • Machine learning methods, and how to validate them properly
  • Clear, reproducible code and reports
  • Explaining results to technical and non-technical colleagues
  • Curious and adaptable, happy to work quickly and test ideas against the evidence

We’d love to see:

  • Atomic Force Microscopy or other nano-characterisation (SEM, FIB, profilometry), or semiconductor metrology
  • Physics-based modelling or simulation
  • Version control (Git) and C#, and experience building agentic or AI-assisted analysis workflows

A bit about us: 

Infinitesima is a privately owned company founded in 2001, as a spin-out of the University of Bristol, by CTO Professor Andrew Humphris. Our dynamic team of scientists and engineers is focussed on enabling the next generation of semiconductor devices through delivery of innovative products to customers around the world. 

Our strength lies in the varied perspectives that come from different cultures, experiences, and identities. We believe that true innovation is fuelled by collaboration, locally and globally. We strive to foster an environment where everyone can contribute meaningfully and thrive. If you require adjustments to take part in the recruitment process, please let us know, we’ll do our best to support you.

Your recruitment journey:

We will interview you: Monday to Friday UK Time 9am to 4.30pm and we'll be as flexible as we can with Global Scheduling

1st stage: (45 minute) Remote meeting to evaluate your experience and technical ability

2nd stage: (2.5 hours) Face to face onsite evaluating technical, presentation and communication skills along with your ways of working and your opportunity to to know more about us

If you're not comfortable with eye contact, let us know at the start of your interview and if REMOTE, once we've said hello, feel free to turn your camera off until the end.

We dress casually so informal attire is absolutely fine for onsite interviews. We want you to feel comfortable when you meet us and if there's anything else we can do to support your journey, just let us know. 

A note on how we use AI:
We use AI only to transcribe our interviews so we can focus fully on you instead of scribbling notes. The AI does not take part in any decision making at any stage. All hiring decisions are made by real humans based on the conversation we have with you.

Location and working pattern:
We recognise the value of flexibility and offer a hybrid working model wherever possible. Most employees work onsite three days per week, although some positions require a greater onsite presence due to the nature of the work and business need

Recruitment agencies: Infinitesima Ltd only works with approved agencies and does not accept unsolicited agency CVs. Please do not submit candidate details in response to this advert or solicit any Infinitesima Ltd employees. Infinitesima Ltd is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited CVs.

Ons data team groeit, en daarbij geloven we in één ding: de juiste persoon is belangrijker dan de juiste functietitel. Ben jij een echt datatalent? Dan maken we graag een plek voor je. Vertel ons waar jouw krachten liggen, dan kijken we samen hoe jij het beste tot je recht komt in ons team. ✈️

title: DevOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:
For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands.

About SkinVision

Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped nearly 3 million people worldwide detect early signs of skin cancer. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin spot assessments and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. High-risk cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need.

DevOps at SkinVision

As a DevOps Engineer at SkinVision, you will play a key role in building, scaling, and securing the infrastructure that powers our AI-driven health platform. You’ll design and maintain our cloud-based systems in AWS, implement CI/CD pipelines, enhance observability using Datadog, and drive operational excellence through automation and monitoring.

Your work will directly impact the reliability and scalability of a medical-grade system that serves users globally. You’ll collaborate closely with backend, ML, and product teams to ensure smooth delivery, rapid deployments, and resilient operations — ultimately enabling us to deliver life-saving technology with confidence.

Beyond hands-on expertise with AWS and modern DevOps tooling, we’re looking for someone who thinks architecturally. You’ll get to know our current setup, form your own view of how it should evolve, and help define a target vision for our infrastructure, then drive its implementation. Day-to-day operational work is part of the role, but we value someone who thinks before building and takes ownership of where our infrastructure goes next.

What you will do

Cloud Infrastructure & Automation

  • Design, build, and manage AWS-based infrastructure, ensuring high availability, scalability, and cost efficiency.

  • Implement and manage infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Terraform or CloudFormation.

  • Automate environment provisioning, configuration, and deployments using CI/CD pipelines.

  • Ensure system resilience, security, and performance through automated monitoring and alerting.

CI/CD & Deployment

  • Design and optimize CI/CD pipelines to support rapid, reliable, and safe deployments across environments.

  • Manage deployment workflows using Argo CD and Kubernetes.

  • Collaborate with developers and ML engineers to streamline build, test, and release processes.

  • Integrate automated testing, rollback strategies, and version control into the deployment lifecycle.

Observability & Monitoring

  • Build a comprehensive observability stack using Datadog for metrics, logs, traces, and alerts.

  • Define service-level objectives (SLOs), service-level indicators (SLIs), and dashboards for system performance.

  • Proactively detect and resolve performance bottlenecks, capacity issues, and reliability risks.

  • Create automated health checks and ensure visibility across production systems.

Security & Compliance

  • Implement security best practices for AWS, containers, and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Manage identity, access, and secret handling (IAM, Secrets Manager, Parameter Store).

  • Ensure compliance with medical device standards and data privacy regulations (GDPR, HIPAA).

  • Partner with the Information Security Officer to embed security controls across infrastructure and deployments.

Reliability & Incident Management

  • Lead incident response and root cause analysis for infrastructure or deployment-related issues.

  • Establish SLAs and operational runbooks for production environments.

  • Continuously improve system reliability through chaos testing, redundancy, and fault tolerance.

  • Mentor engineers on DevOps principles, observability practices, and infrastructure automation.

Infrastructure Strategy & Architecture

  • Assess the current infrastructure and deployment setup, and form a well-reasoned view of how it should evolve.

  • Define and maintain a target architecture for our cloud platform, balancing reliability, scalability, security, and cost.

  • Translate the target vision into a practical roadmap and drive its implementation incrementally, alongside day-to-day operations.

  • Document and communicate architectural decisions, aligning with engineering and leadership on technical direction.


Essential skills

  • Minimum of 6 years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Cloud Infrastructure roles.

  • Strong expertise with AWS services (EC2, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, Lambda, etc.).

  • Expert in Kubernetes and Argo CD, deploying and managing production-grade custom Helm charts with secure, automated GitOps workflows in EKS

  • Advanced knowledge of CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar).

  • Proficiency in Datadog for observability, monitoring, and alerting.

  • Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, Bash, or Go.

  • Experience managing infrastructure with Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible.

  • Familiarity with networking fundamentals, load balancing, and API gateway configuration.

  • Excellent problem-solving and incident management skills.

Desirable skills

  • Experience in regulated industries such as healthcare, MedTech, or FinTech.

  • Familiarity with multi-environment architecture (staging, pre-prod, production) and blue-green deployments.

  • Exposure to event-driven systems, message queues, and data streaming (Kafka, SNS/SQS).

  • Understanding of Zero Trust networking and cloud security best practices.

  • Experience in cost optimization and performance tuning in AWS.

Qualifications

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

  • Certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), or Terraform Associate are a plus.

What we offer

  • A competitive salary, additional benefits, and a hybrid working policy

  • A vibrant, dynamic, and rapidly growing scale-up in Amsterdam

  • An enthusiastic, professional, and international team

  • Regular team events, including off-sites and fun activities

  • Unlimited skin checks for you

title: DevOps/Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to own the infrastructure under a health-tech operation that touches hundreds of thousands of lives? This is a dedicated infrastructure, security, and platform role, and there's a lot of ground to claim. Right now a handful of engineers keep the whole stack running between them. Your job is to turn that into something that runs and scales on purpose, and to make it more secure while you do. The more reliable we are, the more people we help lead healthier, happier lives.

About Wellis

Wellis is a fast-growing healthtech scale-up reinventing healthcare. We are building the first truly integrated health platform in the Netherlands, offering on-demand care for everyday health needs such as weight loss, hair loss, sexual health, and more. Our platform covers the full journey: from diagnosis and medical assessment to prescription and delivery at home. By combining medical expertise, technology, and data, we make healthcare smarter, more accessible, more personal, and easier to use. We are growing quickly, which means we are building the structures, teams, products, and processes that will help us scale responsibly. You will join an ambitious, international team where ownership is encouraged, collaboration is key, and impact is visible from day one.

The Role

You won't inherit a mature platform team here. You'll help build one. Our services already run across more than one cloud, most provisioning still happens by hand, and we have very little visibility into what's actually going on in production. Fixing that is the job: bringing order, portability, and security to all of it, and doing it the way our engineering team already works, which is agent-first.

The role covers three areas, and we mean all three. On infrastructure, you'll own how and where we run. We want managed services that stay portable, so we can pick up a workload and move it between GCP, AWS, or anywhere else without rewriting it. On security, you'll own access provisioning, database security, secrets, and the controls a company handling patient data has to get right. On IT and platform admin, you'll own onboarding, offboarding, team access, and tooling: the unglamorous plumbing that keeps a growing team moving.

What ties the three together is automation. We're not looking for someone to click through consoles all day. We're looking for someone who builds the systems and agents that make provisioning, deployment, and access self-serve.

We're an AI-native engineering team. Agentic coding tools are how we work, and infrastructure is no exception. Think Terraform written and reviewed with an agent, runbooks that are actually scripts, an access request that a workflow fulfills on its own. You'll bring that habit to a corner of the company that usually gets it last.

What You'll Own

  • Provider-agnostic infrastructure. Define our infra as code so it's reproducible and portable. Containerize workloads, standardize how services get deployed, and keep us free to move between clouds instead of locked into one. Today we run across more than one provider mostly by accident. You'll make it a choice.

  • CI/CD and release engineering. Build the pipelines that take code from merge to production safely: automated, repeatable, with the guardrails that let a small team ship often without breaking things.

  • Observability and reliability. We have almost no monitoring, alerting, or error tracking today. You'll build the visibility layer from scratch, from metrics and logs through tracing, uptime, and the basics of on-call, so we catch problems before customers do.

  • Security and access. Own IAM and least-privilege access across our systems, plus database hardening, secrets management, and the audit trails a regulated healthcare business needs. Access for people and services should be controlled and reviewable, never handed out ad hoc.

  • Team provisioning and IT admin, automated. Onboarding, offboarding, accounts, and tooling access, built as workflows and agents rather than a ticket queue. When someone joins or leaves, the right things should happen without a person doing them by hand.

  • Infrastructure agents and tooling. Build the skills, scripts, and agent workflows that let the whole team self-serve infra and access. This is the leverage that lets a small team run like a bigger one.

What we offer

  • Salary range €5,500 – €8,000 gross per month, depending on experience, plus 8% holiday allowance

  • Pension plan

  • Learning budget

  • Monthly personal budget (Alleo)

  • Hybrid working: partly from our new office in central Rotterdam (2 days)

  • 20 days of remote working per year

  • Working from home allowance (2 days a week)

  • 25 holidays

  • A culture of short lines, speed, and continuous improvement, where pragmatism and impact matter

  • The chance to build a healthtech scale-up's entire infrastructure and security foundation from the ground up


Essential

  • 3+ years of professional DevOps, platform, SRE, or infrastructure engineering. You've owned production infrastructure, not just touched it. Fundamentals matter more than years here: what happens on deploy, how to recover, how to keep it running.

  • Infrastructure as code, done properly. Terraform, Pulumi, OpenTofu, or equivalent. You provision through version control, not a console, and you know why that discipline matters.

  • Cloud, with an eye on portability. Real experience with at least one major cloud (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and the container tooling (Docker, plus Kubernetes or a managed equivalent) that keeps workloads movable. You've thought about lock-in and how to avoid it.

  • CI/CD ownership. You've built and maintained pipelines that other engineers depend on, with the automated checks and rollbacks that make frequent deploys safe.

  • Security fundamentals. IAM and access control, secrets management, network basics, and database security. You know how to give people and services exactly the access they need and nothing more.

  • Agentic AI development is how you work. You spend a real part of your day in tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Pi, or opencode, and you point them at infrastructure and ops, not just app code. Given a repetitive task, your instinct is to automate it.

  • You've felt the pain. A migration that locked a table, a deploy that took down an endpoint, an access mistake you had to clean up at 2am. You owned it, fixed it, and built the guardrail so it couldn't happen twice.

Nice to Have

  • Building agents and agentic workflows, not just using them: plugins, skills, or custom automations that made infra or ops better for a team.

  • Experience with regulated or sensitive data (healthcare, financial services, government). You know why 'move fast and break things' has no place near patient data.

  • Observability tooling stood up from scratch: Sentry, Prometheus and Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, or similar.

  • IT administration at a growing company: SSO and identity providers, device and access lifecycle, automated on and offboarding.

  • Audit logging and compliance in regulated environments (NEN 7513, GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC 2, or similar).

  • Running Supabase, Postgres, or serverless and edge platforms (Cloud Run, edge functions) in production.

  • Multi-cloud or cloud-migration experience, meaning you've moved real workloads between providers.

  • Dutch and/or German (business English is the working language).

Who You Are

  • You take ownership from provisioning through deployment through monitoring, right up to the 2am page.

  • You automate by instinct. Do something twice by hand and you're already writing the thing that does it for you.

  • You're comfortable being the first and only person in your domain, making decisions that carry weight, with no team to hide behind yet.

  • You treat security as the default. You handle access and data like someone's health depends on it, because it does.

  • You work fast and stay careful.

With Your Application

Alongside your CV, share a transcript or a detailed walkthrough of the most interesting agentic session you've had recently, one where the agent did real infrastructure, ops, or automation work. Provisioning, a pipeline, a migration, an access workflow, whatever it was. Tell us what you were building, how you steered the agent, and what you'd do differently. We'd rather read that than a cover letter.

Hiring Process

  • We want the application process at Wellis to be fast, transparent, and personal.

  • Introductory chat with Georgios (Senior Recruiter)

  • Introductory interview with the CTO. Come ready to talk about a production incident you owned: what broke, what you did, what changed afterwards.

  • Technical assessment with the CTO

title: Director, Data Science and Solutions, UK
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

3753 - Director, Data Science and Solutions, UK

Role Summary and Impact 

Practice Overview 

WPP Media Data, Tech & Analytics is WPP’s data, analytics, and technology services division. We’re on a mission to transform marketing by leveraging the fastest, most connected data platform that bridges marketing strategy to scaled activation.  

Our team works with agencies and clients to transform the value of data by bringing together technology, data and analytics capabilities. We deliver this through analytically minded people leveraging AI and tech to drive real business change for our clients. We’re endlessly curious. Our team of analytical thinkers, builders, creators and problem solvers are over 1,000 strong, across 20 markets around the world. Within our UK Data, Tech and Analytics team we host three core practices – Modelling Services, Applied Analytics and Data Science and Solutions. 

The Data Science & Solutions practice is the innovation engine and technical accelerator for WPP Media Data, Tech & Analytics Division in the UK. We bridge advanced data science, artificial intelligence, and software engineering to solve high-value client challenges and supercharge agency capabilities. The practice operates at the intersection of technical innovation and commercial media application—incubating proprietary analytical tools, advancing AI adoption, and delivering specialised machine learning models that go beyond traditional econometrics. We strive to be the benchmark for intelligent, ethical and commercially transformative decisioning through applied data science.

Team Summary and Remit 

Sitting alongside Modelling Services and Applied Analytics within our 120-strong UK Analytics organisation, the Data Science & Solutions team has two core mandates: 

  • Advanced Tool & Solution Development: Designing, engineering, and productising bespoke analytical applications, automation pipelines, and AI-enabled tools that elevate the speed, sophistication, and efficiency of our wider Modelling and Applied Analytics teams. 
  • Specialised Modelling & Advanced Analytics (Role Focus): Delivering high-impact data science assignments requiring techniques beyond the core scope of Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM), such as customer lifetime value (CLV), propensity and churn modelling, advanced incrementality algorithms, and price elasticity. 

This Director role will focus on the second of the two above – Specialised Modelling and Advanced Analytics, helping to enhance the implementation of our internal solutions related to this. Our other director's remit sits in the first area of mandates. There is of course collaboration – but we are looking for someone to bring expertise in the second mandate of the team. 

These mandates are delivered in line with our principles – Value, Scale and Innovation. Turning complex data signals into undeniable business growth for our clients. Being trusted co-pilots who make solutions scalable, interpretable and actionable. Working in a high trust, high impact environment where innovation yields measurable consequence. 

Summary of Role Responsibilities 

As Director, Data Science and Solutions, UK, your core mandate is to Execute Strategy at Scale - specifically driving our implementation of Advanced Analytics Data Science solutions across the UK. You will translate practice strategy set by the VP and functional leadership into measurable operational outcomes and delivery excellence across significant client portfolios. You are accountable for overseeing programme delivery, driving operational optimisation, and managing team structures that deliver robust, production-grade analytics. 

Strategic Execution & Technical Leadership 

  • Operational Planning: Translate practice strategy and data science roadmaps into actionable, short-to-mid-term operational plans (<1 year) across client accounts. 
  • Technical Excellence: Enforce technical excellence and operational standards across all client deliverables, including causal impact analysis, Bayesian econometrics, predictive propensity modelling, and geospatial segmentation. 
  • Engineering & Governance: Champion rigorous engineering and governance practices across the team: clean code, GitHub project management, reproducibility, data privacy, and ethical AI compliance. 
  • Media Strategy Integration: Bridge advanced data science capability with client-facing media strategy, directly demonstrating how predictive modelling optimizes planning, budget allocation, and activation. 

Programme Delivery & Client Integration 

  • Complex Programme Delivery: Direct and oversee large, complex client delivery workstreams, ensuring solutions are robust, delivered within scope and timeline, and embedded directly into media activation workflows and WPP Open tools. 
  • Senior Client Partnership: Act as a trusted technical and strategic partner for senior client stakeholders (Heads of Analytics, Marketing Directors, Performance Leads), interpreting complex data science outputs into clear commercial recommendations. 
  • Cross-Functional Integration: Partner with Agency Planning, Client Leadership, and Data Strategy teams to embed advanced data science solutions (e.g., headroom analysis, automated audience generation) into day-to-day media operations. 

People & Operational Management 

  • People Leadership & Development: Line manage and mentor Associate Directors and Managers, fostering technical growth, high-performance delivery, and structured career progression. 
  • Resource & Capacity Management: Manage resource allocation, capacity planning, and billable utilization across your assigned portfolio, identifying staffing requirements and technical capability gaps. 
  • Commercial & Cost Governance: Partner with the VP to monitor project scopes, manage cloud computing/infrastructure costs, and support accurate revenue forecasting. 

Skills and Experience 

Must Have

  • Marketing, Media Planning & Activation Cycle: Understanding across the modern media cycle, demonstrating how data science models directly inform insight generation, audience discovery, cross-channel budget optimization, and live activation. 
  • Operational & Programme Leadership: Proven track record managing multi-disciplinary delivery teams and leading managers/specialists within a media agency, management consultancy, or tech-enabled enterprise. 
  • Advanced Technical Mastery: Comprehensive hands-on and architectural understanding of statistical modelling, audience propensity models, inference, regression/econometric frameworks, classification/clustering algorithms, and ML pipelines (Python, SQL, Git). 
  • Stakeholder Translation: Demonstrated ability to communicate highly sophisticated mathematical and technical concepts clearly to non-technical executive stakeholders and commercial partners. 
  • Delivery Governance: Experience managing project scope, milestones, cloud infrastructure expenditure, and cross-functional project teams. 
  • Experience: Typically requires a University Degree (STEM or quantitative field preferred) or equivalent experience, with 10+ years of progressive professional and technical leadership experience. 

Nice to Haves 

  • Experience operationalizing data products or custom algorithms within cloud environments (GCP, AWS, Azure). 
  • Familiarity with agentic workflows, LLM orchestration, and modern data platforms (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks).

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. 

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. 

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.  Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.

Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location

While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.
