title: Director, Fraud Risk
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

About the Role

As Director, Fraud, you will lead Airwallex’s First Line of Defence (1LoD) Fraud function. You will own the design, execution, and continuous optimization of our global fraud strategy, policies, detection systems, and operational workflows across Airwallex’s financial infrastructure. In this role, you will lead a high-performing team responsible for stopping fraud in real time while keeping friction low for legitimate, high-growth global businesses. Airwallex processes billions in cross-border payments, multi-currency corporate cards, merchant acquiring, and embedded finance products. You and your team will directly defend our ecosystem against card fraud, account takeover (ATO), merchant bust-out, payment scams, and synthetic identities.

You will partner directly with Engineering, Data Science, Product, Legal, and Compliance and interface closely with Second Line Risk to build and operate scalable, AI-native fraud detection models, effective triaging processes and operational guardrails.

What You’ll Do

  • Define & Execute 1LoD Global Fraud Strategy: Direct and build out the operational fraud strategy across all Airwallex products (Global Accounts, FX, Acquiring, Cards, and Embedded Finance / BaaS). Translate enterprise risk appetite set by the board and 2LoD Risk into actionable rules, detection logic, operational policies, and loss-prevention workflows.

  • Lead & Scale the 1LoD Fraud Team: Build, lead, and mentor a world-class team of fraud strategists, analysts, and operations specialists responsible for rule writing, alert triage, incident response, and dispute operations.

  • Optimize Risk vs. Conversion: Own and execute real-time fraud decisioning rules, loss-mitigation frameworks, and chargeback monitoring programs. Drive precision in risk controls to reduce fraud losses without introducing unnecessary friction for legitimate customers.

  • Drive Product & AI/ML Execution: Co-own the fraud product roadmap with Data Science and ML Engineering teams. Directly inform and test next-generation models for real-time transaction monitoring, device fingerprinting, behavioral biometrics, and anomaly detection.

  • Own Partner & Scheme Operational Compliance: Ensure operational adherence to fraud rules, monitoring programs, and threshold limits established by card schemes (Visa, Mastercard, local schemes), banking partners, and regulators across all active markets.

  • Incident Management & Root Cause Remediation: Lead real-time response to complex or high-value fraud incidents. Conduct post-mortems, deploy immediate policy/rule fixes, and implement long-term structural remediations.

  • Metrics & Loss Budget Ownership: Own operational KPIs, fraud loss performance against targets, False Positive Rates (FPR), triage SLAs, and chargeback recovery rates. Serve as the primary operational presenter on 1LoD performance to risk committees and leadership.

Essentials

  • 10+ years of hands-on Fraud Management experience in fintech, payment processing, acquiring, or modern banking infrastructure, with direct experience leading operational 1LoD teams and holding loss budget accountability.

  • People Leadership: Proven track record of scaling, mentoring, and directing high-performing strategy and operational fraud teams in fast-paced environments.

  • Deep Domain Expertise: Comprehensive operational knowledge of merchant acquiring fraud, card issuing fraud, CNP chargebacks, account takeover (ATO), and cross-border payment typologies.

  • Card Scheme Mastery: Deep practical expertise in Visa/Mastercard dispute management, scheme monitoring programs (e.g., VFMP, VAMP, ECM), and payment gateway risk mechanics.

  • Data & Technical Fluency: Hands-on experience working directly with complex data environments and decision engine tooling (SQL, Python/R, real-time risk platforms, rule engines).

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Demonstrated ability to drive operational execution across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Legal, 2LoD Risk, and external banking partners.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Director, International Delivery Management - Professional Services
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

Elastic is looking for an exceptional delivery consulting leader — someone who has built and run international delivery organisations, understands how to drive bookings growth and revenue expansion inside complex enterprise accounts, and can operate at the highest levels of client engagement while simultaneously leading and transforming a mid-sized, globally distributed team.

You will own the international Delivery Management function across Elastic Professional Services — leading the team, driving the transformation, and acting as the senior client presence on our most strategic engagements. You will be accountable for both the operational health of the delivery organisation and the commercial outcomes it generates: bookings, revenue, and margin across EMEA and APJ.

Delivery excellence is your foundation. Commercial growth is your north star. Building the team that industrialises both — and equips it for an AI-enabled future — is your legacy.

What You Will Be Doing 

International Delivery Organisation — EMEA & APJ

▸  Own and lead the international Delivery Management function  a team of ~15 Delivery Managers today, distributed across global delivery hubs in EMEA and APJ — with a clear mandate and expectation to scale substantially through 2027 and 2028 as the practice grows and demand accelerates across both regions.

▸  Drive a team transformation — reframing how Delivery Managers operate, shifting from project execution to outcome-led consulting, equipping the team to hold more strategic client conversations and drive greater account value.

▸  Champion and drive the adoption of Fixed Price engagement models  leading the organisation through the commercial, contractual, and delivery discipline required to scope, price, and execute fixed-price engagements with confidence, especially with platform migrations — protecting margin while driving predictable, high-quality client outcomes.

▸  Build a dual-mode delivery capability that operates with excellence across two distinct motions:

①  Packaged Solutions  —  fast, repeatable, industrialised delivery of high-value outcome-based offerings at scale — anchored in Fixed Price commercial models.

②  Transformative Engagements  —  large, complex migrations and solution delivery that require senior delivery governance, deep client partnership, and adaptive programme leadership.

▸  Lead the integration of AI into the Delivery Management function  identifying and embedding AI-powered tools and practices that improve team productivity, sharpen delivery insight, and — critically — enrich the client experience by enabling more proactive, personalised, and higher-value engagement throughout the delivery lifecycle.

▸  Design and embed delivery standards, frameworks, and tooling — including AI-augmented capabilities — that enable the team to scale both delivery modes without sacrificing quality or client outcomes.

▸  Act as a player-coach — maintaining direct governance oversight on the most complex or at-risk international engagements, intervening and course-correcting where needed.

▸  Build a coaching and development culture within the team — raising the floor on delivery craft and the ceiling on consulting commerciality across every region working closely with the Regional Services Directors, to generate new opportunities on the back of outstanding delivery. 

Financial Leadership & Commercial Growth

▸  Own financial accountability across the international delivery portfolio  driving consulting bookings growth from delivery, maximising revenue realisation from engagements, and actively improving delivery margin through disciplined engagement management, Fixed Price adoption, and commercial rigour.

▸  Grow the consulting footprint within a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts across EMEA and APJ, driving land-and-expand value outcomes in close partnership with regional Sales organisations.

▸  Build and sustain C-level and VP-level executive relationships that extend beyond the project — becoming the trusted advisor clients return to for their most important decisions.

▸  Develop compelling value narratives that articulate the value of engaging Elastic's consulting services, influencing renewal, expansion, and new commercial commitments.

▸  Partner with Regional Services Directors on pipeline development — acting as a senior consulting delivery voice in pre-sales conversations, solution framing, and commercial structuring including Fixed Price proposals.

Cross-Functional & Organisational Impact

▸  Serve as the connective tissue between Consulting, Sales, Customer Success, and Product when driving an engagement — ensuring a unified client experience and shared accountability for outcomes across EMEA and APJ.

▸  Contribute to the evolution of Elastic's delivery consulting go-to-market: methodology design, packaged solution development, delivery model innovation, AI-enabled tooling, and commercial frameworks.

▸  Represent Elastic Professional Services at the senior leadership level — internally and externally — with the credibility and presence to influence how the organisation grows internationally.

What You Bring 

▸  International enterprise leadership  Proven track record building and leading delivery teams across EMEA and/or APJ. You understand how regional culture, client expectations, and hub-based delivery dynamics shape outcomes.

▸  Fixed Price engagement expertise  You have designed, sold, and delivered Fixed Price consulting engagements at scale. You understand the scoping rigour, risk management, and delivery discipline required to make this model work — and you have driven its adoption across a delivery organisation.

▸  Financial accountability  You have owned a P&L or delivery portfolio with direct accountability for bookings, revenue, and margin — and you have a track record of improving all three.

▸  Dual-mode delivery experience  You have designed and operated delivery models that handle both high-velocity repeatable engagements and complex, multi-stakeholder transformations — simultaneously.

▸  AI fluency in a delivery context  You have a clear point of view on how AI can transform delivery management and client engagement — and you have practical experience applying AI tools to improve team effectiveness, delivery quality, or customer outcomes.

▸  Commercial acumen  You have expanded client accounts, shaped SOWs, and driven revenue growth from within a delivery or consulting organisation. You know how value conversations are won.

▸  Executive presence  You are credible at the C-suite level across multiple geographies. You have built relationships that outlast individual projects and turned delivery success into long-term strategic partnership.

▸  People leadership at scale  You have led and transformed mid-to-large delivery teams, building coaching cultures that raise performance and commerciality across a distributed, multi-timezone workforce.

▸  12+ years  in management consulting, professional services, or enterprise SaaS delivery leadership — with meaningful time spent in both client-facing growth roles and people/org leadership.

Bonus Points 

▸  Experience industrialising packaged service offerings — creating repeatable, Fixed Price delivery motions from complex, bespoke prior engagements.

▸  Hands-on experience deploying AI tools within a professional services or consulting delivery environment.

▸  Background spanning pre-sales/solutioning and post-sales delivery — the full consulting lifecycle.

▸  Experience with enterprise SaaS platforms (e.g. Elastic, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Databricks) in a consulting or professional services capacity.

▸  Agile and hybrid delivery framework fluency in complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise environments, but with extensive experience of platform migrations / tools consolidation.

▸  Certifications (PMP, CSM, or equivalent) are valued, though leadership track record and client outcomes matter more.

Elastic's Professional Services organisation is at an inflection point internationally. We are scaling a delivery team across EMEA and APJ — with significant headcount growth expected through 2027 and 2028 — building a dual-mode delivery capability, shifting to Fixed Price engagement models, embedding AI into how we deliver and engage clients, and growing a client base that demands senior, outcome-focused leadership. All at once.

This role carries real financial weight and a real transformation mandate. You will have the authority to reshape how an international team operates, the commercial platform to build lasting client partnerships across two major regions, and the executive visibility to influence how Elastic goes to market with its consulting capability globally.

If you have built delivery organisations, owned the numbers, led through transformation, embraced AI as a genuine force multiplier, and made Fixed Price work where others haven't — and you are looking for a role where all of it matters — this is it.

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

  • Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
  • Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
  • Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
  • Generous number of vacation days each year
  • Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
  • Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
  • Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. title: Director of Sales, RM, Switzerland
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT SOTHEBY'S

Established in 1744, Sotheby’s promotes access and ownership of exceptional art and luxury objects through auctions, private sales and retail. Our deep expertise across 70 selling categories is supported by a leading technology platform and a global network of specialists spanning 40 countries. Selling categories include Contemporary Art, Modern and Impressionist Art, Old Masters, Chinese Works of Art, Jewelry, Watches, Wine and Spirits and Design, as well as collectible cars and real estate through RM Sotheby’s and Concierge. Sotheby’s Financial Services is a leading art lender and provides capital solutions for collectors around the world, having originated more than $12 billion in loans since its inception. Sotheby’s new global headquarters is now open at the iconic Breuer building at 945 Madison Avenue in New York City.

ABOUT RM SOTHEBY’S

RM Sotheby’s is the world's leading collector car auction house, specializing in the sale of the world's most exceptional automobiles. With a global presence and a reputation built on expertise, integrity, and unparalleled client service, RM Sotheby’s has established itself as a trusted leader in the international collector car market.

Beyond its renowned live auctions, RM Sotheby’s offers clients exclusive opportunities to buy and sell through RM Sotheby’s Sealed, an innovative and discreet auction platform, and Private Sales, providing a personalized, confidential approach to buying and selling extraordinary automobiles through private treaty transactions.

Our global team of specialists and professionals works closely with collectors, enthusiasts, and industry leaders to deliver extraordinary experiences and results. We offer a dynamic, collaborative environment where individuals have the opportunity to build meaningful careers in the exciting world of collector automobiles.

THE ROLE

The Director of Sales, Switzerland will lead and grow RM Sotheby's business in Switzerland and the neighbouring DACH markets, across both Auctions and Private Sales. Reporting to the Managing Director, they will build deep, trusted networks among Swiss collectors, family offices, private banks and wealth managers, and lead client adoption of Sealed in Switzerland. They will work on the development of the Swiss team, collaborate with other Sotheby’s categories and the wider European team to give clients a seamless service across the region. They will also work on our Swiss auctions, supporting consignments, client development and sale delivery for RM Sotheby's auctions in Switzerland alongside Private Sales and Sealed. 

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build lasting and trusted relationships with clients based on collector car expertise and quality advice.
  • Work with the Managing Director and leadership team to lead and grow revenue and infrastructure in Switzerland and the neighbouring DACH markets.
  • Build and maintain strong networks with Swiss collectors, family offices, private banks, wealth managers and their advisers.
  • Work with the Managing Director to lead the client adoption and expansion of the Sealed business in Switzerland.
  • Work closely with Sotheby's luxury division in Switzerland to identify opportunities for collaboration and client development.

title: Director/Senior Director, EMEA Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) Leader
descriptionHtml:
Scholar Rock is delivering muscle-targeted breakthroughs to transform the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and other rare neuromuscular diseases where muscle atrophy remains a critical unmet need.

As a global leader in myostatin biology, a field focused on proteins that regulate muscle mass, the biopharmaceutical company is named for the visual resemblance of a scholar rock to protein structures. Our commitment to unlock fundamentally different treatment approaches is powered by broad application of a proprietary platform, which has developed novel monoclonal antibodies to modulate protein growth factors with extraordinary selectivity. Scholar Rock works every day to create new possibilities for patients through its highly innovative anti-myostatin program, including opportunities in additional rare neuromuscular diseases. Learn more about our neuromuscular franchise at ScholarRock.com and follow @ScholarRock on X and on LinkedIn.

Summary of Position:

The Director/Senior Director, EMEA Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) Leader, reporting to the Vice President Global Medical Affairs, will lead the development and execution of the go-to market strategy and deliverables to support value of apitegromab as well as the clinical stage Scholar Rock portfolio, in close partnership with the cross-functional matrix team.

This individual will serve as the strategic leader and subject matter expert for EMEA HEOR, responsible for country-level budget impact and cost-effectiveness model adaptations, evidence generation plans, and value communications required to support the national health technology assessment (HTA), payer dossiers, EU Joint Clinical Assessment (JCA), and reimbursement negotiations of Scholar Rock treatments. The role requires strong strategic leadership and cross-functional collaboration with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Commercial, Clinical Development and the regional teams in EMEA to optimize access and reimbursement for patients worldwide.

The successful candidate will develop strategic partnerships and research collaborations with external experts, healthcare policymakers, payers and various academic centers to support the strategy for apitegromab and future products.


Position Responsibilities
  • Develop HEOR strategies for EMEA, with an emphasis on Europe, that support product value demonstration, reimbursement, market access, and launch objectives.
  • Lead the design, implementation, and oversight of HEOR studies, models, and deliverables for Europe.
  • Collaborate with Medical, Market Access, and Biostatistics to determine real-world evidence needs for payers in Europe—including registries, natural history and external control analyses, burden of illness, treatment patterns, resource use, and addressing evidence requirements arising in HTA appraisal and reimbursement negotiations.
  • Incorporate evidence gaps needed for European payers into evidence generation plans
  • Direct evidence synthesis and value communication for payer and HTA bodies.
  • Serve as Europe HEOR partner to Europe Market Access for access and reimbursement dossiers by providing country-specific adaptations of models, methodology guidance, and scientific reviews that support country-level deliverables.
  • Own the HEOR deliverables for timely submissions to EU JCA, including PICO-driven evidence planning and comparative effectiveness analyses.
  • Work closely across Global HEOR and cross-functional teams to inform endpoint, patient-reported outcome, and utility data collection strategy for clinical development programs so that trials generate evidence acceptable to payers and HTA bodies.
  • Manage external HEOR vendors, budgets, and contracts, ensuring quality and timely delivery across competing priorities.
  • Translate complex HEOR outputs and requirements into plain-language value narratives for internal leadership and external payers.

    • Candidate Requirements
  • Graduate degree in health economics, epidemiology, health services research, or another research-focused public health discipline
  • 8+ years of HEOR experience with an MSc/MPH, or 5+ years with a PhD
  • Extensive experience leading HEOR evidence generation to support HTA submissions across multiple markets in Europe
  • Direct experience engaging with HTA organizations in Europe
  • Working knowledge of EU HTA regulations and Joint Clinical Assessment process
  • Experience developing or adapting budget-impact and cost-effectiveness models
  • Experience conducted indirect treatment comparisons or network meta-analysis
  • Strong track record of managing vendors
  • Ability to influence cross-functional and regional stakeholders without direct authority
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Prior experience in neuromuscular disease and/or rare diseases is preferred but not required.
  • ~15% travel, ability to work across global time zones

title: Director, Venture Cafe London
descriptionHtml:
Are you a natural leader with a strong network, driven to tackle your city's biggest challenges and connect diverse groups to make things happen? If so, you belong at Venture Café!

At Venture Café, we aim to create a global community of innovators with equal access to resources and opportunities, addressing our most pressing challenges. Ready to make an impact with us?

The Venture Café Global Institute (VCGI) seeks a strategic, dynamic, and self-driven Director to lead Venture Café London in the heart of the Knowledge Quarter. This is a unique opportunity to operate and grow a hub for Deeptech innovation and connection, in close collaboration with ARIA.

ABOUT VENTURE CAFÉ

Venture Café believes that Isolation is the enemy of innovation and our mission is clear: Connect innovators to make things happen. We are a neutral and trusted center of gravity that connects the entire innovation ecosystem and is available for everyone.

Our flagship program, the Thursday Gathering, is a dynamic and intentionally designed experience freely accessible to all. Featuring vibrant networking sessions activated with captivating demos or immersion in the night’s theme by attending thought-provoking sessions led by inspiring speakers. Here, curiosity meets opportunity, connections flourish, and innovation thrives.

Venture Café was founded by Tim Rowe, founder and CEO of the Cambridge Innovation Center (CIC), in 2009 and helped fuel the growth of one of the world’s most powerful innovation ecosystems: Boston’s Kendall Square. What began with a modest gathering of 12 people at our inaugural Thursday Gathering has flourished into the Venture Café Global Institute (VCGI). Over the past 15 years, VCGI has united over 900,000 visionaries, developers, creatives, and civic leaders across 24cities worldwide, building a global community of communities.

At VCGI, we believe if we’re going to solve humankind’s biggest challenges, we need as many amazing humans as possible involved in that process.

YOUR DAY-TO-DAY WORK

Reporting to the Head of UK, Venture Cafe United Kingdom, you will lead the established Venture Café London team, directing programming for the Thursday Gathering and other ecosystem-building activities. Your goal is to ensure Venture Café programming continues to connect local innovators to the national and international entrepreneurship community.

Your role would be to execute weekly Venture Café Thursday Gatherings including the following:

• Collaborating closely with VCGI and ARIA to continue to successfully implement and refine the strategy for Venture Café London.

• Scoping and securing financial partners for Venture Café London and building a pipeline for funding opportunities.

• Working closely with the Head of UK and the other UK Directors to ensure success and align initiatives where appropriate.

• Scoping and developing a rolling programming strategy to inspire and connect the local innovation community.

• Collaborate with the ARIA team and Programme Directors to drive value to the ARIA Opportunity Spaces.

• Identifying and partnering with local ecosystem leaders as an advocate and spokesperson to build diverse and inclusive programs.

• Developing innovative program formats for delivering content and creating connection opportunities to maximize engagement.

• Leading and overseeing strategic planning, impact measurement and program budget for Venture Café in London.

• Attracting sponsorship for programs and aligning them within the Thursday Gathering framework.

• Leading and coaching your three direct reports towards success.

• Continuously reviewing and implementing improvements/changes to ensure the ongoing success and reputation of Venture Café London.

• Collaborating with the Venture Café global network and ARIA to connect the London community to global opportunities.

• Identifying and mitigating risks to the effective operation of the Thursday Gathering.

• Nurturing existing initiatives to support Venture Café’s Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, & Belonging (DEIB) efforts, while bringing a visionary approach to developing and expanding DEIB-driven programming and partnership opportunities.

ABOUT YOU

You understand your city’s challenges and see them as opportunities, combining a fascination with trends and a humanistic perspective. Passionate about mission-driven work, you'll lead Venture Café London by nurturing relationships, leading teams, and thriving in ambiguity. Your skills include leading programs, matchmaking, innovating, connecting with the community, and fostering collaboration. You are comfortable with public speaking, have excellent communication skills, and excel at connecting across business, academia, government, and civil society. You bring a global outlook with local roots and a strong community commitment.

​​More specifically, you thrive in:

• Leading people and complex programs.

• Being a match-maker extraordinaire and seeing opportunities at the intersections of people, ideas & resources.

• Envisioning, developing and implementing innovative program experiences.

• Connecting with a broad cross-section of the community.

• Bringing people together to collaborate towards a common goal.

• Identifying and developing mutually beneficial partnerships.

Additionally, you have:

• Knowledge of London’s startup community, key influencers, networks and organizations.

• Excellent organizational, project, and task management skills.

• Experience securing funding opportunities and a network of potential funders.

• Comfort in Google Suite, email campaign software, and project management software.

• Fluency in English.

• Ability to legally work in the UK. We are unable to sponsor visas for this role at this time.

OUR OFFER

• Employment contract.

• Competitive compensation based on experience

• 4% Pension Contribution
• 25 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays
• Supplemental medical and dental insurance
• £200 Monthly Commuter Allowance
• Life insurance
• Business Travel Insurance
• Hybrid work model – You will work three days per week in the office, with Thursdays required as a core in-office day.

VENTURE CAFÉ LONDON - GUIDING ORGANIZATIONAL OBJECTIVES

As an organization, Venture Café London is guided by five core objectives that shape how success is measured. These objectives are advanced through purposeful programming, storytelling, and bringing together a diverse community of innovators, entrepreneurs, investors, researchers, corporates, and ecosystem partners.

  1. Broaden access to innovation and economic opportunity. Lower barriers to entry and create an inclusive, welcoming environment where people from diverse backgrounds can participate in and contribute to London's innovation ecosystem.

  2. Connect people and break down silos. Build bridges across sectors, disciplines, industries, and communities to encourage collaboration, knowledge sharing, and the development of a globally competitive innovation ecosystem.

  3. Improve access to resources and opportunities. Foster meaningful relationships that connect innovators and entrepreneurs with the capital, talent, expertise, ideas, and strategic partnerships they need to develop and scale their ventures.

  4. Create spaces for meaningful human connection. Bring people together through accessible, engaging experiences that encourage the exchange of ideas, build trust, and turn spontaneous interactions into lasting relationships and collaborations.

  5. Strengthen the wider innovation ecosystem through shared resources. Openly share knowledge, tools, and opportunities while collaborating with ecosystem partners to align efforts, amplify impact, and support collective progress.

The Venture Café Gathering

The flagship Venture Café model is the weekly Gathering: a recurring community event where innovators, entrepreneurs, investors, researchers, and other ecosystem stakeholders come together to exchange ideas, share knowledge, explore emerging technologies, and build meaningful connections.

Through expert-led discussions, educational sessions, networking opportunities, and informal interactions, the Gathering creates the conditions for collaboration and new opportunities to emerge organically. It serves as a platform for connecting London's innovation community and provides a foundation for wider programming, strategic partnerships, and ecosystem-building initiatives.

The Gathering is more than an event; it is a recurring platform for strengthening relationships across the innovation ecosystem and helping promising ideas develop into meaningful collaborations and real-world outcomes.

title: DSX MEP Infra Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

The role

As DSX MEP Infra Lead, you will lead the delivery of the MEP infrastructure that supports the DSX platform across Volta’s AI factories. You will set the design, sequencing and commissioning standards that pull turnover dates forward and keep power and cooling off the critical path.

This is a senior leadership role focused on speed, safety and repeatability. You will ensure MEP design frameworks align with the NVIDIA DSX platform and that lessons from delivery and operations feed back into the build standards, so every AI factory builds faster than the last.

What you will do

• Embed critical-path optimisation, trade sequencing and streamlined Level 1-5 commissioning workflows into white space BODs and baseline schedules to pull turnover dates forward.

• Establish field execution playbooks for white space MEP installation, ensuring these are the basis for project baseline schedules on each project.

• Drive Hot Aisle Containment design standards to maximise M&E plug-and-play capability including overhead busway drops, facility cooling system integration and flexible framing to minimise site integration time across diverse room configurations.

• Ensure MEP design frameworks are fully aligned with the requirements of the NVIDIA DSX platform including power, cooling, spatial and structural requirements.

• Define the commissioning strategies for CDUs and their integration to facility water systems to support high-density GPU rack environments.

• Drive efficient and practical design and commissioning strategies for electrical systems to ensure power distribution systems commissioning remains off the critical path.

• Push design and execution strategies towards safe, fast integration of facility racks to commissioned power and cooling systems.

• Partner with Design and Supply Chain teams to evaluate schedule opportunities related to off-site assembly, reducing site trade congestion, de-risking long-lead items and eliminating critical-path delays.

• Drive the reporting and implementation of lessons learned from delivery and operations back into the build standards, so every AI factory builds faster, safer and more efficiently than the last.

• Set the standards for clean handovers from construction to operations teams, ensuring alignment on expectations.

What we are looking for

• Senior experience leading MEP design and delivery for data centres or other mission-critical facilities. Data centre experience is essential.

• Strong knowledge of critical-path planning, trade sequencing and baseline scheduling on large construction programmes.

• Experience leading Level 1-5 commissioning, including electrical power distribution systems.

• Hands-on knowledge of high-density power and liquid cooling, including CDUs and facility water systems.

• Ability to work with Design, Supply Chain and construction teams to drive off-site assembly and de-risk long-lead items.

• A track record of setting standards and playbooks that are adopted across multiple projects and sites.

• Experience with the NVIDIA DSX platform or other high-density GPU rack environments.

• Hot aisle containment design and overhead busway systems.

• Experience setting clean handover standards between construction and operations teams

title: EMEA Regional Events Field Marketing Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Point One Navigation is building the future of precise location. Our mission is to deliver a unified location platform that enables autonomy, safety, and efficiency across industries from robotics to transportation. We are a high-performance, high-collaboration team that thrives on solving complex problems, moving fast, and delivering impact.

Role Outcome

We are seeking a European Events Field Marketing Lead to own the strategy, planning, and execution of events and programs that builds Point One's presence, pipeline, and aligns with our brand across the region. This is a hands-on, execution-first role combining regional market insight, program management discipline, and hustle.

You will work directly with Marketing, Sales, Product, and Customer Success to identify the highest-leverage events, conferences, and customer gatherings across Europe, then run each one end to end — from strategy and budget through booth design, booth experience, speaker placement, and post-event pipeline handoff. You will serve as the region's on-the-ground marketing owner, translating market knowledge into a calendar of events that generates qualified pipeline and reinforces Point One as the category leader in precise location.

The ultimate outcome of this role is a European field program that reliably converts marketing spend into qualified pipeline and secondarily supports brand visibility, and customer engagement — planned and executed with minimal oversight.

Success in this role is measured by volume and quality of pipeline generated from events (virtual and in person). Events, sponsorships, and field activity with prospects, customers or partners are the means to achieve these results, not the end in themselves.

Immediate Areas of Focus

Event Strategy & Calendar Ownership

  • Own the European event calendar — identify, prioritize, and select the conferences, trade shows, and customer events that best support pipeline and brand goals.

  • Build the business case for each event: audience fit, expected pipeline, cost, and ROI — and defend that case against a limited budget.

  • Continuously evaluate the regional event landscape and reallocate investment toward what's working.

End-to-End Logistics & Operational Execution

  • Run every logistical element of an event — booth and sponsorship design, shipping, staffing, collateral, signage, and on-site coordination — while in alignment with centralized dedicated events, brand, and product teams.

  • Coordinate speaking opportunities, demos, and customer meetings on-site to maximize the value of each event.

  • Manage vendors, venues, and local partners across multiple European countries and languages.

Pipeline & Follow-Through & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Bring strong operational rigor by partnering with marketing, business development and sales to ensure every event has clear pre-event outreach, on-site lead capture, and post-event follow-up.

  • Track and report pipeline generated, cost per lead, and event ROI back to the business. Align activity with central processes and reporting, working with Marketing Ops team.

  • Close the loop with Sales and Customer Success to make sure event-sourced leads convert.

Regional Brand & Field Presence

  • Align Point One's brand and reputation across Europe through field presence, local press, partner co-marketing, and customer-facing moments.

  • Identify opportunities to bring partners, customers and prospects together outside of large industry events — dinners, roundtables, and regional meetups.

  • Act as the local voice of the brand, adapting global messaging for European markets and customers.

  • Act as the bridge between European Sales and the global Marketing and Product teams.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in field marketing, event marketing, or demand generation roles, with direct ownership of event strategy and execution in a high growth start up environment

  • Track record of running high-impact events and conferences from planning through pipeline delivery, with a scrappy DIY culture.

  • Comfortable owning budget, ROI reporting, and vendor negotiation independently.

  • Experience marketing to technical or engineering audiences.

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to run multiple concurrent events across countries and time zones.

  • Ability to travel up to 50% across Europe.

Preferred

  • Experience marketing into robotics, autonomous systems, automotive, drones, industrial automation, or federal technologies.

  • Fluency in a second European language in addition to English.

  • Experience building a European field marketing

  • Experience working closely with sales in a B2B, enterprise, or deep-tech sales motion. GNSS experience appreciated but not required.

Our Cultural Foundation

At Point One, our cultural and operating design is built around one guiding principle: we must move with extreme speed and efficiency of effort to stay in a leadership position.

This environment gives people a high level of autonomy and the ability to make a real impact. It also challenges every team member to grow — both professionally and personally. Because we focus on promoting from within rather than relying on external hiring, the opportunities for advancement are tremendous for those who seek them.

That said, growth only comes from delivering in the present. What matters most is the job to be done today, not the job you want tomorrow. When we all focus on today’s outcomes with excellence, the path to greater responsibility and growth naturally follows.

We think about our culture in two dimensions:

How We Show Up Every Day

These are the behaviors we expect every team member to bring to work — the foundation of being a consummate, high-output teammate:

  • Trust / Assume Best Intent — Trust allows us to move fast. When we start from trust, we spend no time second-guessing or looking for ulterior motives and thus focus all our energy on acting.

  • High Output, Action Oriented — Our default posture is “yes.” We bias toward action and deliver results quickly, knowing that speed and efficiency compound into impact as we unblock others around us.

  • Divine Discontent — We’re never satisfied with the status quo and are self-motivated to improve ourselves, our work, and our company. We actively seek feedback in real-time to shorten improvement cycles.

  • No Ego, One Team — Collaboration without ego creates leverage. When we win as one team, we eliminate friction and move faster together.

  • Self Accountability — Taking ownership is the straightest line to learning, self-improvement, and correcting our course of action. And blaming others around us is a fast path to destroying trust.

Operating Principles

These are the systems and norms that amplify speed and efficiency at the company level:

  • Edge Innovation — We bias toward action over approval. Experiment, decide, and move — failure is just a step toward faster learning.

  • No Hierarchies — We practice self-prioritization and go direct to the source. Flattening layers reduces drag and maximizes autonomy.

  • Customer Experience First — We optimize for the end-to-end customer outcome, not functional or departmental efficiency. This focus cuts waste, aligns priorities, and ensures we spend effort where it matters most.

If this role sounds like a fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply below and join us in shaping the future of precise location.

title: Engagement Manager (Strategy & Data/AI Transformation)
descriptionHtml:
Who is Artefact?

Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organisations through data and AI. We combine the rigour of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact.

With 2,500+ consultants, data scientists and engineers, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange and Sanofi. Our Zurich office is at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.

Main Responsibilities

As an Engagement Manager in our Zurich or Lausanne office, you will work at the intersection of strategy consulting and data and AI delivery. You will:

  • Strategy Development: Work with client leadership teams to address high-stakes questions. How can AI reshape our business model? How should we govern and organise for data? Which strategic programmes deliver the most impact?
  • Structured Problem-Solving: Break complex challenges down into decisions a client can act on, combining consulting rigour with a working knowledge of what current AI can and cannot actually do.
  • Solution Design: Turn a business question into a solution shape — what data it depends on, what kind of platform or product it should sit on, and what “good” looks like once it is built. You will do this alongside our data scientists and engineers, and you will be accountable for whether the design survives contact with production.
  • Project Delivery: Run engagements end to end, from hypothesis framing and market and competitor analysis through to data maturity assessments, client workshops, governance design and implementation roadmaps.
  • Feasibility & Economics: Own the answer to "will this work, and what will it cost". The evaluation approach, the unit economics per query or per case, and the point at which the business case stops closing.
  • Client Engagement: Work closely with C-level stakeholders and business unit leaders. You will build trusted relationships, communicate recommendations with clarity, and keep the work aligned to what the client is actually trying to decide.
  • Team Leadership: Lead mixed teams of consultants, data scientists and engineers. You are the person who can tell whether the technical plan is realistic, and the person the client believes when you say that it is.
  • Knowledge & Practice Building: Contribute to the growth of Artefact's Zurich and Lausanne offices by shaping new offerings, creating intellectual capital - frameworks, thought pieces, benchmarks - and taking part in business development.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who can hold a technical position and a commercial one at the same time, and lead a team through both. The strongest candidates meet most of the following.

  • Education: A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Economics or a related field. A strong technical foundation counts for more with us than where you studied.
  • Work Experience: Five to eight years across consulting and technology delivery, including at least one dedicated AI or data project.
  • Business Acumen & AI Fluency: A strong dual affinity for business and technology. You have a deep working understanding of modern data and AI concepts — generative AI and LLMs, retrieval, predictive machine learning, cloud architectures — and of their practical business applications. You are capable of scoping AI use cases and of discussing technical constraints and opportunities confidently with C-level stakeholders.
  • Technical Depth: You have owned the technical shape of AI work, not only its business case. You think in terms of enterprise architecture — how a solution fits the existing landscape, what it needs from data and governance, and how it scales from pilot to full rollout — and can defend those choices to technical and commercial stakeholders alike. You will not be writing production code, but you should have been close enough to it to be credible with the engineers with which you will collaborate.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Strong quantitative and analytical skills, and the judgement to know which number actually decides the question. You are comfortable getting to a defensible estimate with your assumptions stated out loud.
  • Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication. You can take a technical trade-off to a non-technical sponsor without flattening it, and be challenged by an engineer without retreating into abstraction. You enjoy working in teams and in front of clients.
  • Languages: Fluency in German/French and English, written and spoken, is strongly preferred. 
  • Work Eligibility: You must be eligible to work in Switzerland.

Why Join Us

  • Strategy and the Build: Artefact is neither a traditional strategy consultancy nor a pure technology player. You will move between the boardroom and the build, and be expected to be credible in both.
  • Engineers, not hand-offs: Our 2,500 people include the data scientists and engineers you will work beside on the same engagement - not a delivery organisation you hand a slide deck to.
  • Zurich Office Impact: As part of a growing Swiss team you will have visibility and impact from the first day. You will help shape Artefact's footprint in the region and work directly with senior leadership.
  • Learning & Growth: Regular training in both consulting method and AI and data capability, combined with international exposure.
  • Culture of Doers: Innovation, action, collaboration. We are entrepreneurial and fast-moving, committed to delivering impact while supporting each other's growth.

This position is based in Zürich or Lausanne.

title: Engineering Manager, Release Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

 

About Superhuman

Superhuman is the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’s collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here.

 

The Opportunity

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Developer Experience/Release Engineering team in Berlin. You will own how code travels from a developer’s commit to millions of users across Superhuman’s products: Grammarly, Superhuman Docs, and Superhuman Mail.

As our product suite grows, so do the number of engineers contributing to it and the number of surfaces we release on (web, desktop, mobile, browser extensions, APIs). Our team makes shipping fast, safe, and boring. The team builds and runs the CI/CD platform, release pipelines, and rollout tooling that let product teams deploy many times a day with confidence; it enables engineers to be productive, use new technologies to optimize the SLDC, and push on green many times a day.

You will lead a team of engineers working at the intersection of developer productivity, infrastructure, and reliability. You will partner with Product Engineering, SRE, Platform/Infrastructure, and Security to increase release speed and safety. This role is hands-on: you will help set the technical direction and stay close to the work.

As an Engineering Manager, Release Engineering, you will:

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Engineers; hire great people and build a strong, inclusive team culture in Berlin and across a distributed organization.

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for CI/CD, build, and release systems that scale with company growth and the number of products and surfaces we ship.

  • Drive faster, safer delivery: improve lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and time to restore, and make these measures visible to engineering leadership.

  • Build and operate release tooling, including progressive rollouts, canaries, feature flags, automated rollback, and release health monitoring.

  • Coordinate release trains and launches across all our products, working with Product, QA, Support, and Marketing to ensure major launches land smoothly.

  • Partner with SRE, Infrastructure, and Security to keep the delivery platform reliable and compliant, including supply chain security, artifact integrity, and access controls.

  • Reduce friction for product engineers: cut build and test times, eliminate flaky tests and pipelines, and offer self-service paths so teams can ship without waiting on us.

  • Act as an escalation point and Incident Commander for release-related incidents, and lead blameless postmortems that turn into lasting fixes.

  • Balance near-term pipeline fixes with foundational investments, and make clear tradeoffs in a fast-moving environment.

  • Stay hands-on where it matters: review designs, help debug tough pipeline problems, and set a high engineering bar.

 

Qualifications

  • Have 5+ years of software, DevOps, or release/build engineering experience, and 2+ years managing engineers (or engineering managers) with a record of hiring, developing, and retaining talent.

  • Bring hands-on depth in CI/CD systems and build tooling (for example, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Buildkite, Bazel, or similar) and can reason independently about pipeline architecture and trade-offs.

  • Know cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and Kubernetes or another container orchestration system.

  • Have shipped and operated release systems at scale, using progressive delivery, feature flags, canary releases, and safe rollback.

  • Understand release practices across multiple surfaces (web, desktop, mobile, browser extensions, or backend services).

  • Know infrastructure as code (eg Terraform) and observability tooling, and use delivery metrics (DORA) to guide decisions.

  • Have experience as an Incident Commander and running blameless postmortems.

  • Know the basics of software supply chain security: dependency management, artifact signing, and secrets handling.

  • Have experience managing people in a distributed or remote setting, and can collaborate effectively with Product, SRE, Security, QA, and Support.

  • Operate well in ambiguity, set a high engineering bar, and empower senior engineers to own technical decisions.

  • Has a demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal guidance, proactively manages tasks and priorities across multiple projects, analyzes and executes work efficiently, collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams, and thrives in fast-paced, results-driven environments.

 

Compensation and Benefits

  • Professional growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being. We also support professional development and advancement with training, coaching, and regular feedback.

  • A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture supported by our values. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our employee resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.

  • Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.

title: Entwicklungsingenieur*in im Bereich Embedded Software
descriptionHtml:
CANopen, IO-Link, Profinet, EtherCAT – du weißt nicht nur, was dahintersteckt, sondern auch, worauf es ankommt, wenn diese Schnittstellen in sicherheitsrelevanten Systemen zuverlässig funktionieren müssen. Du entwickelst Embedded Software nicht für die Schublade, sondern für Maschinen, die im Einsatz stehen. Und du willst nicht nur umsetzen, was andere spezifizieren – du willst vom Konzept bis zum Code Review mitgestalten. Genau dafür suchen wir dich.

Wir bei TWK entwickeln und produzieren seit über 60 Jahren im Wachstumsmarkt der Mess- und Automatisierungstechnik kundenspezifische Sensoren für den Anlagen- und Maschinenbau. Funktionale Sicherheit für Mensch und Maschine ist unser Anspruch – und der lässt sich nicht mit halbgaren Lösungen oder endlosen Abstimmungsschleifen erfüllen.

Wenn du Lust hast, Teilprojekte wirklich zu verantworten, dich in interdisziplinären Teams einzubringen und an einer gewachsenen Sensor-Bibliothekslandschaft weiterzubauen, die Substanz hat, dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Aufgaben

Du übernimmst Verantwortung, wo andere noch auf Freigaben warten – das sind deine Themen bei uns:

  • Konzeptionierung, Entwicklung und Implementierung von Embedded Software auf ARM Cortex-Mikrocontrollern (vorrangig STM32)
  • Entwicklung für Echtzeitbetriebssysteme, insbesondere FreeRTOS
  • Optimierung und Weiterentwicklung bestehender Firmware und Softwarekomponenten auf Basis einer umfangreichen Sensor-Bibliothekslandschaft
  • Anbindung von Embedded-Schnittstellen über gängige Bussysteme wie CANopen, IO-Link, Profinet und EtherCAT
  • Testen von Software- und Hardwaremodulen sowie Dokumentation im Rahmen der funktionalen Sicherheit (SiL, PLd)
  • Analyse, Spezifikation und Umsetzung von Softwareanforderungen in enger Abstimmung mit Produktmanagement und Kunden
  • Code Reviews mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen zur gemeinsamen Weiterentwicklung der Entwicklungsergebnisse
  • Eigenverantwortliche Betreuung von Teilprojekten
  • Mitarbeit in interdisziplinären Projektteams

Qualifikation

Du bringst technisches Fundament und den Anspruch mit, Dinge wirklich durchzudenken – das erwartet dich bei uns:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, technischen Informatik, Elektrotechnik, Systemtechnik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Erfahrung in der Embedded-Software-Entwicklung
  • Sicherer Umgang mit C; Kenntnisse in Python, .NET und/oder C# von Vorteil
  • Ergebnisorientiertes, eigenverantwortliches Denken und Handeln
  • Ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit und kommunikative Stärke
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie mindestens gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Präzise und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

Das beeindruckt uns zusätzlich:

  • Kenntnisse in der Nachrichtentechnik (Buskommunikation, Funksysteme)
  • Erfahrung mit Echtzeitbetriebssystemen auf Mikrocontrollern
  • Vertrautheit mit Git als Versionsverwaltungssystem

Benefits

Warum TWK? Weil hier mehr zählt als Obstkorb und Parkplatz.

Ja, wir haben Deutschlandticket, Dienstrad, Wellhub, Getränke, Obst und Firmenevents – aber seien wir ehrlich: Dafür wechselst du nicht den Job. Das hier macht den echten Unterschied:

Stabil aufgestellt und bereit zu investieren.

Ein familiengeführtes Unternehmen mit einer jungen, nahbaren Geschäftsleitung und einem stabilen wirtschaftlichen Fundament. Das schafft nicht nur Sicherheit, sondern auch den Spielraum, in Ausstattung zu investieren: Hochwertige Testumgebungen mit moderner Ausstattung von Steuerungen über Drehmotoren und Klimakammern bis hin zu modernen Messsensoren. Kontinuierlich erweitert und erneuert, ohne Investitionsmüdigkeit oder Sparrunden.

Dein Wachstum wird gefördert.

Weil das beste Equipment nichts nützt ohne die richtigen Menschen dahinter: Du startest mit einer strukturierten Einarbeitung, die dich in alle relevanten Prozesse, Systeme und Tools einführt und sicher in deine Rolle hineinwachsen lässt. Danach geht es mit Schulungen, Weiterbildungen und dem Freiraum, dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln, weiter. Wer den Willen mitbringt, etwas zu bewegen, findet bei uns den Raum dazu und flache Hierarchien sorgen dafür, dass Ideen ankommen, ohne sich durch Hierarchieebenen kämpfen zu müssen.

Dein Arbeitsalltag passt zu deinem Leben.

Ob im Büro oder von zuhause – flexible Arbeitszeiten und mobiles Arbeiten geben dir den Spielraum, der zu deinem Leben passt. Dazu ein gut angebundener Standort in Wedel oder Düsseldorf.

Bereit für den nächsten Schritt?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt – unkompliziert und direkt. Lebenslauf, relevante Zeugnisse und ein paar Sätze darüber, warum du zu uns passt. Kein Roman, einfach ehrlich.

Innerhalb einer Woche melden sich Christine oder Alina bei dir. Erstes Gespräch online, zweites vor Ort in Wedel. Ganz entspannt.

Kein Bullshit, keine leeren Versprechen – nur ehrliche Arbeit in einem Unternehmen, das vorwärts will.

title: Field Marketing Lead
descriptionHtml:
About the role

As Field Marketing Lead, you make sure our global strategy has local impact: every region turns our positioning, campaigns and content into pipeline in its own market.

Scope

Field marketing takes our global strategy into each market through four areas: pipeline support, partner marketing, events, and content. You'll build and lead a team of 3 Field Marketing Managers (North America, France & MEA, Italy, Spain & DACH).

The team is still being formed, and you'll help hire the regional roles. Success means pipeline sourced and influenced in every region, with field plans that stay aligned with global priorities.

Core responsibilities

Lead the team across the four areas

  • Pipeline support: make sure pipeline is generated locally and tracked through every GTM activation, with processes agreed with the sales, BDR and sales enablement managers.
  • Partner marketing: build the system that turns partner relationships into visibility, co-marketing, joint GTM motions and shared events, alongside our partnerships team.
  • Events: apply the global event strategy locally and bring regional feedback back into the global plan.
  • Content: localize global content, feed local insight back to the global content team, and design the media and PR activation program each region runs.

Cross-functional coordination

  • Coordinate across departments and functions so global plans and regional execution stay in sync.
  • Bring market intelligence back to Product Marketing: local competitors, regulatory differences and what buyers ask.

Team, budget and reporting

  • Help hire the regional Field Marketing Managers, then coach them and set shared playbooks so every region works the same way.
  • Own the field marketing budget across regions, including local agencies and vendors.
  • Define field KPIs (pipeline sourced and influenced, event ROI, partner contribution) and report to the Global Head of Marketing and sales leadership.

Who you work with

  • Reports to: Global Head of Marketing
  • Manages: Regional Field Marketing Managers (North America, France & MEA, Italy, Spain & DACH)
  • Daily collaboration: Global Head of Marketing, Content and Product Marketing leads, regional sales leaders
  • Key stakeholders: Sales leadership, Alliances & Legal Expertise, Revenue Ops

What we're looking for

  • 10+ years in B2B marketing, including at least 5 in field marketing and experience hiring and managing a team across several regions.
  • A B2B SaaS background: you know long sales cycles, complex buying committees and enterprise buyers.
  • You've built a multi-region field marketing plan and budget, and defended it with numbers.
  • Strong grasp of pipeline metrics and attribution, and proficient in HubSpot or a comparable CRM.
  • Experience across events, partner marketing, ABM and content.
  • PR and media relations experience, ideally running a media program across several markets.
  • Fluent English. French, Italian, Spanish or German is a plus.

What really sets you apart

  • Leader who still does the work: you coach your team and step in when a region needs an extra pair of hands.
  • Commercial: you link every program to pipeline and revenue.
  • Builder: you set up processes and playbooks where none exist yet.
  • Collaborative and proactive: you spot what needs doing and act before anyone asks.
  • AI in your daily work: you use it to analyse results, plan campaigns and move faster.

Recruitment process

1.Phone screening with Talent Acquisition 2.First interview with our Global Head of Marketing 3.Field marketing strategy case 4.Team and stakeholder interviews, including sales leadership 5.Final interview with our CEO or another key stakeholder

title: Founding Account Executive (Italian Speaker)
descriptionHtml:
About Sona

Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them.

Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past.

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here (https://www.sona.ai/careers).

About the Role

We're hiring a Founding Account Executive to win Sona's first customers in Italy and open the market for us. This is a senior, seller-first role, and you'll run every conversation with prospects in Italian, from the first call to the close.

Our expansion into Europe is starting now and ramps up through 2027 across key markets. Italy is one of them, and you'll own the go-to-market launch there. Colleagues across Sona will be running the product, operations and other launch activities, so your focus is winning customers, building partnerships and creating the collateral to sell. With no sales team in market yet, you'll work with less support than a typical AE, and the team around you will grow as the market does.


Day to day, you'll decide which Retail and Hospitality accounts to go after, from mid-market through to enterprise, and run consultative sales conversations yourself. You'll also build what a new market needs, including partnerships and Italian-language collateral. The platform is already localised for Italy, and you'll have product and solutions support.

It's early, and the ground will shift as we learn what works. If you want a structured environment with lots of support around you, this won't be the right fit. If you want to shape how Sona sells in Italy from the start, it could be exactly that. The role is office-based in London, with travel to Italy as needed.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the go-to-market launch in Italy and win Sona's first customers, taking each deal from first conversation to close.

  • Build your own pipeline across Retail and Hospitality, from mid-market to enterprise.

  • Run strategic, consultative sales conversations in Italian.

  • Build and run partnerships that open doors in the Italian market.

  • Create the collateral Sona needs to sell in Italy.

  • Work with Sona's Strategy and Expansion Lead on where to focus and how to approach the market.

  • Feed what you learn from the market back to our Commercial and Product teams.

  • Travel to Italy as the role requires.

Requirements

  • You're a native Italian speaker, comfortable selling and negotiating in Italian, with fluent English for working with colleagues in London.

  • You have a senior Account Executive track record of winning new business, ideally across mid-market and enterprise deals.

  • You have a founder mentality. You take ownership, make decisions with limited information, and are happy building without a playbook.

  • You're strategic and consultative in how you sell, and you work well independently with less support than most AEs get.

  • You're comfortable creating partnerships and collateral from scratch.

  • You're based in London, or able to be, and happy to travel to Italy as the role needs.

  • Strongly preferred: Spanish, French or German as an additional language. It doesn't replace Italian.

Benefits

  • Salary: £80,000 - £120,000 base depending on experience, with OTE of £160,000 - £240,000

  • Share options

title: Founding Engineer (Product)
descriptionHtml:
Founding Product Engineer
London · £120K–£200K plus equity · Visa sponsorship available

The Mission

We are replacing the Management Consulting industry with software.

The $1 trillion consulting industry is powered by some of the world’s brightest minds, yet they remain trapped in manual, inefficient workflows: spreadsheet orchestration, slide-deck assembly, and fragmented data synthesis.

We proved it on ourselves first. Our advisory business serves six private equity funds across the UK, Europe and the US, and one Riplo consultant delivers an engagement that a tier-one firm staffs with a full team. The platform we built behind that work is now open to the world. Next, we are running the same playbook on a much bigger market: AI transformations for PE funds and the companies they own.

Our team comes from QuantumBlack/McKinsey, BCG, DeepMind, Hg Capital and KKR. Cherry Ventures, Blue Lion and the founders of QuantumBlack back us, with angels from OpenAI, McKinsey, BCG and Apple. We are nine people, and we are hiring one Founding Product Engineer.

The Challenge

As our Founding Product Engineer, your role is not just “writing code”. You will report directly to our CTO, and define the product DNA of the company. You will:

  • Build Beyond the Chatbot: Design multi-step agentic workflows that move past simple RAG and produce analysis a PE fund pays for.

  • Make Quality Measurable: “Good enough for a partner” is a hard standard to code against. Build the evals, harnesses and review checks that prove an agent’s output meets it.

  • Turn Evidence into Insight: Connect research, data and sources to the final page, so that every claim on a slide traces back to its evidence.

  • Work Directly with Our Clients: Build AI use cases inside client organisations, alongside the people who use them. What you learn there shapes the core roadmap.

  • Pioneer the Agentic SDLC: Agents write most of our code. Design the systems, steer the agents, and push our own way of building software forward with a very large token budget.

You Are a Fit If:

  • You are a Product Builder: You might be a product engineer at a SaaS company, a product manager who now ships code, or a consultant building serious AI tooling on the side. We judge purely on the quality of what you have built. You don’t need a 20-page PRD. You can take a vague user pain point from a client and ship a functional prototype by Friday.

  • You value Speed: You believe that in an early-stage startup, iteration velocity is the only unfair advantage. You prefer shipping a 90% solution today over a perfect one next month.

  • You are “T-Shaped”: You hold deep experience in one area (product management, management consulting, or front-end engineering), but are comfortable enough with the others to add value across the business.

Our Stack

  • Product: TypeScript, Next.js, React, Tailwind

  • Data and Infra: PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS, Terraform

  • Real-time: Collaboration over WebSockets

Why Join Us?

  • Real Ownership: £120K to £200K base salary plus equity. You will own a piece of the company you are building, and you will own the product roadmap with the CTO.

  • High Trust / Low Bureaucracy: We value clarity of thought and bias to action. No middle management, no pointless meetings, just building.

  • The Practicalities: London-based, four days a week in the office, one flexible day, and client site time when projects require it. Visa sponsorship available.

title: Fraud & Disputes Specialist

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

title: GPU Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Kog

At Kog, we're building real-time LLM inference for AI agents.

Coding agents execute sequences of tasks where each step depends on the model's previous response. The faster the model generates tokens, the faster these agents can reason, code, and act.

Our approach is to co-design model architecture, the inference engine, and low-level GPU kernels to minimize generation latency on standard NVIDIA and AMD datacenter GPUs.

We've developed several technologies to make this possible:

  • Monokernel: a persistent GPU program that keeps the entire token generation loop on the GPU, avoiding CPU handoffs.

  • KCCL: our custom inter-GPU communication layer, designed to minimize latency.

  • Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP): a model architecture that overlaps communication with computation and weight loading.

  • Laneformer 2B: our code-generation model demonstrating this co-design approach.

Our engineers work directly with GPU hardware, using CUDA, PTX, HIP, and CDNA ISA to optimize execution.

Implementing and optimizing a new AI model for a specific GPU architecture can take months of manual engineering. Meanwhile, new models are constantly being released.

Our goal is to use AI agents to implement and optimize the models we choose on the GPUs we choose, in a fraction of the time required today.

These agents will build on the GPU optimizations and hardware insights our team has developed. They'll explore optimization strategies, generate and modify kernels, verify correctness, benchmark performance on real hardware, and iterate based on the results.

We want to make model porting and GPU optimization much faster and repeatable, allowing Kog to keep pace with the latest AI models rather than spending months adapting each one manually.

This is a major engineering direction we're now developing, and you'll help shape it.

Learn more at https://blog.kog.ai.

What you'll work on

You'll join our GPU engineering team to tackle challenging performance problems and help build the internal agents that will accelerate this work.

  • Develop and optimize GPU kernels using C++, CUDA, HIP, and low-level instructions.

  • Investigate GPU architecture, memory access, synchronization, and execution bottlenecks.

  • Profile and benchmark workloads to identify and validate performance improvements.

  • Optimize inference operations and communication across multiple GPUs.

  • Implement and optimize new AI models on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.

  • Help build AI agents for GPU engineering, enabling automated code optimization, correctness testing, benchmarking, and iterative improvements.

  • Take ownership of technical decisions and their implementation.

What we're looking for

We're looking for an experienced GPU Engineer who can contribute quickly and independently to complex performance problems.

  • Strong hands-on experience developing and optimizing GPU kernels, ideally using CUDA C++ or HIP/ROCm.

  • Deep understanding of GPU architecture, memory hierarchy, parallel execution, and performance bottlenecks.

  • Strong C++ skills and experience profiling and benchmarking GPU workloads.

  • Proven ownership of challenging technical projects, from implementation to measured results.

  • Interest in developing AI agents and tools to accelerate GPU engineering.

Experience with PTX, CDNA ISA, multi-GPU systems, low-latency inference, or GPU performance portability is particularly valuable.

A PhD in HPC, computer science, or a related field is a plus when backed by substantial engineering work. Previous experience building AI agents is not required.

Location and availability

Candidates must already be based in Paris or elsewhere in Île-de-France.

We are not considering relocation from other regions or countries for this position.

We're looking for someone who can join the team quickly.
