The Role

As an iOS Developer at CM.com, you'll help develop and evolve our white-label mobile event platform, powering over 200 applications for music festivals, venues, and sporting events worldwide.

You'll work on an actively developed platform, building new features and continuously improving its architecture, performance, and maintainability. You'll contribute to a shared application framework that serves millions of event visitors across different clients and industries.

You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of your work, contribute ideas, and collaborate with colleagues across different disciplines. As we expand our focus towards a broader mobile ecosystem across CM.com, you'll also have opportunities to contribute to other mobile initiatives.

You will

  • Develop and maintain native iOS applications used by millions of event visitors worldwide.

  • Build scalable, reusable features that support different clients, industries, and use cases within a shared application framework.

  • Continuously improve and evolve our iOS codebase, introducing modern practices and enhancing architecture, performance, and maintainability.

  • Integrate third-party SDKs, REST APIs, and native Apple frameworks to deliver rich, interactive mobile experiences.

  • Collaborate with developers, designers, and product owners to deliver high-quality applications, with a focus on automated testing and regression prevention.

Use AI-assisted development tools where they add value, while taking responsibility for the quality and maintainability of your code.


You have

  • Solid professional experience in native iOS development, with strong proficiency in both Swift and Objective-C.

  • Strong hands-on experience with UIKit, Auto Layout, and Storyboards.

  • Experience working with native Apple frameworks such as Core Data, Core Location, and Core NFC, as well as integrating third-party SDKs and REST APIs.

  • A good understanding of software architecture, modular design, and maintaining large, established codebases.

  • A pragmatic engineering mindset, with strong problem-solving skills and a focus on readable, maintainable code, careful testing, and responsible use of AI-assisted development tools.

  • A responsible, proactive attitude, with the ability to work independently, take ownership of your work, and collaborate effectively within a team.

  • Good communication skills and fluency in English, preferably also in Dutch.

What we offer

  • Healthy food: Daily healthy lunches and snacks to keep you energized.

  • Invest in your future: A solid pension plan.

  • Time off: Recharge with 25 vacation days, plus the option to purchase 10 additional days.

  • Own your success: Become a shareholder with our Employee Share Purchase Program.

  • Your Development: We support your growth and development through initiatives like the CM Academy, Udemy courses, exclusive meetups with thought leaders, the Young Professional Program, and our own CM Business Adventure (CMBA), ensuring you’re always learning and evolving

  • Vitality: Our Vitality Team organizes a year-round vitality program to support a healthy body and mind for all colleagues. Think of stress prevention workshops, ergonomist visit, weekly bootcamps, yoga sessions and our CM sports day.

  • Together at CM.com: Weekly drinks, board game nights, karaoke throwdowns, yearly ski trip, and more! We have something for everyone.

Our diverse perspectives fuel innovation and drive us forward. We welcome everyone, regardless of age, background, or beliefs.

Before you apply

We work on-site, move fast, and expect you to bring your own thinking. Priorities shift, AI is actively changing how we work and we embrace that reality. If that sounds like a great environment to you, we'd love to hear from you.

About Calibre

Calibre is building an AI-native certification body. Our platform helps auditors review evidence, document findings and prepare reports, giving them more time to test whether controls work in practice. Auditors retain responsibility for every finding.


The role

We’re hiring a Lead Auditor to deliver independent ISO/IEC 27001 certification audits, witness new auditors and help shape the tools our audit team uses. You’ll work with colleagues in certification, product and engineering to make the audit process clearer and easier to use.

  • Witness new auditors in practice, document what you observe and give clear feedback.

  • Use Calibre’s platform in live audits and show the product team where changes would improve evidence review, reporting or quality checks.

  • Enough hands-on understanding of cloud and security infrastructure to assess evidence such as IAM policies, infrastructure configuration and audit logs.

  • Clear writing and sound audit judgement. You can explain your conclusions to a client’s technical team and defend them in a review.

title: IT & Cloud Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
IT & Cloud Manager (m/w/d)

Krumbach-Niederraunau, Bayern · Hybrid · Vollzeit, unbefristet

Über Everfield

Everfield übernimmt, entwickelt und skaliert europäische Softwareunternehmen aus vertikalen Märkten und Spezialnischen und gibt ihnen die Werkzeuge an die Hand, um den nächsten Schritt zu gehen. Unsere Mission: Ambitionen fördern, Wachstum vorantreiben und Chancen für Europas Software-Ökosystem eröffnen.

Die Unternehmen im Everfield-Ökosystem arbeiten dezentral: Sie behalten ihre Teams, Marken und Standorte und konzentrieren sich auf das, was sie am besten können – Produkte entwickeln und Kunden betreuen. Everfield unterstützt mit Talent Acquisition, HR und einem Expertenteam, das zu Finanz- und Operations-Themen berät. Seit der Gründung 2022 ist Everfield in neun Ländern vertreten, Tendenz steigend.

Über SoCom

Die SoCom Informationssysteme GmbH entwickelt mit rund 45 Mitarbeitenden TIKOS, die führende ERP-Lösung für gewerbliche Wäschereien und Textildienstleister. Mit rund 40 % Marktanteil in der DACH-Region und über 30 Jahren Erfahrung steuern Kunden mit TIKOS ihre gesamte Prozesskette, von der Wäscheannahme über RFID-Tracking bis zur Auslieferung. Seit Oktober 2026 gehört auch die Düchting Software & Consulting GmbH zur SoCom-Familie. SoCom ist Teil des Everfield-Ökosystems.

Über die Rolle

Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für unsere gesamte IT: die interne Infrastruktur, die Informationssicherheit und die SoCom Cloud, in der wir TIKOS für unsere Kunden betreiben. Viele dieser Leistungen haben wir bisher extern eingekauft. Jetzt holen wir das Know-how ins Haus – und du stellst die IT so auf, dass sie mit unserem Wachstum, der Integration neuer Unternehmensteile und steigenden regulatorischen Anforderungen Schritt hält.

Du bist Gestalter:in und Macher:in zugleich: Du entwickelst die IT-Strategie gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung und packst im Tagesgeschäft selbst mit an.

Deine Aufgaben

• IT-Verantwortung und Strategie: Du verantwortest die IT von SoCom ganzheitlich, entwickelst gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung eine IT-Roadmap und steuerst das IT-Budget für Hardware, Lizenzen, Cloud und Dienstleister.

• Insourcing und Dienstleistersteuerung: Du überführst bisher extern erbrachte Leistungen – Netzwerk, Firewall, Server, Backup und E-Mail-Security – schrittweise in die eigene Verantwortung. Verbleibende Dienstleister und Verträge steuerst du über klare SLAs.

• Cloud und Hosting: Du betreibst die SoCom Cloud, in der wir TIKOS für Kunden hosten, und entwickelst sie weiter. Gemeinsam mit Vertrieb und Support kalkulierst du Hosting-Angebote, verantwortest Verfügbarkeit, Kapazität und Kosten und treibst eine zukunftsfähige Hosting-Architektur voran.

• Infrastruktur und Betrieb: Du verantwortest Server, Netzwerk, Firewall, Backup und Disaster Recovery – am Standort und in der Cloud – sowie Microsoft 365, Endgeräte, Telefonie und Mobilfunk. Monitoring und Patch-Management steuerst du über ein RMM-Tool.

title: IT Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Decagon

Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.

Our technology enables industry-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.

We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.

We’re an in-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.

About the Role

As part of a lean, highly collaborative IT team, you'll support a fast-scaling global workforce and help drive automation, security, and operational excellence across the business. We're looking for an IT Engineer to be the hands-on IT presence for our London office and the first point of contact for IT across EMEA.

You'll be the only IT team member in London, five hours ahead of our IT teammate in New York and eight hours ahead of San Francisco. You'll resolve tickets and day-to-day issues yourself, and scope and align on larger projects with the team before building. Expect occasional calls outside UK hours.

Automation is the core of the job. You'll co-own identity and access management, endpoint administration, and SaaS operations for the company, using Serval, our AI-native service management platform, to turn recurring requests into workflows that resolve themselves. If a request shows up twice, the second time should be the last time anyone handles it by hand.

In this role, you will

  • Serve as the on-site IT engineer for our London office and the go-to IT contact for employees across EMEA, resolving hardware, account, and access issues in person and through the ticket queue

  • Build, test, and maintain Serval workflows for access requests, onboarding and offboarding, password and MFA resets, and other recurring requests

  • Review the automations Serval suggests from ticket history, and decide what gets published and what approvals each one needs

  • Track which requests still need a human, and use ticket data to choose what to automate next

  • Co-own the employee identity lifecycle through Okta so that onboarding, offboarding, and access changes are accurate and on time, with time-bound access and approval rules that make least privilege the default

  • Configure and maintain SSO, SAML, OIDC, and SCIM integrations as we bring on new SaaS applications

  • Administer and evolve our core SaaS stack, including Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, and similar tools

  • Co-own Mac endpoint management through Rippling MDM, including configuration policies, OS and app patching, compliance enforcement, and device logistics for EMEA employees

  • Write Python and Bash automation for integrations and API work that falls outside Serval

  • Act as first responder for IT and access incidents during EMEA hours, judging when to resolve an issue yourself and when to escalate to the US team

  • Support security and compliance work, including MFA enforcement, audit-ready evidence for SOC 2, and data protection requirements for EMEA employees

  • Keep runbooks and the Serval knowledge base current so employees can find answers themselves and the US team can pick up your work at handoff

Your background looks something like this

  • 5–7 years of experience in IT systems, endpoint, or identity engineering, ideally at a fast-growing company

  • Hands-on administration experience with Okta

  • Working knowledge of SSO, SAML, OIDC, and SCIM

  • Experience managing SaaS platforms such as Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Rippling, and Claude

  • Experience with Mac endpoint management (Rippling or similar MDM)

  • Automation you've shipped and can measure, whether scripts in Python or Bash or workflows in an iPaaS or ITSM platform, with results you can point to, such as ticket volume you eliminated

  • Experience as the sole or senior IT person at a site, comfortable making day-to-day decisions and knowing when a change needs sign-off

  • Strong async written communication, including clear handoffs, decision notes, and documentation as thorough as what you build

  • Strong troubleshooting instincts across systems that touch identity, networking, and SaaS integrations

  • Willingness to work in our London office 5 days a week

Even better if you have

  • Experience with Serval or another AI-native ITSM platform

  • Experience with iPaaS platforms like Workato, Zapier, or Tines

  • Exposure to AWS, GCP, or Azure administration

  • Familiarity with SOC 2, ISO 27001, or UK GDPR

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or similar)

  • Okta certifications

  • Experience supporting EMEA employees at a US-headquartered company

Benefits

We proudly offer the following benefits for our full-time employees:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life Insurance and Disability Benefits

  • Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension)

  • Parental Leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work-life balance

  • Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best

  • Take what you need vacation policy (subject to local requirements; UK employees receive 25 days of statutory leave)

Decagon offers a competitive benefits package that varies by country and complements local statutory benefits. Details for this location will be provided during the recruitment process.

Compensation: £50K – £75K • Offers Equity

title: Junior Gis/GEO Tester
descriptionHtml:
Je bent nieuwsgierig, werkt nauwkeurig en vindt het interessant om uit te zoeken hoe systemen en data werken. Je hebt oog voor detail en krijgt er energie van om te ontdekken waar iets beter of slimmer kan. Een combinatie van IT, testen en geografische informatie spreekt je aan. Dan is deze functie als Junior GIS/GEO Tester iets voor jou.

Wat ga je doen als Junior GIS/GEO Tester?

Als Junior GIS/GEO Tester ga je aan de slag binnen een professioneel IT-team dat werkt met geografische informatie en GEO-applicaties. Je helpt mee om te zorgen dat applicaties, functionaliteiten en data goed werken voordat deze in gebruik worden genomen.

Je leert hoe je testgevallen opstelt, functionaliteiten controleert en resultaten analyseert. Je werkt daarbij met GIS/GEO-systemen en leert steeds meer over geografische data, applicaties en de technische omgeving daarachter.

Concreet zijn jouw werkzaamheden

  • Opstellen en uitvoeren van testgevallen voor GIS/GEO-applicaties

  • Controleren of nieuwe functionaliteiten werken zoals bedoeld

  • Testen van geografische data en controleren op juistheid en volledigheid

  • Analyseren en documenteren van testresultaten

  • Signaleren, reproduceren en vastleggen van fouten en afwijkingen

  • Meedenken over hoe applicaties en processen verbeterd kunnen worden

  • Samenwerken met ontwikkelaars, functioneel beheerders en andere IT-specialisten

  • Ondersteunen bij regressietesten en het testen van nieuwe releases

  • Werken met GIS/GEO-tools en je verder ontwikkelen in het vakgebied

Je hoeft nog niet alles te kunnen. Juist tijdens het traineeship leer je hoe je gestructureerd test, hoe je fouten onderzoekt en hoe je steeds zelfstandiger wordt in het werken met GIS/GEO-systemen. Heb je al kennis van GIS, geografische data, softwaretesten of bijvoorbeeld SQL? Dan is dat mooi meegenomen.

Ook als je vooral een sterke interesse hebt in IT en GEO en graag wilt leren, komen we graag met je in contact.


Wat kun je verwachten van het traineeship?

Je start met een onboarding in Bunnik. Hier leer je samen met andere trainees de basis van IT en ontwikkel je vaardigheden die je direct kunt toepassen in je opdracht. Tijdens het tweejarige traineeship krijg je volop ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen en je te verdiepen in GIS/GEO, testen en andere IT-onderwerpen die bij jou passen.

Je krijgt begeleiding van een People Manager die regelmatig met je meekijkt naar je ontwikkeling, leerdoelen en carrière. Daarnaast behaal je verschillende trainingen en erkende certificaten, zodat je niet alleen ervaring opdoet in de praktijk, maar ook werkt aan een stevig fundament voor je verdere IT-carrière.

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Een tweejarig IT-traineeship met veel ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling

  • Een startsalaris van €2.600 tot €2.800

  • Direct een vast contract

  • Jaarlijks een evaluatiemoment met de mogelijkheid om je salaris met maximaal €500 te verhogen

  • 25 vakantiedagen en vakantiegeld

  • Een passende reiskostenvergoeding

  • Verschillende trainingen en erkende IT-certificaten

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding van een People Manager

  • Een jong en energiek team met regelmatig leuke activiteiten en borrels

Dit vragen wij van jou

  • Je hebt een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in de richting van IT, Geo-informatie, Geografie, GIS, Data, Informatica of een vergelijkbare richting

  • Je hebt interesse in softwaretesten, GIS/GEO en IT

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en vindt het leuk om problemen uit te pluizen

  • Je bent analytisch en denkt graag in oplossingen

  • Je kunt goed samenwerken en je bevindingen duidelijk uitleggen

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig en staat open om nieuwe technieken en systemen te leren

  • Kennis van GIS, geografische data, SQL of softwaretesten is een pluspunt, maar geen vereiste

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed

  • Je bent bereid om minimaal 2 dagen per week in Assen te werken

Deze vacature is onderdeel van onze werving voor de traineeshipklas die in maart 2027 start. We komen graag nu al met je in contact. Je werkt minimaal 2 dagen per week vanuit de locatie in Assen.

We’re looking for junior operations analysts to join our Transfers team in Edinburgh on a six-month fixed term contract. It’s a hands-on way to build your operational expertise in a fast-paced financial services business, with the chance to move into a permanent role.

You’ll help make sure pension and investment transfers run smoothly: managing communications with ceding and receiving schemes, keeping records accurate and making sure firms know where their transfers stand. You’ll work from our Edinburgh office alongside experienced colleagues who’ll support your development, and you’ll contribute from day one.

Whether you’re starting your career or broadening your experience, you’ll get real ownership, exposure to products, technology and investment wrappers, and work that directly shapes the service our clients receive.

What you’ll own

  • Keeping transfers moving by managing communications between transferring pension and investment schemes and Seccl

  • Progressing transfer activity through calls and emails with ceding and receiving schemes

  • Maintaining accurate internal client and scheme records

  • Keeping firms informed with timely updates on transfer progress

  • Delivering accurate submissions within agreed service levels

  • Answering transfer queries from across the business quickly and professionally

  • Supporting other operational teams and business areas to deliver a seamless client experience

This role’s for you if...

  • You’re keen to learn about financial services, technology and investment wrappers

  • You’ve worked in a fast-paced environment where juggling multiple tasks is the norm

  • You want to take ownership of processes and customer outcomes

  • You enjoy working with numbers, have a sharp eye for detail and are a solid problem solver

  • You communicate clearly, stay organised and care about accuracy

  • You’re a team player, focused on customers and delivery, who wants to build new skills along the way

What’s in it for you

We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:

  • Annual salary of £28,000, plus 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance

  • 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays (some can be flexible), plus your birthday off

  • Health and wellbeing: free therapy through Wellness Cloud, mental health support through Headspace

  • Financial wellbeing: will writing through Octopus Legacy, and Seccl invest, our own platform for you to manage your investments

  • Perkbox: flexible points for discounts and perks, including a free weekly coffee, gym and retail discounts

Benefits are pro-rata to the contract duration.

Our culture

We put people first and try hard to create an environment where people feel trusted, heard and able to do their best work.

We value openness, curiosity and different perspectives. You’ll have the freedom to challenge how things are done, experiment with better ways of working and take real ownership of your impact.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Everyone’s welcome

Our aim is to build a diverse and inclusive company of awesome people, with unique skills, passions and experiences. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran status, neurodiversity or disability.

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you.

descriptionHtml:

Doctolib recherche un(e) Key Account Manager Senior pour piloter ses relations avec les 6 plus grands groupes de laboratoires en France, représentant près de 75 % du marché : Cerballiance, Biogroup, Eurofins, Inovie, Synlab et Unilabs.

La consolidation du marché de la biologie médicale est bien avancée. Les grands groupes ont initié leur transformation digitale — la mission de ce poste est d'y prendre toute la place possible : comprendre leurs stratégies, s'y inscrire au plus tôt, les influencer, et positionner Doctolib comme le partenaire digital de référence de chaque groupe. Ce rôle combine gestion d'un portefeuille de +4M€, stratégie patient de bout en bout, pilotage d'une stratégie d'upsell à fort impact (Patient Intake, Phone Assistant, Téléconsultation, Portail Patient) et un ownership fort dans un environnement en construction.

Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :

  • Bâtir et piloter des plans commerciaux par groupe, avec des roadmaps adaptées et des priorités d'upsell co-construites avec les clients, en naviguant dans la complexité propre au cluster (architectures multi-sites, intégrations API, cycles de vente longs, spécificités contractuelles)

  • Mener les négociations commerciales stratégiques avec les décideurs de haut niveau (DG, DAF, DSI, Directeurs Qualité, Biologistes référents) et développer des relations de confiance durables avec les interlocuteurs C-level

  • Participer à la définition de la stratégie patient : augmenter l'usage et l'adoption de bout en bout, de la prescription par le médecin à l'interprétation des résultats, et être force de proposition sur chaque étape du parcours

  • Prévenir le churn, transformer les insatisfactions en opportunités et animer des business reviews régulières avec les comités de direction des groupes

Les qualités attendues en tant que Key Account Manager Senior

Ce serait fantastique si :

title: Key Account Manager — Treasury Expert
descriptionHtml:
About Agicap Créée à Lyon en 2016 par trois entrepreneurs français, Agicap est l'une des scale-ups avec la plus forte croissance d’Europe, avec plus de 8 000 clients, 700 employés et une croissance rapide du chiffre d'affaires (multiplié par 7 entre 2021 et 2024). Agicap fait partie du French Tech 120, qui récompense les startups les plus prometteuses de France. Agicap permet aux directions financières des entreprises de taille intermédiaire de gérer et de prévoir efficacement leur trésorerie, de payer leurs fournisseurs et de se faire payer. En combinant un système de gestion de trésorerie avec des solutions de gestion des comptes fournisseurs et des comptes clients sur une seule plateforme, Agicap ambitionne de devenir la nouvelle référence en matière de gestion de trésorerie pour les entreprises de taille intermédiaire. Nous avons levé 145 millions d’euros depuis notre création, auprès de fonds de capital-risque prestigieux tels qu’AVP, Greenoaks, Partech et BlackFin, avec un dernier tour en novembre 2024. Ces ressources supplémentaires alimentent encore davantage notre innovation produit, nous permettant de croître significativement et d’accélérer notre expansion internationale à travers le monde. Nous sommes convaincus que notre succès réside dans nos équipes passionnées et dévouées, engagées à bâtir une entreprise où chacun peut évoluer et construire sa carrière. Nous sommes constamment à la recherche de nouveaux talents, visant l’excellence et prêts à rejoindre notre aventure ambitieuse ! Home page Customer Stories Our Values
⚡️ Le rôle

Agicap est en pleine phase de scale-up : nous signons chaque mois de nombreux nouveaux clients, et développer et fidéliser nos clients existants est désormais tout aussi important. L'expansion et le churn font partie des premiers indicateurs suivis par notre board.

En tant que Key Account Manager, vous êtes responsable d'un portefeuille d'environ 150 comptes mid-market : des entreprises de plus de 50 M€ de chiffre d'affaires, souvent des groupes multi-entités, des sociétés en hypercroissance ou détenues par des fonds de private equity. Vous travaillez avec des DAF, directeur·rices financier·ères, trésorier·ères, responsables comptables et parfois des CEO.

Ce qui rend ce poste unique : vous apportez une vraie expertise en trésorerie. Vous ne vous contentez pas de comprendre les enjeux des équipes finance (maîtriser les prévisions de trésorerie, améliorer la performance financière, assurer la gestion quotidienne des paiements et de la liquidité, gérer la relation bancaire, intégrer et piloter toutes les entités d'un groupe) : vous savez les challenger. Vous êtes un·e véritable conseiller·ère de confiance pour vos clients.

Vous rejoignez une équipe de 7 KAM qui a obtenu d'excellents résultats cette année, avec un fort esprit d'équipe et des objectifs ambitieux.


🎯 Vos missions

🤝 Construire des relations solides avec les décideur·ses finance

  • Instaurer une relation de confiance avec les décideur·ses de vos comptes et cartographier toutes les parties prenantes clés, souvent sur plusieurs entités
  • Comprendre leur contexte business, leur organisation trésorerie, leurs process et leurs priorités, et les challenger avec les bonnes pratiques adaptées
  • Gérer les frictions et les situations complexes avec assurance

    • 📈 Développer votre portefeuille

title: Lead AI Enabled Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Working at CreateFuture

CreateFuture is an AI-native consulting partner where people do work that matters and are supported to do it well. We work alongside organisations such as PayPal, adidas, NatWest, FanDuel and Money Saving Expert, building digital products and services that make a difference  while always putting people first.

We’re a team of creators. We write code, shape delivery, build go-to-market strategies, develop AI solutions and create the practices that support our people. We work side by side with our clients, challenging what’s not working and helping them to build the future. Our commitment to craft, quality, and culture has helped us scale to over 600 people in just a few years.

CreateFuture is a Great Place to Work-Certified™ company and has won Best Workplaces UK multiple years in a row.

Join us on our journey. Let’s create tomorrow, together, today.

About the role and team:

You’ll join our  team, working side by side with clients and our delivery teams to shape architectural direction and turn it into production systems. Increasingly, our clients want products and platforms that are AI-native from the start. As a Lead AI-enabled Software Engineer, you’ll be the technical lead for a team or engagement: staying hands-on where it matters most, owning the technical approach from design through to delivery, anticipating operational and delivery risks before they land, and setting the engineering standards our teams and clients work to.

How we work
CreateFuture is an AI-native organisation. Every core technical role is expected to:

  • Work with AI-native delivery and workflow practices.
  • Practise agentic engineering through at least one harness.
  • Apply context engineering through prompts, skills, tools and harnesses.
  • Know at least one runtime or language.
  • Use CI/CD and automated quality practices to verify work in all its forms.

What you'll be doing:

As a Lead AI-enabled Software Engineer, you’ll lead the technical delivery of application features and systems using AI-assisted engineering. You’ll set the direction for how sound software engineering and agentic ways of working come together on an engagement, and make sure the team delivers to that standard.

You’ll bring deep, role-specific capability, and the judgement to lead others in:
  • Application architecture and modular design, including owning architectural decisions and trade-offs across a system.
  • Application data, state, and persistence design.
  • Application feature, API, interface, and service-integration engineering.
  • Spec-driven development, including defining how specs are written and used across a team.
  • Test-driven development and wider quality strategy.
  • Secure application development.
  • Application performance, operability and production readiness.
  • Context and workflow optimisation for agentic engineering, at team and engagement level.
  • AI Agent Orchestration & Workflow Design.
  • AI Evaluation, Observability & Guardrails, including setting the approach a team follows.
  • Java, Kotlin Multiplatform or .NET, with extensive commercial experience in at least one and a track record of leading teams that use it.

You won’t need depth in all of these, but leadership experience in one or more of the following would be valuable:
  • Front-end application development.
  • Mobile application development.
  • Back-end and service development.
  • Cloud-native application development.
  • Real-time and event-driven systems.
  • Legacy application modernisation and migration.
  • AI-enabled product features.
  • Agentic development environments and harnesses.
  • Agentic engineering evaluation and observability platforms.

We'd love to talk to you if: 

  • Lead the resolution of complex, ambiguous problems that span teams, systems or an entire engagement, and make sound calls when the right answer isn’t obvious.
  • Set and own technical direction for application design and delivery, deciding how work gets done and holding the team to it.
  • Act as the senior technical voice with client stakeholders, advising on architecture, quality, risk and engineering trade-offs, and helping shape engagements from discovery onwards.
  • Lead, coach and grow engineers, including Seniors, and contribute to hiring and capability building.
  • Raise standards beyond your own engagement, shaping practices, patterns and tooling across our software engineering discipline.

What we’ll offer you:

We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.

We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.

We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.

Our hiring process

We try to keep our hiring process clear, fair and respectful of your time. We aim to get back to everyone who applies and we will be upfront about where you are in the process.

It usually looks like this:

  • Call with our Talent Acquisition Team 
  • Role specific capability interview 

Depending on the role, we might also ask you to do a short presentation, a practical or technical task or have a values focused conversation. We will explain what is involved before anything happens.

Inclusion at CreateFuture 

We believe diverse teams build better workplaces and better products. We want CreateFuture to be a place where people feel able to be themselves and do their best work.

If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just. We will do what we can to help.

We look forward to your application!

title: Lead Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Level Up Your Career! At Kwalee, you’ll join a gaming powerhouse that boasts a mobile empire with 1.5 billion+ downloads alongside a thriving PC & Console division that has achieved numerous global chart-topping releases across Steam, Consoles, and Amazon, driving millions of Wishlists. Most recently publishing breakout hits such as The Precinct and Town to City. It’s a unique chance to bring your expertise to a global studio that dominates both the mobile, and the indie PC and Console space. At Kwalee, as well as a competitive salary we also offer; Private Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, Life Assurance, Royal London Pension, a Free On-site Gym, Dog-friendly Office, LinkedIn Learning, 25 holiday days + bank holidays, and 1 day extra holiday for each year of service capped at 5.

Join The Team!

Kwalee’s Product & Growth team is looking for a Lead Product Manager to shape what comes next in our live games: what we change, why, and what it will earn.

You’ll team up with our Executive Producers: they lead how we build; you lead what we build and why, and together you make our games better and better.

We’ll match the title to your experience. This role is for you if you’re a product leader who loves living in player data, forming bold hypotheses about retention, engagement, and monetisation, running clean experiments, and turning results into confident decisions.

This role is based onsite 5 days per week at our Leamington Spa studio, where our daily in-office collaboration fuels creativity and innovation.


What You’ll Do:

  • Understand the games inside out. Know the key numbers for each game, find the biggest opportunities in retention, engagement, economy and monetisation, and size them.

  • Start with a hypothesis. Turn every opportunity into a clear hypothesis with a success metric, so every feature ships with a purpose.

  • Run experiments that decide. Design A/B tests with our product analysts, read them with an open mind, and decide together with the producer what ships next.

  • Shape the roadmap. Build and prioritise the game roadmap with the Executive Producer, ranked by the value it will create.

  • Connect growth and product. Bring what UA and creative learn about our players into the games, and work with monetisation on the best player experience.

  • Grow the product craft. Guide our product analysts and help set how we do product across the portfolio.

  • Spot tomorrow’s hits. Bring a product view to our most promising new games as they grow


    • What You’ll Own:

    Great product decisions and the extra player value that they will create in our biggest games.

    You’ll be the champion who ensures every big player opportunity gets a smart hypothesis, a clear experiment, and a place on the roadmap.

    How we’ll celebrate your success:

  • Growth in LTV and profit from product changes
  • Retention, engagement, and monetisation in your games
  • Experiments launched, learned from, and shipped
  • Clear, well-reasoned roadmap decisions

    • What We’re Looking For:

    Essential

  • Senior product management experience in F2P mobile games, with live games you’ve measurably improved.

Kaluza est l’Energy Intelligence Platform : nous transformons la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les acteurs de l’énergie à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié.

Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel entre les foyers, les équipements, les marchés et les réseaux. En combinant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie de tous les jours.

Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des innovateurs comme Volvo et Volkswagen.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Faire le lien entre notre technologie et celles et ceux qui l’utilisent : accompagner nos clients, partenaires et collègues, principalement sur le marché français et plus largement dans les marchés francophones, pour qu’ils comprennent la plateforme Kaluza et surtout la maîtrisent.

  • Suivre l’efficacité de vos programmes et les améliorer en continu à partir des retours et des indicateurs de performance, pour que la formation ait un impact concret pour nos utilisateurs et pour le secteur de l’énergie.


Ce que vous apportez

Critères essentiels :

  • Bilinguisme : vous êtes à l’aise en français comme en anglais, avec d’excellentes qualités de communication écrite et orale.

  • Expertise en formation SaaS : vous avez une expérience avérée de conception et d’animation de programmes de formation à fort impact dans un environnement SaaS ou technologique.

  • Sens de la simplification : vous savez naturellement traduire des concepts techniques et métier complexes en supports clairs, engageants et pratiques.

  • Une culture de l’excellence opérationnelle : une connaissance des processus de centre de contact ou des technologies de service client, pour concevoir des formations qui améliorent l’efficacité opérationnelle.

  • Une expérience de leadership en formation : un parcours démontré de montée en charge de programmes de formation et une capacité à réfléchir stratégiquement à la construction d’une culture d’apprentissage au sein d’une organisation internationale.

Nos valeurs

Cinq valeurs guident notre façon de travailler chez Kaluza :

title: Machine Learning Fellow - Human Frontier Collective
descriptionHtml:
The Human Frontier Collective (HFC)’s mission is to bring the world's best minds to shape the future of AI – because the future of AI depends not only on powerful models, but on the people who teach them to think. We bring together researchers, academics, and domain leaders across 70+ fields – over 90% of members hold doctorates – to shape how frontier AI systems are built, evaluated, and governed. HFC members have since co-authored published work including SciPredict, PropensityBench, and Professional Reasoning Benchmark.

Why join the HFC

HFC centers on three core pillars: the network itself, participation in selected AI/ML projects, and opportunities to publish with our research team.

  • Join a unique and exclusive expert network: You’ll become a part of an interdisciplinary community, consisting of over 90% doctorates and field leaders representing 70+ fields from the leading institutions. We’re a collective of top innovators and thought leaders committed to advancing frontier AI to power the world’s most important decisions.
  • Participate in AI/ML projects: Beyond the collective network, you’ll be regularly invited to work on high-impact projects with Scale AI and its affiliated lab and platform: building AI safety and policy guardrails, helping models understand real-world deep learning workflows by designing, reviewing, and optimizing PyTorch models, evaluating complex ML code and AI-generated implementations for efficiency and correctness, and more.
  • Co-author selected research publications: Collaborate with Scale’s research team to co-author technical reports and research papers—boosting your academic visibility and professional recognition.

Who should apply

  • Background: PhD, or postdoctoral research experience, in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related field; or senior industry experience in Machine Learning or a related field.
  • Skills: Strong proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow). Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and MLOps tools (Docker) and LLM frameworks (LangChain) is a plus.
  • Professional Mindset: Detail-oriented, innovative thinker with a passion for applied AI research and a commitment to collaboration.

How it works

  • Duration: This is a fully remote opportunity with no fixed end date; engagements continue as long as there's mutual interest. This is a 1099 independent contractor engagement. 
  • Work authorization: We do not sponsor visas for Fellows. To participate in the HFC Fellows program, you need to have or independently obtain full-time work authorization in the country you reside in. 
  • Community Network: Once you’ve received an invitation to join the HFC, you’ll also gain access to our newsletters, discussion channels, virtual sessions, IRL events, and much more.
  • Projects Logistics: 
    • Project selection: You’ll regularly get matched to carefully selected projects from our partners. Depending on the partner, projects range from evaluating AI models to designing experiments, building RL environments, co-authoring research papers, and more. 
    • Flexible schedule: There's no minimum commitment – you decide whether to take on a project. Most fellows spend 10–25 hours per week, on a schedule they set themselves.
    • Competitive pay: Project pay rates vary across platforms and depend on a number of factors, including but not limited to: projects, scope, skillset, and location. You’ll receive the pay information upon receiving project matching notifications.

Application process

  1. Apply: We review applications on a rolling basis.
  2. Interview: Candidates will get to discuss their research experience, professional background, and alignment with our mission to advance human-centered AI. Note: If we invited you directly, your invitation will say whether this step applies.
  3. Join the Collective: Successful candidates will receive an invitation to join the Human Frontier Collective Fellowship.

PLEASE NOTE: Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants.

About Us:

At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst& Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. We are expanding our team to accelerate the development of AI applications.

title: Manager Amazon
descriptionHtml:
Über uns

Kijimea – Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen.

Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 (Kijimea Reizdarm). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert – u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet.

Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen.

Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken.

Für Dich klingt das spannend? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Deine Mission bei uns

Möchtest Du den Erfolg unserer Gesundheitsmarken auf Amazon mitgestalten und mit kreativen, datenbasierten Lösungen neue Maßstäbe setzen? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig!

Als Manager Amazon verantwortest Du unseren Amazon-Vertriebskanal ganzheitlich und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Healthcare-Produkte sichtbar, verfügbar und erfolgreich sind. Hilf uns dabei, Millionen von Menschen ein längeres und gesünderes Leben zu ermöglichen.

  • Du entwickelst einen einheitlichen, überzeugenden und performanceorientierten Markenauftritt auf unseren Product Detail Pages (PDPs) sowie in unseren Amazon-Werbeanzeigen.

title: Manager, Compliance Advisory
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Role

Checkout is looking for an experienced financial crime compliance lead to establish, grow, and maintain a global second-line team. This role will oversee the compliance frameworks supporting our rapidly evolving portfolio of mass market products.

This opportunity is a perfect fit if you are excited by the prospect of leveraging the momentum and resources of a global scale-up to support the launch and scale of high velocity products. As products expand and launch, there will be an opportunity to grow your team across multiple regions.

You will be expected to:

  • Build the Framework: Establish the global framework for second-line escalations for new products; working closely with relevant regional MLROs to ensure consistency and operational excellence.

  • Drive Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with Risk, Operations, and Product teams to align compliance requirements with fraud mitigation and user experience goals.

  • Monitor Emerging Trends: Maintain a deep understanding of financial crime typologies, regulatory guidance, and emerging industry trends, ensuring these are proactively factored into our control framework and knowledge base.

  • Design & Deliver Training: Develop and deliver targeted training to business and compliance teams regarding complex financial crime and fraud risks inherent in high-volume environments.

  • Ensure Compliance-by-Design: Partner with our Regulatory Compliance function to integrate compliance requirements early in the product development lifecycle.

  • Own Compliance Requirements: Assume central responsibility for mapping and maintaining SDD, CDD, and EDD requirements for our evolving product set, ensuring relevant factors are codified into global minimum standards.

  • Strategic Advisory: Directly advise Product and Operations teams on the opportunities and risks associated with automation, AI deployment, and system scale.

  • Integrate Risk Assessments: Collaborate closely with regional MLROs to ensure product-specific risk profiles are accurately captured and factored into Business-Wide Risk Assessments.

  • Implement Assurance: Collaborate with our Assurance and Internal Controls team to design and execute robust compliance monitoring processes for new product lines.

Experience we are looking for:

  • 6+ years of second-line compliance experience in fintech, payments, or banking at scale (neobank/fintech experience strongly preferred).

  • Deep expertise in financial crime (AML/CFT/Sanctions/Fraud) risk, with regulatory compliance experience as a strong plus.

  • Experience growing and leading a team, with cross-border/global management experience highly desirable.

  • Proven track record in architecting frameworks for high-volume environments and working directly with technical/product stakeholders to design solutions.

Personal qualities we look for:

  • Confident decision-maker: Ability to quickly assess risks, weigh mitigations, and provide strong, defensible rationale for your decisions.

  • Technical fluency: Comfortable working directly with technical leaders to drill down into the configuration of user journeys, systems, and tooling.

  • AI-first mindset: Experience deploying AI or automation tools to accelerate compliance processes at scale.

  • Strategic thinker: Ability to immerse yourself in fine details while keeping the broader organisational picture in mind.

  • Growth-oriented: Relentlessly curious and driven; always learning and spotting opportunities to develop yourself and others.

  • Proportionate and Collaborative: An obsession with balancing strong compliance with scalability and user experience, supported by exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

title: Manager Recruitment Onderwijs
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij op operationeel niveau bouwen aan de mensen die het onderwijs van duizenden leerlingen versterken? Als Resource Manager bij Lyceo in Leiden krijg je een sleutelpositie binnen een landelijke marktleider die volop groeit. Een baan met directe impact, veel verantwoordelijkheid en volop ruimte om recruitment en capaciteitsmanagement verder te professionaliseren.

Taken

Maak het verschil als Resource Manager in Leiden

Als Resource Manager zorg je ervoor dat Lyceo nu en in de toekomst beschikt over de juiste begeleiders om scholen en leerlingen tijdig te ondersteunen. Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor hun beschikbaarheid, kwaliteit en inzetbaarheid. Je maakt deel uit van het MT en rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de directie van Lyceo. Met ondersteuning van het datateam bepaal je welke begeleiders waar en wanneer nodig zijn. Op basis daarvan laat je gerichte recruitmentacties uitvoeren en geef je richting aan selectie, matching en onboarding. Met KPI’s bewaak je de instroom, retentie, vervulling en doorlooptijden en stuur je gericht bij. Daarnaast optimaliseer je processen en geef je leiding aan een team met onder andere een Recruiter en een Coördinator Matching en Onboarding. Samen met de Operationeel Manager zorg je voor voldoende geschikte mensen en een succesvolle uitvoering van alle onderwijsprojecten. Bij afwezigheid kunnen jullie elkaars verantwoordelijkheden overnemen.

Kortom, jij pakt de regie bij het:

  • realiseren van voldoende gerichte instroom en een kwalitatief sterke recruitment, selectie en onboarding;
  • verbinden van vraag en aanbod op basis van regio, vakgebied, onderwijstype, beschikbaarheid en reisbereidheid;
  • voorspellen, bewaken en bijsturen van de capaciteitsbehoefte met data en KPI’s;
  • optimaliseren van recruitment en instroomprocessen en adviseren over selectiecriteria, retentie en capaciteit;
  • aansturen van het team en bewaken van het recruitmentbudget.

Vereisten

Voor deze vacature neem jij mee:

Je vertaalt recruitmentdoelstellingen naar concrete acties en stuurt met data op kwaliteit, instroom en capaciteit. Historische resultaten combineer je met verwachtingen en ontwikkelingen in de markt. Ook wanneer nog niet alles vaststaat, kijk je vooruit, maak je keuzes en stuur je tijdig bij. Als leidinggevende sta je dicht bij je team, geef je richting en neem je mensen met positieve energie mee. Ervaring binnen recruitment, arbeidsbemiddeling, detachering of vergelijkbare dienstverlening helpt je om wisselende capaciteitsvragen snel te doorgronden.

Vink jij deze checklist ook af?

  • minimaal hbo werk- en denkniveau;
  • ervaring met recruitment, werving en selectie;
  • leidinggevende ervaring binnen recruitment, capaciteitsmanagement of een vergelijkbare dienstverlenende omgeving;
  • ervaring met het sturen op data en KPI’s binnen recruitment of capaciteitsplanning;
  • ervaring met het optimaliseren van recruitment- of instroomprocessen.

Jouw werkgebied

Jouw nieuwe werkplek bevindt zich in Leiden, vlak bij Leiden Centraal. Vanuit het kantoor werk je nauw samen met de verschillende afdelingen van Lyceo. Dankzij de ligging nabij het centraal station is de werkplek goed bereikbaar met het openbaar vervoer.

Benefits

Als gedreven Resource Manager kun jij rekenen op:

Een verantwoordelijke functie bij een groeiende onderwijsorganisatie waar ontwikkeling niet alleen voor leerlingen centraal staat. Lyceo biedt je ruimte voor initiatief, eigenaarschap en nieuwe ideeën. Via de Lyceo Academie blijf je bovendien zelf leren en krijg je volop mogelijkheden om binnen de organisatie door te groeien.

Op basis van een fulltime dienstverband krijg je daarbovenop:

  • een verantwoordelijke functie van 32 tot 40 uur per week, waarbij je tijdens de drukke periodes in het schooljaar flexibel beschikbaar bent;
  • 25 vakantiedagen, waarvan je naar rato 10 vakantiedagen opneemt in de zomervakantie;
  • de mogelijkheid om 5 extra verlofdagen bij te kopen;
  • 8% vakantiegeld, uitbetaald in mei;
  • reiskostenvergoeding per kilometer of volledige vergoeding van OV-kosten;
  • een pensioenregeling waarbij Lyceo 6% premie betaalt;
  • een laptop en telefoon van de zaak;
  • toegang tot exclusieve kortingen via Benefits at Work;
  • deelname aan de Lyceo Academie met diverse online en fysieke trainingen;
  • volop mogelijkheden om door te groeien binnen Lyceo;
  • leuke activiteiten via onze personeelsvereniging Nablijven.

Werken bij Lyceo

Wie werkt bij Lyceo, blijft leren. Lyceo is een toonaangevende landelijke organisatie in aanvullend onderwijs en helpt jaarlijks duizenden leerlingen met onder andere huiswerkbegeleiding, bijspijkertrajecten, examentrainingen en lente- en zomerscholen. Scholen beoordelen de dienstverlening van Lyceo gemiddeld met een 8,5 of hoger.

Als marktleider is Lyceo volop in beweging en heeft de organisatie duidelijke groeiambities. Je werkt in een betrokken en energieke omgeving waarin samenwerking centraal staat en ruimte is voor initiatief, eigenaarschap en nieuwe ideeën. Samen werkt Lyceo aan de beste verbinding tussen regulier en aanvullend onderwijs, zodat ieder kind tot zijn recht kan komen.

title: Manager/Senior Manager, Financial Services - Banking & Markets
descriptionHtml:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Banking & Markets practice are looking for experienced Managers & Senior Managers to join the team. 

Banking and Markets are being reinvented. AI is transforming how institutions operate, customer and regulatory expectations are rising, and established players are under pressure to grow, modernise and perform at pace. Our team works alongside senior leaders at financial institutions to tackle the challenges that matter most - from unlocking new sources of growth and reimagining operating models, to harnessing AI, modernising technology and responding to rapidly changing markets.

Our clients include global transaction, corporate and investment banks, leading high-street banks, building societies, growing digital banking providers and more. You’ll combine strategic thinking and analytical rigour with hands-on delivery experience and an AI-first mindset, helping clients turn complex problems into meaningful, lasting change.

What you will be doing

  • Shaping and delivering large-scale technology, AI and digital transformation programmes, supporting our clients on their transformation journeys.

  • Maximising business value for our clients through the definition and delivery of effective technology, digital, AI and data projects. We see strong demand in the market for pragmatic, delivery-focused consultants who are capable of leading teams, and have the ability to adapt to hybrid delivery models (e.g. Waterfall and Agile). 

  • Helping our clients reimagine how their operations will work in an AI age - redesigning processes, operating models and ways of working to drive operational excellence, and balancing the technology change with the people and process change needed to make it stick.

  • Working directly with client stakeholders, building trusted working relationships and supporting effective communication across teams. 

  • Developing our people, coaching and managing colleagues, providing high-quality feedback and creating opportunities for others to grow.

 
Your skills and experience 
 

  • Proven experience leading complex consulting engagements or transformation programmes, with accountability for successful delivery and measurable client outcomes.

  • Product knowledge in one or more of the following domains: Retail, Commercial or Corporate Banking or Capital Markets (propositions, channels, operations and technologies). 

  • A track record of building trusted client relationships and originating or shaping new work, alongside successful delivery of complex engagements.

  • Strong commercial awareness, with experience contributing to business development, proposals, account growth or the development of new client opportunities.

  • Experience leading and developing high-performing teams, including coaching more junior colleagues and managing delivery across multidisciplinary teams.

  • A  proven track record in one or more of the following areas:

    • Leading complex programmes spanning technology, business and operations, with AI at the core

    • Delivering technology and AI solutions at pace, using Agile and hybrid delivery models

    • Defining and delivering operating models built for an AI age

    • Reinventing processes and driving operational excellence through data, automation and AI

    • Shaping payments strategy and modernising payments (e.g. real-time payments, ISO 20022) 

    • Shaping technology and AI strategy and architecture

    • Supporting digital assets and tokenisation, and navigating regulatory change (e.g. DORA, AI regulation).

What a career at Baringa will give you 


Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave. 
  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. 
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice. 
  • Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success. 

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people. 

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this. 

Using business as a force for good. 

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve. 

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

Join us

All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We never rely solely on automated screening or AI tools to make hiring decisions. Your application will be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, disability, age, faith or social background. We do not filter applications by university background and encourage those who have taken alternative educational and career paths to apply. We would like to actively encourage applications from those who identify with less represented and minority groups. We operate an inclusive recruitment process, ensuring reasonable adjustments where needed. Please contact a member of our Recruitment Team to discuss further.

Baringa Privacy Notices

For UK & EU

Your personal data will be retained by Baringa for up to two years, in accordance with our UK Recruitment Privacy Notice / EU Recruitment Privacy Notice, to evaluate your application and meet our legal and reporting obligations. In line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to request access to, rectification, or erasure (subject to legal limitations) of your personal data. Your personal data may be retained by Baringa for up to two years, as outlined in our Recruitment Privacy Notice (AMER & APAC), to support the recruitment process and internal reporting requirements. Where applicable, and in accordance with relevant federal and state laws, you may have the right to request access to or correction of your personal information. title: Marketing Generalist
descriptionHtml:
Company

Neuphonic is building the future of on-device voice AI.

We develop ultra-low-latency neural text-to-speech systems that enable super-realistic, human-like speech directly on devices. Our focus is on building efficient generative audio models and infrastructure that can run on CPU-constrained hardware, enabling real-time voice interaction without relying on large cloud infrastructure.

By dramatically reducing latency and compute requirements, we are making natural conversational AI possible on phones, embedded devices, browsers, and edge systems. This requires building high-performance systems that bridge machine learning, real-time audio processing, and distributed infrastructure.

Neuphonic was founded in April 2024 and is backed by leading B2B venture capital firms in Europe. Our customers include OEM handset manufacturers, chip manufacturers, and consumer AI companies building the next generation of voice-enabled products.

Our vision is a world where voice becomes the most natural interface for AI, enabling seamless, intuitive interactions that are accessible to everyone.

We’re solving challenging problems across real-time machine learning, edge inference, streaming systems, and ultra-low-latency infrastructure. If you enjoy working in a fast-moving environment and turning technical ideas into something people want to talk about, you’ll feel at home here.

Role

We’re looking for a Marketing Generalist to help build Neuphonic’s brand and grow awareness of our technology.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is excited about AI, startups and technology, and wants to work across a broad range of marketing activities. You’ll work closely with the founders and wider team to help turn what we are building into interesting content, campaigns and moments that get people talking about Neuphonic.

We’re looking for someone who is proactive, creative and highly organised. You don’t need to come in with a fully formed marketing playbook. What matters more is that you are curious, move quickly and are happy to take an idea and make it happen.

Your work will include:

  • Creating and publishing content across LinkedIn, X, our website and other relevant channels

  • Helping plan and execute product launches, open-source releases and company announcements

  • Turning technical work from our engineering and research teams into clear, engaging content

  • Coming up with creative ideas to increase awareness of Neuphonic and our products

  • Helping organise events, demos, conferences and other marketing activities

  • Supporting campaigns and identifying interesting companies, communities and audiences to reach

  • Writing case studies, blog posts, newsletters and other marketing materials

  • Tracking the performance of campaigns and content and learning what works

  • Keeping our website, social channels and marketing materials up to date

  • Jumping into ad hoc projects and helping wherever needed as the company grows

This is a broad role with lots of ownership. Some weeks you might be helping launch a new model, others you might be creating content from a research paper, organising an event or testing a new campaign.

You have

  • Around 2–5 years of experience in marketing, content, growth, communications or a similar role

  • Ideally, experience working at a startup and helping it grow or scale

  • Excellent written communication skills and the ability to explain ideas clearly and simply

  • A genuine interest in AI, technology and startups

  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail

  • The ability to take ownership of a task and drive it through to completion

  • A creative mindset and lots of ideas for how to make technical products interesting

  • A willingness to learn quickly and get involved in lots of different areas

  • Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where priorities can change

In addition, one or more of the following would be particularly valuable:

  • Experience as an early marketing hire or working in a small, fast-growing team

  • Experience creating content for a technology or startup audience

  • Familiarity with LinkedIn, X, newsletters or other content channels

  • Experience with tools such as Figma, Canva, Webflow, Framer or similar

  • An interest in developer marketing, open source or technical communities

  • Experience helping with events, product launches or campaigns

  • Basic understanding of analytics and measuring marketing performance

Most importantly, we’re looking for a do-er. Someone who doesn’t need a perfectly defined brief before getting started, is happy to try things, and takes pride in getting good work out into the world.

Location: London (King’s Cross) - in-office role.

Benefits

  • Help us set the company culture - you’d be joining us as part of our founding team. Help us set and guide the company culture! Whether it’s breakfasts, reading groups or games nights. Give us your ideas and we’ll make it happen together.

  • Competitive salary and equity - we want to make sure you’re rewarded not just in financial terms but also have a sizeable stake in the business as well. We’re in this together.

  • Private health insurance - your health and well-being is paramount. We want to make sure that everyone in the company is supported when it comes to health.

  • Conference, travel and development budget - your development will also grow the business. We want to make sure that you have access to the resources and opportunities you need to be at your best.

title: Mass Timber Field Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
You don't just see timber. You see the future of construction.

The construction industry is changing. Sustainable building solutions, innovative materials and more efficient construction methods are shaping the way we build tomorrow.

You understand the potential of mass timber – and know how to turn that potential into business opportunities.

At Simpson Strong-Tie, we develop solutions that help make buildings safer, stronger and more sustainable. Our expertise in structural solutions, engineering and innovation enables us to support customers in tackling the challenges of modern construction.

To drive the next phase of growth in this exciting market, we are looking for a Mass Timber Field Engineer (m/f/d).

In this role, you will play a key part in expanding our mass timber business across Europe, combining strategic business development, technical expertise and commercial drive. You will connect with key stakeholders across the construction value chain and turn opportunities into long-term business success.

What you can expect

You are more than a sales manager.

You are a business builder, a trusted partner and a driving force behind the development of our mass timber business.

Working closely with our European teams, regional sales colleagues and technical experts, you will help shape our market position, strengthen customer relationships and unlock new opportunities in the growing mass timber sector.

Your key responsibilities:

  • Drive business growth: Execute our mass timber sales strategy and deliver revenue growth by developing new accounts, building a strong project pipeline and converting opportunities into business.

  • Build strategic relationships: Establish and develop long-term partnerships with architects, structural engineers, designers, developers, contractors, engineered wood product (EWP) suppliers and prefabrication companies.

  • Develop market opportunities: Identify target customers, key projects and emerging market trends to strengthen our position in the mass timber industry.

  • Turn opportunities into projects: Engage with stakeholders early in the project lifecycle and drive opportunities from initial contact and technical specification through to commercial conversion.

title: Mechanical Forward Deployed Engineer - Switzerland
descriptionHtml:
About CoLab

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster.

Proudly based in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018. Since then we’ve raised a $72M Series C, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (Fast 500™), signed multi-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier, and grown to a team of 250+.

About the Role

This is a high-impact role that helps define how CoLab delivers technical value to its most strategic customers in Aerospace and Defence. CoLab is a category-creating product, which means adoption isn't just a rollout. It's a change in how the organization works.

In this role, you'd act as a trusted advisor, leveraging people, process, and technology to help teams rethink how they manage feedback, data, and decision-making across design and PLM. That means getting deep into customer workflows, testing new ways of working, and building repeatable methods the rest of the team can scale.

You'll work alongside a Customer Success Manager, and use what you learn on the front line to help shape product direction. This role isn't about selling or pitching. It's about deeply understanding engineering problems and solving them alongside the customer.

We are looking for a candidate in Switzerland to work regularly on-site with local CoLab customers.

Our Ideal Candidate

You’re a mechanical engineer by trade and have worked as a designer in an A&D company. You also understand the full product development life cycle: how design, manufacturing, quality, and engineering leadership depend on each other, and where collaboration breaks down. You can coach those teams toward working together better.

You know how to improve that life cycle with technology. Maybe you’ve championed internal tools or created automation or scripts.

You also know a process that makes sense on paper won’t get adopted on its own. You can meet people where they are, including the stakeholders who don’t want to change.

You don’t need to be the loudest voice in the room, but you can run a sprint and lead a cross-functional project. If the average person might find this job too undefined or complex, that probably excites you.

Job Responsibilities

  • Mapping a customer's current-state design review and engineering workflows, and defining the target-state process their teams will actually adopt.

  • Expanding adoption into new teams, programs, and sites within the account, partnering with the Customer Success Manager on where the next opportunity sits.
  • Collaborating with product teams to identify feature gaps, improve capabilities, and refine AutoReview.

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects and cross-functional collaborations.

  • Strong written communication and documentation skills.
  • Working knowledge of high-level AI architecture, specifically LLMs.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with internal tool development, scripting, or automation.
  • Exposure to AI/ML tools applied to engineering workflows.
  • Prior work in design consulting or product development at scale.

Travel Expectations

While this is a fully remote role, travel is a consistent part of the job. There are two primary types of travel you can expect:

  • Team Weeks: Once per quarter, the sales team or entire company gets together in person. These typically involve traveling out on a Monday and returning on a Thursday or Friday. Two of these each year are held at our headquarters in St. John's, Newfoundland, Canada and the others take place in more central locations that evolve as the team grows.
  • On-sites: This role will work closely with a local customer with expectations to be on site with that customer, so there will likely be far less travel than our typical MFDE roll. Most on-sites involve 2-3 days with the customer, with travel on either side. Travel is primarily within North America, and you can expect 4 customer on-sites per quarter.”
