title: Product Manager (US Cards)
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

In six years, Lendable has built a profitable, market-leading credit card in the UK. In 2023, we brought that playbook to the US and set an even higher bar. This year the US credit card business scaled rapidly: our run rate grew more than 20x in the last six months.

A lot of the work of getting customers through the door is in place. The next stage is about what happens once they’re in: helping them pay on time, giving more credit to the ones who earn it, getting people back on track when they fall behind, and ensuring an intuitive user experience across channels.

If you're excited by fintech, lending and scaling products in a fast-moving environment, this role offers real ownership, impact and room to grow.

About the role

We're hiring a Product Manager to join the product team, and will cover post booking areas including payments, collections, credit limit increases, spend, and the mobile app.

No two weeks look the same. One week you might be sizing an opportunity, the next week sitting with the ops team to understand why customers are calling, or putting a rough version of an idea in front of real customers before anyone builds the proper one. We care more about how quickly we learn than how polished the first attempt looks.

What you'll work on

  • Running experiments across the customer lifecycle, such as how and when we remind people to pay, what gets them to set up autopay, and how we gamify engagement

  • Working with credit risk and data science on how to apply models to new use cases and opportunities

  • Finding cheap, fast ways to test an idea (a manual process, an email, a script) with AI before committing engineering time to it

  • Gathering customer research to get truthful and unbiased reads

  • Building tools and automations with AI that save time for you, the ops team and the wider business

  • Doing whatever it takes to get something live, including the unglamorous parts like unblocking developers, socializing with legal and compliance, or writing the guide for the ops team

What we're looking for

Don’t worry if you don’t meet all these criteria. We'd love to talk to any great candidate that is excited, inquisitive, and a go-getter.

  • 1-4 years in product, strategy, analytics, consulting or operations, with some time spent working closely to product or execution teams to deliver value

  • You ask a lot of questions and you're not satisfied until you understand why something is happening

  • You enjoy forming a hypothesis and finding the quickest way to test it, even if the first version is rough

  • You're comfortable with data: you can write SQL or Python and answer your own questions

  • You're already using AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor or Codex in your work or side projects, and you want to see how far they go

  • You're happy to pick up the small jobs, understanding that as a lean product team no job is too unworthy of our attention

  • You like days that look different from each other

  • Bonus: experience in lending, payments, fintech or a fast-growing startup

Keep in mind: you will not be a fit for this role if you're looking for a well-defined backlog to manage, or you'd rather wait until a problem is fully specified before starting on it. Much of what we work on starts as a loose question with multiple options possible.

AI at Lendable

We want to build the most AI-forward financial services company in the world. PMs here make their own dashboards to answer questions that used to need an analyst, build their own agents and workflows to take care of repetitive work, and ship straightforward changes to production themselves. You don't need to be an expert on day one, but we'll expect you to keep pushing what one person can do.

Your team

You'll report to the Senior Product Manager for Customer Management, and work most closely with:

  • A developer and design team split across London and Europe, covering frontend and backend

  • A data science team building models specific to the US business

  • A credit risk team

  • A growth team

  • An operations team

The team spans our London office, remote engineers in Europe, and our office in Arlington, Virginia, near DC, which you'll visit.

Life at Lendable

  • No one here is limited to their lane. If you want to pick up credit analysis, prototype a feature or fix something in ops, you will be supported.

  • Work from home Mondays and Fridays, and be in the office Tuesday to Thursday, with lunches prepared by our top-tier in-house chefs

  • Top-tier private health insurance

  • Offsites for the US Cards product and engineering team, and an annual whole-company trip abroad (previously Turkey and France)

Interview process

We respect your time and move quickly:

title: Product Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Caya nimmt Unternehmen die Dokumentenarbeit ab: Post und digitale Dokumente landen automatisch in unserer Plattform, werden ausgelesen, geprüft und an die Tools übergeben, mit denen unsere Kund*innen bereits arbeiten. Klingt einfach – steckt aber einiges an Technik dahinter.

Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel. Als Product Marketing Manager*in bist du Übersetzer*in zwischen unserem Produkt und den Menschen, die es nutzen. Du machst aus komplexen Features klare, relevante und überzeugende Botschaften. So, dass unsere Zielkund*innen nicht nur verstehen, was Caya kann, sondern es auch nutzen wollen. Du holst sie mit ihren echten Pain-Points ab und sorgst für den Aha-Moment.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle steht auf drei wichtigen Säulen:

  1. Übersetzen -> Produktkommunikation nach außen. Du arbeitest dich tief in Produkt, technische Details und Roadmap ein und machst daraus Botschaften, die sitzen. Du schärfst die Value Proposition für unterschiedliche Stakeholder (z. B. CFOs, IT-Leiter*innen, Operations) und spielst sie konsistent vom ersten Kontakt bis zum „Jetzt verstehe ich, was das mir bringt.
  2. Feature Adoption -> Kommunikation im Produkt. Du sorgst dafür, dass Kund*innen die Funktionen auch wirklich einsetzen. Zum Beispiel über In-App-Kommunikation und E-Mail-Kampagnen führst du Nutzerinnen an neue und bestehende Features heran, steigerst Adoption und Kundenbindung. Gemessen an konkreten Zahlen, nicht an Bauchgefühl.
  3. Onboarding -> vom Sign-up zum Aha-Moment. Du gestaltest die Kommunikation, die neue Kund*innen zum ersten Erfolg führt, mit besonderem Fokus auf Direktbuchungen über die Website. Du sorgst dafür, dass jemand, der sich selbst anmeldet, schnell versteht, wie Caya funktioniert und den Wert im eigenen Alltag erlebt.

Über alle drei Säulen hinweg gilt:

  • Du übersetzt technische Features in verständliche, nutzenorientierte Inhalte entlang der gesamten Customer Journey. Kurzvideos & Tutorials, Website-Content, Vertriebsunterlagen, Social-Media-Content und Anzeigen.
  • Du baust echtes Markt- und Kundenverständnis auf: Du kennst Zielgruppen, Pain Points und Wettbewerber und nutzt diese Erkenntnisse für starke Kommunikation.
  • Du etablierst Feedback-Schleifen mit Product, Sales und Customer Success, sammelst Nutzerfeedback und leitest daraus konkrete Optimierungen für Messaging und Content ab.
  • Du bist Teil des Marketing-Teams, arbeitest aber eng mit Product, Sales und Customer Success zusammen, als verbindendes Element zwischen unserem Produkt und unseren Kunden.

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in Produktmarketing, Go-to-Market oder Content Marketing. Idealerweise im B2B-SaaS-Umfeld.
  • Du kannst komplexe technische Sachverhalte in einfache, kreative und überzeugende Geschichten verpacken und den berühmten Aha-Moment auslösen.
  • Großes Interesse an B2B-Technologie und Software. Du arbeitest dich schnell und gern in neue Themen ein.
  • Du wechselst mühelos zwischen kreativer und analytischer Arbeit, denkst in Zielen, KPIs und Zielkonflikten und triffst fundierte Entscheidungen.
  • Du bist kommunikationsstark und fühlst dich im Austausch mit Marketing, Product, Sales und CS wohl.
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Deine ersten 6 Monate

  • Nach 2 Monaten kennst du unser Produkt, unsere Zielgruppen und ihre Pain Points im Detail. Du hast mit Product, Sales und CS gesprochen und verstehst, wo unsere Kommunikation heute überzeugt und wo nicht.
  • Nach 3 Monaten hast du die Kernbotschaften für unsere wichtigsten Zielgruppen geschärft und erste Inhalte live gebracht. Z. B. überarbeitete Produktkommunikation auf der Website oder eine erste Feature-Adoption-Kampagne.
  • Nach 6 Monaten läuft mindestens eine messbare Kampagne pro Säule (Außenkommunikation, Feature Adoption, Onboarding), und du hast eine Feedback-Schleife etabliert, mit der du Messaging und Content laufend verbesserst.

Benefits

  • Du wirst Teil eines starken Marketing-Teams und arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Kolleg*innen aus Marketing, Produkt, Design, Motion Design und Tech zusammen – Du bist nicht allein.
  • Du hast echten Gestaltungsspielraum und prägst aktiv, wie Caya seine Produkte am Markt positioniert und skaliert.
  • Dich erwartet ein offenes, herzliches und ambitioniertes Team mit starkem Zusammenhalt – remote, im Office oder auf Teamevents.
  • Hybrides Arbeiten: Du kannst flexibel entscheiden, ob Du im Homeoffice oder im Büro arbeiten möchtest. Ein Wohnsitz in Berlin und die Bereitschaft Deine Kolleg*innen 2-3 mal pro Woche in unserem tollen Office in Kreuzberg zu treffen, ist jedoch erforderlich.
  • Du wirst im Homeoffice durch entsprechendes Equipment (Laptop, Monitor, Stuhl, Tisch etc.) von Caya unterstützt.
  • On top gibt es attraktive Benefits wie einen Zuschuss zu Urban Sports, BVG oder anderen Mobility-Anbietern.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Vielfalt ist für uns kein Programmpunkt, sondern Überzeugung. Alter, Geschlecht, Hintergrund, Behinderung, sexuelle Identität – alle sind willkommen. Und wenn du oben nicht jeden Haken setzen kannst: Bewirb dich trotzdem. Die spannendsten Menschen kommen selten mit der perfekten Checkliste.

Bei uns gibt es kein starres 9-to-5-Arbeitsmodell. Es ist uns wichtig, Flexibilität und Effizienz miteinander zu verbinden. Du entscheidest, wie Du am besten arbeitest und was Du dafür brauchst. Solange die Leistung stimmt und wir gemeinsam Großes erreichen, ist alles möglich.

title: Produktionsmitarbeiter  (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Bei GALVANY ist es unser Ziel, klimaneutrales Wohnen für alle zur Realität zu machen. Wir setzen auf Umsetzung und entwickeln konkrete, smarte Lösungen, indem wir Wärmepumpen, Batteriespeicher und Smart Metering einfach zugänglich, zuverlässig und bezahlbar machen.

Wir sind ein profitables Greentech-Startup und glauben, dass nachhaltiger Impact und langfristiges Wachstum nur auf Basis eines gesunden Geschäftsmodells möglich sind. Um unsere ambitionierte Tech Roadmap umzusetzen haben wir im Frühjahr 2026 eine Seed-Finanzierung in Höhe von 10 Millionen Euro mit Set Ventures und AENU abgeschlossen. Getrieben von Kundennutzen, Klarheit und Verantwortung stehen wir für hochwertige Heizlösungen und ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen Verantwortung übernehmen und nachhaltigen Mehrwert schaffen.

Die Rolle

In unserer Eigenproduktion bauen wir die Komponenten vor, die unsere Installationsteams beim Kunden direkt einsetzen: hydraulische Cubes und elektrische Unterverteilungen für die Wärmepumpe. Je besser sie vorgefertigt sind, desto schneller und sauberer läuft die Installation vor Ort.

Cubes sind unsere vormontierten Hydraulikmodule, die alle wesentlichen Komponenten für den Heizkreis kompakt in einem Gehäuse bündeln. Wir fertigen sie in mehreren Varianten für unterschiedliche Wärmepumpen und Einbausituationen.

Unterverteilungen sind die elektrischen Verteiler, über die die Wärmepumpe abgesichert und angeschlossen wird. Sie werden nach Plan in Standardvarianten je Geräteserie und Leistungsklasse aufgebaut.

Du arbeitest in einem kleinen Produktionsteam innerhalb von Supply Chain, eng verzahnt mit Lager, Kommissionierung und Einkauf. Die Produktion wächst mit unseren Installationszahlen und zieht 2027 in unser neues Hauptlager in Ludwigsfelde.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Montage von Cubes: Rahmen aus Aluprofilen aufbauen, Komponenten einsetzen, Verrohrung in Edelstahl-Pressfitting und Gewinde herstellen, Verkleidung montieren.

  • Aufbau und Verdrahtung von Unterverteilungen nach Bestückungsplan, Stückliste und Stromlaufplan, inklusive Beschriftung der Betriebsmittel.

  • Qualitätsprüfung vor Auslieferung: Dichtheitsprüfung der Cubes, Sicht- und Funktionsprüfung der Unterverteilungen, Dokumentation der Prüfergebnisse.

  • Vorbereitung von Material für die Produktion, z. B. Kabel ablängen, Anschlusssets zusammenstellen, Rohre zuschneiden.

  • Übergabe fertiger Cubes und Unterverteilungen in die Projektkommissionierung, termingerecht zur geplanten Installation.

  • Pflege der Materialbestände am Arbeitsplatz und frühzeitige Meldung von Fehlmengen an Lager und Einkauf.

  • Mitarbeit an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Varianten und Arbeitsabläufe: Rückmeldung aus der Montage zu Stücklisten, Bauteilen und Prozessen.

  • Ordnung, Sauberkeit und Arbeitssicherheit in deinem Produktionsbereich.

Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektroniker:in für Energie- und Gebäudetechnik, Anlagenmechaniker:in SHK, Mechatroniker:in oder vergleichbare Qualifikation.

  • Erfahrung in Montage, Verdrahtung oder Rohrinstallation, idealerweise im Schaltschrank-/Verteilerbau oder in der Heizungstechnik.

  • Du liest Stromlaufpläne, Bestückungspläne und Stücklisten sicher und setzt sie genau um.

  • Handwerkliches Geschick und sauberer Umgang mit Werkzeug, z. B. Pressmaschine, Crimpzange, Abisolierwerkzeug.

  • Von Vorteil: Qualifikation als Elektrofachkraft, Erfahrung mit Prüfungen nach DIN VDE 0100-600 bzw. DIN EN 61439 oder Grundkenntnisse zu Wärmepumpen-Hydraulik.

  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. B2), um Arbeitsanweisungen und Pläne sicher zu verstehen.

Benefits

  • Werde Teil eines schnell wachsenden und profitablen Climate-Tech-Startups.

  • Attraktive und wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung.

  • Feste Arbeitszeiten ohne Montage- und Reisetätigkeit.

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung in unsere Cube- und Unterverteilungsvarianten.

  • Individuelle Benefits, abgestimmt auf deine Bedürfnisse, z. B. Sportmitgliedschaften, ÖPNV-Ticket oder Learning Budget.

title: Proposition Development Manager
descriptionHtml:
THE CARWOW GROUP

Carwow Group is driven by a passion for getting people into cars. But not just any car, the right car. That’s why we are building the go-to destination for car-changing. Designed to reach drivers everywhere with our trail-blazing portfolio of personality rich automotive brands; Carwow, Auto Express, evo, Driving Electric and Car Buyer.

What started as a simple reviews site, is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe - over 10m customers have used Carwow to help them buy and sell cars since its inception. Last year we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia, doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with over 1.1 billion annual views, sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

 

WHY JOIN US?

We are winners of the prestigious Culture 100 award that recognises the most loved and happiest tech companies to work for! We recently raised $52m in funding led by global venture capital firm Bessemer Venture Partners (an early backer of LinkedIn and Shopify) to accelerate our growth plans!

As pioneers, we’re always driving for new territory and positive change, so our work as a group is never done. Where others see difficulty, it’s our responsibility to see possibility – building new experiences, launching new titles and listening to drivers.

Being a part of Carwow Group means championing drivers and the automotive industry, acting as a disrupter and never being afraid to fail (but learning fast when we do!).

Our team of 500 employees across the UK, Spain and Portugal are revolutionising car-changing and we are fast expanding our mission across every single brand and country we operate in, so jump in!

OEM & MEDIA TEAM @ CARWOW

Our OEM & Media team works with 40+ car manufacturers, helping them reach millions of in-market car buyers across Carwow, Auto Express and evo. Our Brand Partnerships Managers own those relationships. This role owns what they take to market: the products, data and tools that make our partnerships work harder for every brand.

YOUR MISSION

You'll own the day-to-day development of our OEM & Media proposition, running the commercial projects that keep Carwow ahead of the industry, from data and reporting to marketplace integrations. Your job is to make sure our Brand Partnerships team have everything they need to grow their relationships with manufacturers.

This is a role for a generalist project manager who loves getting stuck into intricate, cross-functional work and is interested in the commercial side of the automotive industry. No two weeks look the same. One day you'll be scoping a finance calculator integration with Product and Legal, and the next you'll be building the data story for a major manufacturer pitch.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own a portfolio of projects from first idea to final delivery, using Carwow's OKR process to prioritise what will make the biggest commercial difference.

  • Be the go-to person for everything happening across the OEM proposition, keeping Product, Data & Analytics, Legal and Commercial pulling in the same direction.

  • Deliver the integrations that connect manufacturers to our marketplace, from OEM stock feeds and lead integrations to finance calculators.

  • Own our OEM & Media data suite (dashboards, Google Sheets, automated decks and AI integrations) and keep making it better.

  • Equip our Brand Partnerships Managers with the tools, collateral and best practice they need, and help bring our biggest pitches to life with data.

  • Be the voice of OEM & Media on cross-functional Carwow Group projects, and help raise the team's profile across the automotive industry.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Experience in project management, proposition development or commercial operations, taking projects from a blank page to delivery.

  • A track record of delivering intricate projects with lots of moving parts and lots of stakeholders.

  • Seriously good organisation skills: you'll be juggling several projects at once, each at a different stage and with different people involved.

  • The ability to bring people with you, influencing stakeholders at every level and keeping their priorities aligned with project timelines.

  • Confidence with data and the ability to turn the numbers into a clear story.

  • Clear, engaging written and visual communication, whether that's client collateral or an internal deck.

BONUS POINTS

  • Commercial experience in the automotive industry, whether OEM-side, at an agency, or at a marketplace or publisher working with manufacturers.

  • Experience delivering technical or integration projects with Product and Engineering teams.

  • An understanding of media and advertising, such as campaign reporting, attribution or measurement.

  • Curiosity about AI tools and finding new ways to automate reporting and workflows.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Introductory call with our Talent team

  • Online interview with the Hiring Manager

  • Task Interview

  • Values Interview

 

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Hybrid working (2 days working from home)

  • Competitive salary

  • Matched pension contributions

  • Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

  • Bupa Private medical and dental insurance, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

  • Life Assurance

  • Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

  • Enhanced holiday package, plus Bank Holidays

  • 28 days annual leave

  • 1 day for your wedding

  • 1 day off when you move house - because moving is hard enough without work!

  • For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year

  • For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year

  • Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year

  • The option to work from abroad up to 4 weeks

  • Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies

  • Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones

  • Up to £500/€550 home office allowance for that massage chair you’ve been talking about

  • Generous learning and development budget to help you master your craft

  • Regular social events: tech lunches, coffee with the exec sessions, lunch 8 learns, book clubs, social events/anything else you pester us for

  • Refer a friend, get paid. Repeat for infinite money

descriptionHtml:

Our team is composed of industry experts with deep experience in cybersecurity, automation and AI-driven solutions. Backed by leading investors, we are rapidly growing and seeking top talent to join our mission of revolutionizing the AI-Native MDR landscape.

The Tenex Cloud Security Specialist is a field seller who builds and closes Tenex's cloud security business alongside Wiz and Google Cloud. Now that Google has acquired Wiz and Wiz is depending on partners to deliver services, the opportunity to become the leading security operations partner in the Wiz ecosystem is open right now. This role is how Tenex captures it.

You'll be part of a regional sales pod: a Sales Leader, Enterprise Sales Directors, and a Customer Engineer. You are an overlay to the account owners, not a second sales team. You bring Wiz-led cloud security opportunities into the pod and run them to close with the account owner, the customer's Google Cloud rep, and the Wiz seller. The job combines five responsibilities: new business, co-sell, channel, field marketing, and partner enablement.

What you'll do

Pipeline generation, partner deal registration, and closed ARR.

title: Cluster Architect
descriptionHtml:
About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure - from powered land, to compute, to software .

As we scale our platform and expand our engineering organisation, we are looking for leaders who can build strong teams, uphold high standards, and deliver reliably at pace.

As part of the Infrastructure Solutions team, the Cluster Architect is the tip of the spear leading Radiant’s new GPU deployments. The Cluster Architect contributes to the technical strategy, reference architecture, and governance standards underpinning Radiant's GPU compute platform. They translate the high-level designs provided by the Customer Success organization into fully operational supercomputers. In conjunction with the Datacenter Engineering team, they lead the definition of the low-level design of upcoming high-performance computing (HPC) and artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure deployments.

You must be a solution finder, able to adapt to evolving technology and customer requirements, and be ready to handle scale. The right person for this role will be technically focused and detail-oriented, and able to work with the broader team to successfully deliver some of the world’s largest supercomputers at a rapid pace with precision. It is critical to document each step of the process to enable effective communication with internal and external stakeholders.

About the Infrastructure Team

The Infrastructure Engineering team spearheads the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of critical HPC/AI infrastructure to the broader Technology and Customer organizations. Its mission is to deploy scalable, secure, and efficient infrastructure solutions tailored to the organization's strategic needs. The team defines Radiant’s supercomputers’ reference architecture in line with the customer, software, and operational requirements of the company.

They work closely with third-party suppliers to provide and maintain the list of technologies that form part of Radiant’s portfolio of offerings.

They provide technical support throughout the procurement process with vendors to ensure the suitability of RFI/RFP responses.


They work in tandem with OEMs and infrastructure providers during the infrastructure rollout, and providing technical inputs to DC providers and OEMs

They work closely with the program management office, and align the hardware infrastructure rollout programs with the parallel datacenter fitout and software engineering programs.

They play an instrumental role in the successful deployments of cloud infrastructure, whilst ensuring optimal performance and reliability for high-demand computing environments. Once accepted, the infrastructure solutions are then handed over to the Infrastructure Operations team who manages the daily management of the infrastructure.

What you’ll do

  • Engage with key stakeholders (such as the Program Management Office, Data Center Engineering, Solutions Engineering and Infrastructure Operations teams) and translate inputs into Radiant’s reference architecture and low-level designs blueprints.

  • Remain abreast of technology advancements and roadmaps with key vendors in the space.

  • Lead the low-level design of high-density AI supercomputer systems (compute, interconnect, storage, management).

  • Participate in the Architecture Review Board involving key stakeholders to ensure collaboration and company alignment behind the designs being produced.

  • Evaluate tradeoffs between performance, power, cooling, serviceability, and cost throughout the procurement process.

  • In tandem with potential suppliers, drive the creation of detailed low-level designs, including (but not limited to):

    • Rack elevation diagrams and layouts

    • Data center floor plans and spatial planning

    • Power distribution and cooling architecture and related detailed specifications

    • Detailed Bill of Materials (BoM)

    • Port mapping documents.

  • Drive thorough technical evaluations and response accuracy from vendors during the RFx processes, ensuring designs are aligned with vendor capabilities and long-lead item constraints.

  • Play a hands-on and pro-active role in the manufacturing, burn-in, cabling, logical configuration, benchmarking, and logical implementation of new deployments to turn designs into production-grade systems.

  • Drive acceptance criteria with quality, reliability, safety, and performance goals in mind.

  • Work with the Software Engineering and Solutions Engineering teams to ensure the infrastructure supports AI workload requirements.

  • Engage with project management to define milestones, risks, resourcing, and deliverables associated with the delivery.

  • Produce accurate architecture diagrams, configuration documentation, runbooks, and operational guidance to facilitate the handover of the new deployments to the Infrastructure Operations team.

  • Establish delivery best practices and continuously improve the designs, processes, and documentation through the participation of “lessons learned” workshops.

Requirements

  • BSc in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or other related Engineering fields.

  • 5+ years of solution architecture experience, demonstrating motivation and skills to drive technical design and delivery processes.

  • Deep expertise in GPU systems, high performance networking (like InfiniBand), including a proven understanding of network topologies and storage architecture.

  • Proficiency in system-level aspects, encompassing Operating Systems, Linux kernel drivers, GPUs, NICs, and infrastructure software solutions.

  • Demonstrated experience producing detailed infrastructure designs (including network topologies, rack layouts, BoMs, power/cooling planning)

  • Deep understanding of the interafce between datacenter and GPU supercomputers (power/cooling constraints, failure modes)

  • Good understanding in datacenter fit-out, datacenter engineering (mechanical, eletrical, constraints)

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a track record interfacing with various types of stakeholders (engineering/operations teams, vendors, etc.) and writing clear deliverables.

  • Comfortable working in fast-moving, high-complexity technical environments.

Nice to have

  • Prior work experience in HPC, Telco, or hyperscale supercomputing environments designing, delivering, and/or operating large scale HPC systems.

  • Work or research experience in networking fundamentals, TCP/IP stack, and data center designs.

  • Familiarity with monitoring/telemetry systems and observability for infrastructure health.

  • Demonstrated expertise in cloud orchestration software and job schedulers, including platforms like Kubernetes, Docker Swarm, and HPC-specific schedulers such as Slurm.

  • Knowledge of DevOps/MLOps technologies such as Docker/containers, Kubernetes, datacenter compute/network/storage deployments.

  • Hands-on experience with NVIDIA systems/SDKs (e.g., CUDA), NVIDIA Networking technologies (e.g., DPU, RoCE, InfiniBand), ARM CPU solutions, coupled with proficiency in C/C++ programming, parallel programming, and GPU development.

 

Why should you join us?

 

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

 

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the Role

We're hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to make our systems work reliably in real-world deployed environments, not just in controlled engineering settings. This role closes the gap between Engineering, Product, Operations, Customer Success, and the customer — owning technical execution in the field, catching issues early, and turning field reality into clear engineering action.

You'll need to be comfortable operating across domains rather than as a single-discipline specialist: reasoning practically across software, electronics, hardware, comms, and operations, and diagnosing issues with whatever time, tools, and backup are actually available onsite. Expect regular travel and field time, hands-on work outside a narrow job description, and close collaboration with Engineering, Product, Operations, and Customer Success.

What you will do

  • Own technical execution in the field — deploying, troubleshooting, and supporting systems in real-world environments outside the lab.

  • Diagnose and resolve issues across domains without needing everything translated by specialists, using structured fault-finding under real-world time and resource constraints.

  • Support demonstrations, trials, and customer-facing technical activity, representing the technical team credibly in front of customers and operators.

What we're looking for

  • Systems-minded engineering judgment — can explain interfaces, dependencies, and trade-offs across a complex technical system, and reason practically across software, electronics, hardware, and comms.

  • Practical field troubleshooting experience — has diagnosed and solved technical problems in deployed or operational environments (field, workshop, lab, customer site, military, maritime, robotics, aerospace, or automotive settings) with limited time, tools, or backup.

  • Deployed operational discipline — has prepared equipment, documentation, checklists, spares, or field processes ahead of operational activity, and is willing and able to travel and work outside a narrow discipline.

Nice-to-have:

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.

About the Role

As a Principal Networking Software Engineer at Radiant, you’ll be a hands-on technical leader, driving the design and development of our networking software, including the control plane that provisions, configures, and automates our high-performance cluster fabrics and Managed Networks for AI workloads.

You’ll set the standard for engineering excellence across the team, working closely with other principal engineers to align on strategy and drive technical leadership. You’ll partner with peers across Engineering to deliver the networking solutions for high-performance AI systems, and mentor engineers across multiple squads. You’ll play a pivotal role in shaping engineering direction, design decisions, and cross-team collaboration.

Our Engineering teams are grouped as follows:

  • Infrastructure: Compute, Infra, Network & Storage

  • Platform: Cloud, Observability & Security

  • AI: Training & Inference

Key Responsibilities

  • Set the technical vision and architecture for Radiant's networking software, and lead its design and implementation.

  • Design and build the control plane that provisions, configures, and automates our cluster fabrics and Managed Networks.

  • Translate product requirements into robust architectures, APIs, and technical designs, working closely with Product.

  • Own network performance, isolation, and reliability for AI training and inference workloads.

  • Lead integration of networking with compute, Kubernetes, storage, security, and observability.

  • Drive operational excellence with SRE and Infra Ops, including automation, monitoring, and incident response.

  • Raise the engineering bar across the organisation through mentoring, design and code review, and technical standards.

Your Profile

  • Extensive experience building and operating large-scale network software or software-driven networks.

  • A track record of technical leadership at staff or principal level, including setting direction across multiple teams and delivering complex, high-stakes systems.

  • Strong hands-on engineering skills in one or more systems languages such as Go or similar.

  • Deep technical expertise across:

  • Fabrics: RDMA, InfiniBand, RoCE, Ethernet at scale, congestion control

  • Networking: routing, switching, BGP, EVPN/VXLAN, overlays and underlays

  • Automation: network-as-code, configuration management, APIs for network devices

  • Multi-tenancy: isolation, segmentation, network security

  • Hands-on experience with technologies such as NVIDIA networking, SONiC, Cumulus, or similar.

  • Understanding of how network design affects AI training and inference performance.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including clear design documents and explaining complex trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

What You Bring

  • Networking domain expertise: Understand how the network shapes workload performance, from the fabric up to the application.

  • Engineering excellence: Write and review code that sets the standard for correctness, performance, and maintainability.

  • Architectural judgement: Make sound long-term decisions on systems that are hard to change once built.

  • Technical leadership: Influence direction across teams without relying on authority, and grow the engineers around you.

  • Systems thinking: Understand how your area interacts with compute, storage, and the rest of the cloud platform.

  • Ownership: Drive capabilities from design through production, operation, and continuous improvement.

Qualities we look for:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There's no blueprint for the future. You'll embrace challenges and change

  • You're real and you're true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you'll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you're talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

Our process: Talent screen → Hiring Manager → Technical interview (two Principal Engineers) → Whiteboard Exercise → Final.

title: Senior Application Security Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

We are looking for our first dedicated Senior Application Security Engineer to build our AppSec practice from the ground up. This is a greenfield opportunity with a real attack surface: public partner-facing APIs and payment flows. You will own secure development, define what gets reviewed, implement security gates, build the "paved road" for ~150 engineers, and see the impact of your work in production within weeks.

What you will do:

  • Lead threat modeling and secure design reviews for high-risk changes, partner integrations, and payment flows.

  • Implement, tune, and enforce security gates in GitLab CI/CD (SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, and DAST) while minimizing developer friction.

  • Act as the primary technical owner for triaging, reproducing, and prioritizing findings from bug bounties, partner pentests, and automated scanners.

  • Work hands-on with the DevOps team to implement GCP organizational policies, IAM least-privilege architectures, and Cloud Armor (WAF/rate limiting).

  • Establish a security-champions network across engineering squads and leverage automation/AI-assisted tooling to scale code reviews effectively.

  • Own vulnerability management end to end: a risk-ranked backlog, remediation SLAs, an escalation path, and closing findings together with the teams.

  • Scope and coordinate the annual external penetration test and produce secure-development evidence for PCI-DSS and ISO 27001.

Workplace:

We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe and a HQ in Berlin.


Who you are:

  • You bring 5+ years in Product/Application Security (or 3+ years and a strong software engineering/web-pentesting background), with a track record of true ownership.

  • You read and write production code (Python, Go, TypeScript, Ruby, etc.) and deeply understand web frameworks, CI/CD, and Kubernetes.

  • You have deep knowledge of web and API security, specifically authentication/authorization models (OAuth2, JWT), rate limiting, tenant isolation, IDOR, and XSS.

  • You have strong cloud security fundamentals (GCP preferred), specifically regarding public exposure, secrets hygiene, and WAF rules.

  • You have run threat modelling and secure design reviews on real systems (STRIDE or similar).

  • Hands-on with SAST/SCA/secrets scanning in CI (Aikido, Semgrep, Snyk or similar).

  • You prioritize by real-world risk, propose trade-offs rather than demanding perfection, and communicate complex risks plainly to engineers and leadership.

  • Bonus Points: You have experience securing high-volume, multi-tenant B2B APIs and utilizing AI tooling to accelerate triage and review.

What you can expect:

  • You will join a fast-paced travel tech company with a flat organizational structure.

  • You will have exciting opportunities, ownership, and responsibility and contribute directly to the success of the company.

  • You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day!

  • We have a flexible work policy with the option of working remotely and international opportunities arising as we continue to expand our global footprint – Our heart is in Berlin, but you’ll find us across the globe.

  • You will get a competitive salary.

title: Senior Infrastructure Solutions Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role: 

A Senior Infrastructure Solutions Engineer makes Planet's infrastructure easier to use. Infra Solutions is a small, multi-disciplinary team: engineers who are as comfortable operating a system as building one, and as comfortable in a hard conversation as in a code review. We sit between the teams who build Planet's platform capabilities and the teams who need them, and our market is every engineering team at Planet, which we earn one engagement at a time. Teams work with us because we make their week lighter, not because anyone told them to, and every team that lands on the platform is infrastructure Planet no longer has to duplicate, secure and pay for.

Most of what you do takes the shape of a hands-on engagement with a team that is blocked, mid-migration, or arriving on the platform for the first time. They usually arrive with a proposed solution rather than the problem behind it, and working out the difference is where the engagement starts. From there you own it end to end: the diagnosis, the hands-on fix, the argument for what should change upstream, and the durable artifact that stops the next team hitting the same wall. This is a role driven by unreasonable hospitality (value out of proportion to what anyone asked us for) and backed by solid engineering and operator depth. You have run things in production, and you write the code other engineers depend on. The ideal candidate is energized by other teams' success: someone who would rather ship the thing that makes ten teams faster than own a system outright, and who does their best work in a room they don't own, with people who are not yet convinced they need help.

This is a full-time, remote position based in Germany, the Netherlands or Slovenia. If located near a Planet office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Lead end-to-end technical engagements: Partner directly with engineering teams to diagnose, unblock, and resolve complex infrastructure challenges.
  • Execute critical migrations: Develop reference implementations, tooling, and guidance to transition teams off deprecated systems seamlessly.
  • Accelerate platform adoption: Act as the primary technical contact for new teams onboarding to Planet’s core infrastructure.
  • Establish standardized paths: Consolidate disparate solutions into well-supported, paved-road infrastructure offerings.
  • Build scalable, shared artifacts: Design re-usable libraries, Terraform modules, and Helm charts to solve recurring technical patterns across teams.
  • Enhance platform observability: Implement instrumentation and attribution tooling to provide visibility into infrastructure cost, usage, and adoption.
  • Inform platform strategy: Synthesize engineering feedback and common pain points to influence the broader infrastructure roadmap.

What You Bring:

  • 6+ years of professional experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering, including experience leading at least one cross-team project or migration.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
  • Background in technical enablement, developer experience, or solutions architecture with a focus on internal developer productivity.
  • Hands-on experience operating and maintaining production infrastructure environments.
  • Deep expertise with Kubernetes orchestration, including workload optimization and operations.
  • Working knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or other public cloud providers, including its compute, storage, quota, and capacity mode.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Proficiency in software development using Go or Python.
  • Ability to translate ambiguous requirements into structured, actionable engineering tasks.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation and cross-functional collaboration.

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • Experience with large-scale block storage (Persistent Disk, Hyperdisk, Ceph, SAN, or equivalent) operated at fleet scale rather than per-service.
  • Experience driving large-scale migrations or deprecations that required buy-in from teams outside your reporting line.
  • Experience in a consulting-adjacent engineering role (solutions architecture, professional services, or technical account engineering) applied to an internal platform.
  • Familiarity with workflow orchestration (e.g. Temporal), batch and job-execution systems, or large-scale data processing pipelines.
  • Experience defining and measuring platform adoption: developer-productivity instrumentation, NPS, or internal marketshare.

Application Deadline:

11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.

We’re dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. That’s why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work.  If this job intrigues you, but you’re thinking you might not have all the qualifications, please... do apply!  At Planet, we are looking for well-rounded people from around the world who can contribute to more ways than just what is listed in this job description.  We don’t just fill positions, we aspire to fulfill people’s careers, most excited about folks who are motivated by our underlying humanitarian efforts.  We are a few orbits around the sun before we get to where we want to be, so we hope you’re excited to come along for the ride.

descriptionHtml:

title: Senior Manager, Partnerships EMEA
descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

Temporal powers critical applications and AI agents at companies including OpenAI, Stripe, Netflix and JPMorgan Chase. Following our $550M Series E at a $12.55B valuation, we’re accelerating our global expansion as demand for reliable AI infrastructure grows.

As Director / Sr. Manager, EMEA Partnerships, you’ll run our regional partner business like a GM, owning the strategy, team, execution and results. Your mandate is to make Partnerships mission-critical to winning EMEA, sourcing new opportunities, helping our field teams win and accelerating consumption.

This is a player-coach role. You’ll attract and develop strong talent while personally building partner relationships, creating pipeline and working deals alongside our sellers. SI and GSI partnerships will be a primary focus, with hyperscalers central to how we build and win business together. You’ll determine the right partner mix, build the team to execute, and instill the mindset that partners are how we sell and win.

What You’ll Do

  • Run the EMEA partner business like a GM, making clear choices about strategy, priorities and investment, and making Partnerships mission-critical to winning in the region

  • Lead and develop the existing team while recruiting and hiring strong talent as we grow; build a team that great people want to join

  • Set clear priorities and expectations, coach the team on partner development and deal execution, and establish a consistent approach to pipeline reviews, forecasting and accountability

  • Scale our SI and GSI ecosystem, generating new business from existing partners while recruiting and activating priority partners across EMEA

  • Lead our regional hyperscaler partnerships to drive joint pipeline and consumption, making “power of three” co-selling between Temporal, hyperscalers and SI/GSI partners a core part of the motion

  • Work hand-in-hand with EMEA sales leadership to instill the mindset that partners are how we sell and win; equip sellers with the partner relationships, knowledge and plays to put that into practice in account planning, pipeline creation and deal execution

  • Operate as a player-coach, personally recruiting and developing partners, sourcing opportunities and working deals through close, while coaching your team to do the same

  • Partner with our Technical Services team to get SI and GSI practitioners trained, certified and delivering successful Temporal projects

  • Evaluate and develop emerging partner models, including ISVs, and adjust the regional partner mix based on business impact

  • Represent EMEA at the global level, working with global partner owners so regional execution and global strategy reinforce each other

What You’ll Bring

  • A track record of owning and growing a regional partnerships business in EMEA, including building and scaling services partner ecosystems

  • A strong eye for talent and demonstrated ability to attract, recruit and hire high-performing partnerships or sales professionals

  • Proven experience directly managing and developing a team, including setting goals, coaching individuals, addressing underperformance and helping people grow

  • A track record of originating partner-sourced pipeline and closing deals, with numbers you can point to for both your own work and the teams you’ve led

  • Strong business judgment about where to invest time and resources across markets, partners and motions, with the ability to turn those decisions into results

  • Established relationships with regional and global SIs and hyperscaler teams, and experience bringing them together to win business

  • Demonstrated ability to earn credibility with sales leaders and sellers, influence how they sell, and translate partner strategy into sales execution

  • Ability to build rapport with and influence partner executives, global alliance stakeholders and cross-functional teams

  • Comfort in conversations with developer and architect personas; a background in developer platforms, cloud infrastructure, open source or AI is a strong plus

  • Maniacal attention to detail, excellent work ethic and unwavering commitment to delivering business results

  • Willingness to travel regularly across EMEA

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionaryin 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

We're looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer who's passionate about building reliable, scalable infrastructure that helps developers ship better software faster. You'll design and maintain our Kubernetes-based multi-cloud platform, improve our monitoring and observability tools, and collaborate with product and engineering teams to solve real problems in real time. This is a role where you'll own the systems that power Camunda, drive automation that raises the bar for everyone, and mentor others who want to do the same. If you thrive on building things that work well and don't break when they shouldn't, we'd love to talk.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Design and maintain our infrastructure – You'll evolve our Kubernetes-based, multi-cloud platform architecture, ensuring it's available, scalable, and fault-tolerant. You'll establish configuration best practices and network services that our teams rely on.

  • Build observability that matters – Implement and improve monitoring and alerting tools that give both SREs and developers real visibility into system health and performance. Make it easy for teams to understand what's happening across our stack.

  • Own your systems end-to-end – You'll adopt a "you build it, you run it" mentality, which means participating in on-call rotations and being the go-to person when things need quick fixes. You'll create runbooks and automation that turn complex problems into manageable processes.

  • Ship features and improvements with product teams – Work cross-functionally with product engineering, product management, and support to define and deliver features that move the needle. Bring your expertise to the table early and often.

  • Push automation to the next level – Identify repetitive work and automate it away. Share what you learn with your teammates so everyone gets better at their craft. We measure progress by the quality of our systems, not hours worked.

  • Be the expert others learn from – Help less experienced engineers tackle complex infrastructure challenges. Break down technical problems into clear steps and support others in growing their skills. 

What You Bring:

Must Haves:

  • Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes – You've built, deployed, and maintained Kubernetes clusters in production environments. You understand how to manage workloads, networking, and storage at scale.

  • Infrastructure as code expertise – You're fluent in tools like Terraform (or similar IaC tools) and know how to version, test, and safely deploy infrastructure changes.

  • Demonstrated experience in monitoring and observability – You've worked with tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or similar platforms to instrument systems and alert on what matters.

  • Strong 3rd-level support and incident response skills – You've responded to production incidents, diagnosed complex issues, and communicated clearly with stakeholders under pressure. You understand root cause analysis and how to prevent issues from happening again.

  • A passion for automation and raising the quality bar – You see manual work as a problem to be solved. You care deeply about building systems that are reliable, maintainable, and easy to understand.

  • Responsible use of AI tools – You leverage AI for research, code review, documentation, test generation, and automation to improve your effectiveness. You know how to validate AI outputs against requirements, never share confidential or personal data with AI systems without authorization, and always retain human accountability for decisions and deliverables.

 Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with major cloud providers – You've worked with AWS (EKS), Google Cloud Platform (GKE), or similar managed Kubernetes services.

  • ArgoCD or GitOps workflows – You've used declarative, Git-driven infrastructure management to keep systems in sync.

  • Proficiency in Python, Go, or similar languages – You write scripts and automation tools that solve real problems.

  • Experience with SLOs and alerting frameworks – You've helped teams define meaningful service level objectives and set up alerts that don't cry wolf.

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market.   • United Kingdom: £94,100.00 to £154,700.00

  • Singapore: S$186,100.00 to S$279,100.00

  • Canada: C$159,100 to C$261,600

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

title: Talent Pool: Data Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️

Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!

We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates.

With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️

Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation.

Do you care as much about why we build something as how we build it? At RoomPriceGenie, Data Engineers work where software engineering, data analytics and business impact meet. You won’t just build pipelines: you’ll understand who relies on your work and which decisions it enables. Our data powers pricing recommendations for 3,000+ hotels worldwide on a modern data stack (Snowflake, Databricks, Dagster, dbt, AWS), helping independent hoteliers set the right prices. When you ship something here, you see the direct impact on real businesses and the people who run them.

We take both culture and product seriously, and we’ve been recognised for both: Best Place to Work in Hotel Tech (2026) and Best Revenue Management Software (2026). Our engineers get real ownership and autonomy, with support whenever they need it.

We regularly hire Data Engineers, fully remote, especially in these locations:

  • Germany (DACH)

  • Spain

  • Portugal

  • UK & Ireland

  • Netherlands

This is our talent pool for Data Engineer roles. There may not be an open position right now, but by applying here you’ll be the first to hear from us when a role opens up in your location.

Your Role

  • Build and own: Design scalable data pipelines on our modern stack (Snowflake, Dagster, dbt) and take them from idea to production to monitoring.

  • Modernise with purpose: Help migrate legacy Django/Celery pipelines to our modern platform and reshape how data flows through our product.

  • Bridge the gap: Work closely with Product, Analytics and Engineering (Backend, Frontend and Data Science), turn business questions into technical designs and make sure analysts and data scientists can actually use what you build.

  • Care about quality: Champion data reliability through testing, observability and documentation, because multiple teams depend on your work every day.

Your Profile

  • 4+ years of professional Python experience, ideally in data engineering and/or backend systems

  • Strong experience building and maintaining production ETL/ELT pipelines on modern cloud data warehouses (e.g. Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery or Redshift)

  • Strong data modelling skills, including analytics-ready schema design, fact/dimension modelling and performance optimisation, plus solid data testing and documentation practices

  • Experience with orchestrated data pipelines (e.g. Dagster, Airflow or similar)

  • Experience building backend or ingestion services with Python web frameworks such as Django, FastAPI or Flask

  • Familiarity with background task processing and asynchronous workflows (e.g. Celery)

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS (e.g. S3, RDS/Aurora)

  • Strong understanding of software design principles and data pipeline architecture

  • Experience working with large datasets using pandas, polars or NumPy

  • An analytical mindset with an interest in data quality, KPIs and data-driven decision-making

  • Able to explain complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • High ownership: you take responsibility for reliability, quality and long-term maintainability

  • A collaborative, egoless team player who enjoys working across teams

  • Fluent in English and comfortable in technical discussions

  • Based in a European time zone (UTC+0 to UTC+2)

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with dbt (modelling, testing, documentation, performance tuning)

  • Experience with or interest in modernising legacy data pipelines

  • Hands-on experience with Celery & RabbitMQ, PostgreSQL, Django/FastAPI, Datadog and/or Sentry

  • Semantic layers or metrics modelling tools (e.g. Cube, Looker/LookML, dbt metrics or MetricFlow)

  • Experience building data observability and monitoring solutions

What We Offer at RoomPriceGenie 💪

At RoomPriceGenie, we don’t just offer jobs; we offer an adventure! 🚀 Join us in an exciting startup atmosphere where you can grow your career while changing the world for tens of thousands of independent hoteliers. 🌍 Our global and diverse team is fueled by passion and a shared mission. We thrive in a culture that’s all about transparency, respect, and making a real impact together.

Here’s what you can expect when you become part of our Genie family:

  • Remote-First Model: Work from (almost!) anywhere. 🌍🧑‍💻 Some roles need you in a specific country or time zone — we'll always flag that in the job ad. And whenever you like, come co-work with us in Mannheim, Berlin, or Sydney. 🏢

The Tax Manager, EMEA will take ownership of all tax provision, compliance, and tax audit matters for the region, working closely with external advisors and local finance/accounting teams and partnering with the U.S.-based corporate tax team on cross-border tax matters. This role will report to the Senior Manager, International Tax.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage quarterly and annual tax provisions for the EMEA entities under U.S. GAAP and local statutory standards.

  • Ensure the timely and accurate preparation and submission of corporate income tax and indirect tax filings across multiple EMEA jurisdictions, working closely with accounting/finance teams and external tax advisors.

  • Assist with operational tax matters such as withholding taxes and tax registrations.

  • Support and manage tax audits, enquiries and correspondence with local tax authorities.

  • Partner closely with the U.S. tax team, as well as corporate legal and accounting teams, on complex initiatives including entity restructuring, transfer pricing documentation, and permanent establishment (PE) risks analysis.

  • Monitor legislative and regulatory developments across the region and assess business impact.

  • Partner with the global tax team to develop and implement tax-efficient structures for new business and existing operations in EMEA.

  • Effectively communicate status/issues to the Senior Manager, International Tax in the U.S. for all EMEA entities.

  • Perform general EMEA tax research to resolve issues and work with external advisers where needed to support business initiatives.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date tax compliance calendars and documentation, ensuring robust control and risk management.

  • Develop tax staff by managing performance, setting goals, providing ongoing training, and maintaining strong employee relationships.

Experience & Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or tax required.

  • At least 5 years’ experience in corporate tax gained within a multinational organisation or Big 4/public accounting environment.

  • Professional qualification in Tax, Accounting, or Finance (e.g. ACA, ACCA) preferred.

  • Strong technical knowledge of EMEA direct and indirect tax rules, reporting obligations and tax accounting standards.

  • Experience with US GAAP tax provision preparation and review (ASC 740) preferred.

  • Familiarity with transfer pricing principles and international tax frameworks (e.g., BEPS, Pillar Two).

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively with the U.S.-based tax team across time zones.

  • Detail-oriented and highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, growing environment.

title: Technical Integrations Manager
descriptionHtml:
At Vio we believe booking accommodation should feel smart, fair, and effortless — never overwhelming or unclear.

As one of the world’s fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites — so they can find the perfect place, at the best price, anywhere in the world. We cut through the noise and complexity of hotel and vacation rental booking, surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays — booked with confidence. With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology travelers can trust.

We are looking for an experienced Technical Integrations Manager to join our Supply Integrations team and help us onboard new hotel suppliers, keep 70+ live integrations healthy, and be the technical voice our partners talk to.

Vio connects to hotel suppliers through APIs: wholesalers, bed banks, hotel chains, and connectivity platforms. The Supply Integrations squad builds and runs those integrations. You will join a second Technical Integrations Manager and a team of backend engineers, reporting to the squad's Engineering Manager. This is a hands-on technical role, not a coordination role: you own each integration in your portfolio from the first look at a partner's API documentation through implementation, QA sign-off, launch, and live operations. You decide when an integration is good enough to go live, and you are the person a partner's representative emails when something looks wrong.

What you will do:

  • Assess new partner APIs: read the documentation critically, make test calls, find the gaps and limitations before our engineers hit them, and document what we need from the partner.

  • Run technical onboarding with partners: credentials, environments, communication channels, and everything an engineer needs to start on day one.

  • Act as the single technical point of contact for both partners and engineers during implementation, answering questions and unblocking issues fast.

  • Own pre-launch quality: test search, booking, cancellation, and modification flows end to end; verify prices, availability, and tax and fee breakdowns; and sign off on go-live. No integration launches without your approval.

  • Watch the live portfolio: use dashboards and alerts to catch throttling, error spikes, and data-quality drift early, investigate, fix what is in reach (configuration, CMS, small pull requests), and work with partners on the rest.

  • Keep a per-supplier incident history, spot recurring patterns, and drive the automation and process changes that remove manual work.

  • Maintain the integrations roadmap with the Engineering Manager, Product, and Partnerships, and keep stakeholders informed on progress and risks.

  • Continuously improve our integration lifecycle checklist based on what each launch teaches us.

Who you are:

  • You have 3+ years in a partner-facing technical role, such as technical integrations manager, integration or solutions engineer, technical account manager, or connectivity manager, and have owned a portfolio of live API integrations.

  • You are comfortable in Postman or similar software, not afraid of JSON and XML payloads, and can tell from a response what is wrong with it. Logs and dashboards are tools you reach for, not something you ask engineers to check.

  • You read API documentation critically and can assess technical viability.

  • You write clearly and briefly. A partner engineer can act on your email without a call.

  • You manage many parallel threads without dropping follow-ups and are resourceful when a partner is slow or the documentation is incomplete.

  • You improve processes rather than repeat them: you have built checklists, templates, or automation that made your previous team faster.

  • Hotel distribution experience (rate types, board codes, merchant vs agency models) is a strong plus; we will teach it to someone with the skills above.

Why join us now?

  • We are one of the most innovative and fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms in the world today, having grown our bookings 30x between 2017 and 2025, and catering to the needs of over 100 million unique visitors worldwide each year. We do that by harnessing the power of advanced algorithms and an innovative suite of power features and managed to overcome the corona crisis remarkably fast;

  • The mobile applications (iOS and Android) we launched in 2023 are already a big success, reaching 5 million installs with great customer reviews, as we are beginning to build Vio as the brand for value-seeking travellers worldwide;

  • We are a passionate and diverse team of tech enthusiasts and creatives with a commitment and focus on the traveler above all else - and it shows in our industry-leading TrustPilot score;

  • We place huge importance on rewarding our employees for the value they generate by giving Stock Appreciation Rights to all employees.

Do you want to know if Vio is the right place for you? Find out by reading about the attitude that thrives at Vio.

What we offer:

  • Plenty of chances to learn and grow within an open, diverse culture which promotes knowledge sharing, trust and transparency;

  • A great compensation package, perks and benefits (including significant stock appreciation rights);

  • Flexible time off (take as many holidays as you need) and a chance to work remotely;

  • We enjoy getting together to celebrate our wins with company events in Amsterdam and abroad;
