title: Senior Cloud Engineer - Resilience
descriptionHtml:
Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.

About the role

LemFi moves money across 30+ countries for people who cannot afford downtime. Our infrastructure has to be as resilient as our customers are determined, and right now we need 1 person to own that end to end. This role sits inside the core engineering team and is the single point of accountability for how we plan for failure, test for it deliberately, recover from it fast, and prove with data that we are getting better every quarter.


You will work across cloud infrastructure, databases, and platform tooling to build systems that bend without breaking. If you are the kind of engineer who would rather break things in a controlled blast radius on a Tuesday afternoon than be paged at 03:00 on a Saturday, this is the job for you.

What you'll build and own

  • Own the disaster recovery programme end to end: design runbooks, run drills, close gaps, and report hard RTO/RPO numbers to the business.

  • Build and mature a chaos engineering practice, designing experiments that surface real weaknesses before customers find them.

  • Design and operate database monitoring across the stack so degradation, replication lag, or backup failures surface immediately, not after the fact.

  • Define and track resilience benchmarks and SLOs that give engineering leadership a clear, honest picture of system health, not a vanity dashboard.

  • Own backup strategy and integrity: automate, test restores regularly, and treat an untested backup as no backup at all.

  • Use AI tooling to accelerate incident analysis, pattern detection in observability data, and runbook generation so the team moves faster on every incident.

  • Partner with product and platform teams to embed resilience requirements early in design, so reliability is never a last-minute retrofit.

Your experience

  • 5 or more years in cloud infrastructure or site reliability engineering, with clear ownership of resilience or availability outcomes.

  • Hands-on experience designing and executing disaster recovery plans and chaos experiments in a production cloud environment.

  • Strong working knowledge of database operations: replication, backup, restore, monitoring, and failover across at least 1 major engine (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar).

  • Comfortable with infrastructure-as-code and the tooling that keeps cloud environments observable and controllable.

  • Experience defining SLOs, error budgets, or resilience benchmarks that the wider engineering org actually uses.

  • Able to translate resilience data into plain language for non-technical stakeholders, because a metric nobody understands changes nothing.

  • Bias for action when systems are degraded: you investigate, communicate clearly, and drive resolution without waiting to be told.

Nice to have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or any regulated environment where data integrity is non-negotiable.

  • Familiarity with multi-region active-active or active-passive architectures at scale.

  • Contributions to chaos engineering frameworks or open-source observability tooling.


Why join LemFi?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down.

Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours.

Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play.


Don't feel that you're right for this role, but want to submit your interest in working for LemFi? You can join our talent community to stay in touch for future opportunities.

Recruitment agencies notice

LemFi does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. We work only with agencies on our preferred supplier list, and only when we’ve asked them for their support. Any CVs sent to us outside this arrangement will not incur a fee.

AI in hiring at LemFi

We use AI to cut admin, like notetakers that let interviewers focus on the conversation instead of typing. AI never makes hiring decisions. That responsibility always sits with our hiring teams. Read our AI use policy to see how we use AI and how we expect you to use it too.

title: Senior Computer Vision Engineer (m/f/d) Robotic Manipulation
descriptionHtml:
The AI Teams at Agile Robots are looking for a Senior Computer Vision Engineer (m/f/d) Robotic Manipulation, who will build vision and software components that let our robots recognize and handle objects in close-to-industry applications. The stack combines in-house software with external research models, so you will help bring new results onto real robots without breaking what already runs.

Responsibilities

  • Vision Components: Develop and integrate learning-based vision components, such as object detection, segmentation, and pose estimation, that give robots the input they need to grasp and manipulate objects.
  • Software Architecture: Design and implement software components, architectures, and applications for AI-enhanced robotic systems.
  • Robot Integration: Bring applications onto a changing range of robots and sensors, including dual-arm and humanoid platforms.
  • Research Transfer: Follow current research in computer vision and robot learning, and evaluate which external models and components are ready to integrate into the stack.
  • Stack Maintenance: Review, test, and maintain the shared software stack so that existing applications keep running as new components are added.

Essential Skills

  • Background: Degree in robotics, computer vision, computer science, electrical or mechanical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience, with around four years of professional experience building robotics or vision software.
  • Computer Vision: Hands-on experience training, adapting, and deploying current learning-based vision models, including pretrained vision and vision-language models, on real camera data.
  • ROS 2: Professional experience developing robotics software with ROS 2.
  • Programming: Production experience in C++ and Python, working with CMake, Git, and shell scripting.

Beneficial Skills

  • Vision-Based Manipulation: Experience using camera input to guide grasping or manipulation, for example grasp pose estimation or visual servoing.
  • Humanoid Platforms: Experience developing software for dual-arm or humanoid robots.
  • Motion Control: Working knowledge of robot motion planning and control.
  • Task Logic: Experience structuring robot task logic with state machines or behavior trees.

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots is a leading provider of AI-powered robotics solutions. By combining artificial intelligence and robotics, the company makes industries smarter, more flexible, and more efficient. 

Founded in Munich in 2018 by renowned robotics researchers from the German Aerospace Center (DLR), Agile Robots has experienced rapid global growth. Today, more than 3,500 highly skilled robotics and AI enthusiasts are employed worldwide. The company has one of the largest research and development teams in the AI and robotics industry. 

Agile Robots has built a unique portfolio; together with the subsidiaries BÄR Automation, Franka Robotics, idealworks, and Krause Automation, the company covers all areas of AI-driven robotics.

title: Consultant Digitale Transformatie
descriptionHtml:
Bouw mee aan succesvolle IT-projecten bij ambitieuze MKB-organisaties

Digital Motions helpt MKB-bedrijven bij complexe IT-vraagstukken, softwareselecties en implementaties. Veel organisaties starten een softwareselectie terwijl processen nog niet scherp zijn, belangen uiteenlopen en verwachtingen verschillen. Daardoor worden verkeerde keuzes gemaakt, ontstaan discussies tijdens implementaties en wordt software aangepast aan processen die eigenlijk eerst verbeterd hadden moeten worden.

Bij Digital Motions geloven wij dat succesvolle digitale transformaties beginnen met inzicht, structuur en draagvlak. Daarom brengen wij processen, mensen en technologie samen voordat software wordt gekozen.

Voor deze vraagstukken zoeken wij een Senior Consultant Digitale Transformatie.

Taken

Jouw rol

Jij helpt organisaties om de juiste softwarekeuzes te maken door bedrijfsprocessen, knelpunten en behoeften helder in kaart te brengen. Daarmee draag je bij aan een goede voorbereiding van softwareselecties en succesvolle implementaties.

Je werkt zelfstandig met management, key-users en proceseigenaren. Je begeleidt workshops, stelt kritische vragen en brengt structuur aan in bedrijfsprocessen en klantvraagstukken. Je helpt organisaties om verbeterkansen te herkennen en keuzes te maken die aansluiten bij hun dagelijkse praktijk.

Samen met collega's vertaal je deze inzichten naar duidelijke requirements en software-uitvragen. Je bent betrokken bij de beoordeling van softwareleveranciers tijdens demo's, leverancierssessies en fit-gap analyses. Daarbij werk je volgens de methodiek van Digital Motions en stem je complexe vraagstukken af met ervaren collega's.

Je werkzaamheden

In deze rol werk je aan de inhoudelijke voorbereiding en uitvoering van softwareselecties en IT-transformaties. De belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden zijn:

  • Analyseren van werkprocessen, knelpunten, afhankelijkheden en verbeterkansen.

  • Zelfstandig begeleiden van werksessies met management, key-users en proceseigenaren.

  • Ontwerpen en uitwerken van huidige en gewenste processen, procesflows en matrices.

  • Vertalen van bedrijfsprocessen en klantbehoeften naar requirements, prioriteiten en beoordelingscriteria.

  • Meewerken aan het opstellen van software-uitvragen richting leveranciers.

  • Begeleiden en ondersteunen van leveranciersdemo's, fit-gap analyses en inhoudelijke verdiepende sessies.

  • Signaleren van risico's, afhankelijkheden en besluitpunten en deze bespreken met het projectteam.

Vereisten

Wie zoeken wij?

We zoeken een consultant die processen bij bedrijven in productie, handel en installatie begrijpt en helpt om structuur aan te brengen in uiteenlopende vraagstukken. Analytisch vermogen is belangrijk, maar niet genoeg. Deze rol vraagt ook om adviesvaardigheden, communicatieve kracht en het vermogen om mensen mee te nemen in veranderingen. Je begeleidt zelfstandig klantworkshops, stelt kritische vragen en weet bedrijfsprocessen en klantbehoeften helder in kaart te brengen.

Een sterke kandidaat luistert goed, vraagt door en vertaalt informatie naar duidelijke inzichten en praktische oplossingen. We zoeken geen procesnotulist, maar een consultant die inhoud toevoegt, initiatief neemt en klanten helpt om betere keuzes te maken.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • HBO- of WO-werk- en denkniveau.

  • Minimaal 5 jaar relevante ervaring als business consultant, procesconsultant, business analist, ERP-consultant of implementatieconsultant.

  • Ervaring met het analyseren en optimaliseren van bedrijfsprocessen en het zelfstandig begeleiden van workshops.

  • Vaardigheid in het ontwerpen en uitwerken van bedrijfsprocessen, procesflows en procesdocumentatie.

  • Affiniteit met de implementatie van applicaties zoals ERP, WMS, PLM, PIM en aanverwante software in operationele processen.

  • Kennis van softwareselectie- en implementatietrajecten.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden richting management, key-users, leveranciers en andere stakeholders.

  • Een gestructureerde manier van werken, eigenaarschap en een hoge kwaliteitsstandaard.

Benefits

Wat bieden wij?

Een rol voor 32 of 40 uur per week met veel verantwoordelijkheid, directe klantimpact en ruimte om mee te bouwen aan Digital Motions.

  • Uitdagende opdrachten bij MKB-organisaties in productie, handel en installatie, waar je direct impact maakt op bedrijfsprocessen en digitale transformaties.

  • Een ondernemende werkomgeving met een klein, ambitieus team, korte lijnen en veel autonomie. Je krijgt direct klantcontact, werkt volgens onze eigen bewezen methodiek en hebt volop ruimte om mee te bouwen aan de verdere groei van Digital Motions.

  • Een team waarin kennisdeling, samenwerking en persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal staan.

  • Samen lunchen op kantoor, kennisdelingssessies en leuke teamactiviteiten.

  • Een bruto maandsalaris van € 4.500 tot € 5.600 op basis van een fulltime dienstverband van 40 uur per week, afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring.

  • Een jaarlijkse bonusregeling tot maximaal 150% van één bruto maandsalaris, gekoppeld aan persoonlijke bijdrage, klantresultaat en de ontwikkeling van Digital Motions.

  • 28 vakantiedagen en 8% vakantiegeld op basis van een fulltime dienstverband.

  • Een goede mobiliteitsregeling passend bij de rol en klantwerkzaamheden.

  • Een collectieve pensioenregeling.

  • Laptop, telefoon en alle middelen die je nodig hebt om professioneel te werken.

Wanneer pas je goed bij ons?

Je voelt je thuis bij Digital Motions als je graag wilt werken in een klein, gedreven team met ambitie om te groeien. Samenwerken is vanzelfsprekend, daarom helpen we elkaar, delen we actief kennis en geven we elkaar eerlijke feedback om continu te blijven groeien.

Deze rol vraagt om zelfstandigheid, een kritische blik en het vermogen om met verschillende stakeholders samen te werken. Je durft vragen te stellen, denkt actief mee met klanten en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je werkzaamheden. Je weet wanneer je zelfstandig kunt handelen en wanneer het waardevol is om met collega's te overleggen.

We zijn succesvol omdat we dicht bij onze klanten staan. Je bent regelmatig aanwezig bij klanten om processen te analyseren, workshops te begeleiden en samen met stakeholders verbeteringen vorm te geven. Op kantoor werken we bewust samen aan kennisdeling, projectafstemming en de verdere ontwikkeling van onze methodiek. We werken hard, vieren onze successen samen en staan voor elkaar klaar wanneer dat nodig is.

About us:

🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

Hear from our UK team about what it's like working at Monzo ✨

About the team:

Our Borrowing (lending) business is growing rapidly across both our existing products and the planned launch of new initiatives. We aim to create a genuine feel-good factor when it comes to personal credit, and we’re looking for driven, analytical and creative individuals to help us achieve this goal.

We’re great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowering the wider business. All our data lives in one place and is easy to use. Over 90% of day-to-day data-driven decisions are supported through self-serve analytics in Looker, giving analysts the headspace to focus on solving high-impact business problems.

Our Credit Platform squad builds the shared infrastructure that powers lending decisioning across Monzo. We develop the core credit valuation (NPV) infrastructure, decisioning capabilities and data foundations that enable our Product Credit teams to develop, evaluate and deploy lending strategies across products and markets. As we scale internationally, our platform is at the heart of delivering consistent, scalable credit capabilities globally. You'll lead a team of five Credit Analysts, shaping the evolution of our platform, pushing the boundaries to unlock the next generation of lending capabilities and drive efficiencies.

Join a team where your ideas can rapidly transform into reality, leveraging our cutting-edge technology and agile ways of working. Credit Platform is a cross-functional squad bringing together Credit, Product, Engineering and Data expertise to build shared capabilities that power Borrowing across Monzo. 

How you’ll contribute:

  • Shape our Credit Platform: Define the roadmap for Monzo's Credit Platform, evolving the shared infrastructure that enables Product Credit teams to develop, evaluate and deploy lending strategies across our retail and business lending products in the UK and new global markets.

  • Build Credit Valuation Infrastructure: Lead the evolution of the infrastructure that supports Monzo's credit valuation capabilities, including our NPV modelling framework, ensuring it is scalable, reliable and enables Product Credit teams to optimise lending economics.

  • Lead and Develop a High-Performing Team: Hire, coach and develop a high-performing team of Credit Analysts, fostering a culture of technical excellence, ownership and continuous improvement while delivering platform capabilities with broad organisational impact.

  • Partner Across Monzo: Work closely with Credit, Engineering, Product, Machine Learning, Data and Risk teams to build platform capabilities that accelerate experimentation, simplify strategy deployment and improve the speed and quality of credit decisioning.

  • Influence Through Technical Leadership: Represent the Credit Platform across Monzo, translating complex technical concepts into clear recommendations for senior leaders and helping shape the future direction of our lending platform.

You should apply if:

What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!

  • You are a technical and strategic credit leader with extensive experience in unsecured lending.
  • You understand lending economics inside out, with deep experience in NPV modelling and the infrastructure and frameworks that enable effective credit decisioning
  • You are highly motivated by fast-paced environments, enjoy ambiguity, designing frameworks from scratch, and delivering meaningful change.
  • You are an exceptional cross-functional leader who thrives when partnering with Engineering, Product, Risk, Machine Learning and Credit teams to deliver shared platform capabilities.
  • You have a track record of leading and developing analytical talent, and you are excited by the prospect of leading a high-impact team.
  • You have strong analytical and data capabilities backed up by technical coding skills (SQL is a must-have; Python and Looker experience is a plus).

✅ We can sponsor visas

title: Senior Director, ML Software
descriptionHtml:
About the job

Set the direction for Graphcore’s ML software, with accountability for organisational leadership, investment priorities and delivery across platform generations. As Senior Director of ML Software in Bristol, you’ll report to the VP of Software. Your organisation delivers the machine learning software and analysis tools that enable AI models to run on Graphcore’s platform. You’ll translate business objectives into multi year roadmaps, aligning resources, investment and delivery commitments. You’ll own outcomes from early platform bring-up through production release and support. Your remit spans machine learning frameworks, kernel libraries, hardware simulation, networking software, profiling and debugging tools. You’ll lead through senior engineering leaders, shape organisational structure and develop successors. Beyond your function, you’ll shape wider software priorities, influence executive decisions and sponsor initiatives across the organisation. 

The team and culture

You’ll partner with silicon, hardware, architecture, system software, product and operations leaders to align roadmaps and resolve integration risks. With architecture leaders, you’ll challenge design assumptions across frameworks, simulation, collectives and tooling. Your leadership team will own achievable, adequately resourced plans, with clear expectations for milestones, quality and outcomes. You’ll resolve risks promptly, make portfolio trade-offs and escalate decisions requiring executive alignment. Delivery and quality measures will guide investment in continuous integration, automated testing, hardware-in-the-loop validation, regression coverage and release governance. You’ll turn incidents into lasting improvements, with reliability, security and testability treated as engineering outcomes. 

What we’re looking for

  • Organisational leadership: You’ve led sizeable system software organisations through managers and senior technical leaders, accountable for complex, multi-team hardware and software programmes. You set clear expectations and hold leaders accountable for delivery, quality and business outcomes.

  • Building leadership capacity: You’ve scaled engineering organisations, shaped structures and workforce plans, and led performance management and organisational change. You coach senior leaders, develop successors and build the capabilities needed to meet changing product and business priorities.

  • Strategy and investment: You’ve owned multi-year roadmaps and delivery portfolios, aligning investment, capacity and commitments with business objectives. You make portfolio-level trade-offs under resource constraints, resolve critical technical dependencies and manage risks across competing programmes.

  • Engineering quality and governance: You’ve set organisation-wide quality and release standards, supported by hardware-based automation, regression coverage and robust validation. You use delivery and quality measures, incident learning and risk governance to drive improvements across teams.

  • Executive influence: You’ve aligned senior stakeholders across organisational boundaries, resolved complex decisions and communicated strategic risks and investment choices. You translate technical trade-offs into implications for products, customers, operational resilience and business outcomes, contributing beyond your immediate function.

  • Strategic and technical judgement: You balance delivery commitments and business outcomes with reliability, security, maintainability and long-term platform needs. Experience with machine learning software, hardware-software interfaces, AI accelerators, GPUs or high-performance computing would be valuable. 

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.

Benefits

  • Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
  • Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work
  • Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension
  • Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success

  • Electric Vehicle Scheme: Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice
  • Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme and dental cover

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.

Sponsorship

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role. 

Access to controlled technology

Some roles at Graphcore involve access to technology subject to U.S. export control regulations. Depending on the role, we may need to assess whether export authorisation is required, taking account of factors such as work location, citizenship and immigration status. Where authorisation is required, this may affect whether or when you can start the role. We’ll explain any relevant requirements during the recruitment process. 

Join the Team at Graphcore

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry. As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute. 

Ready to set Graphcore’s ML software direction and build the leadership team to deliver it? Apply now.

title: Senior Engineer II - EngEx AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Senior Engineer II - EngEx & AI Engineer

● Location: UK Hybrid

● Level: TL1

● Team: Engineering Experience & AI Foundations

This role is based in the UK and requires an existing right to work in the UK.

At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship.

Kaluza Overview

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

You'll join the Engineering Experience & AI Foundations team within our broader Kaluza Technology community. Your work will directly impact how Kaluza scales productivity safely and with high quality, and defines the gold standard for Agentic Software Development in the organisation.

As a Senior II Engineer, you'll help set the technical direction for our Internal AI Engineering Platform and the Kaluza Agentic SDLC Framework (KASF). You'll design and implement the infrastructure, from Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to shared agentic workflows, and use your influence across teams to make it the way Kaluza builds software. In 2027, our goal is org wide adoption of KASF across engineering, and you'll be a technical owner of getting there safely, securely and with measurable impact on quality and velocity.

  • Technical Direction & Architecture: Drive the architecture and technical roadmap for our EngEx & AI Platform Foundations team, including the Kaluza AI Control Plane (KAIC), the AI governance layer (MCP and LLM gateways), and shared Agents, Skills, Workflows and Standards. Shape and document build-vs-buy decisions and balance fast-moving vendor capabilities against long-term platform stability.

  • Hands-On Delivery: Stay close to the implementation. Design, build and ship core platform components, set the engineering bar through your own code, and prototype new approaches to prove them before the team scales them.

  • Agentic SDLC (KASF) Adoption: Drive KASF from early adoption to all engineering teams during 2027. Oversee creation and evolution of reference architectures, standards and adoption playbooks, work with engineering leaders to embed KASF in how teams plan, build, review and ship, and use feedback and metrics to remove blockers.

  • AI Tooling Evaluation & Deployment: Lead structured, time-boxed trials of emerging engineering tools with clear success criteria and go/no-go recommendations. Keep Kaluza at the forefront of the AI space while retiring tools that don't earn their place.

  • Governance, Security & Risk: Act as the technical authority on AI risk for engineering. Work with Security, Legal and Data Protection to design approval processes and guardrails (data leakage, prompt injection, model access) that protect the business without slowing innovation.

  • Champion Engineering Experience: Support the definition and evolution of engineering experience at Kaluza and enable our engineers to do more. Drawing on established frameworks such as DORA and SPACE alongside integrated tooling to surface trends, feedback and points of friction to drive improvements and optimisations across the organisation. Evolve our understanding and assessment of AI Metrics and their impact on outcomes.

  • Cost Optimisation: Partner with Finance and Security to keep AI usage secure and cost-efficient at scale, including guardrails and unit economics for model spend.

  • Technical Leadership: Mentor Senior and mid-level engineers, lead design reviews, and raise the technical standard of the team and the wider engineering community. Influence senior stakeholders across disciplines, turn ambiguous problems into clear plans, and build a network of AI champions in engineering teams. Pragmatic and open-minded and able to see things from different perspectives with both technical and non-technical cohorts.

About You

Ideally you'll have/be:

  • Technical Leadership Experience: A substantial engineering background, with a track record of leading technical direction on platform, infrastructure or developer-experience work, and still hands-on in the code.

  • Production-Grade AI Implementation: Experience building and running production systems, ideally including LLM-based or agentic systems, and a deep interest in the "LLM-ops" lifecycle beyond chat interfaces, including evaluation, observability and reliability. Ideally experience across multiple model providers and multi-agent systems.

  • Systems Thinker: Strong distributed systems foundations and the judgement to integrate third-party AI APIs (Claude, OpenAI and others) without compromising reliability or latency.

  • Full-Stack Experience: You have hands-on experience across the stack and know what good looks like. Ideally you have experience with AWS in production, and you treat AI prompts, MCP configurations, and agent definitions with the same version-control rigor as your infrastructure.

  • The EngEx Mindset: You are passionate about engineer productivity. You don’t just build tools; you build experiences that make an engineer's day-to-day life easier and more creative. Supportive and empathetic towards others and able to make connections between symptoms and underlying causes.

  • Security & Governance First: You understand AI risks such as data leakage and prompt injection, and can design guardrails and approval processes that protect the business without slowing it down.

  • Data-Informed: You define success measures up front, automate the metrics AI-generated code volume, PR velocity, adoption), and change course when the data says so.

  • Influence & Communication: You can bring senior stakeholders and sceptical teams with you, and translate complex AI concepts into clear guides, onboarding docs and shared best practice.

  • Collaboration: You are a strong communicator who can translate complex AI concepts into clear guides, onboarding docs, and shared best practices for the wider engineering. community. Consideration for different audiences, including non-technical, being friendly, approachable and non-judgemental are key.

  • Curiosity & Judgement: The AI landscape changes weekly. You enjoy trialling new tools, and you have the judgement to pivot, or to say no, when a better option emerges.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

title: Senior Engineering Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

Our mission is clear: deliver robust, enterprise-grade, resilient, and reliable AI solutions at speed. In a fast-moving market where sales cycles for multimillion-dollar deals can be as short as 1-2 months, speed is our currency. We are competing head-to-head with the big-tech companies and fast-moving AI-native startups.

Our engineering organization is structured into Customer Experience Automation (CXA), Product Platform, and Technology Platform together delivering a Composable Customer Experience Platform built from Packaged Business Capabilities (PBCs). Think AWS-like granularity, but built to empower enterprises with speed, flexibility, and resilience.

About The Role

A Senior Engineering Manager at Parloa does the same job as an Engineering Manager, at a bigger and harder scope. You own delivery and business outcomes for a large team, for two or more teams, or for a domain whose work spans several teams. Sometimes the scope is defined by size; sometimes it is defined by difficulty, such as a problem area where the technical and organisational complexity is genuinely hard, and where getting it right matters to the company's roadmap.

What changes at this level is altitude and durability. You communicate credibly to Directors and VPs without your manager in the room, framing recommendations and trade-offs rather than reporting status. You own the narrative for cross-functional work that travels beyond your teams. You take the conversations that Engineering Managers escalate to you - performance edge cases, prioritisation conflicts between teams, hard disagreements with peers - and you resolve them. And you are building the next layer of leaders: the tech leads who will become EMs, the senior engineers who will become Staff.

You are not primarily a manager of managers. Some Senior EMs move that way, on the path to Director, but most do not and this role does not require it. The people work gets harder at this level, not lighter.

Areas Of Ownership

  • Own delivery across a multi-team or multi-domain scope. Set milestones, critical path, and quality gates. Manage cross-team dependencies actively rather than reporting on them. Hold a consistent bar for Definition of Done and quality across the scope.

  • Set strategy and roadmap with Product, not unilaterally. Frame engineering investment in commercial terms - revenue, retention, margin - and surface customer and market signals into the plan.

  • Own the narrative for cross-functional initiatives. Stakeholders walk away aligned, not merely informed. Author durable artefacts - plans, RFCs, escalation memos, postmortems — that still stand up months later and travel beyond the people in the room.

  • Create the conditions for coherent technical direction. Partner with Staff+ ICs to shape the technical agenda and own tech debt strategy across your scope. Champion experimentation and prune low-signal bets early. Codify and share the learnings from failures.

  • Hold operational discipline to a consistent standard. On-call, incident response, and postmortem practice across your scope; reliability targets aligned to product expectations; cost and unit-economics trends tracked and corrected before they spike. Treat blockers as priority work and clear them hands-on across team boundaries.

  • Design the operating model for your scope. Roles, ownership, and on-call rotations; multi-team operating rhythm; aggregated DORA and SLO metrics; 3–6 month dependency mapping and capacity rebalancing.

  • Grow the next layer of leaders. Hire senior ICs up to Staff level and, where applicable, first-line team leads. Build a pipeline for hard-to-fill roles. Identify and develop future managers and senior ICs from within. Drive calibration across your scope and coach peer managers on promotion standards.

  • Eliminate classes of blockers, not just individual ones. When something breaks twice, you fix the system that lets it break.

Who You Are

  • A proven engineering leader, typically 10+ years in software engineering with 4-6+ years of people leadership. You have owned outcomes for more than one team or for a domain spanning several teams.

  • Credible with senior leadership. You can walk into a room with a VP or a CPO and frame a trade-off, not just present a status update. Your written work is concise and decision-driving.

  • A builder of leaders. You can point to specific people you hired, grew, and promoted(e.g. a tech lead who became an EM, a senior engineer who became Staff) and describe what you actually did.

  • Technically credible without needing to be the decision-maker. You partner with Staff and Principal engineers to shape technical direction through influence, and you know when to hold a standard versus when to let a team choose.

  • Commercially fluent. You understand what your scope costs, what it returns, and how to have that conversation with Product and Finance.

  • Comfortable with the hard conversations. Performance edge cases, prioritisation conflict between teams, and disagreements with peers are part of the job, and you take them on early rather than letting them fester.

  • Pragmatic under real pressure. You have recovered a stalled cross-team initiative, or taken on a scope that had lost predictability, without burning out the engineers or making the EMs feel stepped on.

What This Role Is Not

  • An Engineering Manager with a bigger title. The scope or impact has to be real.

  • A step on the way to managing managers. Some Senior EMs go that way; most do not. This is a complete job on its own terms.

  • Distance from your team. If you are looking for a role where the people work gets lighter, this is not it.

Why Join Parloa's Engineering Organization?

  • Impact at Scale: Define the future of enterprise AI in a market ripe for disruption.

  • Elite Talent Density: Work alongside top-tier engineers, Staff, and Principal leaders in a reverse-pyramid structure optimized for speed and innovation.

  • Culture of Builders: Ownership, autonomy, and fearless iteration are not slogans—they are how we win.

  • Uncapped Growth: Be part of an org growing 4x annually, where career opportunities multiply as fast as our business.

Global Ambition: Help establish Parloa as Europe’s most admired engineering organization, competing head-to-head with FAANG and beyond.

 

Our Recruiting Process:

Recruiter Interview → Peer Interview → 360° Technical Interview Loop → Bar Raiser Interview

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We've grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we're scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.

Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients' and employees' data. All our employees are instrumental in ensuring the utmost care, GDPR, and ISO compliance, including ISO 27001, in handling sensitive information.

Parloa is an e-verify employer in the USA. Please click here to learn more. If you receive an offer of employment from Parloa, you will need to go through the E-Verify process of digital verification of your employment authorization documents as provided on the Form I-9. Participation in E-Verify does not limit your right to work and verification will only be completed after you become an employee with Parloa.

* We provide equal opportunities to all qualified applicants regardless race, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, national origin, disability status, socioeconomic background and other characteristics.

title: Senior Growth Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Tracksuit exists to help marketers prove their brand building is working. We give teams the data they need to make smarter decisions, convince stakeholders, defend budgets, and track their progress. The brand tracking industry is dominated by 100-page reports, static data and big price-tags. We're doing things differently by being built for the modern marketer: always-on, accessible, and approachable.

We're now tracking more than 16,000 brands across 25 countries globally. With offices in Auckland, Sydney, London and New York City, we're scaling fast with a brilliant team of collaborative and ambitious humans. Our culture is defined by "high care, high performance". We strive to be the best and look after each other while we do it.

Are you our next Senior Growth Account Executive in London?

Brand matters. Most marketers know that already. The hard part is proving it to a CFO. Our customers use Tracksuit to do exactly that, and many of them could get even more from it.

As a Senior Growth Account Executive in London, you'll help them get there. You'll own expansion across a portfolio of UK and European customers, working hand in hand with our Brand Champions (our version of Customer Success Managers). You'll start in the new year, just as we reveal the next chapter of brand tracking in January 2027.

What you'll do

  • Run practical, repeatable plays to uncover needs and grow accounts, from new markets and categories to multi-year deals

  • Own an expansion target across your portfolio, with forecasts people can rely on

  • Partner with Brand Champions to spot the right moments to grow an account, without overlap

  • Lead negotiations with marketing leaders, brand managers and procurement

  • Keep your pipeline clean and your account plans current

  • Share what you learn about objections and wins so the whole team gets better

What you'll bring

  • A record of growing accounts against a target. You've carried an expansion, renewal or new business number in B2B software and beaten it. We'd love to hear from you whether you've carried a number for 2 years or 5.

  • You sell outcomes, not features. You start with what the customer is trying to achieve.

  • Drive that holds up after a "no". You stay organised, keep your forecast honest, and see a lost deal as something to learn from.

  • You want to be coached. You ask for feedback and use it quickly. (Fair warning: you'll get to show us this in the interview.)

  • You move decisions forward. A thoughtful, kind and commercially sharp communicator, with marketing leaders and procurement alike.

Bonus points if you love brands, or know marketing or marketing technology.

Why you'll like it here

  • You'll start with a cohort. You'll join alongside other new starters, so you'll learn and ramp up together, not on your own.

  • Time together in the office. With the team in 3 to 4 days a week, you'll pick things up faster: sitting alongside people who've done it before, getting feedback in the moment, and celebrating the wins together.

  • Customers who already love us. You'll be growing relationships with brands that already see the value of Tracksuit.

  • A growing London team. The UK and Europe are among our fastest-growing markets, with plenty still to build.

  • A team that wins together. High care, high performance. We're competitive, but we're not jerks about it.

Salary

£65,000 to £80,000 base salary, with on-target earnings (OTE) of £108,000 to £133,000. Pay is fixed, so what you see is what we offer.

OTE is your base salary plus commission when you hit 100% of your target. Commission depends on performance and isn't guaranteed.

The details

  • Location. London, our Clerkenwell office. We're office-first, so you'll be in with the team 3 to 4 days each week.

  • Start date. Offers by the first week of January, with hires starting from mid-January into February.

How our process works

We want to get to know more of the people who apply, not just the ones whose CV tells the whole story. So instead of shortlisting on CVs alone, we'll invite more applicants into the first stage of our process.

That first stage happens in your own time. You'll record a short video interview and complete any other quick online steps, whenever suits you over a few days. It's your chance to show us how you think and what drives you. AI tools help us review these, and a real person makes every decision.

Once we've reviewed the video interviews, shortlisted candidates get a chance to speak with our Talent team about the role and their application in more detail. Then you'll come into our office to interview with the team. We'll let you know exactly what to expect, and anything to prepare, when we invite you.

Key dates

  • From Monday 23 November: invitations to record your video interview, sent as applications come in

  • Sunday 29 November: applications close

  • Once we've reviewed the video interviews: if you're shortlisted, a chance to talk with our Talent team about the role and your application in more detail

  • Monday 14 to Wednesday 16 December: interviews in our office. That's our goal, though some interviews may take place the following week

  • By the first week of January: outcomes and offers, once we're back from the Christmas break

  • From mid-January into February: new hires start

You'll hear from us either way.

Sound like you? Hit apply before Midnight Sunday 29 November. We'd love to hear from you.

Compensation: £65K – £80K • £43K – £53K Commission

title: (Senior) Hardware Testing Engineer - Robotics (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

Your Responsibilities

  • Test planning: Plan and define tests and own the timeline. Participate in D-FMEAs, coordinate external test labs and organize internal tests.

  • Test execution and evaluation: Verify the product requirements and explore the limits of our robots through lifetime and reliability, environmental, functional and performance testing.

  • Reporting: Document the tests and discuss the results and next steps with the relevant stakeholders.

  • Root cause analysis: Investigates failures down to their root cause, working closely with the engineering teams, and makes sure the corrective actions are verified.

  • Test infrastructure: Improve and extend the test infrastructure. Design and improve test benches, or define them together with external partners. Analyze test data to find weaknesses and derive improvements.

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Technical background: A degree in an engineering field of study gives you the understanding of how robots work and can fail (mechanics, electronics and control design) and enables you to do the calculations needed to design tests and interpret results independently

  • Hands-on: Enjoys practical work, from building and adjusting test setups to mounting sensors and taking hardware apart when needed. Comfortable with tools and the workbench

  • Self-reliance & flexibility: Takes ownership of tests from planning to final report. Proactively spots issues, drives solutions and knows when to involve others. Adapts quickly to changing priorities and adjusts test plans on short notice when needed

  • Team player: Works closely with engineering, production and quality, shares findings openly and is happy to lend a hand where the team needs it

  • Experience: 3+ years in system integration, test or validation engineering within robotics, automotive or aerospace

  • Communication: Able to clearly convey technical risks to non-technical stakeholders without diluting the underlying reality

  • Language: Very good English skills; German is a plus

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

  • Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously.

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and - depending on the role - the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events - from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that continuously learns and improves, requiring zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. In October 2026, RobCo reached unicorn status with a valuation exceeding one billion US dollars, with its valuation doubling in less than nine months. With $200M raised from investors including Sequoia, Lightspeed, Lingotto, Kindred, Cherry Ventures, and the European Tech Collective, 225+ people globally, and 3.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our Bay Area Lab in San Francisco.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements.

descriptionHtml:

With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

 

The team

You'll join the Security Operations Team, will be a hands-on responder on Ledger's high-severity security incidents. You get into the logs, the endpoints and the cloud yourself, work out what happened, and turn it into a clear plan the rest of the company can act on, from engineering to Legal, Communications and executives.

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead the hands-on response to high-severity incidents: investigation, containment, eradication and recovery, working with Security Operations and the security engineering team.

  • Investigate in depth across AWS, networks, endpoints and applications: collect and analyse evidence, reconstruct the attacker's path and confirm what was affected.

  • Use offensive knowledge to anticipate the attacker's next move and to check that containment holds.

  • Translate an incident into a work plan, with clear actions, owners and dates, and work with R&D, Legal, Communications, Customer Support and executives to deliver it.

  • Run incidents that involve partners and vendors: request evidence, analyse what they share, and keep our own investigation independent.

  • Work with our external incident response firm when needed, and preserve evidence to a standard Legal and law enforcement can use.

  • Run blameless post-incident reviews, turn the findings into owned actions, and improve the playbooks and detection with Security Operations.

  • Take part in the on-call rota and in exercises, including with executives.

What we’re looking for

  • 5 years in incident response or security operations,

  • Strong technical depth in AWS, networking, endpoints (Windows, macOS, Linux) and application security.

  • Good knowledge of offensive techniques: how attackers gain access, move and persist.

  • Hands-on forensics: memory, disk, cloud and log analysis, with tools such as Splunk, SOAR (for example Torq) and malware sandboxes.

  • Ability to turn an incident into a work plan and drive it across R&D, Legal, Communications and executives.

  • Availability for an on-call rota; fluent English is a must, French is a plus.

title: Senior Industrialization Engineer

As a Senior Industrialization Engineer, you will own the transition of our advanced robotic systems from R&D into scalable, high-quality production. Right now, this means spearheading Design for Excellence (DFX) initiatives and ensuring our next-generation quadruped robots are optimized for manufacturing and assembly. You'll work in close collaboration with our Hardware Engineering, Supply Chain, and Production teams to bridge the gap between complex engineering concepts and robust manufacturing realities.

We build quadruped robots designed to perform autonomous inspections in the world's most challenging industrial environments, from offshore energy platforms to complex chemical plants. Moving beyond prototyping, our hardware must meet rigorous standards for reliability, ingress protection, and durability while remaining feasible for efficient, scalable assembly.
Your Impact
  • Own and lead the Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) strategy across new hardware programs
  • Collaborate closely with R&D during the early design phases to embed Design for Excellence (DFX) principles into every mechanical component
  • Optimize complex mechanical designs for manufacturability without compromising the robot's performance or ruggedness in harsh environments
  • Drive continuous improvement in production processes by identifying design bottlenecks and engineering scalable solutions
  • Serve as the technical authority on industrialization, guiding hardware teams and setting the standard for how we transition products from prototype to production

  • Proven background in industries such as aerospace, automotive, or specialized robotics, with a focus on high-complexity rather than mass manufacturing
  • Strong proficiency in CAD software (SolidWorks preferred) to evaluate, review, and modify mechanical designs for manufacturability

Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments.

    Our approach to AI in interviews

    At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030, we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs.

    Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process.

    Behavioural and competency-based interviews: please don't use AI. These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other.

    Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

title: Senior Key Accounts Manager
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The Airbnb Hotels team is a fun, fast-growing group leading Airbnb’s expansion into the hotel sector. Operating with an entrepreneurial spirit, this team combines the simplicity, product excellence, and guest-centered ethos that define Airbnb. This team’s mission is to deliver the smoothest, most intuitive hotel booking experience for guests, while helping hotels easily drive incremental bookings so they can focus on delivering the best hospitality. The ultimate aim is to help more people discover high-quality hotels, creating value for guests and our hotel partners.

The Difference You will Make:

As a Senior Key Account Manager on the Hotels Enterprise team, you will own the commercial relationship with a portfolio of global and multinational hotel groups in your region. Your goal is to turn introductions into signed agreements then into live, healthy, growing inventory by increasing participation, bookings and revenue across Airbnb and HotelTonight. You will lead the account planning cycle with each partner, negotiate and renew commercial terms, and be the single point of contact between their executives and many Airbnb teams including Connectivity, Product, Legal and Market Management teams.

A Typical Day: 

  • Be accountable for the end-to-end lifecycle from prospecting, to acquisition, contracting, rollout and performance management  of Key Account partnerships
  • Execute a global win-win strategy for your portfolio that drives value to all parties and position Airbnb as a top strategic partner across all distribution channels.
  • Through the creation of mutual account plans with your partners you will design clear actions which deliver on the Objectives and KPIs of Airbnb and our Key Account Partners
  • Negotiate agreements with partners to unlock new opportunities for both parties & promote long term mutual success
  • Leverage data to make decisions and design projects to best expand and enhance availability and revenue through existing partnerships.
  • Monitor & analyze over/underperformance, market trends, growth opportunities or anomalies and regularly communicate performance to Executives leveraging available production data and global market insight.
  • Work with partners to ensure that the partnership is held to the highest industry standards and that commercial agreements as well as operational SLAs are met.
  • Develop close working relationships with key internal teams and individuals to ensure that they  provide appropriate levels of support to these key partnerships and key enhancements are made to unlock revenue for the business.
  • Conduct regular business reviews, formal presentations for internal and external purposes.
  • Work cross-functionally to execute changes at scale while collaborating with Market Management as a subject matter expert in Key Accounts accounts to drive local property performance. 
  • Proactively contribute to the development and standardization of Enterprise team processes, playbooks, and best practices across the global function

Your Expertise:

  • 8+ years of Travel Industry Account Management experience; including 5 years in a Key Account Manager role with at least 2 years  being responsible for a global partner base. 
  • Proven track record of executing on strategic priorities
  • Experience in analyzing, structuring and negotiating complex deals that align across multiple business unit needs
  • Strong negotiation skills with a proven ability to structure and close high-value, complex deals that establish long-term, strategic partnerships.
  • Comfortable performing data analysis and making decisions based on the results
  • Ability to balance time spent between strategic initiatives and operations while diving into the details when necessary.
  • Experience developing and selling complex business solutions at the C-Suite level
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to effectively influence top leaders internally and within the industry
  • Have a passion for redefining travel, Airbnb, and being the best!
  • Proactive self-starter able to prioritize and manage work autonomously
  • Excellent verbal/written communication and presentation skills
  • Ability to travel at least 50% of the time.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Germany Annual Pay Range€84.000—€105.000 EUR

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: Senior Legal Compliance Counsel
descriptionHtml:
About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role:

As Senior Legal Compliance Counsel, you will shape and drive Parloa's compliance strategy. You will be the go-to expert for Product, Engineering, and Sales on the rules that apply to SaaS and AI companies, and you will make sure our products and business practices meet them.

This is your opportunity to build compliance into an enterprise AI platform from the ground up, right as AI regulation is taking shape.

Areas of ownership:

  • Compliance Leadership: Lead on compliance topics and advise people at every level, from daily operational questions to go-to-market decisions. Set priorities and steer the company's compliance direction.

  • Product Compliance: Work with Product and Engineering to build requirements like the EU AI Act, data protection and industry-specific rules into products early in development. Make compliance-by-design the default way Parloa builds.

  • Compliance Reviews and Risk Management: Lead reviews of contracts, product features and business processes. Identify, assess and prioritize legal and regulatory risks, then turn them into practical solutions that keep the business moving.

  • Policies and Commercial Enablement: Write and roll out policies and processes for commercial teams, working with Sales Enablement to spread best practices across the company. Manage external counsel on complex matters.

  • Regulatory Monitoring and Function Building: Track new regulation, especially in AI, and turn its impact into clear recommendations for leadership. Build and improve compliance processes over time and mentor team members as the function grows.

Who you are:

  • Fully qualified lawyer (German state exams / Volljurist) or an equivalent degree from a recognized institution. We also consider candidates with an LL.M. in German law after a different first degree.

  • Several years as Legal Counsel with a clear focus on regulatory compliance. Ideally this includes product compliance or close work with Product, Engineering, GRC or the CISO.

  • Solid understanding of regulatory requirements for SaaS and/or AI companies, such as the EU AI Act, EU Data Act, DORA, HIPAA and GDPR.

  • Proven track record of driving compliance topics as the subject-matter lead, ideally with some leadership or mentoring experience.

  • Ability to turn complex legal topics into practical, business-focused solutions that non-legal teams, especially product and engineering, can act on.

Our recruiting process:

Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview(s) → Bar Raiser

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We've grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we're scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.

Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients' and employees' data. All our employees are instrumental in ensuring the utmost care, GDPR, and ISO compliance, including ISO 27001, in handling sensitive information.

Parloa is an e-verify employer in the USA. Please click here to learn more. If you receive an offer of employment from Parloa, you will need to go through the E-Verify process of digital verification of your employment authorization documents as provided on the Form I-9. Participation in E-Verify does not limit your right to work and verification will only be completed after you become an employee with Parloa.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Applied AI & LLMs (x/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Your Impact

We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join the ML Engineering team in Patient Solutions.

Your mission will be to improve how people access quality care and manage their health over time by building and leading AI and ML systems that create real, measurable impact. You will work in a feature team developing intelligent patient-facing solutions, from smart practitioner discovery to long-term care management, playing a key technical role in shaping how we scale our AI capabilities across Europe.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Design and implement ML and AI solutions aligned with patient product goals, covering search, retrieval, and personalized care pathways

  • Build and maintain large-scale retrieval pipelines, including hybrid search, embedding systems, vector databases, and multi-stage re-ranking architectures

  • Develop, fine-tune, and evaluate LLM and VLM models using techniques such as knowledge distillation, Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures, and prompt engineering

  • Build and orchestrate agentic AI systems, integrating external data and capabilities through tools and MCP-based integrations

  • Define metrics aligned with product goals, run controlled end-to-end experiments using W&B, MLFlow, or Braintrust, and communicate findings to guide product and technical decisions

  • Deploy solutions to production in collaboration with our ML platform team, ensuring reliability, observability, and performance at scale, and act as a technical reference to elevate the team's standards and practices

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

 

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • You have 7+ years of experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, or AI Engineering, with a strong track record of taking models from prototype to production at scale

  • You have strong experience in Information Retrieval and modern retrieval stacks: hybrid search (sparse + dense), large-scale embeddings and vector databases, multi-stage retrieval and re-ranking pipelines, RAG architectures, and tool/MCP-based integrations

  • You are proficient in LLM and VLM application development: fine-tuning, MoE architectures (via LiteLLM or Model Garden), knowledge distillation, prompt engineering, and systematic benchmarking of LLM/VLM systems

  • You have hands-on experience building and orchestrating agentic AI systems (e.g., using ADK)

  • You demonstrate strong scientific rigor: designing metrics aligned with product goals, running controlled experiments, and communicating results clearly to both product and engineering stakeholders

  • You have experience operating large-scale applications in production (monitoring, reliability, performance, observability), bring strong analytical skills, and approach your work with a user-first mindset. You are fluent in English

 

It would be fantastic if you:

  • Have experience in B2C marketplace environments

  • Have experience in other ML methodologies: pattern mining, recommendation systems, experimentation, or causal inference

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

  • Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

What we offer

  • Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

  • 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

  • Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

  • A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

  • 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription

  • ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave, and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib

  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

  • Relocation support in case of international mobility

  • Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

Our interview process

  • Recruiter Interview

  • Feature Building Interview

  • System Design Interview

  • Behavioral Interview

  • At least one reference check

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page.

Job details

  • Permanent position

  • Full-time

  • Location: Doctolib Paris office in Levallois-Perret

  • Hybrid work setup (3 days/week in the office)

  • Start date: as soon as possible

We welcome everyone

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

All information provided is processed by Doctolib for application management. For data processing details, click here: France. Please contact hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com for inquiries or to exercise your rights.
