title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Policy & Safety
descriptionHtml:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.


The Policy & Safety team sits within Content Platform in the Experience Mission, building the systems that keep Spotify safe, compliant, and trusted by millions of users and creators. This team owns Spotify’s content moderation infrastructure — from detection models to policy enforcement systems and compliance data pipelines.

Working at the intersection of machine learning, platform engineering, and regulatory compliance, the team partners closely with Trust & Safety, Legal, and Public Affairs. They’re on the critical path for every new content type and social feature — including messaging, comments, and collaborative experiences — ensuring safety is built in from day one. With a strong focus on “safety by default,” the team is investing in large-scale rearchitecture and ML-driven systems to proactively protect users and empower safer interactions across the platform.

  • Design, build, and ship production-grade machine learning systems that power content safety and policy enforcement at Spotify scale

  • Own and lead key technical initiatives across detection, classification, and policy evaluation systems

  • Develop and maintain ML models for content moderation, including multimodal and LLM-based systems

  • Build robust evaluation frameworks, including standardized datasets, offline and online metrics, and continuous improvement loops

  • Drive experimentation to improve model performance, reliability, and fairness in safety-critical systems

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners in Trust & Safety, Legal, and Public Affairs to align on policy and enforcement needs

  • Provide technical leadership within the team, mentoring engineers and contributing to ML strategy and prioritization

  • Represent technical decisions and trade-offs in stakeholder discussions and influence product direction


    • Who You Are

  • You have solid experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production environments at scale

  • You are experienced with training, evaluating, and maintaining ML models using modern frameworks such as PyTorch

  • You have a deep understanding of machine learning evaluation, including dataset design, metrics, and continuous improvement systems

  • You know how to design systems that balance performance, reliability, and real-world impact in high-stakes domains

  • You care about building safe, responsible, and user-centric ML systems

  • You are comfortable working across disciplines, partnering with legal, policy, and product stakeholders

  • You have experience leading technical projects and influencing direction within a team or product area

title: Senior Manager, AI Forward Deployed Engineering - London
descriptionHtml:
REQ ID: CSQ128R7

Location: London, United Kingdom - Remote location for candidates to be based in the United Kingdom region ONLY (not remote from any other country)

Mission

The Forward Deployed AI Engineering (AI FDE) team is a highly specialised customer-facing AI team at Databricks. We deliver professional services (PS) engagements to help our customers build and productionize first-of-its-kind AI applications with a focus on GenAI. We work cross-functionally with AI/ML Product, Research, and Engineering to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives.

We are looking for a world-class leader to lead and grow our UK AI FDE team. In this role, you will lead customers on their AI/ML transformation with Databricks, push the boundaries of our product, recruit and develop top data scientists/machine learning engineers, and manage a portfolio of key EMEA accounts. 

You will report directly to the Director AI FDE. 

The impact you will have:

  • Lead and scale a world-class AI/ML professional services team, including hiring, mentoring, and building a team structure to support long-term growth and execution at scale
  • Develop and expand executive relationships with EMEA customers and partners (including VP+, CIO/CDO-level stakeholders), acting as a trusted advisor during complex technical engagements and AI transformations
  • Align with Field Engineering and Sales Leaders to define joint strategies for strategic accounts and ensure strong delivery coordination across functions
  • Lead strategic AI PS initiatives, practice development, and standardised delivery processes; design scalable engagement models and reusable solutions for repeatability across the global team
  • Shape cross-functional collaboration by influencing Product, R&D, and GTM—ensuring voice-of-customer insights and delivery learnings help inform the product roadmap and GTM strategy
  • Own OKRs for AI-services led accounts, revenue, utilisation, and public references
  • Represent Databricks as a thought leader in AI/ML

What we look for:

  • Extensive experience managing, hiring, and building a team of high-performing data scientists/ML engineers and leaders, with a track record of scaling organisations through developing scalable processes and cultivating leaders
  • Ability to scope, guide, and sell technical engagements, manage escalations, and ensure successful delivery in enterprise environments
  • Deep technical expertise in ML, GenAI, and data science, and curiosity to continue to stay up-to-date in this ever-changing field
  • Experience leading teams building cutting-edge production ML solutions in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Proven success in developing a strategy with senior executive stakeholders to define program-level goals, align technical vision, and build trust throughout complex enterprise engagements
  • Demonstrated experience in cross-functional leadership roles, collaborating with Sales, Product, and GTM teams to drive business impact through AI/ML
  • “Company-first” mindset
  • Graduate degree in a quantitative discipline (Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Operations Research, etc.) or equivalent practical experience

Preferred:

  • Experience in a customer-facing consulting or professional services leadership role
  • Experience working with Databricks

title: Senior Manager, Corporate Services Sourcing
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Finance team shapes the company's future by directing capital to high-impact investments, developing robust financial strategies, and ensuring we deliver long-term value while pursuing our ambitious mission.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Corporate Services Sourcing to join our team. This is a remote role based in Europe (preferred hubs: London, Berlin, Copenhagen, or Helsinki). In this role, you’ll help us lead the Corporate Services Sourcing team for the Deliveroo and Wolt brands, driving strategic category management and delivering commercial value across a multi-million-pound indirect spend portfolio.

Get to know our Finance team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Global Sourcing team within our Global Procurement organization, reporting into the Director, Head of Global Strategic Sourcing. You will lead a team of five (5) managing a broad portfolio across EMEA (including Professional Services, Global Security, Facilities/Real Estate, BPO, HR/Benefits, and Contingent Workforce), while partnering with the DoorDash Corporate Services team to capture global enterprise synergies.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

Category Strategy & Leadership

  • Lead and develop a high-performing sourcing team of five, setting clear goals, driving accountability, and building capability across the Corporate Services portfolio.

  • Build and execute multi-year category strategies that increase category maturity, optimise total cost of ownership (TCO), and unlock value beyond traditional cost savings.

  • Partner with DoorDash sourcing leads to align global category strategies, leverage enterprise scale across brands, and capture cross-regional synergies.

Execution & Supplier Management

  • Own the end-to-end sourcing lifecycle for high-stakes corporate procurement, including data analysis, RFx creation, proposal evaluation, and complex contract negotiations (MSAs/SOWs).

  • Act as a trusted advisor and escalation point for executive stakeholders across G&A functions (Finance, Legal, HR, Security) and core business lines.

  • Establish best-in-class supplier ecosystems, tracking performance, SLAs, and supplier risk while embedding ethical and sustainable sourcing (ESG) practices.

  • Contribute to procurement transformation initiatives, championing new tooling, AI-driven sourcing workflows, and continuous process improvements.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Significant experience in Corporate Services Sourcing, with a proven track record of developing and executing strategic category plans across indirect spend categories.

  • Demonstrated people management capability, with experience leading, mentoring, and developing high-performing sourcing professionals.

  • Strong commercial and negotiation acumen, with proven ability to structure and negotiate complex commercial agreements (MSAs, SOWs) and utilise TCO modelling.

  • Exceptional stakeholder engagement and communication skills, capable of influencing senior leaders, managing matrixed business partners, and driving cross-brand collaboration.

  • Deep risk management expertise, including third-party risk assessments, contract governance, and mitigation strategies within multi-jurisdictional environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working within the technology sector or high-growth, fast-paced marketplace environments.

  • Proficiency with modern procurement and CLM platforms (e.g., Coupa, NetSuite, Pivot) and enthusiasm for applying AI tools in day-to-day sourcing workflows.

  • Experience operating across European markets and diverse regulatory/legal structures.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

title: Senior Manager, Product Partnerships
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

Perk works best when it connects seamlessly with the tools and platforms our customers

already rely on. From ERP and accounting systems to workplace software, mobility providers,

technology platforms, and emerging AI ecosystems, these third-party relationships can directly

shape the value customers get from Perk.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Product Partnerships to own and build those relationships.

Unlike our Growth Partnerships and Supplier Partnerships teams, this role isn’t responsible for

generating sales pipeline or supplier commission revenue. Its goal is to make Perk’s product

and customer experience stronger through the third parties we depend on and integrate with.

You’ll determine where strategic relationships can unlock the most customer value, build and

manage those partnerships, secure the access and agreements our teams need, and work

closely with Product and Engineering to turn them into successful customer-facing experiences.

This is a new role at Perk with significant opportunity to define how Product Partnerships should

work as we scale.

What You’ll Do

  • Build our product partnership strategy: Translate Perk’s product and company priorities into a clear roadmap of third-party relationships across areas such as ERP and accounting, business software, mobility, integration platforms, and AI.

  • Own strategic partner relationships: Serve as Perk’s primary relationship owner for the external platforms and technology companies that enable or enhance customer-facing product experiences.

  • Unlock Product and Engineering: Secure the developer access, API licences, programme memberships, certifications, marketplace approvals, and other partner support our teams need to build and maintain integrations.

  • Structure and negotiate partnerships: Lead commercial and strategic discussions around API access, data, licensing, marketplace participation, co-marketing, and other partnership terms, working closely with Legal, Security, Finance, Product, and Engineering.

  • Partner with Product on priorities: Bring the partner and market perspective into roadmap discussions while Product Managers own product requirements and delivery. Help determine which external relationships and integration models create the greatest customer value.

  • Own the partner lifecycle: Manage relationships from initial engagement through integration, certification, launch, ongoing roadmap alignment, escalations, programme changes, and renewals.

  • Drive adoption and customer value: Work with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Sales, and Support to ensure partnerships aren’t simply launched—they are discoverable, useful, reliable, and adopted by customers.

  • Build the Product Partnerships playbook: Establish how Perk evaluates, prioritises, launches, measures, and manages product partnerships as this function grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience in strategic partnerships, ecosystem partnerships, business development, or a product-adjacent role within SaaS, fintech, or B2B technology.

  • Experience building and managing complex relationships with technology or platform companies, ideally including developer, API, certification, or marketplace programmes.

  • Comfortable working with Product and Engineering and understanding technical concepts such as APIs, OAuth, data models, sandboxes, and integration dependencies without needing to be an engineer.

  • Ability to distinguish between an interesting partnership and one that will meaningfully improve Perk’s product or customer experience.

  • Strong relationship-building, negotiation, and communication skills across both external partners and senior internal stakeholders.

  • Able to move complex initiatives forward across Product, Engineering, Legal, Security, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, and Sales without relying on direct authority.

  • Comfortable defining the strategy, operating model, priorities, and processes for a new function rather than inheriting an established playbook.

  • Able to build the case for a partnership and measure its impact through adoption, customer experience, integration quality, and other relevant outcomes.

  • Based within commuting distance of our London or Barcelona hub.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with ERP, accounting, spend management, payments, travel, or fintech ecosystems.

  • Experience managing relationships with major business software, technology, mobility, or AI platforms.

  • Familiarity with unified API or integration-platform models.

  • Experience with European ERP and accounting ecosystems across markets such as DACH, Benelux, France, the Nordics, or the UK.

  • Additional European languages.

 

What We Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

The Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30 mins - Virtual

  • Hiring Manager Interview - 30 mins - Virtual

  • Assessment Interview - 60 mins - IRL / Virtual

  • Values interview - 30 mins - Virtual

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

4076 - Senior Manager, Global Resource Management – GOC (Parental Leave Cover)

Role Summary and Impact

The Senior Manager, Global Resource Management will play a key role in supporting the effective planning, deployment and utilisation of talent across the Global Operations Centres (GOCs).

The role will have responsibility for the day-to-day Resource Management of selected GOC Global clients, while also leading key RM activities including utilisation reviews, balanced team management, bench governance and cross-GOC RM projects.

Working closely with Capacity Planners, Staffing Strategists, Talent Acquisition, HR and market teams, the Senior Manager will help ensure client demand is effectively resourced, workforce risks are proactively identified, and RM processes are consistently managed across the GOCs.

The role will act as a key operational partner to the GOC RM Lead, taking ownership of defined areas and escalating strategic, commercial or significant workforce decisions where required.

Key Responsibilities

Global Client Resource Management

  • Own Resource Management for selected strategic global clients using GOC talent.
  • Support new global client opportunities and transitions, translating demand into clear resource requirements and staffing plans.
  • Coordinate staffing requirements across multiple GOC locations and disciplines.
  • Work with Capacity Planning and Staffing teams to identify appropriate resources and drive open requirements through to fulfilment.
  • Maintain oversight of the client's GOC workforce, including open roles, upcoming demand, resource movements, backfills and capacity risks.
  • Establish an effective RM cadence with relevant client and market stakeholders.
  • Proactively identify resource issues and drive actions to resolution.
  • Escalate significant commercial, capacity or stakeholder risks to the GOC RM Lead.

Utilisation & Workforce Optimisation

  • Coordinate regular utilisation reviews across GOC teams.
  • Identify under-utilisation, over-utilisation and available capacity and work with relevant teams to agree appropriate actions.
  • Monitor utilisation trends and highlight emerging risks or opportunities.
  • Ensure actions from utilisation reviews are tracked through to completion.
  • Support proactive redeployment of available talent against suitable client demand.
  • Provide concise utilisation insights and exception reporting to the GOC RM Lead.

Balanced Teams

  • Support regular reviews of team structures across GOC clients.
  • Identify opportunities to improve team balance, workload distribution and appropriate management oversight.
  • Work with RM, client and operational teams to address identified team structure or workload issues.
  • Monitor agreed actions and ensure they are followed through.
  • Highlight structural workforce issues requiring longer-term intervention.

Bench Management & Redeployment

  • Own the ongoing coordination and governance of GOC bench activity.
  • Support the rollout of the existing bench framework across additional GOC locations.
  • Maintain visibility of available resources and actively connect relevant skills and capacity with upcoming client requirements.
  • Coordinate appropriate bench project opportunities where immediate billable deployment is not available.
  • Track bench movements and provide visibility of key risks, ageing cases and redeployment opportunities.
  • Work with relevant GOC stakeholders to ensure consistent adoption of the bench process.

Resource Planning & Operational Support

  • Provide support on complex staffing requirements that require coordination across multiple markets, clients, disciplines or GOCs.
  • Assist Capacity Planners and Staffing teams with more complex resource challenges.
  • Monitor key staffing risks, blockers and ageing requirements and help drive them towards resolution.
  • Coordinate with Finance, Talent Acquisition, HR and other functions where additional support is required to fulfil resource needs.
  • Support workforce and capacity planning activities by ensuring emerging demand and supply risks are visible.

RM Projects & Continuous Improvement

  • Own and deliver selected Resource Management projects and improvement initiatives.
  • Support the rollout of consistent RM practices across GOC locations.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify manual RM processes and improve ways of working.
  • Support improvements to RM reporting, dashboards and workforce visibility.
  • Lead agreed workstreams such as:
    • Bench management rollout
    • Balanced Teams
    • Utilisation governance
    • RM reporting and dashboards
    • Process standardisation
    • Skills and capability visibility

Skills & Experience

The successful candidate will ideally have:

  • Experience in Resource Management, People Operations, or a related area is desirable.
  • This is a hands-on role that requires someone who is motivated to make an impact, not simply tick boxes; it requires initiative, ownership and an appetite for challenge.
  • Strong communication, proactive, organisation and influencing skills.
  • Experience managing resource requirements across multiple clients, teams or geographies.
  • Good understanding of utilisation, capacity management and workforce deployment.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to convert workforce data into practical actions.
  • Strong stakeholder-management skills and confidence working with senior stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and drive actions to completion.
  • Experience delivering cross-functional projects or process improvements.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a practical, solutions-focused approach.
  • Ability to operate independently while recognising when issues require senior escalation.

What Success Looks Like

The Senior Manager will be successful when:

  • Selected global clients have clear, proactive RM ownership.
  • Complex staffing requirements are driven to resolution without requiring continuous intervention from the GOC RM Lead.
  • Utilisation and balanced-team reviews result in clear actions and follow-through, rather than simply reporting.
  • Bench capacity is visible and actively managed across GOCs.
  • RM initiatives are delivered consistently across locations.
  • Capacity Planning and Staffing teams have an effective senior operational escalation point.
  • Major workforce risks are identified early and escalated with clear recommendations.

title: Senior Managing Consultant
descriptionHtml:
Your mission

The Role 

As a Senior Managing Consultant, reporting to the Head of Consultancy, you will serve as a trusted advisor to senior technology leaders at FTSE and public sector organisations. You will lead multi-disciplinary teams through complex digital transformations, shape cutting-edge IT operating models, and drive the adoption of established and emerging technology, from enterprise platforms such as Atlassian, AWS and Anthropic to areas such as DevOps, cloud and agentic AI. Beyond delivery, you will act as a market-facing leader, leveraging your industry knowledge and contacts to originate new business and expand Automation Consultants’ market footprint.

 
Responsibilities and Duties
 
Core Responsibilities
  • Engagement Management & IT Delivery:
    • Oversee end-to-end delivery of large-scale, complex technology portfolios, including projects led by you or others.
    • Own engagement and account commercials, including scoping, pricing, negotiation, budgeting, margin and risk.
    • Translate a client’s overarching business vision into a resilient, future-proof target state architecture and actionable roadmap.
    • Be accountable for delivery health, quality and customer satisfaction across your accounts, driving retention and repeat business.
    • Direct application rationalisation, cloud migration paths, and legacy modernisation strategies.
    • Act as the go-to leader for both the delivery team and the client, making decisions and owning outcomes against client requirements.
  • Business Development, Account Growth & Market Eminence:
    • Deliver against annual sales and revenue targets through proactive account planning, opportunity discovery and conversion.
    • Surface client insights and influence client strategy, feeding this back into the firm to sharpen outcome-led proposals and targeted workshops.
    • Originate, shape and convert significant new opportunities across assigned accounts, beyond the engagements you personally deliver.
    • Lead pursuit teams in responding to complex Requests for Proposals (RFPs).
    • Author and deliver thought leadership content, white papers, and speaking engagements regarding emerging IT trends to elevate the firm's brand. 
  • People & Practice Leadership:
    • Build, resource and develop delivery teams; mentor, coach and manage the performance of more junior consultants.
    • Actively contribute to internal initiatives to recruit, retain, and scale tech talent.
    • Contribute to practice strategy, offering development and key technology partner relationships.
    • Help define and deliver training pathways and new technology initiatives.
 


Your profile

Key Requirements & Technical Skills

  • Experience Profile:
    • 10+ years of total IT experience within a consulting firm or enterprise IT environment, with at least 3 years managing delivery teams and/or line management experience.
    • A relevant and strong degree within a STEM based subject or a highly related business field, 2:1 minimum, or equivalent experience.
    • Experience in our core service offerings, including Enterprise Service Management (ITSM/ESM), cloud ecosystems (AWS/Azure/GCP) and platform migrations, is essential.
    • Exceptional presentation and communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to senior and executive non-technical stakeholders, up to and including C-suite.
    • Proven ability to originate, shape and convert opportunities: leading discovery on client challenges and desired outcomes, designing the solution, and seeing it through to successful delivery.
    • Demonstrable track record of managing high-value client accounts and owning sales cycles from origination through to close.
    • Experience maintaining disciplined sales pipeline hygiene and monthly forecasting to manage the future revenue outlook of assigned accounts.
    • Strong systems thinking to seamlessly weave organisation, process, data, and technology into one framework.
  • Technical Mastery (two or more of the following):
  1. Solution architecture and design:Hands-on experience with TOGAF, Zachman, or ArchiMate modelling. Extensive experience in the following core tenets:
    • System Design: Design scalable, secure and reliable architectures that fit client business needs and outcomes.
    • Stakeholder Alignment: Translate complex technical concepts into clear plans for both business leaders and engineering teams.
    • Technology Roadmaps: Define technology roadmaps and platform choices that guide long-term digital growth.
    • Risk Management: Identify architectural, security and compliance risks and define mitigations in line with regulatory requirements.
    • Governance: Set technical standards, assure design decisions and provide technical oversight during delivery.
  2. AI & Data: Experience with frontier LLMs (ideally Claude) and/or self-hosted and open-source models, data platforms or enterprise AI implementation. Knows how to identify the highest-value AI use cases, take pilots into production, establish governance and change management for successful adoption, and measure the ROI of AI initiatives to decide where to adjust and where to invest.
    • Data Platform & Governance: Has shaped data platform architectures (e.g., lakehouses, data fabrics) in regulated environments, with governance designed in from the start, including lineage, access controls and data residency.
    • AI Data Readiness: Can assess a client’s data estate for AI readiness and lead remediation of quality, structure and access issues across both structured and unstructured sources.
    • Generative & Agentic AI Solutions: Has designed and overseen delivery of generative or agentic AI solutions (e.g., retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, workflow automation) integrated with enterprise systems.
    • AI Assurance & Guardrails: Understands how to define evaluation approaches and guardrails that give regulated clients confidence in AI outputs, covering accuracy, hallucination, bias, and IP and data leakage.
    • Operating AI at Scale: Familiar with LLMOps/MLOps practices for monitoring, observability and continuous improvement of AI solutions in production.
  3. DevOps and software delivery: Understands and has experience auditing existing developer workflows, designing target operating models, and implementing compliance or policy-as-code frameworks while driving organisational adoption. 
    • Cloud & Container Orchestration: Strong understanding of major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), Infrastructure as Code and container orchestration (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, Docker, Kubernetes).
    • CI/CD & DevSecOps: Experience designing and governing automated release pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps) with embedded security controls.
    • MLOps and AIOps: Understanding of emerging agentic operations tooling (e.g., Ansible Lightspeed, CAST AI, Dynatrace) is a bonus, particularly for:
      • Automated Incident Response
      • Noise Reduction Strategies
      • Predictive Scaling & Alerting
  4. Portfolio,Programmeand Agile Delivery:Is grounded in the values and principles of the Agile Manifesto and has significant and varied experience in Scrum, Kanban and Lean methodologies. Deep experience leading both project and programme level deliveries in either a consulting or an enterprise/product environment.
    • Strategic Alignment: Linking enterprise business needs with long-term portfolio plans, key performance indicators and budgeting.
    • Scaling Frameworks: Applying enterprise methodologies like SAFe, Scrum of Scrums, or Kanban at scale.
    • Complex Dependency Tracking: Overseeing multi-workstream dependencies, milestones, and integrated roadmaps. 
    • Vendor & Ecosystem Management: Managing external vendors and commercial constraints across large delivery lifecycles and removing systemic organisational blockers.
    • Certification: Has or is working towards one or more of the following: Project Management Professional (PMP), PRINCE2 Practitioner, PMI-Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP), Professional Scrum Master (PSM).

Experience defined in the Target Sector Matrix and Core Challenges table below and any experience working within the associated regulatory frameworks would be considered a strong advantage.

title: Senior Marketingcommunicatieadviseur
descriptionHtml:
Jouw impact bij Movares

Jij zorgt dat de expertise van Movares niet alleen wordt gezien, maar ook leidt tot een sterkere marktpositie, hechtere klantrelaties en nieuwe opdrachten.

Dit ga je doen bij Movares

  • Jij bent strategisch businesspartner voor directies en businessverantwoordelijken binnen verschillende marktunits.

  • Jij vertaalt markt- en businessdoelstellingen naar scherpe marketingcommunicatiestrategieën en concrete, resultaatgerichte aanpakken.

  • Jij voert de regie van strategie tot uitvoering en maakt zichtbaar hoe marketingcommunicatie bijdraagt aan positionering, klantrelaties en commerciële groei.

Als senior marketingcommunicatieadviseur verbind je de ambities van de business met de positionering van Movares. Je initieert en regisseert de ontwikkeling van proposities, campagnes, casestudies, standpunten en events rond thema’s als Leefomgeving, Energie, Infrastructuur en Bereikbaarheid. Daarbij stel je prioriteiten, bewaak je de samenhang en stuur je collega’s en externe partners projectmatig aan. Je houdt regie op de marketingcommunicatieaanpak en het resultaat, waarbij je de specialistische uitvoering bij collega's en externe partners legt.

Dit ben jij bij Movares

Je bent een stevige en resultaatgerichte adviseur die snel tot de kern komt. Je schakelt gemakkelijk tussen directie, inhoudelijke experts en uitvoerende partners, brengt focus in uiteenlopende belangen en durft richting te geven. Daarbij combineer je strategisch inzicht met commerciële scherpte en daadkracht.

Dit breng je ook mee: 

  • een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in marketing of marketingcommunicatie;

  • ruime ervaring in een strategische marketing-communicatierol. Bij voorkeur in een zakelijke of kennisintensieve B2B-omgeving;

  • aantoonbare ervaring met het adviseren van directies en businessverantwoordelijken en het vertalen van organisatiedoelstellingen naar een resultaatgerichte marketingcommunicatieaanpak;

  • ervaring met het coördineren van multidisciplinaire werkzaamheden en het projectmatig aansturen van interne specialisten en externe partners.

Dit krijg je bij Movares

Bij Movares werk je aan opgaven die Nederland verder helpen. Tegelijk krijg je de ruimte om je werk en loopbaan in te richten op een manier die bij jou past. Met goede arbeidsvoorwaarden, veel flexibiliteit en volop mogelijkheden om je te ontwikkelen.

Een sterk fundament

Een goede basis begint bij voorwaarden waarop je kunt rekenen:

  • een salaris tussen € 6.500 en € 7.500 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur;

  • een flexibele pot van minimaal 15% van je jaarsalaris, inclusief vakantiegeld;

  • een goede pensioenregeling bij Zwitserleven, waarbij Movares twee derde van de pensioenpremie betaalt;

  • een NS Business Card voor woon-werkverkeer en zakelijke reizen. Privé profiteer je met de kaart van de dalurenkorting.

Maximaal flexibel

Vorm een manier van werken die aansluit bij jouw leven én jouw ambities. Maak keuzes die bij jou passen:

  • flexibel werken volgens ons Any Time Any Place-principe, passend bij je team, klanten en projecten;

  • de mogelijkheid om twee weken per jaar te werken vanaf je vakantieadres binnen de EU;

  • 20 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen te kopen vanuit je flexibele pot;

  • met je flexibele pot kies je wat voor jou belangrijk is, bijvoorbeeld voor extra inkomen, pensioen, een fiets, bedrijfsfitness, verduurzaming van je woning of het aflossen van je studieschuld;

  • € 750 budget per vijf jaar om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten;

  • € 2,45 netto thuiswerkvergoeding per thuiswerkdag.

Veel ontwikkelmogelijkheden

Ontwikkel een loopbaan die past bij jouw talenten en ambities. Kies jouw eigen pad:

  • ruimte om je expertise, ambitie en loopbaan verder te ontwikkelen;

  • leren door te doen, samen met ervaren collega's en met gebruik van een breed aanbod aan ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • de kans om actief kennis te delen en mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van ons vakgebied.

Samen groeien

Deel mee in de waarde die we samen creëren en de groei van onze organisatie. Samen voor succes:

  • je flexibele pot groeit mee met de resultaten van Movares;

  • een winstdeling met een doelbedrag van 5% van je bruto jaarsalaris, afhankelijk van de resultaten;

  • en de mogelijkheid tot participeren in de waardeontwikkeling van Movares door middel van aankoop van phantom aandelen.

Jouw team bij Movares

Je wordt onderdeel van het team Marketing & Communicatie, dat momenteel bestaat uit veertien vakspecialisten. Het team is volop in ontwikkeling, er gebeurt veel, de lijnen zijn kort en niet alles ligt al vast. Dat geeft jou de ruimte om initiatief te nemen, nieuwe ideeën uit te proberen en zichtbaar bij te dragen aan de manier waarop Movares zich intern en extern presenteert.

Je werkt nauw samen met communicatieadviseurs, marketeers, recruiters, collega’s uit de verschillende businessonderdelen. Zij kennen de projecten en inhoud, jij helpt om relevante en aantrekkelijke verhalen in de markt te zetten. Binnen het team vind je gedreven aanpakkers die kennis delen, van elkaar leren en ook tijd maken om samen te lunchen of een wandeling te maken. Op maandag en donderdag werk je met het team in Utrecht. Op andere dagen rouleren we tussen verschillende Movares-locaties en thuis. Zo combineer je samenwerking en verbinding op kantoor met ruimte om geconcentreerd aan content te werken.

title: (Senior) Media Manager (m/w/d) (Vollzeit)
descriptionHtml:
Gestalte und führe einen unserer wichtigsten Wachstumsbereiche, von Amazon DSP bis Full Funnel Media. Vollzeit · Hamburg · hybrid · ab sofort

Du kennst das Amazon und Retail Media Universum in und auswendig und willst mehr, als nur Kampagnen zu steuern? Du willst einen strategischen Wachstumsbereich prägen und ein eigenes Team dahinter aufbauen und führen?

Bei Remazing Moin haben wir uns als eine der führenden Amazon Agenturen Deutschlands etabliert. Jetzt erweitern wir unser Angebot konsequent in Richtung digitale Media-Beratung und Full Funnel-Konzepte. Wir setzen dabei auf einen klaren Fokus auf Amazon DSP, wo wir bereits stark aufgestellt sind, und bauen das Thema strategisch weiter aus, bis hin zu Streaming TV, Online Video, Audio und programmatischen Kampagnen über Amazon wie beispielweise Netflix, Disney+, Joyn, Spotify hinaus.

Für diesen Bereich suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die unseren Media Service maßgeblich prägt, ein eigenes Team aufbaut und führt und eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammenarbeitet. Klingt nach dir? Dann lass uns sprechen.

Remazing Moin ist eine der führenden Amazon Marketing Agenturen in Deutschland und Teil der Remazing Group. Mit einem motivierten und ehrgeizigen Team betreuen wir nationale und internationale Marken dabei, ihr Amazon und E-Commerce Business auf das nächste Level zu bringen, von Sponsored Ads über DSP bis hin zu datengetriebenem Measurement mit der Amazon Marketing Cloud.

Mit unserem Media Service gehen wir jetzt den nächsten logischen Schritt und bündeln unsere Stärken in einem eigenen Bereich. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Du gestaltest diesen Bereich aktiv mit, baust dein Team auf und machst ihn zu einem festen Bestandteil unseres Angebots.

Aufgaben

  • Teamaufbau und Führung: Du baust den Media Bereich personell auf, entwickelst dein Team weiter und führst es fachlich. Du bringst das Media Wissen ins gesamte Unternehmen, in Account Management, Sales und Data

  • Strategischer Ausbau des Media Service: Du entwickelst unser digitales Media Angebot strategisch weiter und etablierst Prozesse, Standards und Best Practices für Setup, Testing und Skalierung

  • Amazon DSP und Programmatic: Du verantwortest die strategische Planung, Steuerung und Optimierung von DSP-Media und programmatischen Kampagnen für endemische und nicht endemische Kunden

  • Full Funnel Media: Du denkst über die Plattform hinaus und verbindest Streaming TV, Online Video, Audio und weitere Upper Funnel Formate zu einer durchgängigen Strategie aus Awareness und Performance

  • Measurement als USP: Du machst unseren Media Service messbar, unter anderem mit der Amazon Marketing Cloud, und baust ein überzeugendes Full Funnel Reporting auf. Das ist unser klarer Vorteil gegenüber klassischen Media Agenturen

  • Sales Support: Du unterstützt beim Verkauf des Media Service an Bestands- und Neukunden, von der überzeugenden Story bis zur sauberen Umsetzung

  • Qualität und Weiterentwicklung: Du verantwortest die Qualität der Media Kampagnen und entwickelst den Bereich kontinuierlich weiter, mit dem Anspruch, Vorreiter zu sein

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung im Media oder Retail Media Bereich: Du bringst mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Amazon DSP, Programmatic Advertising oder Media Planung mit, agentur- oder unternehmensseitig.

  • Verständnis für Markenaufbau und Werbewirkung: Du weißt genau, wie moderner digitaler Markenaufbau funktioniert und ab wann Kampagnen – insbesondere im Bereich Streaming TV – wirklich Wirkung zeigen. Du kennst die relevanten Marken-KPIs und verstehst es, den Werbeerfolg durch Brand Lift Studies und Co. messbar und transparent zu machen

  • Lust auf Verantwortung und Teamaufbau: Du willst nicht nur umsetzen, sondern einen Bereich prägen, ein Team formen und führen. Du denkst unternehmerisch und arbeitest eigenverantwortlich

  • Amazon Know-how: Du kennst dich im Amazon Advertising Universum bestens aus. Erfahrung mit der Amazon Marketing Cloud ist ein klares Plus

  • Zahlen- und Datenaffinität: Du liebst datengetriebenes Arbeiten, sauberes Reporting und klare Handlungsempfehlungen

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du vermittelst komplexe Themen verständlich, intern wie gegenüber Kunden, in sehr gutem Deutsch und gutem Englisch

  • Das Wichtigste: Du hast richtig Bock, etwas zu bewegen, willst Gas geben und gemeinsam mit uns etwas Großes aufbauen

Benefits

  • Verantwortung von Anfang an: Du prägst einen strategisch wichtigen Wachstumsbereich und führst dein eigenes Team.

  • Die Sicherheit einer etablierten Agentur mit einer starken Gruppe im Rücken (Remazing Group)

  • Kurze Wege: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Gründern zusammen und lernst direkt von ihnen

  • Gleitzeit und die Möglichkeit zum Home-Office, plus bis zu 5 mobile Arbeitstage pro Jahr innerhalb der EU

  • 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr, alle zwei Jahre steigend auf bis zu 33 Tage

  • Persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung – dafür stellen wir dir ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget von 1.000 € zur Verfügung , Englisch-Workshops und eine offene Feedbackkultur in alle Richtungen

  • Edenred Card & Urban Sports Club – Monatliches Guthaben für deine individuellen Wünsche

  • Ein attraktives und faires Gehalt und eine angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge

  • Ein moderner Arbeitsplatz mitten in Hamburg, Getränke von Hafermilch bis Softdrinks

  • Die besten Partys und Events, All-Company Get Togethers zweimal im Jahr

Du fühlst dich angesprochen? Dann bewirb dich jetzt in nur wenigen Minuten. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich bald persönlich kennenzulernen.

Bewirb dich trotzdem. Uns zählen Drive, Potenzial und echte Begeisterung fürs Thema mindestens genauso viel wie der perfekte Lebenslauf.

title: Senior Network Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Our client is an established, family-owned industrial technology company headquartered near Zurich. Its systems run at customer sites in more than 60 countries. To keep them reachable and secure, it needs someone who can build and run the networks behind them, and who is comfortable intervening and troubleshooting when a customer's connection goes down.

What you'll do

  • Set up, run and troubleshoot site-to-site and remote-access VPNs to customer sites (IPsec, OpenVPN)

  • Configure and maintain firewalls (Fortinet, OPNsense and others)

  • Design and implement networks at customer sites: switching, routing, VLANs, WLAN

  • Find and fix network problems together with customers and colleagues around the world, remotely or on site

  • Install and roll out software on Windows and Linux systems

  • Build and maintain the internal test and lab networks

  • Keep network documentation clear and up to date, and help improve how the team works


What you bring

  • A completed IT or electrical engineering education (EFZ with further training, HF, FH or equivalent)

  • At least three years of hands-on experience in network or system engineering

  • Solid knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching and firewalls

  • Real experience with VPNs, ideally IPsec and OpenVPN

  • Working knowledge of Windows Server

  • A calm, customer-focused way of solving problems, including under pressure

  • Fluent German and English

  • Willingness to travel occasionally for on-site work

Nice to have

  • Linux administration

  • Scripting or automation (Python, Bash)

  • Certifications such as CCNA/CCNP or Fortinet NSE

  • A background in network or cyber security

What's on offer

  • Room to shape the role and how things are done

  • Flexible working model with home office (up to 60%)

  • Individual training and certification budget

  • Comprehensive social benefits

  • A long-term position in a stable, family-owned company

title: Senior Operations Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Die PAUL Tech AG ist Technologieführer der Immobilienwirtschaft mit der Mission, Bestandsgebäude klimaneutral zu machen. Unsere Lösung PAUL Net Zero kombiniert KI, IoT-Geräte und Wärmepumpen zu einem intelligenten Gesamtsystem für CO₂-neutrale Wärme – ganz ohne Sanierungsaufwand oder Investitionsrisiko.

Deine Mission wird es, unsere operative Umsetzung so zu steuern und wirtschaftlich zu durchdringen, dass wir mit jedem weiteren Projekt effizienter werden. Dabei verbindest du Kapazitätssteuerung, Nachkalkulation, Kostenoptimierung und Prozessskalierung mit einer unternehmerischen, umsetzungsstarken Arbeitsweise.

Klingt nach dir? Dann starte bei uns als

Senior Operations Manager (m/w/d) – Projektsteuerung & Wirtschaftlichkeit in Mannheim

Deine Aufgaben



Steuerung der operativen Umsetzung

  • Du steuerst Kapazitäts- und Einsatzplanung über Projekte und Teams hinweg und sorgst für eine belastbare Ressourcenzuweisung
  • Du steuerst den Einsatz von Nachunternehmern und Partnerbetrieben nach Kosten-, Termin- und Qualitätsvorgaben
  • Du stellst sicher, dass Material, Werkzeug und Ausstattung dort verfügbar sind, wo die Teams sie brauchen


Wirtschaftlichkeit & Transparenz

  • Du verantwortest die Nachkalkulation unserer Projekte und leitest daraus belastbare Erkenntnisse für Kalkulation, Preisgestaltung und Abläufe ab
  • Du entwickelst ein Kennzahlensystem zu Projektkosten, Auslastung, Durchlaufzeiten und Abrechnungsstand und übersetzt es in konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen für die Geschäftsführung
  • Du löst manuelle Statuslisten durch digitale Dashboards und Auswertungen ab


Kostenoptimierung & Value Engineering

  • Du identifizierst Kostentreiber über den gesamten Projektverlauf und setzt Optimierungsinitiativen mit messbarem Ergebnis um
  • Du bewertest Material-, Leistungs- und Nachunternehmerkosten und erschließt Einsparpotenziale


Prozessdesign & Digitalisierung

  • Du analysierst unsere Abläufe von der Beauftragung bis zur Abnahme und Abrechnung und überführst sie in standardisierte, skalierbare Prozesse
  • Du treibst Digitalisierung und Automatisierung im ERP-System und den angrenzenden Tools gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen voran


Schnittstellen & Sonderprojekte

  • Du verbindest Geschäftsführung, Teamleitungen, technische Betriebsleitung, Projektleitung, Einkauf, Controlling und Personal und sorgst für klare Verantwortlichkeiten und Übergaben
  • Du übernimmst bereichsübergreifende Sonderthemen ohne etablierte Zuständigkeit, arbeitest dich bei Bedarf in laufende Projekte ein und steuerst Abweichungen nach

Das bringst du mit



Fachlicher Hintergrund

  • Wichtiger als Ausbildung oder Studium ist uns, was du kannst und mitbringst — typische Wege in diese Rolle sind dennoch: ein Studium mit wirtschaftlichem, technischem oder wirtschaftsingenieurwissenschaftlichem Schwerpunkt, gern ergänzt um einen MBA, mit nachweisbarer Verantwortung an der Schnittstelle von Analyse und operativer Umsetzung
  • Du kommst z. B. aus Rollen wie Operations Manager, Operational Excellence Manager, Inhouse Consultant mit Operations-Fokus oder Venture bzw. Business Development Manager im Bau-, Handwerks-, Energie- oder Serviceumfeld
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in genau dieser Kombination; Branchenerfahrung ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung — die fachliche Einarbeitung in unser Geschäft stellen wir sicher


Erfahrung & Methoden

  • Erfahrung in Projekt- und Nachkalkulation sowie sicherer Umgang mit Finanzkennzahlen wie P&L, Cashflow und ROI
  • Praxis in der Kapazitäts- und Ressourcensteuerung vieler paralleler Projekte
  • Erfahrung in der Prozessgestaltung und im Aufbau von Strukturen in Wachstumsphasen


Tools, Systeme & Sprache

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Excel und ERP-Systemen, idealerweise ergänzt um BI- und Automatisierungstools (z. B. Power BI, n8n)
  • Routinierter Einsatz von KI-Tools (z. B. ChatGPT, Claude) für Analysen, Auswertungen und Automatisierung
  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Führerschein Klasse B und Bereitschaft zu Reisen an Baustellen und Standorte


Du passt zu uns, wenn

  • du dir vor Ort ein eigenes Bild machst, bevor du Entscheidungen vorbereitest, und Themen auf allen Ebenen überzeugend vertrittst — von der Baustelle bis zur Geschäftsführung
  • du mit Lösungsorientierung und Eigenverantwortung eigenständig Lösungen umsetzt
  • du Proaktivität zeigst, auch wenn noch nicht jeder Prozess perfekt definiert ist
  • du Exzellenz in Qualität und Wirtschaftlichkeit anstrebst
  • du für Strukturierung und Skalierbarkeit komplexer Themen sorgst


Das bieten wir dir

  • Sinnstiftende Tätigkeit mit echtem Impact — direkter Beitrag zur CO₂-Einsparung im Gebäudebestand

title: Senior People Ops Manager (International)
descriptionHtml:
About us

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator’s Summer 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading AI photo and video solution for e-commerce, helping businesses sell at first sight.

Backed by Series B funding, we’ve reached 300M+ downloads and now process around 7 billion images a year for businesses of every size, from solo sellers to global brands and marketplaces like Amazon, Decathlon, and Depop. We serve them through our mobile app, web platform, and API, with tailored solutions for enterprise catalogs.

We’re an international team of 130+, with offices in Paris and New York. We take ownership of what we build, move quickly to learn what works, and speak candidly, united by our ambition to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

The role

We are looking for a Senior People Operations Manager to own and improve the systems, processes and operational foundations behind our People function, across all of our markets.

You will own the core People Operations scope: payroll, HRIS, contracts, compliance, benefits, employee lifecycle operations, immigration, people data and our HR tooling. But this is not simply a role about running existing processes - your job is to make them better. You will build the people workflows, automation, documentation and self-service mechanisms that allow Photoroom to keep moving quickly as we grow, without creating unnecessary complexity.

This scope has so far sat within a small generalist People team. You will be the first person to own it as a dedicated senior scope, giving you the opportunity to shape this operating model.

We are also an AI-native company, and we want our People function to operate the same way. We expect you to actively use automation and AI to improve speed, reliability and employee experience, while maintaining a high bar for privacy, compliance and trust.

You will report to our VP People. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports today.

 

Why this role exists

We have built a lot quickly. Today, our People Operations environment includes:

  • French and USA payroll and entity obligations

  • European employees through an EOR setup

  • Growing Paris and New York offices

  • Multiple benefits providers and external partners

  • An HR technology stack that has grown alongside the company

The foundations work. Now they need a clear owner and regular improvements.

We want to move from processes that depend on individual knowledge and manual intervention to an operating model that is documented, automated, measurable and more self-service for our employees.

Your goal is to strengthen our foundations with proven best practices and build a model that scales comfortably with the company.

  

What you will own

 

Payroll

  • Own and Run monthly payroll for France and our European population, and twice-monthly US payroll, working closely with our external providers

  • Manage relationships with payroll, EOR and employment providers

 

Compliance

  • Maintain our French statutory obligations and HR compliance calendar, including employee records, social declarations, DUERP and employee data requirements

  • Own the operational administration of our CSE, including convocations, agendas, meeting preparation, PV review, annual budget administration and mandatory timelines

  • Monitor relevant employment law developments and translate changes into concrete actions

  • Coordinate compliance across our European and US setups, with deep expertise expected in France primarly

 

Contracts and People documentation

  • Employment contracts, amendments, offer letters, attestations and standard HR letters, maintaining and improving templates as our organisation and legal environment evolve

  • Setting clear service levels for recurring People Ops requests

  • Building practical People playbooks and documentation that employees and managers can actually find, understand and use

 

Employee lifecycle

  • Onboarding administration from signed offer through day one, coordinating payroll, benefits, declarations, IT access, equipment, manager actions ect..

  • Offboarding and exit administration, including documentation, payroll, benefits, access removal and final employment documents

  • Promotions, compensation changes, employment changes, contract amendments, leaves, parental leave and other employee changes

  • Immigration and visa administration, including external providers, applications, renewals and deadline tracking

 

Benefits & Compensation

  • Administer benefits and manage providers across France, Europe and the US

  • Run annual renewals with Finance and the VP People, using cost, usage and employee value to inform decisions

  • Support compensation benchmarking and salary band maintenance

 

HRIS, data and automation

Our HRIS is Hibob today, which may or may not change. You will own the reliability and evolution of our People systems.

This includes:

  • HRIS configuration, permissions, workflows, integrations and data quality

  • Making the HRIS the reliable source of truth for employee data

  • Assessing opportunities to consolidate or improve our HR technology stack

  • Automating repetitive workflows wherever doing so improves speed and reliability

 

Employee support

You will help us move from a People team that repeatedly answers standard questions to one that builds systems people can use themselves.

You will build the documentation, workflows, processes and self-service infrastructure that make the majority of standard People requests easy to solve without intervention, while personally handling the exceptions and escalations that genuinely require expertise.

  

What we are looking for

You have already owned a meaningful People Operations scope in a fast-moving company of +100 employees.

In particular, we are looking for:

  • Hands-on experience with French payroll and employment compliance

  • Experience owning People Operations processes, workflows, and controls

  • HRIS experience. Hibob is a plus, but experience configuring and improving a comparable system matters more

  • A systems mindset and a strong instinct for automation

  • Excellent operational judgement. You know which issues you can solve yourself and which require specialist advice

  • High standards of accuracy, discretion and follow-through

  • Comfort operating independently in a small team where you will both design the process and run it

  • Fluent French and English. English is our working language, while much of our payroll and employment law environment is French

  • Based in Paris and able to work from our office at least three days per week.

 

The person who will thrive here likes that combination: build it, simplify it, automate it and own it.

 

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work in a hybrid environment, and extended parental leave.

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

Unser People-Team ist bewusst schlank: Neben dir und Jasmina gehört eine Werkstudentin dazu, die das Office Management verantwortet und in HR hineinwächst, und ab November wieder unser Kollege aus HR Operations.

Sie setzt deine Gedanken schneller um, das Denken bleibt bei dir. Du bist mindestens drei Tage pro Woche bei uns im Office an der Köpenicker Straße, das ist gesetzt, denn HR passiert hier vor Ort. Wenn du Bock hast, People-Arbeit nicht nur zu verwalten, sondern aufzubauen, lies weiter.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Senior Platform Engineer 

À propos du rôle et de l'équipe

La Cloud Platform Engineering (CPE) est une Business Unit de près de 200 personnes qui continue de se renforcer pour accompagner les ambitions tech de Decathlon. Notre objectif principal est de rationaliser le catalogue de produits techniques et de fournir des services clé en main pour les équipes IT, afin de leur permettre de se concentrer sur le développement de fonctionnalités à fort impact applicatif.

Au sein de la CPE, tu rejoindras l'équipe Cloud Dev. Notre mission est de fournir des fonctionnalités essentielles et abstraites pour le Cloud, en appliquant les meilleures pratiques de développement d'ingénierie logicielle pour unifier, sécuriser et optimiser nos plateformes.

Tu rejoindras une équipe à taille humaine, composée d'ingénieurs passionnés. Nous sommes fans de développement logiciel, d'Infrastructure as Code, de culture DevOps/SRE, d'automatisation, de veille technologique... et bien sûr, de sport !

Périmètre et missions d'un Platform Engineer

En tant que Platform Engineer, tu joueras un rôle central dans l'autonomisation des équipes de développement grâce à l'ingénierie de plateforme. Tes missions s'articuleront autour des piliers suivants :

1. Ingénierie Logicielle & Abstraction Cloud

  • Utiliser les meilleures pratiques de développement (Software Engineering, Software Architecture) pour concevoir du code propre, robuste et maintenable créant des couches d'abstraction au-dessus du Cloud.
  • Développer et industrialiser des API, outils internes et modules d'infrastructure en Python et Go.
  • Consommer et orchestrer des services Serverless (Google Cloud Functions, Google Workflows) et moderniser l'outillage de déploiement.

2. Infrastructure as Code & Automatisation DevSecOps

  • Concevoir, tester et déployer l'infrastructure de manière cohérente et automatisée avec Terraform.
  • Construire et optimiser des pipelines CI/CD modernes (de préférence avec GitHub Actions) intégrant les standards de sécurité DevSecOps dès la conception.
  • Automatiser les tâches récurrentes par du scripting (Python, Bash) afin de réduire l'effort manuel et maximiser la fiabilité.

3. Intégration Transversale & Excellence Opérationnelle

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Réseau, Sécurité et Bases de données pour garantir des intégrations fluides, performantes et sécurisées.
  • Rôle de Run Captain: prendre en charge le support de niveau 2/3, l'analyse des incidents et le traitement des demandes de service pour assurer la stabilité opérationnelle.
  • Contribuer à la définition et au respect des SLO/SLI ainsi qu'à la démarche de réduction du MTTR en automatisant la résolution des problèmes récurrents.

4. Accompagnement, Partage & Culture Produit

Native-level or near-native German language skills (written and spoken), with the ability to confidently engage German-speaking customers, facilitate workshops, and present to executive stakeholders.

title: Senior Privacy Counsel
descriptionHtml:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we’ve turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In the last couple of years we have gone big and acquired both Carwow Leasey, a leasing broker, and Autovia, creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines, doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach of over 350 million. We also launched our successful Sell My Car business in Germany. We are continually driving to make Carwow the go-to destination for people looking to change their car.

And we’re a long way from done!

LEGAL & COMPLIANCE @ CARWOW

Our fantastic legal team has been compared to a set of high-performance tyres, enabling Carwow to drive and corner at high speeds whilst keeping Carwow firmly on the road in all conditions. As the business pushes forward with bold ambitions, the legal team’s purpose is clear: to drive Carwow’s growth with integrity and confidence – and that’s where you come in!

YOUR MISSION

We are a platform that sits right in the middle between consumers and OEMs/Dealers in the car-changing journey. Datasits at the heart of everything we do and we want to commercialise it responsibly.

As Senior Privacy Counsel, you will be Carwow’s dedicated in-house privacy lawyer and operational privacy lead, playing a pivotal role in enabling the business to grow and scale at pace with integrity. This is an exciting opportunity to develop your career in a complex, high-growth and data-thirsty marketplace business.

We are looking for a Senior Privacy Counsel who wants to do more than provide legal advice from the sidelines. This is a rare opportunity to join a high-performing legal function as our first dedicated in-house privacy hire, taking ownership of the day-to-day privacy programme while acting as a senior legal and strategic advisor to the business as it sharpens its privacy governance programme and steers towards further growth and an exit.

We are not at “Day Zero”. We currently have an external DPO, established policies, templates, a RoPA and a risk register.

We need a tech-fluent privacy lawyer who is equally comfortable advising and doing: someone who can interpret complex legal requirements, exercise sound legal judgement and provide pragmatic advice, but who will also roll up their sleeves and build, operate and continuously improve the mechanisms that make privacy work in practice.

You will have the mandate to lift the lid on our technology stack, validate our data flows, identify legal and operational privacy risks and work directly with our Product, Engineering, Data, Marketing and commercial teams to keep the business safe and moving fast.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Privacy governance and framework development: Own, develop and maintain Carwow’s enterprise privacy governance framework, encompassing internal policies, ROPAs, privacy notices, risk registers, retention schedules and associated controls. Interpret applicable legal requirements and ensure our documentation and processes reflect the reality of Carwow’s technology stack and processing activities, leading remediation where discrepancies or risks are identified.

  • Legal advice and business partnering: Act as Carwow’s principal in-house legal advisor on privacy and data protection matters. Develop strong business partnering relationships across Marketing, Media, Product, Engineering, Data and other parts of the business, providing pragmatic, risk-based legal advice that enables commercial objectives while appropriately managing privacy risk. Provide advice to senior management and support the General Counsel in updating the Company’s Senior Leadership Team and Executives as needed.

  • Culture & Training: Build a strong internal perception of privacy as a “trust builder”. Design and deliver role-specific training that is engaging, commercially relevant and free of unnecessary legal jargon, helping teams understand both their legal obligations and how to apply them in practice.

  • Breach response: Lead the privacy aspects of data breach and incident response, working cross-functionally to investigate incidents, assess legal and regulatory risk, determine notification obligations and oversee remediation. Liaise with the external DPO, regulators and other relevant stakeholders as appropriate.

  • DPAs, DSAs and data contracting: Draft, review and negotiate DPAs, DSAs and other data protection provisions and agreements arising from commercial arrangements. Provide practical legal advice on controller/processor relationships, data sharing, international transfers and related privacy risks.

  • DSARs and individual rights: Own and continuously improve Carwow’s processes for responding to data subject rights requests, ensuring requests can be handled lawfully, efficiently and with minimal disruption to the business. Provide legal guidance on complex or sensitive requests where required.

  • Retail Media and Ad Tech: Provide legal and operational privacy support on new commercial propositions looking to leverage Carwow’s data for third-party audience targeting, segmentation and advertising. Advise on the appropriate use of personal data, profiling, consent and data-sharing structures and help design commercially workable and legally robust mechanisms for using and sharing data.

  • Product, Data and Technology: Work closely with Data & Insights, IT, Engineering and Product teams throughout the product lifecycle to embed Privacy by Design. Lead or support privacy assessments, identify legal and operational risks in new products and processing activities, and translate complex technical data flows into clear, risk-based advice for the General Counsel, Executives and wider business.

  • Operationalise Compliance: Own and operate core privacy compliance processes, including DPIAs, LIAs and data-sharing assessments. Look continuously for opportunities to integrate these into existing business workflows, with an eye on making compliance proportionate, scalable and automated wherever possible.

  • Regulatory developments: Monitor and interpret relevant developments in privacy, data protection, digital regulation and related areas, assess their impact on Carwow and translate new legal requirements into practical changes to products, policies, controls and business processes.

  • Corporate work: Provide privacy legal support on M&A, funding and other corporate transactions, including conducting privacy due diligence, identifying material risks and supporting remediation and integration activity.

  • AI and emerging technology: Advise on the privacy implications of AI and emerging technologies adopted or developed across the business, while supporting the development of practical governance mechanisms that allow Carwow to innovate responsibly.

  • Multi-jurisdictional: Support Carwow’s businesses across the UK, Germany, Spain and Portugal, advising on relevant local and European privacy requirements and working with external counsel where specialist local advice is required.

KEY REQUIREMENTS

  • A qualified lawyer, admitted to practise in England & Wales or another relevant UK or European jurisdiction, with significant experience advising on privacy and data protection matters.

  • Significant experience working in-house, balancing legal and regulatory requirements with commercial objectives and operating as a trusted advisor to the business.

  • Strong working knowledge of UK and European data protection law, with the ability to interpret legislation, regulatory guidance and emerging issues and translate them into clear, practical and commercially workable advice.

  • Experience not only providing privacy legal advice but also building, operating or materially contributing to a privacy programme, including areas such as DPIAs, RoPAs, privacy notices, data rights, retention, incident response and privacy governance.

  • The ability and willingness to work autonomously as Carwow’s principal in-house privacy specialist, moving comfortably between complex legal analysis and hands-on operational delivery.

  • Passionate about the intersection of AI and privacy, with an interest in how to safeguard the organisation during technology adoption while also leveraging AI to enhance and automate privacy operations.

  • A team player with a growth mindset, high EQ and low ego, excited to be part of a scale-up, high-growth company where every day brings new challenges and opportunities.

  • To be able to work in a fast-paced environment with teams that move and pivot quickly.

  • Fluency in English and strong written and verbal communication skills, together with a proactive, persuasive and adaptable manner.

  • Driven to ensure the Legal & Compliance Team is viewed as a genuine partner to the business, with the initiative and credibility to build relationships across functions and at senior levels.

  • Ability to lead cross-functional projects and influence stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

  • A track record of working effectively with all levels of an organisation, including senior management and executives.

BONUS POINTS

  • Experience working in a tech platform or marketplace environment.

  • Experience in Mar-Tech or Ad-Tech.

  • Experience in the automotive industry.

  • Experience advising on AI governance or wider digital regulation.

  • Experience supporting organisations operating across multiple European jurisdictions.

  • A CIPP/E and/or CIPM qualification from the IAPP, or equivalent demonstrable privacy expertise.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Introductory call with our Talent team.

  • Interview with our Director of Legal and another member of our Legal Team.

  • Interview with our General Counsel

  • Carwow Values interview with 2 x members of the Carwow business.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Hybrid working (2 days working from home)

  • Competitive salary

  • Matched pension contributions

  • Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

  • Bupa Private medical and dental insurance, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

  • Life Assurance

  • Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

  • Enhanced holiday package, plus Bank Holidays

  • 28 days annual leave

  • 1 day for your wedding

  • 1 day off when you move house - because moving is hard enough without work!

  • For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year

  • For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year

  • Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year

  • The option to work from abroad up to 4 weeks

  • Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies

  • Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones

  • Up to £500/€550 home office allowance for that massage chair you’ve been talking about

  • Generous learning and development budget to help you master your craft

  • Regular social events: tech lunches, coffee with the exec sessions, lunch 8 learns, book clubs, social events/anything else you pester us for

  • Refer a friend, get paid. Repeat for infinite money

Diversity and inclusion is an integral part of our culture. We know that diverse teams are strong teams, so we welcome those with alternative identities, backgrounds, and experiences to apply for this position. We make recruiting decisions based on experience, skills and potential, so all our applicants are treated fairly and equally.
