title: Technical Project Manager - France
descriptionHtml:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

About the Role

You care about making complex systems actually work, not just in theory, but in practice - across teams, stakeholders, and real-world constraints. In previous roles, you were likely the person who brought clarity to messy situations: aligning engineers, partners, and product teams to get things shipped.

At Tandem, you'll drive how our platform connects with the external systems used across French and European healthcare - owning and driving some of the most critical technical initiatives we have. You'll be based in our France office, working alongside the local team, in close collaboration with our central Integrations team in Stockholm. A big part of the role is deeply understanding both sides: the capabilities and constraints of external systems, and those of our own platform. From that understanding, you'll find ways to integrate them and shape concrete proposals for how integrations should work, together with external partners.

You move fast, but not carelessly. You know how to break down complex problems, prioritize what matters, and keep momentum across multiple workstreams. You're comfortable going deep technically when needed, understanding APIs, data flows, and system constraints, while still keeping the bigger product picture in mind.


This is a high-impact role where you'll not only deliver projects, but shape how we build and scale technical products at Tandem.


What You'll Do

  • Lead integration work with external partners and healthcare systems, ensuring high-quality, scalable implementations.

  • Map external systems against our own platform and propose concrete integration designs to external partners.

  • Act as the central point of coordination between engineering, partnerships, and external stakeholders, bridging the local team in France and the integrations team in Stockholm.

  • Translate complex technical requirements into clear priorities, plans, and deliverables.

  • Work closely with engineers to understand APIs, data models, and system architecture, and ensure solutions are robust and aligned with our platform.

  • Identify bottlenecks, manage dependencies, and keep projects moving at high velocity.

  • Build and improve how we work - establishing processes, templates, and frameworks for integrations and technical delivery.

  • Ensure strong visibility across stakeholders - tracking progress, surfacing risks, and communicating clearly.

  • Support our sales organisation in answering technical questions from our customers.

What You Bring

  • Experience as a Technical Project Manager or similar role in a SaaS, platform, or healthtech environment.

  • Strong ability to drive complex, cross-functional initiatives involving both internal teams and external stakeholders.

  • Technical fluency - comfortable discussing APIs, authentication, integrations, and system design with engineers.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams without losing clarity or momentum.

  • Ability to anticipate, assess, and manage risk in projects, from scoping through to delivery.

  • Strong communication skills, you can translate technical complexity into clear decisions and direction.

  • A product mindset - you care about building the right thing, not just delivering on time.

  • Native level french speaking.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in tech sales, enterprise sales, or enterprise software delivery

  • Experience working with healthcare systems or regulated environments

  • Familiarity with FHIR, HL7, or other healthcare data standards

  • Experience working with platform or API products

  • Some hands-on technical experience (e.g. scripting, debugging, light coding)

  • Experience scaling integration processes or working with multiple external partners

Location

We believe the best ideas happen when we're together. This role is based in our Paris office, where you will work primarily on-site with the local team, while collaborating closely with colleagues at our HQ in Stockholm.

How to Apply

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of 4 stages:

  • Screening interview with Talent Acquisition

  • Technical interview with some of our Engineering team

  • Follow-up interview with one of our Team Leads

  • Home case and presentation at our Paris office - Join us for a lunch, a discovery meeting and a presentation to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.

Culture at Tandem

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

title: Technical Project Manager
descriptionHtml:
Certa (certa.ai) is an AI-native third-party risk management platform that unifies the full third-party lifecycle, from onboarding through continuous monitoring and offboarding. Enterprises from the Fortune 500 to fast-growing startups use our no-code platform to manage vendors, suppliers, and partners across risk, compliance, and ESG. Trusted by Honeywell, Uber, MARS, and Boeing, we've processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries.

We're looking for a Technical Project Manager to own the end-to-end delivery of complex enterprise software implementations. This is a client-facing role at the center of every engagement: you'll translate what a customer needs into a plan, drive a cross-functional team to build it, and keep both sides aligned from kickoff to go-live and beyond. You won't just track tasks, you'll understand the product deeply, engage in technical conversations with solution architects and engineers, lead the business requirement sessions, and make the decisions that keep delivery on track. The best person for this role thinks like an owner of the account, not a coordinator of it.

What You'll Do

  • Own delivery end to end: Run enterprise implementation projects from kickoff through go-live and stabilization, accountable for scope, timeline, budget, quality, and client satisfaction on every engagement you lead.

  • Build & manage the plan: Break down complex, ambiguous requirements into a clear project plan with phases, milestones, dependencies, and owners, keeping it current and making trade-offs visible when reality shifts.

  • Lead requirements gathering: Own the business requirement sessions end to end, facilitating discovery workshops that surface what the client actually needs, documenting requirements in a structured, unambiguous format, managing sign-off, and keeping them traceable through design, build, and testing.

  • Run the cross-functional team: Coordinate solution architects, engineers, QA, and client stakeholders toward a shared outcome, removing blockers, resolving conflicts, and making sure everyone knows what they own and by when.

  • Own the client relationship: Be the client's primary point of contact, leading status meetings, steering committee updates, and escalations, setting expectations early, and protecting the relationship even during hard conversations.

  • Manage scope, risk & change: Hold the line on scope creep, documenting and quantifying changes before work starts, and manage risks and issues proactively with a live view of mitigation plans and early escalation.

  • Stay technical, report & improve: Understand the architecture, integrations, and configuration decisions well enough to challenge estimates and speak credibly with engineers and technical buyers, produce honest, easy-to-read status reports and executive updates, and feed lessons learned back into delivery methodology.

What Success Looks Like

  • On-target delivery: Projects land on time, on budget, and within scope, with a clear plan stakeholders trust.

  • Trusted clients: Clients feel informed and in control throughout the engagement, and would take your call for the next one.

  • Managed risk: Risks surface early and get managed, so escalations are rare and never a surprise.

  • Aligned team & clean handoffs: The delivery team is aligned, unblocked, and clear on priorities, and handoffs to support and account teams are clean, with nothing left undocumented.

What You'll Need

  • Experience: 5+ years managing technical or software implementation projects, ideally in enterprise SaaS, professional services, or a client-facing delivery environment, with a track record of delivering complex, multi-stakeholder projects on time and within budget as the primary delivery owner for enterprise clients.

  • Technical fluency: You can read a solution design, understand integrations and data flows, and hold your own in a technical discussion without being the engineer.

  • Requirements & delivery craft: Proven ability to run requirements and discovery sessions and translate them into clear, documented business requirements, plus solid command of project management fundamentals (planning, estimation, dependency management, risk and issue tracking, and change control).

  • Stakeholder management: Excellent communication, comfort presenting to senior and executive audiences, and the ability to manage scope, timelines, and difficult conversations without losing the relationship.

  • Ways of working: Organized and calm under pressure, you over-communicate rather than under-communicate, you're direct when a project needs a hard truth and diplomatic when a relationship needs care, and you own outcomes rather than pointing to a process.

  • Preferred: An earlier technical role (engineering, solution architecture, or implementation consulting); experience delivering configurable enterprise platforms or workflow/automation software; fluency in both agile and traditional delivery and the judgment to know when to use which; experience in a regulated or risk-sensitive domain; PMP, PRINCE2, PSM, or equivalent certification; and exposure to AI-assisted or modern delivery tooling.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Compensation: Top of market salary + bonuses and equity

  • Time off: 49 days paid time off

  • Benefits: PTO, full benefits, retirement and wellness plans

  • Growth: Professional development support, remote workspace setup bonus

  • Team building: Annual company offsites in exciting locations around the world

Location

Certa is a remote-first company and we hire globally. We believe strongly in each team member working from the location that they choose. Should Certers wish to meet and work in person, they have 3 lively office locations they can travel to:

  • London

  • San Francisco

  • Jaipur

The perfect place for Certers to collaborate, co-work, and have face-to-face meetings.

Why Certa

  • Category leadership. Certa was named a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Third-Party Risk Management Tools - recognition that we're defining the category, not following it.

  • Industry recognition. We've been honored across the analyst and awards landscape, including Top Tech and Customer Value distinctions in The Hackett Group's 2026 Risk Management SolutionMap, the ProcureTech100 (Advanced AI and Risk Management categories), and Best Overall eProcurement Software in the FinTech Breakthrough Awards.

  • A top place to work. Certa was named one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers in the US. We're a fast-growing company where you'll wear many hats, ship quickly, and shape decisions that matter.

  • Real scale with strong backing. We've processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries. We're well-funded by leading investors including Fin Capital, Vertex Ventures, and Point72 Ventures, on the back of an oversubscribed Series B, headed towards Series C.

We're excited to meet you!

Für unser Vertriebsteam suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt Technische Vertriebsmitarbeitende (m/w/d) im Außendienst. Je nach Wohnort und Einsatzgebiet übernimmst du die Betreuung unserer Kunden und Projekte in Nord-/Ostdeutschland oder Süddeutschland. Dabei arbeitest du flexibel aus deiner Region heraus und bist zugleich eng mit unserem Team in Kürten vernetzt.

Das sind wir

Die Peter Berghaus GmbH ist ein seit über 60 Jahren international erfolgreich tätiges Unternehmen in der Verkehrstechnik und einer der führenden Hersteller von mobilen Ampeln und innovativen Produkten für Verkehrssicherheit. Die Firma Berghaus gehört zur AVS Gruppe, die komplette Dienstleistungen rund um Verkehrssicherheitsprojekte aus einer Hand bietet. Mit über 35 Standorten in Deutschland und weiteren internationalen Niederlassungen beschäftigt die Unternehmensgruppe mehr als 1.000 Mitarbeitende.

DAS BEKOMMST DU

  • Zusatzleistungen – Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, vermögenswirksame Leistungen, JobRad und Mitarbeiterrabatte bei namhaften Unternehmen.
  • Firmenwagen – Du erhältst einen Firmenwagen für deine Tätigkeit im Außendienst, den du auch privat nutzen darfst.
  • Weiterbildung – Individuelle Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Sicherheit – Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag in einer zukunftssicheren Branche und einem wachsenden Unternehmen.
  • Einarbeitung – Sorgfältige und persönliche Einarbeitung in unsere Produkte, Prozesse und Systeme.
  • Arbeitsplatz – Moderne Arbeitsplatzausstattung und Arbeitsgeräte.
  • Flache Hierarchien – Kurze Entscheidungswege und eine unternehmensweite Mitarbeiter-App.


WAS DU BEI UNS BEWEGST

  • Du betreust und entwickelst eigenverantwortlich bestehende Kundenbeziehungen, gewinnst aktiv Neukunden in deinem Vertriebsgebiet und baust unseren Kundenstamm gezielt aus.
  • Du planst, organisierst und führst Kundenbesuche durch und ermittelst technische Anforderungen sowie konkrete Einsatzbedingungen direkt vor Ort.
  • Du berätst unsere Kunden technisch und kaufmännisch zu mobilen Ampeln und weiteren Produkten für die Verkehrssicherheit, präsentierst unsere Lösungen beim Kunden und erarbeitest individuelle, praxisgerechte Lösungsvorschläge.
  • Du entwickelst neue Marktpotenziale in bestehenden und neuen Geschäftsfeldern, planst und realisierst regionale Vertriebs- und Wachstumskonzepte und erkennst neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Vertriebsinnendienst, Service und Produktion zusammen, um kundenorientierte Lösungen umzusetzen.
  • Du erstellst Angebote gemeinsam mit dem Vertriebsinnendienst und verfolgst sie nach. Preis- und Vertragsverhandlungen führst du im Rahmen abgestimmter Vorgaben.
  • Du begleitest Vertriebsprojekte von der Bedarfsermittlung bis zum Vertragsabschluss, koordinierst den Angebots- und Vertriebsprozess und sorgst für eine strukturierte Übergabe an die Auftragsabwicklung. Dazu dokumentierst du Kunden- und Projektinformationen und pflegst sie in unseren Systemen.
  • Du beobachtest Markt- und Kundenanforderungen, erkennst Trends und gibst Ideen für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Produkte und Prozesse.


WAS UNS ÜBERZEUGT

  • Abgeschlossene technische oder kaufmännische Ausbildung mit ausgeprägtem technischem Verständnis oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im technischen Vertrieb, idealerweise im Außendienst; Kenntnisse der Verkehrstechnik sind von Vorteil.
  • Fähigkeit, technische Anforderungen zu verstehen und in kundenorientierte Lösungen zu übersetzen.
  • Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung, Kommunikationsstärke und Verhandlungsgeschick auf allen Ebenen.
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise sowie ausgeprägtes Organisationsgeschick.
  • Erfahrung im Aufbau von Kundenbeziehungen und der Koordination komplexerer Vertriebsprojekte.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office und ERP-Systemen.
  • Teamfähigkeit und enge Zusammenarbeit mit technischen und kaufmännischen Ansprechpartnern.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.
  • Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen deutschlandweiten Dienstreisen sowie Führerschein Klasse B.


Klingt nach deinem nächsten Job?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil unseres Teams. Gemeinsam sorgen wir dafür, dass Verkehrstechnik zuverlässig funktioniert und Menschen sicher an ihr Ziel kommen.

title: Technology Account Partner - Banking - UK
descriptionHtml:
What we’re all about.

We find, when we come together in the pursuit of excellence, great things happen. And that’s how we do things at Quantexa – together. Our business is data, but our culture is collective. We’re about growth – but not just the bottom line. We create a culture where people feel empowered to do their best work. We might work across continents and time zones, but that doesn’t stop us from collaborating. We’re connected. We celebrate our successes together, and we unite to tackle the challenges. 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We speak over 20 languages across our 47 nationalities, creating a sense of belonging for all.

At Q, we’re looking for people who share that vision. People like you.

The opportunity.

What you’ll be doing.

  • Ensure operational adoption of the Quantexa platform within customer teams.

  • Own and manage key executive relationships, ensuring appropriate governance and driving renewal and expansion of customer engagements.

  • Support the growth and development of the Technology Account Partner team within Quantexa.

What you’ll bring.

Customer Focus

  • Dedicated to understanding customer needs, aligning with both broader business objectives and detailed challenges.

  • Communicate confidently with senior-level business and technology stakeholders, helping customers define strategic roadmaps to maximise the value of Quantexa products.

Technology Expertise

  • Platform implementation experience, understanding of customer challenges, and credibility backed by proven results.

Relationship Management

  • Significant experience building and nurturing executive-level relationships.

  • Customers see you as a trusted advisor and primary point of contact, confident in your commitment to their success.

Consultative Approach

  • Analytical mindset, able to evaluate challenges from multiple perspectives.

  • Collaborative, experienced in consulting roles, and skilled at working with both internal teams and customers to deliver value.

Scaling Teams

  • Experience working across functions to drive collaboration and best practices, and able to provide clear, actionable customer feedback to internal teams.

Teamwork

  • Team player internally across Quantexa and externally with customers, knowing that our collective success depends on strong collaboration.

Preferred Experience & Core Competencies.

  • Significant experience in a Client Partner role or comparable consulting, customer-facing, or enterprise sales position.

  • Enterprise software/services selling or implementation/delivery skills.

  • Experience implementing, running, or using data and technology platforms in the banking sector.

  • Experience defining and executing against a long-term vision and roadmap.

  • Demonstrated credible product and technology expertise in banking.

  • Ability to develop and manage relationships at the executive level.

  • Willingness and ability to travel as required.

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realise your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognised and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary & Company bonus

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

  • Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%)

  • Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover

  • Life Insurance and Income Protection

  • Regularly bench-marked salary rates

  • Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave

  • Well-being days

  • Volunteer Day off

  • Work from Home Equipment

  • Commuter, Tech and cycle to work schemes

  • Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app

  • Continuous Training and Development

  • Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy

  • Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

title: Technology Due Diligence Lead (M&A and SaaS Platforms)
descriptionHtml:
About Intelance

Intelance is an independent technology, AI and cyber assurance firm based in the UK. We help organisations check, govern and improve their technology through enterprise architecture, AI governance, cyber assurance and data governance work. We are building a small panel of senior associates to deliver technology and AI due diligence on company sales and investments.

The role

You will lead technology due diligence engagements for clients who are selling, buying or investing in software companies. Some reviews are paid for by the seller and run in two stages: a private readiness review so the company can fix issues first, then a report that buyers read in the data room. Our first engagements are with data and AI platforms in regulated sectors.

You lead the work day to day. An Intelance engagement partner owns the client relationship and signs off the report, and you work alongside our AI assurance, cloud security, data protection and GxP specialists.

What you will do

  • Review the architecture, code, cloud set up and data pipelines of modern data platforms, such as those built on Google Cloud, BigQuery, dbt, Airflow and Looker.

  • Run code and open source licence scans, and turn the results into clear findings.

  • Interview founders and technical leads, request evidence and review it.

  • Keep the evidence log, so every statement in the report is backed by a document or by two people.

  • Rate each finding by how it could affect the deal, and write a fix list the seller can act on.

  • Bring the specialist findings together and write both reports to a standard a buyer's advisers will trust.

What you will bring

  • At least five years in technology due diligence, technical advisory or senior engineering leadership.

  • At least three due diligence reports written as the main author. Experience of a vendor report shared with buyers is a strong plus.

  • Hands on knowledge of modern data platforms and SaaS architecture. Google Cloud, BigQuery and dbt are a strong plus.

  • Sound judgement on code quality, technical debt, scalability, secure development and open source licence risk.

  • Clear, plain writing. Your reports are read by founders, buyers and lawyers.

  • A calm, respectful manner with founders who are close to their product.

  • Experience with health, clinical or other regulated data is a strong plus.

How the work is set up

  • Remote within the UK, with occasional meetings in London.

  • Around 2 to 3 days a week from late November 2026 to the end of January 2027, with further engagements as the practice grows.

  • Freelance, or through your own limited company, at £650 to £800 a day depending on experience. Reasonable travel costs for client meetings are covered.

  • A panel agreement, NDA and statement of work are signed before any client details are shared.

  • You work from an Intelance mailbox and use our evidence log and report templates, so every report meets the same standard.

How to apply

Send your CV and answer the short screening questions. They take about two minutes. We aim to reply to every shortlisted candidate within five working days.

title: VA Virtuelle Assistenz für den Antragsservice (m/w/d) | 100 % Remote | 2-4 Std. täglich
descriptionHtml:
Du kannst gut organisieren, kommunizierst gerne mit Kunden und bleibst dran, bis offene Fragen geklärt sind? Du behältst auch bei mehreren laufenden Vorgängen den Überblick und bringst Struktur in komplexe Abläufe? Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen!

Für unser Weiterbildungsprojekt suchen wir Unterstützung auf selbstständiger Freelancer-Basis – vollständig remote.

🎓 Das Projekt: Unternehmen bei der Mitarbeiterweiterbildung unterstützen

Wir begleiten Unternehmen bei der Beantragung von Förderungen für die Weiterbildung ihrer Mitarbeitenden bei der Agentur für Arbeit.

Unser Antragsservice unterstützt die Unternehmen dabei, den organisatorischen Ablauf zu bewältigen, erforderliche Unterlagen zusammenzustellen und die nächsten Schritte im Blick zu behalten. Dafür braucht es eine verlässliche Kundenbetreuung und eine gut koordinierte Zusammenarbeit zwischen allen Beteiligten.

Deine Rolle: Antragsbegleitung & Kundenkoordination

Nach der Übergabe durch unser Sales-Team übernimmst du die Betreuung der Unternehmen. Du koordinierst das Onboarding, begleitest die Antragstellung und hältst offene Unterlagen, Rückmeldungen und nächste Schritte nach.

Dabei bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson für organisatorische Fragen und die Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, unserem Team, dem Bildungsinstitut und den Dozenten. Du sorgst dafür, dass Informationen zusammenlaufen, Zuständigkeiten klar sind und Vorgänge strukturiert weiterbearbeitet werden.

Aufgaben

🤝 Kundenmanagement & Antragsbegleitung

  • Du übernimmst neue Unternehmenskunden nach der Übergabe durch Sales und stellst den ersten Kontakt her.

  • Du führst das Kunden-Onboarding durch und erläuterst den organisatorischen Ablauf sowie die nächsten Schritte.

  • Du begleitest die Unternehmen bei der Antragstellung zur Förderung ihrer Mitarbeiterweiterbildung bei der Agentur für Arbeit.

  • Du unterstützt dabei, die für den jeweiligen Antrag benötigten Informationen und Unterlagen zusammenzutragen.

  • Du hältst ausstehende Dokumente und Rückmeldungen nach und betreust offene Kundenfälle durch regelmäßige Follow-ups.

  • Du hältst die Kunden über den aktuellen Stand und anstehende Aufgaben auf dem Laufenden.

⚙️ Operative Projektkoordination

  • Du stimmst dich mit dem Bildungsinstitut, den Dozenten und weiteren Ansprechpartnern ab.

  • Du koordinierst laufende Abläufe und klärst offene organisatorische Fragen.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass relevante Informationen rechtzeitig bei den zuständigen Personen ankommen.

  • Du erkennst frühzeitig, wenn Vorgänge ins Stocken geraten, und stößt die notwendigen nächsten Schritte an.

  • Du stellst eine klare und nachvollziehbare Kommunikation zwischen allen Beteiligten sicher.

📋 CRM & Prozessmanagement

  • Du pflegst die Kundenpipeline und hältst alle relevanten Angaben im CRM aktuell.

  • Du dokumentierst Kundenstatus, Gesprächsergebnisse, offene Aufgaben und nächste Schritte.

  • Du hältst Zuständigkeiten, Termine und Wiedervorlagen nachvollziehbar fest.

  • Du priorisierst laufende Vorgänge und behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Kundenfällen den Überblick.

  • Du erkennst wiederkehrende Hindernisse und bringst konkrete Vorschläge zur Verbesserung der Abläufe ein.

Qualifikation

🎯 Verantwortung übernehmen

Du verschickst nicht nur eine Anfrage und hakst die Aufgabe ab. Du behältst im Blick, ob eine Rückmeldung eingeht und wie es anschließend weitergeht. Fehlen Informationen oder ist eine Zuständigkeit unklar, gehst du dem Thema nach.

🗂️ Eigenständig organisieren

Du strukturierst deine Aufgaben selbstständig, setzt sinnvolle Prioritäten und betreust mehrere Vorgänge parallel. Wenn sich Verzögerungen oder Probleme abzeichnen, kommunizierst du sie frühzeitig.

💬 Verständlich und verbindlich kommunizieren

Du kannst mehrstufige Abläufe verständlich erklären und gehst auf unterschiedliche Ansprechpartner professionell ein. Du bleibst freundlich und serviceorientiert – auch wenn du mehrfach nachfassen musst.

📝 Sorgfältig dokumentieren

Du arbeitest genau und hältst Informationen so fest, dass der aktuelle Stand eines Vorgangs jederzeit nachvollziehbar ist. Mit Kundeninformationen und Unterlagen gehst du verantwortungsbewusst um.

💡 Mitdenken und Lösungen finden

Du arbeitest dich gerne in neue Themen ein, erkennst offene Punkte und bringst Lösungsvorschläge mit. Dein Ziel ist nicht nur, Aufgaben zu erledigen, sondern Abläufe zuverlässig voranzubringen.

Must-haves

  • Erfahrung in Kundenbetreuung, Sachbearbeitung oder Projektkoordination: Du hast bereits Kunden betreut, administrative Vorgänge bearbeitet oder mehrere Beteiligte miteinander koordiniert.

  • Organisationstalent: Du kannst mehrere Kundenfälle parallel strukturieren, priorisieren und konsequent nachverfolgen.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du kommunizierst telefonisch und schriftlich freundlich, klar und verbindlich.

  • Digitale Arbeitsweise: Du gehst sicher mit gängigen Office-Anwendungen um und findest dich schnell in CRM-Systemen und digitalen Tools zurecht.

  • Sorgfalt und Zuverlässigkeit: Du dokumentierst nachvollziehbar, behältst Termine im Blick und hältst Vereinbarungen ein.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse: Du kannst auch erklärungsbedürftige Sachverhalte mündlich und schriftlich sicher vermitteln.

  • Selbstständige Arbeitsweise: Du organisierst deine Tätigkeit eigenverantwortlich und bringst die Voraussetzungen für eine Zusammenarbeit auf Freelancer-Basis mit.

Das ist zusätzlich hilfreich

  • Erfahrung mit Förderanträgen, Antragsservices oder administrativen Abläufen im Weiterbildungsbereich.

  • Berührungspunkte mit der Agentur für Arbeit oder anderen Förderstellen.

  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Bildungsträgern und Unternehmenskunden.

  • Routine im Umgang mit dokumentenintensiven und mehrstufigen Prozessen.

Was dich in der Zusammenarbeit erwartet

🌍 100% remote

Du unterstützt das Projekt vollständig remote. Kommunikation, Dokumentation und Abstimmung erfolgen digital.

Zusammenarbeit auf Freelancer-Basis

Du bringst deine Erfahrung im Rahmen einer selbstständigen Zusammenarbeit in das Projekt ein.

Verantwortung für eigene Kundenfälle

Du begleitest Unternehmen nach der Sales-Übergabe durch das Onboarding und die weiteren organisatorischen Schritte der Antragstellung.

Eine vielseitige Schnittstellenrolle

Du verbindest Kundenkontakt, Antragsbegleitung und Projektkoordination und arbeitest mit unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartnern zusammen.

Raum für deine Erfahrung

Du kannst Vorschläge einbringen, um Abläufe übersichtlicher, die Kommunikation klarer und die Bearbeitung von Kundenfällen effizienter zu gestalten.

🚀 Bereit, Unternehmen auf dem Weg zur Weiterbildung zu begleiten?

Du arbeitest strukturiert, kommunizierst verbindlich und hast Freude daran, offene Vorgänge voranzubringen? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf oder dein Freelancer-Profil und einen kurzen Einblick in deine bisherigen Erfahrungen in der Kundenbetreuung, Antragsbegleitung oder Projektkoordination.

title: Validation Engineering Manager
descriptionHtml:
For over four decades, Cirrus Logic has been propelled by the top engineers in mixed-signal processing. Our rockstar team thrives on solving complex challenges with innovative end-user solutions for the world's top consumer brands. Cirrus Logic is also known for its award-winning culture, built on a foundation of inclusion and fairness, meaningful community engagement, and delivering enjoyable employee experiences at every turn. But we couldn’t do it without our extraordinary workforce – and that’s where you come in. Join our team and help us continue to make Cirrus Logic an exceptional place to grow your career!
As a Product Validation Manager, you will lead, develop, and mentor a dedicated team of engineers working on automation and flows for chip validation and characterization, spanning both product development and emerging advanced technology. In this role you will collaborate across product development teams and help shape the direction of the organization.
Responsibilities:
  • Provide leadership for a team that develops hardware, software and automation for chip validation correlation and characterization.
  • Drive decisions on test strategies with collaboration between cross functional teams, including Applications and Advanced Technology.
  • Own execution of test plans ensuring complete coverage and traceability of feature/system requirements.
  • Participate in developing methodologies for chip test and validation from requirements through tape-out.
  • Contribute towards the continuous development of Tools, Technology and Flows.
  • Foster a culture of continuous engineering improvement through mentorship, feedback, and metrics.
  • Develop training and documentation, supporting your team and product development.
  • Work with peers to implement best practices and continuous improvements to Cirrus Logic characterization and validation methodologies.
  • Collaborate closely with IC Design engineers, Systems engineers, and Application Engineers to collaborate in test and validation methodologies.

    • Required Skills and Qualifications
  • Bachelor's/master's degree in electrical engineering with proven experience in silicon test and characterization projects.
  • Experience leading engineers or technical projects, whether as a people manager or a technical lead.
  • Strong debug skills, aptitude to learn and resolve complex issues.
  • Excellent interpersonal and analytical skills with the ability to lead, mentor, and hire.
  • Able to handle engineering tasks, on an as needed basis, combining experience in Characterization, Failure Analysis, Test Development, Statistical analysis and Customer Support.
  • Mixed Signal background with experience in audio and power analysis.
  • Ability to organize assignments and schedule time to complete work you're doing within established timelines.
  • Creative & lateral thinker.

    • Preferred Skills and Qualifications
  • Mixed-Signal Design & Development experience.
  • Experience validating advanced technology, test chips or early-stage IP ahead of product development.
  • Strong background in circuit design, including analog signal chains, power electronics, and audio signal processing, alongside experience in custom test platform development.

title: Vehicle Safety Operator
descriptionHtml:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Vehicle Operations Teams

 

Our world-class, diverse Vehicle Operations team is dedicated to testing and advancing our autonomous driving technology across Germany. As a Vehicle Safety Operator, you will be at the heart of our real-world AI development, running on-road experiments, providing actionable feedback, and upholding the highest safety standards in collaboration with our research and development teams.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

 

  • Conduct on-road experiments and testing with our vehicles throughout Germany, ensuring all activities are safe and efficient.

  • Monitor artificial intelligence systems while driving, actively responding to any hazards to guarantee safe operation.

  • Evaluate vehicle and AI performance during tests, providing structured, expert feedback to engineering and research teams.

  • Support safety and engineering processes by identifying and reporting safety and vehicle maintenance issues.

  • Deliver real-world driving input to help train and refine our AI before public road testing.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

 

  • Testing and evaluating autonomous vehicle technology in actual road scenarios.

  • Reporting system feedback and real-world driving insights to help improve our AI’s performance.

  • Maintaining safety standards, supporting incident reporting, and collaborating on issue resolution with engineering and safety teams.

  • Travelling nationally and internationally as required for tests and demonstrations.

 

🙌 You should apply if

 

  • Hold a full, clean German driving licence.

  • Have at least 5 years' driving experience, primarily in Germany, with no blameworthy insurance claims in the past three years.

  • Fluent in English and German.

  • Strong communicator who shows empathy and teamwork.

  • Comfortable working independently and as part of a team.

  • Adaptable, flexible, and motivated to solve problems with innovative solutions.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite or equivalent (Google Suite).

  • Familiar with basic navigation, touchscreen gestures, typing, text editing, managing device settings, using basic apps, and troubleshooting.

  • Able to work scheduled shifts (Monday to Sunday, 40 hours per week, with a rota issued 4 weeks in advance; shifts include 06:30-15:00 and 14:30-23:00, weekend work required).

  • Will disclose any secondary employment as part of the application process.

  • Willing to complete a health check (before/after offer) and disclose any conditions affecting safe operation.

  • Able to pass pre-employment and ongoing drug and alcohol testing (including testing during onsite interview).

 

Desirable:

  • Experience in vehicle testing, AV environments, or technical demonstrations.

  • Knowledge of AV technology or autonomous systems.

  • Customer-facing or hospitality experience.

  • T1 and T2 Bertha certification.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

Important details about the role:

  • This is a 1-year Fixed Term Contract (FTC), based onsite at our office in Leonberg.

  • National and international travel is required.

  • Please consider your commute: if your one-way journey is over 1.5 hours, it may not be practical for this role.

  • On-site parking is currently available but cannot be guaranteed as the team grows.

 

More about Wayve:

 

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

 

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

 

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

 

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

 

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Driving Licence Check

  • Drug & Alcohol TestandDriving Assessment

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment

 

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

title: Venture Development Manager (AI Transformation)
descriptionHtml:
Digitale Transformation mit KI

Excelling Ventures ist eine Investmentgesellschaft und baut durch innovative Technologien angetriebene Consumer Brands auf. Als Venture Development Manager (AI Transformation) gestaltest du die KI-Strategie und -Implementierung in unserem Portfolio aktiv mit. Wir suchen eine Person, die selbst baut: in jedes Portfoliounternehmen geht, erkennt, wo AI Agents echten Hebel schaffen, und sie eigenständig und schnell in den Produktivbetrieb bringt.

Dein Erfolg misst sich an ausgerollten Agents, eingesparten Stunden und echter Nutzung in den Teams – nicht an Strategiepräsentationen.

Aufgaben (Responsibilities)

Analysieren und priorisieren

  • Führe AI-Audits in jedem Portfoliounternehmen durch: Workflows, Datenquellen und Tool-Landschaft erfassen und die Automatisierungschancen mit dem höchsten ROI identifizieren.

  • Baue pro Unternehmen ein priorisiertes Use-Case-Backlog auf (Impact × Aufwand) und stimme es mit dem jeweiligen CEO ab.

AI Agents bauen und ausrollen

  • Konzipiere, entwickle und implementiere AI Agents eigenständig und end-to-end über alle Funktionen hinweg: Kundenservice, Performance Marketing, Content- und Creator-Operations, E-Commerce und Order-Operations, Finance und Reporting sowie internes Wissensmanagement.

  • Binde die Agents an die Systeme der Unternehmen an (z. B. Shopify, CRM, Helpdesk, Werbeplattformen, ERP, Google Workspace, Slack, Airtable) – über APIs, MCP-Server und Workflow-Tools.

  • Bring Lösungen in Wochen statt Quartalen vom Prototyp in den Produktivbetrieb – inklusive Evaluation, Guardrails, Human-in-the-Loop, Monitoring und Kostenkontrolle.

AI Adoption vorantreiben

  • Schule Teams praxisnah, etabliere interne Champions und mache AI-Tools zum festen Bestandteil des Arbeitsalltags statt zum Nebenprojekt.

  • Miss Nutzung und Wirkung pro Unternehmen (Nutzungsrate, eingesparte Stunden, Kosten pro Ticket, Durchlaufzeit) und berichte monatlich an den Founder und die Portfolio-CEOs.

Über das Portfolio skalieren

  • Übertrage, was in einem Unternehmen funktioniert, in wiederverwendbare Playbooks, Templates und Agent-Bausteine für das nächste.

  • Etabliere eine schlanke AI-Governance-Basis: Datenschutz (DSGVO / Schweizer DSG), Zugriffsrechte, Anbieterauswahl und Modellwahl.

  • Verfolge die schnelllebige AI-Landschaft und entscheide pragmatisch, was übernommen, was selbst gebaut und was ignoriert wird.

Anforderungen (Requirements)

Must-have

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung mit AI Agents oder LLM-Workflows, die du in den Produktivbetrieb gebracht hast und die tatsächlich genutzt werden – zeig sie uns (Repo, Demo, Case Study).

  • Starke Hands-on-Skills: Python oder TypeScript, REST-APIs und Webhooks, LLM-APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI o. ä.), Tool Use / Function Calling, RAG sowie Agent-Frameworks oder MCP.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit No-Code-/Low-Code-Automatisierung (n8n, Make, Zapier o. ä.) und das Urteilsvermögen, wann Code die bessere Wahl ist.

  • Unternehmerisches Verständnis: Du verstehst P&L, Unit Economics und operative Abläufe und priorisierst nach ROI, nicht nach technischer Neuheit.

  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung und Selbstständigkeit: Du arbeitest ohne fertige Spezifikation, schneidest Probleme selbst zu und lieferst.

  • Du kannst nicht-technische Teams schulen und für neue Tools gewinnen – Adoption ist die halbe Arbeit.

  • Fließend Deutsch und Englisch; Italienisch ist ein Plus.

Nice-to-have

  • Erfahrung in D2C / E-Commerce, Performance Marketing, Creator- oder Influencer-Commerce

  • Hintergrund in einem Startup, Scale-up oder einem Portfolio-Operations- bzw. Value-Creation-Team von PE / VC.

  • Erfahrung mit Evaluation-Frameworks, LLM-Observability und Kostenoptimierung.

Was wir bieten

  • Direkter Draht zum Founder und zu den Portfolio-CEOs: kurze Entscheidungswege, keine Konzernstrukturen.

  • Echte Wirkung in mehreren Unternehmen gleichzeitig – mit der Freiheit, Tools und Vorgehen selbst zu wählen.

  • Budget für AI-Tools, APIs und Infrastruktur.

  • Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung mit einer leistungsabhängigen Komponente, gekoppelt an messbare Ergebnisse.

Bewerbung

Schick uns eine kurze Nachricht, warum die Rolle zu dir passt, deinen Lebenslauf und ein bis zwei Beispiele für AI Agents, die du gebaut hast

title: Workforce Planning and MI Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Motorway

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

The role

As our Workforce Planning and MI Manager, you will lead the team that makes sure every part of our customer contact operations has the right people and the right data at the right time, with AI built into how we plan and report. You will report to the Head of Workforce Planning and lead Workforce Planning, MI and Real Time Analysts across multiple sites.

You will own the whole planning cycle, from long term capacity planning to hitting our service and performance targets on the day. That covers every channel (voice, live chat, email, tickets, WhatsApp, inbound and outbound) and both seller and dealer contact.

Our scope is growing, and AI and automation are changing how much work lands with people. A big part of your job is sizing those changes, modelling what they mean for capacity and driving productivity across the teams we support. You will also own the MI and reporting that operational leaders run their business on, and make sure the numbers can be trusted.


This is a full ownership role. You will be accountable for how Workforce Planning and MI performs, with the autonomy to make the calls. If you want that, you will like this.

What You'll Do (Key Responsibilities)

  • Own forecasting, rolling capacity models, scheduling and real time across all departments, with scenarios that show leaders what each decision means for headcount and coverage

  • Own escalations on the day, make sure every queue and channel is covered, and get stuck in when service is at risk

  • Build a holistic view of demand across AI handled and human handled work, so we plan for the whole workload and not just what reaches an agent

  • Size initiatives, such as automation replacing manual work or AI taking on demand, and model their impact on capacity before launch, then track what really happened

  • Set the AI direction for the whole Workforce Planning and MI team and make sure every function is building with it, with something new live every month, often more, and the time saved clearly measured

  • Drive productivity by building pace and performance reporting that shows teams how they're tracking against target through the day, and following through with leaders on the gaps

  • Build new capacity models from the ground up for departments that are new or changing, agreeing volumes, handling times and assumptions with leaders

  • Own the MI and reporting that operational leaders run their business on, and make sure the numbers can be trusted

  • Give Workforce Planning, MI and Real Time Analysts clear priorities and direction, and show the return on investment of their work

  • Lead, coach and hold to account planners and analysts across Brighton and Durban, and make sure the team's work is visible across the business

  • Partner with department leaders, Finance, Data, Product and Biz Ops, and with our outsource partners, to turn data into decisions and actions

What You'll Bring (Required Skills and Experience)

  • A track record of taking full ownership of a function or team, and being accountable for its results

  • Experience leading workforce planning teams, ideally across more than one site, with MI experience alongside

  • Experience driving AI and automation adoption across a team, with examples of what shipped and what it saved

  • Experience building capacity models from scratch, including sizing the impact of initiatives on capacity and FTE

  • Strong end to end workforce planning knowledge, with hands on real time experience: forecasting, capacity, scheduling and intraday

  • Hands on knowledge of WFM and contact centre tools (Calabrio, Genesys, NICE or similar) and AI tools, and how to get more out of them

  • Understanding of how AI and automation change demand and workload, and how to plan for AI handled and human handled work together

  • A record of improving productivity (utilisation, occupancy, handling time, pace to target), with examples you can talk through

  • Confident turning large data sets into clear recommendations (Google Sheets, BI tools, Claude or similar)

  • Experience owning reporting and KPIs that senior leaders rely on, with a focus on data quality

  • Experience managing and developing analysts and specialists, not just doing the analysis yourself

  • A clear communicator who can explain complex data to non technical leaders and influence without authority

You could be a great fit if

  • You take full ownership and run at problems, rather than waiting to be asked

  • You turn data into a decision, not just a report

  • You'd rather automate it than do it twice, and your first instinct is to ask what AI can do

  • You ask "what does this do to capacity?" before anyone else does

  • You spot problems early and own them through to fixed

  • You treat every department as a customer, and ask what each one needs

  • You're a proactive "arrows out" communicator, owning updates about wins and challenges

  • You're happy to challenge respectfully, and to be challenged back

Why join us

  • Real ownership of a function, with a lot of room to shape how it works and where it goes.

  • Claude connected to our BI data lake, so you and your team can build with live data from day one.

  • We ship things. Good ideas for automation get picked up and live quickly, and the time saved is measured.

  • Work that leaders use every day to run the business, and a direct say in decisions on capacity and coverage.

Benefits

We've got your back, in life's biggest moments and the everyday ones too.

  • Competitive salary

  • Equity scheme - we all share in Motorway’s success

  • 33 days holiday including public holidays

  • Sea-front office with bi-weekly massages and free snacks

  • Private medical insurance via BUPA

  • Life assurance

  • Pension scheme (we contribute 5%)

  • Enhanced family leave (e.g. 26 weeks full pay for maternity or adoption)

  • 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme

  • EV leasing scheme

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Nursery salary sacrifice scheme

  • 1 paid volunteering day a year

As a fast-moving Dutch scale-up, backed by a $36M Series A and an official WhatsApp Business Solutions Provider, we thrive on acceleration. Your expertise will drive growth: you’ll make a strategic impact, champion AI innovation, and help shape the product roadmap. You’ll do this alongside an international team guided by our Dynamic pace, Future-proof mindset, Ownership, and Open culture.

What your role looks like:

Turn inbound interest into opportunities

  • Be the first personal point of contact for new inbound leads, reaching out through calls and personalised emails, ideally within the same working day.

  • Follow up with qualified free-trial sign-ups, demo requests and prospects who have expressed interest but haven't booked a meeting.

  • Re-engage prospects whose meetings weren't booked, were cancelled or resulted in a no-show, and help them take the next step.

  • Connect qualified prospects with the right Account Executive, making sure they have the context needed for a productive conversation.

Help prospects become self-serve customers

  • Reach out to prospects who might not be the right fit for a sales conversation but could still benefit from Trengo.

  • Understand what they're looking for, answer initial questions and guide them towards the right self-serve plan.

  • Follow up with free-trial users to help them get started and encourage them to take the next step towards becoming customers.

Improve how we engage with leads

  • Experiment with different outreach messages, sequences and follow-up approaches to understand what converts best.

  • Share insights with Marketing and Sales about common objections, lead quality and what prospects are looking for.

  • Keep HubSpot accurate and up to date by logging interactions, tracking outcomes and maintaining clean lead data.

How we'll measure success

You'll have a direct impact on our growth, with clear results you can track:

  • Speed of follow-up: Making sure inbound prospects receive timely, personal attention.

  • Meetings generated: Booking qualified meetings that turn into conversations with our Account Executives.

  • Self-serve conversions: Helping prospects progress from initial interest to becoming paying customers.

  • Continuous improvement: Finding better ways to engage prospects and sharing insights that help our Marketing and Sales teams improve.

The tools you'll work with

You'll get hands-on experience with our commercial and AI toolkit:

  • HubSpot: CRM, lead management, outreach sequences and calling.

  • RevenueHero: Lead routing and meeting booking.

  • Fathom: Call recordings, feedback and coaching.

  • Slack & Notion: Team collaboration, processes and playbooks.

  • AI tools: Researching prospects, personalising outreach and experimenting with smarter ways of working.

What you’ll bring

  • 1-2 years of experience, ideally through an internship or an early-career role in sales, marketing, customer success or a customer-facing environment.

  • Fluent English, both written and spoken. Dutch is a big plus.

  • Confidence in communication: You're comfortable picking up the phone, writing personalised emails and starting conversations with people you haven't met.

  • A proactive mindset: You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do next. You spot opportunities and take initiative.

  • An organised way of working: You can manage multiple conversations, prioritise your day and follow through on commitments.

  • Curiosity and willingness to learn: You're interested in SaaS, AI and how businesses grow, and you're open to coaching and feedback.

  • A results-driven attitude: You enjoy working towards clear goals, experimenting with different approaches and understanding what works.

Nice to have

  • Experience working with HubSpot or other CRM tools.

  • Exposure to inbound lead follow-up, prospecting or sales processes.

  • Additional language skills such as Dutch, German, French, Spanish or Italian.

  • Familiarity with eCommerce, WhatsApp Business or customer communication platforms.

  • Experience using AI tools to research prospects, personalise communication or improve workflows.

⚙️ Our tech & AI mindset

AI is not a buzzword at Trengo — it’s part of how we build and operate. You’ll work with AI-driven features, automation, data, or tools that help us move faster and smarter. We value thoughtful use of AI that creates real value for customers and teams.

What’s in it for you?

This is what we carefully prepared for you:

  • 🚀 A key role where you’ll make a visible impact in a vibrant scale-up environment.

  • 🌍 Hybrid working + 2 months per year to work abroad.

  • 🏗️ A strong onboarding program with hands-on training and a dedicated buddy to set you up for success.

  • 🧘 Mental health support with free sessions from on-demand psychologists (OpenUp).

  • 📚 Learning budget + 2 extra days off to attend courses or conferences.

  • 🌴 28 vacation days to rest, recharge, and travel

  • 🚆 Travel reimbursement to our Utrecht HQ.

  • 📶 Monthly internet & phone allowance to stay connected.

  • 🗣️ Dutch courses for our international colleagues.

  • 🍴 Daily warm lunches prepared by our workplace experience team when you’re at our beautiful Utrecht office.

  • 💼 Pension contribution to help you plan for the future.

  • 🛫 Sabbatical: After two years, enjoy up to three months away (unpaid) to rest, recharge, or see the world.

🔍 Our hiring process

  1. Introductory call – First conversation with our Talent team.

  2. Manager interview – Deep dive into experience and expectations.

  3. Practical assignment – Role-related, real-world challenge.

  4. Team connection – Meet future colleagues and confirm mutual fit.

We aim to keep the process clear, fair, and timely, and we’ll keep you informed at every step.

Your next challenge starts here!

Join us in building the future of customer engagement — we’d love to have you on the team.

👉 Apply today and let’s grow together!

title: Working Student / Thesis - Strategy Operations & Business Development (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About TACTILIA

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the team, culture and processes that make that possible.

You will join at the moment when a strong product turns into a real business: how do we build the strategy, the partner and customer pipeline, and the operating rhythm that let us scale as fast as the technology allows?

The Role

As a Working Student or thesis student in Strategy Operations & Business Development, you will work directly with our Business Development lead and on the questions that decide how TACTILIA grows: which markets we go after, how we price and cost what we build, who our first partners and customers are, and how we prove our progress to the board.

Some days you're sizing a market or building a competitor teardown. Other days you're pulling together the numbers for a board update or helping shape a pricing model. Both matter equally here.

What You Will Do

– Support business strategy and market sizing. Help translate our target markets and product priorities into clear numbers – market size, growth, and where the real opportunity sits.

– Track the competitive landscape. Keep tabs on competitors, adjacent players, and relevant funding and product news, and turn it into insights the leadership team can actually use.

– Help build our partner and customer pipeline. Research and qualify potential integrators, partners, and anchor customers, and prepare the materials that support outreach and first conversations.

– Get our office and internal structures off the ground. Help plan and implement our office set-up and the practical structures a growing team needs on the ground – this is a hands-on part of the role, not just an analytical one.

– Help build our internal reporting and steering tools. Contribute to the dashboards and processes that give the leadership team a real-time view of the business.

What You Bring

– Currently studying business administration, industrial engineering, economics, or a related field (Bachelor's or Master's)

– A structured, analytical way of working and genuine comfort with numbers and data

– Real interest in robotics, deep tech, or Physical AI

– Confident with Excel and PowerPoint, and quick to pick up new tools

– Fluent English; German is a plus

– Available for at least four to six months, whether as a working student or for a thesis project

The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.

At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability, and robustness they need to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.

The technology is taking shape. The team is being built. And the standards for robotic hands and their skills are still wide open.

That means your decisions will have a lasting impact – not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.

Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next.

If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that work reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.
